Он запрещён как input для PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY/PUBLISH/BOOKING/PAYMENT/PAYOUT/START; scoped restriction живёт только в RestrictionDecision/EligibilityView по action/resource/market, а account security closure — в отдельном AccountAccess aggregate. Legacy APPROVED/REJECTED никогда не map-ится в OPEN/CLOSED как proof. `OPEN` достаточен только для owner-scoped private commands, включая private profile и drafts, subject to общей account access/content/age policy; identity, guide certificate, trader/tax data и market coverage не являются prerequisites открытия workspace.

`ARCHIVED` означает только осознанно убранный из активной навигации professional workspace. До команды UI получает versioned impact preview. Активные public surfaces/new-sales admission сначала уменьшаются только отдельными явно подтверждёнными `HIDE_PUBLIC_PROFILE | UNPUBLISH_EXCURSION | PAUSE_EXCURSION_SALES` commands и authoritative receipts; archive не подменяет эти effects и не отменяет existing bookings. Service center, participant messaging, refund/complaint/appeal/privacy и payout rights остаются доступны даже при ARCHIVED/CLOSED. Reopen возвращает workspace и drafts, но не публикует профиль/экскурсии и не открывает sales без новых exact authorizations.

`GuideOnboardingReadinessView` — derived, non-authoritative projection: workspace state, private profile completeness, first-draft state, contextual tasks, какие identity/trader/credential steps нужны сейчас или позже, current `EligibilityView` exact next action и один next-best-action. Она не содержит `APPROVED/REJECTED` и не используется как permission. Неудачная identity/merchant/credential проверка изменяет только затронутую EligibilityView/case; workspace и unrelated tourist/guide flows сохраняются.

`GuideOnboardingContinuation` принадлежит auth/user owner и хранит opaque ID, closed intent kind, destination-plan version, allowlisted opaque target ref, locale/entry point, created/expires/consumed/cancelled timestamps, session/audience binding, post-auth subject binding, nonce/replay tombstone и minimal audit metadata. Он signed, short-lived, one-use, не содержит arbitrary URL, PII, документов или legal answers и не является action authority. Closed root lifecycle: `ISSUED → SUBJECT_BOUND | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; `SUBJECT_BOUND → CONSUMED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`. Все terminal states immutable. Cancel/expire из `ISSUED`, bind/cancel/expire race и consume/cancel/expire race сериализуются CAS; intent становится `CONSUMED` только после exact authoritative owner receipt.

`PostAuthDestinationRegistryGeneration` — единственный closed mapping `intent_kind → ordered destination plan → authoritative resource owner/API/outcome lookup`. Для `OPEN_GUIDE_WORKSPACE` effect владеет guide-service; для `CREATE_EXCURSION_DRAFT` explicit workspace confirmation/lookup выполняется guide-service, а private draft создаёт excursion-service; для `ACCEPT_ORGANIZATION_INVITE` membership effect создаёт organization-service и сам по себе не открывает personal workspace или public guide profile. Если роль приглашения предполагает личную работу гидом, после membership preview пользователь отдельно подтверждает successor intent `OPEN_GUIDE_WORKSPACE`. Auth-service координирует, но никогда не пишет guide/excursion/organization store.

Каждый consume создаёт append-only `GuideOnboardingDestinationAttempt` с lifecycle `PREPARED → OWNER_COMMITTING → COMMITTED | NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`; `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → COMMITTED | NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE`. Owner-local commit использует deterministic idempotency key из continuation+plan-step и атомарно сохраняет effect, outcome receipt и outbox. Только `COMMITTED` полного ordered plan переводит root в `CONSUMED`; `NO_EFFECT_RETRYABLE` оставляет `SUBJECT_BOUND`, пока TTL позволяет повтор, cancel или expiry. После `OWNER_COMMITTING` cancel/expiry не может ложно объявить no-effect: UI может сохранить abandon request, но terminal root фиксируется лишь после authoritative outcome lookup. Account switch требует linked re-confirmed successor; ACK loss, retry или failover не создают второй workspace, draft или membership.

Cross-context delivery замкнута отдельными registry edges `ARTIFACT-EDGE-POST-AUTH-GUIDE-WORKSPACE-01`, `ARTIFACT-EDGE-POST-AUTH-EXCURSION-DRAFT-01` и `ARTIFACT-EDGE-POST-AUTH-ORGANIZATION-INVITE-01`. Каждый edge pin-ит auth producer contract, exact destination-plan version, owner command/outcome schemas, binding guards, timeout, retry/reconciliation, signed receipt и evidence; он не является §5.1 authorization dependency и не разрешает public action.

Отдельный user/auth aggregate `AccountAccessEffect` используется только для самостоятельного account-security/legal основания, а не для результата guide onboarding/verification. Lifecycle: `PROPOSED → ACTIVE | REJECTED`; `ACTIVE → REVOKED | EXPIRED`; terminal generation immutable, новое основание создаёт successor. `AccountAccessNotice` имеет `PENDING → PUBLISHED | WITHHELD_BY_CURRENT_AUTHORITY` с retry/review, а `AccountAccessAppeal` — `OPEN → UNDER_REVIEW ↔ NEEDS_INFO → UPHELD | OVERTURNED | WITHDRAWN`; `OVERTURNED` требует linked revoke/restoration receipts и не переписывает историю. Exact apply/revoke/expire, notice, appeal и restoration commands принадлежат user/auth-service. Ни workspace, ни identity/credential case, ни guide restriction не могут создать `AccountAccessEffect` напрямую.

`api:user.ApplyAccountAccessEffect.v1` не является generic mutation: closed `transition_command = PROPOSE | ACTIVATE | REJECT` физически ограничивает три owner-authorized edge и требует distinct authority/expected-version/idempotency receipts. `api:user.PublishAccountAccessNotice.v1` принимает только `PUBLISH | RECORD_AUTHORIZED_WITHHOLDING` с exact withholding authority/review date. `api:user.DecideAccountAccessAppeal.v1` фиксирует NEEDS_INFO/UPHELD/OVERTURNED/WITHDRAWN; OVERTURNED завершается отдельным `api:user.RevokeAccountAccessEffect.v1` и complete restoration manifest. Таким образом create/reject/withholding/restoration имеют точные команды, хотя не размножаются на arbitrary endpoints.

`GuideHomeProjection` read-only композирует workspace, private profile, drafts и scoped EligibilityViews, но не сворачивает их в глобальный readiness. UI `actor_context = TRAVELER | GUIDE | ORGANIZATION_REPRESENTATIVE` сохраняется только как presentation preference/audit hint, не как account role, token authority или decision input.

GuideProfile отдельно хранит professional presentation data. Tourist/social public projection и professional guide projection могут принадлежать одному account subject, но имеют независимые privacy settings, content moderation, reputation semantics и disclosure contracts. Common identity link показывается только когда обе projection публичны и policy это допускает; private tourist profile fields, saved items, bookings, contact data и guide verification/denial reasons никогда не перетекают в public guide projection. Публичность является результатом action authorization, а не статусом «сертифицированный гид».

Public compliance disclosure is a closed discriminated family with common `disclosure_id`, subject/resource generation, market, action, service/remuneration model, closed `basis_class`, closed `requirement_effect`, exact public-safe `basis_source_ref`, authority/policy display name, status/other-requirements status, user-facing label, `as_of`, `valid_until|review_due`, next step, render context and approved basis-specific copy key/version. `requirement_effect` is exactly `LEGAL_ACTION_PREREQUISITE | SITE_ACCESS_PREREQUISITE | PLATFORM_CONDITION | THIRD_PARTY_CONDITION | REPORTING_OBLIGATION | OPTIONAL_CREDENTIAL`:

- `PublicGuideProfileDisclosure` is valid only for standalone market-level guide discovery and never requires or accepts route/date/occurrence fields;
- `PublicExcursionComplianceDisclosure` is bound to exact excursion/occurrence revision and requires route/territory/date/legal timezone;
- `ProtectedTitleDisclosure` contains only exact title, issuer, territory, language, validity and current registry/verification label where lawful and material.

Closed DTO/proto discriminator physically rejects subtype-crossing fields, unknown basis/effect values and catch-all metadata. Generated compatibility guards reject law copy without a current normative authority, basis/effect mismatch, public projection of internal fraud controls and use of a voluntary credential as an adverse prerequisite. Generic «все требования проверены» and universal badge are forbidden: visible card body and screen reader announce scope and reason before status — «по закону/регулятору», «правило объекта/управляющей организации», «требование FlyFy; это не государственная лицензия», «условие партнёра» or «добровольное профессиональное обозначение; оно не является обязательным допуском». Composite requirements render separate reasons rather than collapsing them into one badge. Copy states only the concrete verified/not-required claim and never implies global guide status, safety/quality endorsement or compliance with every law. It never exposes IdentityAssertion/assurance, DOB/age band, nationality/residence, work-authorisation restrictions, policy/credential number, raw evidence, internal denial/fraud/reviewer reason or unrelated market status. Guide previews and can request correction; Legal+Privacy approve claim/copy classes, and revoke/expiry removes only the affected subtype/scope within cutoff. Standalone guide profile reads profile projection, excursion listing reads excursion projection, and title chip reads title projection; no surface fabricates `N/A` route/date or falls back to internal readiness aggregates. Unknown/unmapped basis hides only the affected public claim or blocks its exact mandatory publication; it never fabricates a legal block or disables private workspace, correction or unrelated markets.

`GuideVisibilityControlGeneration` records owner/service-authority safety-reducing commands `PAUSE_EXCURSION_SALES | UNPUBLISH_EXCURSION | HIDE_PUBLIC_PROFILE`, exact resource/market scope, expected revision, reason-safe copy, affected existing-booking manifest/count, committed_at and immutable receipt. These commands require authentication/ownership, CAS and idempotency but never an ALLOW decision and remain reachable during compliance degradation and through a server-rendered old-client fallback. Resume/republish/show creates a new generation and requires fresh applicable authorization; hide/unpublish never cancels an existing contract, deletes workspace/evidence, blocks appeal/payout, or hides the itinerary/remediation path from booked participants.

`BOOKING-SALE-ADMISSION-FENCE-01` is the mandatory linearizable boundary behind every statement that new sales/bookings are stopped. Booking-service is the sole writer of `SaleAdmissionFenceCurrent` and stores one row per ordered `scope_key`: excursion+market, occurrence, public guide/profile+market and every assigned-guide+market scope. Each row has monotonic `fence_epoch`, `OPEN | FENCED`, current active-cause count/hash and `effective_at`. An append-only `SaleAdmissionFenceCauseGeneration` has `cause_id`, source owner/aggregate/generation, cause kind `EXCURSION_PAUSE | EXCURSION_UNPUBLISH | PROFILE_HIDE | ARTICLE30_URGENT_SUPPRESSION | LEGAL_OR_SAFETY_RESTRICTION`, exact scope-key manifest, `ACTIVE | RELEASED`, idempotency identity and signed source/fence receipts. Multiple causes compose: releasing one cause opens a scope only when the complete active-cause set is empty.

Pause/hide/suppression is a receipt-composed protocol, not fictitious cross-database atomicity. The source owner first durably records `FENCE_REQUESTED`, then calls `CommitSaleAdmissionFence` with the complete ordered scope-key manifest. Booking-service runs one serializable RPO-0 transaction: locks those rows in canonical order, verifies expected epochs/source generation/idempotency, inserts or returns the cause, increments affected epochs, sets `FENCED`, persists `SaleAdmissionFenceReceipt` plus outbox and defines the authoritative booking cutoff. Only after that signed receipt may the source commit its own pause/hide/origin-fence state and receipt reference. If the second commit or its acknowledgement fails, sales remain safely fenced and `GetSaleAdmissionFenceOutcome` plus reconciliation completes the source effect; UI says that new sales are blocked while visibility update is still reconciling. A source-only flag, cache invalidation or event can never be shown as a confirmed booking cutoff.

Every booking transaction that can create or widen a new commercial obligation—hold acceptance, contract commit, payment-execution Mark and final confirmation—locks the same applicable fence rows in the same order and pins their epochs. The transaction that commits a booking contract before the fence lock wins is a pre-cutoff existing booking and remains serviceable; if the fence transaction wins first, no later hold/attempt can commit. A hold created before the cutoff has no grandfather right. `MarkSalePaymentExecutionStarted` serializes with the fence and records whether an external money effect may exist; it never overrides a later contract-commit fence. In-flight attempts receive exactly one `SaleAdmissionAttemptDispositionGeneration`: `BLOCKED_PRE_EFFECT`, `PRE_CUTOFF_BOOKING_COMMITTED_PRESERVED`, `VOID_REQUIRED`, `REFUND_REQUIRED` or `RECONCILING`. Unstarted PSP sessions are revoked, holds are released, and authorization/capture arriving after a fenced non-booking attempt goes through the existing late-effect void/refund/reconciliation path; it can never manufacture a booking. Existing confirmed bookings, cancellation/refund, participant itinerary, safety, complaint, privacy and payout rights are unaffected.

Resume/show/republish uses `ReleaseSaleAdmissionFenceCause`, not `status=OPEN`. Booking-service CAS-releases only the exact source cause; it recomputes count/hash and opens rows only when no cause remains. The source may expose the resource again only after the release receipt, a fresh authorization/readiness decision and a new visibility revision. ACK loss uses `GetSaleAdmissionFenceOutcome`; duplicate/reordered events are projections only. RPO-0 failover blocks affected new-sale commits until fence rows, cause sets, receipts, in-flight dispositions and outbox/inbox watermarks reconcile exactly.

For urgent Article 30/public-contact risk, `DSA-ART30-URGENT-SUPPRESSION-01` adds guide-service-owned `PublicSurfaceSuppressionGeneration`: `REQUESTED → BOOKING_FENCED → ORIGIN_FENCED → FLYFY_PROPAGATING → FLYFY_SUPPRESSED`; `BOOKING_FENCED | ORIGIN_FENCED | FLYFY_PROPAGATING → DEGRADED_ESCALATED → FLYFY_PROPAGATING`. The booking cutoff is the separate signed `BOOKING-SALE-ADMISSION-FENCE-01` receipt. After it, guide-service commits origin visibility fence, suppression generation, exact FlyFy-controlled expected-surface manifest and outbox in one local transaction. Manifest members are origin/profile, internal search/recommendation, CDN/edge and supported old-client projections with expected/observed count, ordered hash and signed receipt. `BOOKING_FENCED` proves only the new-sale cutoff; `ORIGIN_FENCED` proves cutoff plus owner-origin hide, but neither proves that projected search/CDN/old-client copies stopped rendering. `FLYFY_SUPPRESSED` is immutable and requires complete convergence.

A later discovered stale FlyFy surface creates a linked successor generation, incident and durable `PublicSurfaceSuppressionReappearanceNotice` in the same guide-owner transaction. The notice says that a controlled copy was found again, identifies a safe surface class, confirmed/expected count, owner, next update/ETA, support/correction action and current origin-fence status; it never silently downgrades the prior receipt or resets the original request chronology. Delivery failure leaves the notice durably readable in the guide workspace and pages Ops. External search engines, archives, screenshots and third-party caches never enter the FlyFy manifest.

Third-party assistance is a separate privacy-owned `ThirdPartyDeindexAssistanceAttempt` with `REQUESTED → PROVIDER_ACKNOWLEDGED | UNCONFIRMED | FAILED`, exact provider/request/evidence and no guaranteed deletion semantics. Thus `ORIGIN_FENCED` truthfully means only that FlyFy source display and new-booking creation are fenced; `FLYFY_PROPAGATING` reports that saved FlyFy copies may still render plus confirmed/expected surfaces and next update, `DEGRADED_ESCALATED` reports remaining possible copies/owner/ETA, and only complete receipts permit `FLYFY_SUPPRESSED`. No UI, event or support macro may say «показ в FlyFy остановлен» or «немедленно удалено» before convergence, nor promise deletion of external copies.

### 6.2.1 RemunerationProfileGeneration

Excursion-service is the single writer of the canonical excursion/resource-scoped profile because it owns the immutable resource revision; payment, merchant, sponsorship, bundle and contract contexts remain authoritative only for their signed source facts. `RemunerationProfileGeneration` stores stable profile/generation/prior/current, tenant, resource kind/ID/revision, seller entity, action set/market scope, `COLLECTING | COMPLETE | INCOMPLETE | SUPERSEDED`, composition algorithm version, expected and observed source-manifest count/hash/version, canonical component-set hash, effective/valid/superseded timestamps and immutable `RemunerationCompositionReceipt`.

Every `RemunerationSourceManifestMember` stores source kind/owner/aggregate/version, projection stream/version/hash and disposition `PRESENT | EXPLICIT_NONE | UNAVAILABLE | GAPPED`. Every component has a stable natural key, payer/beneficiary/value/currency-or-valuation/conditionality/effective interval and exact source generation. `GENUINELY_GRATUITOUS` is never a writable field: it is derived only from a current `COMPLETE` generation whose expected/observed manifest matches, every member is PRESENT or signed EXPLICIT_NONE, and the canonical set is empty. Source-universe/version change invalidates the profile and every dependent ALLOW; activating the profile and its excursion revision uses one local transaction/outbox boundary.

### 6.3 EvidenceArtifact

Единица файла или registry payload:

- evidence_id;
- pre-processing sensitivity disposition `ORDINARY_PROFESSIONAL | SPECIAL_CATEGORY_EXPECTED | ARTICLE10_EXPECTED | AUTHORISED_SENSITIVE_DISPOSAL | AUTHORISED_SENSITIVE_TRIAGE`, expected-category declaration, classifier provenance/confidence, approved full assessment or exact sensitive-ingress disposal/triage authority reference, `quarantine_delete_at` and deletion-receipt reference; rejected/deleted input creates no EvidenceArtifact and only a minimised non-sensitive tombstone, potential sensitive content cannot enter generic OCR/AI/search/reuse, and isolation/deletion is a security/processing operation rather than a legal basis;
- subject и declared purpose;
- document category;
- storage reference;
- integrity checksum;
- malware/OCR/quality status;
- source channel: upload, eID, registry, reviewer;
- extracted claims с confidence;
- redaction state;
- retention class;
- access policy;
- created_at и deletion_due.

Evidence сам по себе ничего не разрешает.

`EvidenceUploadSession` связывает upload с authenticated actor, exact subject, declaration type/ID/revision и processing purpose до выдачи URL. Lifecycle: `CREATED → UPLOADING → UPLOADED → FINALIZING → QUARANTINED_SCAN → ACCEPTED | REJECTED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; multipart parts имеют content-range/ETag, per-part/final checksum, size/MIME/signature limit, expiry и one-purpose token. File-manager `finalize` идемпотентно создаёт/возвращает ровно один FileObject+UploadReceipt, не EvidenceArtifact; changed checksum/purpose/subject конфликтует. После current ACCEPTED scan compliance-service idempotently `Create/AttachProfessionalEvidenceArtifact` по exact upload receipt/file/checksum/purpose/declaration revision и current declaration CAS создаёт owned metadata. File-manager никогда не пишет evidence_artifacts, compliance не пишет blob/session. Transactional outbox/inbox retry returns same artifact; stale declaration leaves an unbound short-retention FileObject, which reconciliation cleans after grace/hold check. Scan/DLP/decompression result append-only; replacement creates new file/artifact revision, while old evidence remains only under approved audit/retention without duplicate review.

До включения любого file-input channel, который технически может принять incidental sensitive bytes, Privacy/Legal утверждают current `SensitiveIngressDisposalAuthorityGeneration`. Она покрывает только неизбежный first-byte receipt, минимальную signature/DLP classification, security isolation, cryptographic/object deletion и non-sensitive tombstone; фиксирует controller, market, declared purpose, possible category, Article 6 basis и применимую Article 9(2)/Article 10 либо non-EU condition, permitted operations, isolated recipients, zero/short non-extendable retention, deletion owner, effective interval and current policy version. Every accepted byte range, object/key deletion command and receipt pins that generation. Если current disposal authority отсутствует, channel physically disabled at the earliest gateway/UI boundary and offers structured registry/manual non-sensitive alternatives; система не принимает bytes с обещанием «удалим позже» и не называет deletion lawful без заранее утверждённой authority.

Privacy-governance является single writer authority, но никогда file disposition или ingress fence. `SensitiveIngressDisposalAuthorityGeneration` и stronger `SensitiveIngressTriageAuthorityGeneration` имеют closed two-owner lifecycle: `DRAFT → REVIEW_PENDING → ACTIVE`; `ACTIVE → SUSPENSION_REQUESTED | REVOCATION_REQUESTED | EXPIRY_REQUESTED | SUPERSESSION_REQUESTED`; каждый requested state переходит в `FILE_INGRESS_FENCE_PENDING`, а затем только по exact signed file-owner receipt — в `SUSPENDED | REVOKED | EXPIRED | SUPERSEDED`. Ошибка/таймаут остаётся `FILE_INGRESS_FENCE_PENDING` с owner/next/absolute due и fail-closed channel; terminal authority нельзя объявить раньше fence receipt. Reactivation из `SUSPENDED` создаёт successor authority/new admission epoch, а не возвращает старую capability. Privacy outbox/event лишь инициирует reconciliation и не может напрямую изменить file-manager row.

The durable cross-owner saga is `SensitiveIngressAuthorityRevocationCoordinatorGeneration`: `REQUESTED → FILE_DRAIN_REQUESTED → FILE_FENCED → TERMINAL_COMMITTED`, with `FILE_DRAIN_REQUESTED | FILE_FENCED → RECONCILING → FILE_DRAIN_REQUESTED | FILE_FENCED`. It pins exact authority/fence epochs, idempotency identity, expected file owner, signed receipt and outcome kind `SUSPEND | REVOKE | EXPIRE | SUPERSEDE`. Compatibility revoke APIs may only create this coordinator and cannot write a terminal authority directly. A lost callback therefore leaves the safer file fence in place, while reconciliation applies the same receipt exactly once.

File-manager owns `SensitiveIngressAdmissionFenceGeneration` per authority scope/epoch: `OPEN → DRAINING → FENCED`, with `OPEN | DRAINING → BLOCKED_MANUAL → DRAINING`; a newly approved authority creates a successor `OPEN`, never reopens a terminal fence. Owner-local transition to `DRAINING` atomically increments the admission epoch, rejects every new `BeginSensitiveIngressSession`/`BeginSensitiveIngressByteLease`, invalidates not-started leases and marks in-flight streams for termination/drain. A lease follows `RESERVED → STREAMING → COMPLETED | ABORTED`. `FENCED` requires a complete zero-live-session/lease manifest and creates the signed receipt consumed by Privacy. Every accepted part/byte passes the file-owner transaction/proxy with a one-use `SensitiveIngressByteLease` bound to current authority+admission epoch; the channel cannot use direct bearer/presigned object-store upload that bypasses the epoch check. Thus the supported linearization claim is exact: new bytes after the signed `FENCED` receipt or derived privacy terminal = 0; before that the user sees «Отключение приёма данных выполняется», never completed revocation. Lost acknowledgement leaves the file side safely fenced and reconciliation completes the privacy projection. Async event adoption SLO applies only to non-authorising projections after this hard fence.

`SensitiveIngressLegalHoldGeneration` separately follows `DRAFT → REVIEW_PENDING → ACTIVATION_PREPARED → ACTIVE`, with `ACTIVATION_PREPARED → ACTIVATION_REJECTED_DELETE_STARTED | CANCELLED | ACTIVATION_RECONCILING`, and `ACTIVE → REVOCATION_REQUESTED | EXPIRY_REQUESTED | SUPERSESSION_REQUESTED → FILE_RESUME_PENDING → REVOKED | EXPIRED | SUPERSEDED`. File-manager serializes `FenceSensitiveIngressDispositionForHold` and `BeginSensitiveIngressDeletion` on the same disposition current pointer/serializable CAS. If hold wins before deletion Start, the file transaction moves `ISOLATED | TRIAGE_ACTIVE | DELETE_DUE | DELETE_FAILED → HOLD_FENCED_PENDING_ACTIVATION`, blocks deletion and writes a signed hold-fence receipt/outbox. Privacy may set `ACTIVE` only from that exact receipt; file-manager then consumes the signed ACTIVE receipt and moves to `HELD_SCOPED`. If deletion Start won first and wrote its tombstone, hold returns typed `ACTIVATION_REJECTED_DELETE_STARTED`, never displays ACTIVE and opens counsel/incident handling. Abort of a prepared file fence requires a signed privacy cancel/reject receipt and returns only to `DELETE_DUE | AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`; `DELETING` has no edge to pending/held state.

File-manager alone owns the remaining `SensitiveIngressDispositionGeneration`: `SESSION_AUTHORISED → ISOLATED`; `ISOLATED | TRIAGE_ACTIVE | DELETE_DUE | DELETE_FAILED → HOLD_FENCED_PENDING_ACTIVATION`; ordinary `ISOLATED → TRIAGE_ACTIVE | DELETE_DUE | AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`; `TRIAGE_ACTIVE → CLASSIFIED_TO_CURRENT_ASSESSMENT | DELETE_DUE | AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`; `HOLD_FENCED_PENDING_ACTIVATION → HELD_SCOPED | DELETE_DUE | AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED` only through exact privacy ACTIVE or abort receipt; `HELD_SCOPED → DELETE_DUE | AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`; `DELETE_DUE → DELETING`; `DELETING → DELETED_CONFIRMED | DELETE_FAILED`; `DELETE_FAILED → DELETE_DUE`. Hold release/revoke/expiry invokes `ResumeSensitiveIngressDisposition`; it may enter `DELETE_DUE` only with a current exact deletion authority (or separately approved disposition-only survival mandate), otherwise `AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED` with owner/next/absolute due. Signature-verified ordered inbox receipts, expected-generation CAS and owner outbox prevent stale reopening/widening/deletion; cross-service DB writes are denied.

Если workflow ожидает `SPECIAL_CATEGORY_EXPECTED` либо `ARTICLE10_EXPECTED`, session не создаётся без stronger current full processing assessment, Article 6 basis и применимого Article 9(2)/Article 10 либо non-EU condition; клиентская метка «обычный документ» не может обойти gate. Если ordinary-purpose upload неожиданно либо из-за misclassification содержит sensitive data, pipeline останавливается до OCR/AI/search/generic-reviewer/vendor access. Retained short classification/triage beyond disposal-only operations requires a separate current ACTIVE `SensitiveIngressTriageAuthorityGeneration`, which documents the same exact scope plus necessity, permitted classification fields/claims, authorised human/vendor recipients, hard TTL and transition only to a current full assessment or file-owned deletion disposition. Isolation is never a processing condition. Generic, late, revoked or expired hold cannot preserve the file; every valid hold termination must converge through the explicit resume transition rather than silently restarting an old countdown.

Legacy potentially sensitive blobs are not assigned an authorityless deletion status. Migration first uses precomputed non-content metadata only to block application access and open counsel review; no content inspection or deletion occurs until a current disposal/triage/full-processing authority exists. The approved authority then drives cryptographic key/object deletion and its receipt, or narrowly scoped lawful retention. A named DPO/Legal owner, short decision deadline, executive escalation and disabled related ingress prevent indefinite limbo without inventing retroactive authority.

Повторное использование не означает silent cross-purpose access. `ProfessionalEvidenceBindingGeneration` связывает artifact/attestation revision с source declaration/purpose и exact target requirement/declaration/purpose/audience, allowlisted claims, subject/owner, authority/legal basis либо specific user/organization ReuseGrant, access-grant ref, valid/expiry/revocation, prior/current generation и access audit. One current binding per artifact+target requirement; changed target, audience, claim set, evidence/attestation revision либо purpose требует new grant/other approved basis. User может preview, link и revoke discretionary future reuse; revocation прекращает новые accesses/authorizations, но не стирает lawful completed review/audit. Mandatory legal reuse опирается не на fake consent, а на documented basis/notice/rights. Raw blob не копируется: target получает минимальные claims/short-lived purpose-bound access, а retention owner считает каждый lawful purpose отдельно.

Duplicate HMAC используется только как confidential signal. Лишь exact replay того же subject+declaration+evidence-set может вернуть тот же upload/review receipt. Cross-subject match даёт uniform response/timing, не раскрывает account/document/case existence, не делит evidence/status и открывает isolated access-controlled conflict/abuse review. Legitimate organization/permit reuse идёт через explicit ownership, confirmed Affiliation/PermitAssignment и ProfessionalEvidenceBinding, никогда по fingerprint similarity.

Professional declaration и verification не имеют двух writers. Authoritative declaration owner контролирует `PRIVATE_DRAFT → READY_TO_SUBMIT → SUBMITTED | WITHDRAWN | SUPERSEDED` revisions, stable ID/current pointer/CAS, ETag/idempotency tombstone, actor/subject/owner, purpose, exact evidence-set hash и replacement. Submit handshake owner-транзакцией фиксирует immutable SubmittedDeclarationReceipt/revision/hash и outbox. Compliance-service владеет отдельным `VerificationCase/DecisionGeneration`: `QUEUED → VERIFYING`; `VERIFYING → NEEDS_INFO | APPROVED | DENIED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; `NEEDS_INFO → VERIFYING | CANCELLED | EXPIRED` only through a new submitted-information revision; current evidence/declaration revision makes the old generation `SUPERSEDED` and creates a linked QUEUED case; a current APPROVED case can later create a separate `REVOKED` decision generation, never mutate the original. Terminal generations are immutable. Case stores evidence/attestation, due/next/absolute due, appeal and signed decision receipt and never mutates declaration aggregate.

Declaration owner materializes only non-authoritative review projection from contiguous signed events or applies decision receipt to its own projection via CAS against exact submitted revision/evidence-set hash. Changed evidence creates superseding declaration revision/new case; stale decision is rejected/history-only. Revocation creates compliance-owned attestation/decision generation and event; owner invalidates affected projection/resources without rewriting declaration history. Correction/renewal/replacement preserve prior decisions; deletion request considers legal hold/retention and returns scoped receipt. `NEEDS_INFO` always references an exact missing/invalid claim/artifact and owner creates a new submitted revision, never asks to upload everything.

### 6.4 PersonCredential

Только личная профессиональная квалификация или регистрация:

- credential type;
- holder person;
- issuer и issuer jurisdiction;
- encrypted number и HMAC duplicate fingerprint;
- issued_at, valid_from, valid_to;
- geographic, activity, language и title scope;
- claimed recognition route/reference and registry/issuer locator;
- evidence references;
- renewal/training obligations.

Registry result, verified recognition status, holder binding and VerificationAttestation are compliance-owned generations; public declaration JSON containing verified/status/verifier/attestation fields is rejected.

`CredentialHolderBindingGeneration` доказывает принадлежность credential текущему verified subject: credential/declaration revision, IdentityAssertion ID/version, issuer holder reference, purpose-bound identity-service compare/selective-disclosure assertion, normalized-name/DOB/alias/transliteration matcher method/version, match/mismatch categories/confidence, reviewer/attestation, valid interval и supersession. Compliance не копирует actual name/DOB match inputs: persist only claim refs/hashes, method/version and signed decision receipt under dedicated retention; events/logs/search never contain values. Authorization requires current same-subject binding; identity/verified-name/issuer-record change invalidates it and starts reassessment. Credential другого account/co-guide нельзя присоединить по файлу, номеру или похожему имени. Organization/permit reuse разрешается только через confirmed Affiliation/PermitAssignment, не через holder-name similarity.

### 6.5 OrganizationRegistration

- organization;
- registration/licence type;
- issuing authority;
- geographic/activity scope;
- validity;
- merchant/tax references по минимально необходимым claims;
- evidence references and claimed issuer/reference.

Declaration принадлежит organization aggregate и имеет authorized-representative proof. Verified corporate/registry status and VerificationAttestation are separate compliance-owned generations and cannot be supplied by public actor. Organization revision/corporate status/registration expiry инвалидирует dependent affiliations, insurance/permits и affected authorizations через versioned facts, но не переносит документы в personal wallet.

#### 6.5.1 OrganizationRepresentativeMembershipGeneration

Organization-service is the sole writer of the authoritative representative roster; email/phone possession, an invitation, an `Affiliation`, an ID check or an organization declaration never independently grants corporate authority. `OrganizationRepresentativeMembershipGeneration` stores organization, verified person binding, closed role set (`ORG_OWNER | ORG_ADMIN | COMPLIANCE_SUBMITTER | AFFILIATION_CONFIRMER | FINANCE_OPERATOR | READ_ONLY`), exact action/audience/market/resource scope, authority source and evidence, verification method, valid interval, risk/step-up policy, prior/current generation, maker/checker receipts for material changes and immutable notification/audit receipts. Backend ABAC checks the current membership generation on every ordinary privileged organization command; invitation acceptance and accountless recovery resolution instead require their exact closed one-use authority discriminator and cannot use a role hint, token claim or client cache as membership.

Lifecycle is closed: `INVITED → VERIFICATION_PENDING → ACTIVE → SUSPENDED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`; `INVITED | VERIFICATION_PENDING → DECLINED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`. Terminal generations are immutable; changed roles/scope or reactivation creates a linked successor. Invite, accept, add, scope change, suspension, removal, ownership transfer and recovery are separate idempotent commands with expected roster/organization versions. High-risk grants/removals, payout/tax/compliance authority and ownership transfer require recent step-up plus an independent checker; the actor cannot approve their own privilege escalation. A transactional last-active-owner/admin guard prevents orphaning the organization, while an emergency security suspension may immediately remove risky access only if a separate assisted recovery owner and deadline are created.

Every affected representative receives a durable, safe notice of invitation, grant/change, suspension/removal and recovery outcome; audit shows who changed which scoped authority and when without exposing identity evidence. The organization admin workspace supports roster search, role-and-scope preview, pending/expired invitations, access review, bulk review without bulk approval, revoke, transfer and downloadable audit receipts. Accountless assisted recovery uses verified official-registry/organization claims, accessible non-biometric alternatives, anti-enumeration responses and maker/checker; it never silently creates a member or bypasses the last-admin guard. No active authorized representative is a blocking state with an owner, ETA and individual/other-organization path, not an invitation loop.

Bootstrap authority is deliberately separate from membership. `OrganizationRepresentativeInvitationGeneration` has complete terminal reachability: `ISSUED → VIEWED_NON_AUTHORISING | DECLINED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`; `VIEWED_NON_AUTHORISING → VERIFIED_SELF_BOUND | DECLINED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`; `VERIFIED_SELF_BOUND → ACCEPTED | DECLINED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`. A one-use `OrganizationRepresentativeInviteAcceptanceAuthorityGeneration` follows `ISSUED → EXCHANGED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`; `EXCHANGED → CONSUMED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`, binds the verified person, exact invitation/organization/role/scope/roster generation and cannot widen it. Exchange/consume/revoke/expire races serialize on one authority current-pointer CAS; Accept atomically consumes the winning authority, creates the valid membership generation and roster pointer, audit, notice and outbox. Possession of token/email alone remains non-authorising.

Accountless recovery uses complete `OrganizationRepresentativeRecoveryCaseGeneration` transitions: `OPENED_OPAQUE → CLAIM_VERIFICATION_PENDING | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; `CLAIM_VERIFICATION_PENDING → INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PENDING | CONFLICT_MANUAL | REJECTED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; `INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PENDING → APPROVED | CONFLICT_MANUAL | REJECTED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; `CONFLICT_MANUAL → CLAIM_VERIFICATION_PENDING | INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PENDING | REJECTED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; `APPROVED → AUTHORITY_ISSUED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; `AUTHORITY_ISSUED → RESOLVED | AUTHORITY_REISSUE_REQUIRED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`; `AUTHORITY_REISSUE_REQUIRED → INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PENDING | CANCELLED | EXPIRED`. `REJECTED`, `RESOLVED`, `CANCELLED` and `EXPIRED` are immutable; materially new evidence creates a linked successor case. Its `OrganizationRepresentativeRecoveryAuthorityGeneration` follows `ISSUED → EXCHANGED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`; `EXCHANGED → CONSUMED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`. A revoked/expired unconsumed authority atomically moves the case to `AUTHORITY_REISSUE_REQUIRED`; consume/revoke/expire and recovery resolution race on one CAS. Authority binds a pre-approved exact roster-delta hash and cannot add payout/tax/compliance/ownership scope beyond that delta. Recovery intake is uniform/no-enumeration and requires no existing account or membership; resolution consumes the authority, exact roster delta, revocation epoch, audit/notices/outbox atomically. Authorization discriminator is closed as `ACTIVE_MEMBERSHIP | SELF_BOUND_INVITE_ACCEPTANCE | ACCOUNTLESS_RECOVERY_RESOLUTION`; every ordinary corporate command accepts only the first.

`OrganizationRosterFailoverReconciliationGeneration` follows `DETECTED → MUTATIONS_FENCED → RECONCILING → REOPEN_APPROVED | BLOCKED_MANUAL`, with `BLOCKED_MANUAL → RECONCILING`. Until signed complete generation/current-pointer/revocation/idempotency/audit/outbox reconciliation reaches `REOPEN_APPROVED`, roster mutations, invite acceptance, recovery resolution and privileged organization commands fail closed; safe roster/status reads and recovery intake remain available.

### 6.6 Affiliation

- person;
- organization;
- role;
- employment/contractor/authorized-agent type;
- scope;
- valid_from/valid_to;
- evidence references;
- revocation path.

Proposal does not contain verified affiliation/attestation. Only signed organization confirmation plus optional independent VerificationAttestation creates CONFIRMED fact; public payload with confirmation/verifier/status/attestation fields is rejected.

Lifecycle требует двух независимых сторон и закрытых переходов: `PROPOSED_BY_GUIDE → PENDING_ORGANIZATION_CONFIRMATION`; pending → `CONFIRMED | REJECTED | WITHDRAWN | EXPIRED`; current `CONFIRMED → REVOKED | EXPIRED | SUPERSEDED`; terminal generation immutable, а correction/re-proposal создаёт linked new generation. Guide/organization actor bindings и expected versions обязательны; proposer не может подтвердить свою связь от имени organization. Revocation effective time, scope, impacted resources и acknowledgement обеих сторон сохраняются; stale affiliation не удовлетворяет seller/operator responsibility.

Если organization ещё не зарегистрирована в FlyFy, guide создаёт `OrganizationAffiliationInvitation`, а не fake organization account. Invite использует opaque high-entropy one-time token stored only as digest, intended organization/representative contact HMAC, role/scope preview, expiry, rate/abuse limits и no-enumeration response. Query-string token forbidden: mail/app link carries fragment or app-bound handoff and exchanges token via no-store POST body with strict Referrer-Policy, no analytics/logging; link scanner/open only shows a non-authorising preview and explicit confirm starts one-time exchange. Resend rotates token and invalidates prior generation; replay/leak gets uniform response, while authenticated device-switch recovery uses opaque invite ID plus independent verification.

Independent representative проходит minimal organization claim/onboarding и representative-authority verification либо assisted official-registry/manual verification; только после этого organization-service подписывает confirmation. Invite can resend/revoke/expire, device/session recovery is idempotent, and email/phone possession alone never proves corporate authority. Пользователь видит PENDING_CONFIRMATION, owner/ETA/next action и alternative individual/different organization route; отсутствие FlyFy account у компании не создаёт dead end.

### 6.7 Permit и SiteAuthorization

`PermitOrSiteAuthorizationDeclaration` принадлежит responsible person/organization/excursion owner, но не маскируется под personal credential. Public actor заявляет поля:

- responsible party;
- authority/land manager/site;
- route/site/activity/group scope;
- occurrence dates;
- quota/slot;
- conditions;
- claimed validity;
- evidence references and claimed issuer/reference.

Verification case отдельно mint-ит `PermitOrSiteAuthorizationAssertion`: declaration/evidence/attestation revisions, verified authority/site/route/activity/group/quota/slot/conditions/validity, exact purpose/actions, generation/revocation epoch and signed receipt. Authorization/PermitUsage использует только current assertion+attestation, никогда declaration. Declaration и assertion — разные aggregates и физически не делят owner: `GUIDE_PERSONAL` declaration находится только в guide-service DB, `ORGANIZATION` — только в organization-service DB, `EXCURSION_RESOURCE` — только в excursion-service DB. Compliance хранит лишь signed SubmittedDeclarationReceipt/ref, non-authoritative projection, VerificationCase/Decision/Attestation/Assertion; shared table, cross-service write и cross-DB FK запрещены, а public field allowlist не позволяет mint verified values.

`PermitAssignment` — отдельный versioned aggregate authoritative resource owner: permit revision назначается exact excursion/occurrence/booking-group, route/site/activity/date/group scope и responsible party; assignment status `DRAFT_PENDING_USAGE_RESERVATION | ACTIVE | INVALIDATED | REMOVED | SUPERSEDED`. One-current compatible assignment и context-resource version/FK обязательны; изменение route/date/group/permit/owner инвалидирует assignment и запускает preflight/remediation.

Ограниченный quota/slot не расходуется простой ссылкой. `PermitUsageLedger` single-writer у permit owner хранит typed capacity unit, time/site/resource exclusion key, `quota_authority_mode/source_generation: FLYFY_EXCLUSIVE_ALLOCATION | EXTERNAL_RESERVATION_API | OWNER_SIGNED_ALLOCATION | NON_EXCLUSIVE_UNKNOWN`, externally allocated/remaining-capacity proof, reservation reference/expiry/freshness and append-only state generations. FlyFy ledger is authoritative only for contractually/technically exclusive allocation; otherwise every reserve/release reconciles with the external authority API or a current authorised owner-signed allocation. `NON_EXCLUSIVE_UNKNOWN`, stale remaining capacity or registry outage cannot hard-ALLOW a quota-limited requirement and exposes assisted/owner confirmation.

| Current | Command/evidence | Next |
|---|---|---|
| AVAILABLE | Reserve с current quota proof | RESERVED |
| RESERVED | PrepareConsume | CONSUME_PENDING |
| RESERVED | Release / expiry / revoke с matching external receipt where required | RELEASED / EXPIRED / REVOKED |
| RESERVED | external/local outcome unknown | RECONCILING |
| CONSUME_PENDING | authoritative local start receipt | CONSUMED |
| CONSUME_PENDING | proven no-start, reservation still valid | RESERVED |
| CONSUME_PENDING | proven no-start + cancellation / expiry / revoke | RELEASED / EXPIRED / REVOKED |
| CONSUME_PENDING | start outcome unknown | RECONCILING |
| RECONCILING | current reserved/started/not-started proof | RESERVED / CONSUMED / RELEASED / EXPIRED / REVOKED |
| RECONCILING | conflicting evidence | CONFLICT_MANUAL |
| CONFLICT_MANUAL | signed maker/checker resolution | RECONCILING |
| CONSUMED / RELEASED / EXPIRED / REVOKED | none | terminal audit fact; new reservation uses a new generation |

Quota remains conservatively held in RESERVED, CONSUME_PENDING, RECONCILING and unresolved CONFLICT_MANUAL; `CONSUMED` never auto-releases, and external quota release requires the same external reservation identity/receipt. Stable usage key связывает permit revision, immutable AssignmentIntent, occurrence/booking group и units. Assignment saga устраняет circular dependency: (1) resource owner CAS создаёт DRAFT assignment + immutable `AssignmentIntent` ID/hash/context revision; (2) permit owner Reserve по intent+permit+scope/units and external allocation proof returns signed reservation/expiry; (3) resource owner CAS делает assignment ACTIVE only with current matching receipt. Failure/stale context idempotently Release/Expire and reconciles external reservation; reconciliation detects orphan/local-external divergence or ACTIVE-without-current-reservation.

Check-in/start consumption boundary задаётся permit policy. До boundary owner вызывает `PreparePermitUsageConsumption`, переводящий current reservation в `CONSUME_PENDING` и выдающий one-time token; затем resource owner одной local CAS фиксирует CHECKED_IN/STARTED + token и outbox receipt. `ApplyPermitUsageConsumptionReceipt` переводит ledger в CONSUMED. Crash до local CAS оставляет capacity held, lookup доказывает no-start и возвращает RESERVED/RELEASED; crash после local CAS повторяет тот же token/receipt и не создаёт второй usage. Reserve/prepare/consume/release идемпотентны и CAS-проверяют permit/intent/assignment/context versions, overlap/exclusion и remaining capacity; concurrent assignments/booking/start не превышают quota. Cancellation/re-route/revocation releases только unconsumed reservation по current policy, а started/consumed usage остаётся audit/remediation fact. `CHECK_IN_OCCURRENCE`/`START_OCCURRENCE_IN_APP` требуют exact current receipt for configured boundary; unknown state fail closed with reconciliation/support, not duplicate reservation.

### 6.7.1 InsuranceCoverageDeclaration и InsuranceCoverageAssertion

Insurance не хранится флагом в Market Operating Model. `InsuranceCoverageDeclaration` хранит user/organization-claimed holder/insured party (`PERSON | ORGANIZATION | EXCURSION`), carrier/policy reference, coverage type, territory/activity/site, claimed `limit_basis: PER_OCCURRENCE | PER_PERSON | AGGREGATE | OTHER`, limits/currency, aggregate/available aggregate, primary/excess layer and priority, deductible, exclusions/conditions, occurrence-versus-claims-made form/retroactive date/reporting tail, validity and evidence revisions. Отдельный verifier-only `InsuranceCoverageAssertion` pin-ит declaration/evidence/attestation revisions, verified carrier/reference fingerprint, insured parties/scope, all limit/layer/form fields, current claims/reservation/available-aggregate fact generation and freshness, exclusions/conditions, valid_from/to, cancellation/revocation/tail, verification policy/method, generation/revocation epoch, renewal/monitoring and signed receipt.

Scope/limits сопоставляются с exact action/occurrence and required basis/layer; authorization использует только current InsuranceCoverageAssertion+attestation. Aggregate exhaustion/reservation, stale claims fact, wrong per-person/per-occurrence basis, layer gap, claims-made/tail mismatch, expired/cancelled/under-limit/excluded coverage does not satisfy requirement. Currency conversion is forbidden unless a current counsel-approved rule fixes source, timestamp, conservative rounding and buffer; otherwise currencies must match. Mid-occurrence cancellation/revoke starts booking/safety remediation rather than retroactively pretending coverage existed or did not exist. Organization policy applies only through current confirmed Affiliation and explicit insured/assignment scope. Public payload cannot set verified/cancel/revoke status, and a declaration never counts as coverage.

### 6.7.2 Cross-border legal assertions

Public actor создаёт только `ProviderLegalStatusDeclaration`, `WorkAuthorizationDeclaration` либо `ProfessionalRecognitionDeclaration`: stable declaration/revision, subject, claimed home/establishment/issuing/qualification origin facts, requested activity/territory/route, claimed validity/conditions, source/evidence refs, privacy classification/purpose и общий declaration lifecycle. Public payload не содержит verified/status/source-authority fields.

Три purpose-minimized assertion aggregates не смешиваются с IdentityAssertion:

- `ProviderLegalStatusAssertion`: subject, home/establishment jurisdiction, `ESTABLISHED | TEMPORARY_CROSS_BORDER`, activity/territory, duration/frequency/regularity/continuity facts, source, validity и supersession;
- `WorkAuthorizationAssertion`: subject, issuing jurisdiction, authorised activity/employer/territory, conditions, valid_from/to, revoked_at и verifier; nationality/residence claims отсутствуют, если exact approved rule их не требует;
- `ProfessionalRecognitionAssertion`: source qualification/credential, origin jurisdiction, recognising authority/route, recognised title/activity/territory, compensatory measure/condition, validity/revocation и attestation.

Каждый assertion purpose/action/scope-bound, имеет one-current generation, evidence provenance, correction/appeal и independent expiry/invalidation. Coarse pre-check не создаёт его и не собирает sensitive status; exact action запрашивает только minimum claims после approved CoverageAssertion/LocalCounselRequirementDecision.

Verifier mapper принимает только current SUBMITTED declaration revision + complete purpose-bound evidence/attestation set. `NEEDS_INFO`/DENIED не мутирует declaration в truth и не mint-ит assertion; APPROVED создаёт minimized signed assertion generation с declaration/evidence hash. Correction/appeal supersede-ит review/assertion only after current proof, preserving user claim and decision chronology.

### 6.8 VerificationAttestation

Фиксирует не документ, а проверенный claim:

- stable attestation_id, append-only generation/prior/current pointer и exactly-one-current constraint;
- claim type и normalized value;
- subject, declaration ID/revision, artifact revisions и complete evidence-set hash;
- exact claim/scope/purpose/audience/actions и reuse boundary;
- verification-policy, method-schema и verifier-adapter versions;
- method: registry, issuer callback, cryptographic, manual;
- verifier;
- verified_at, effective_at, valid_until/freshness и revocation epoch;
- confidence;
- registry status;
- revocation monitoring, revoked_at/reason/source sequence;
- superseded_by и signed generation receipt.

Attestation нельзя расширить на иной subject/purpose/audience/scope через client mapping. Evidence/declaration/method/policy revision, issuer correction, registry revoke либо holder-binding change создаёт superseding/revoked generation и invalidates dependent decisions. Context pin-ит exact generation+epoch; stale compatible-looking claim не удовлетворяет requirement.

### 6.8.1 RequirementDefinition, ResponsibilityAssignment и RequirementEvaluation

`RequirementDefinition` — versioned legal-policy aggregate, а не UI string. Он хранит stable requirement ID/type, exact legal question, rule/source/PolicyRelease versions, CoverageScope/applicability predicate/effective interval, basis type, required claim/attestation schema and accepted evidence methods, subject/owner role, allowed responsible-party alternatives (`GUIDE | CO_GUIDE | ORGANIZATION | SITE_OPERATOR | FLYFY`), Boolean composition `ALL_OF | ANY_OF | ONE_OF | UNLESS` и typed cardinality `AT_LEAST_N | EXACTLY_N | FOR_EACH_SEGMENT | RATIO_OR_FORMULA`. Quantitative rule включает formula AST, numerator/denominator units, threshold bands, `CEIL|FLOOR|EXACT` rounding, minimum/maximum, distinct-subject/credential-counting rule, required simultaneous role mix and time/segment-overlap predicate. Также фиксируются segment/site/resource/date applicability, reuse/purpose/freshness rules, user copy/CTA/acquisition time/verified external cost source, supersession/invalidation and counsel approval. A requirement can explicitly be NOT_APPLICABLE; missing definition never becomes generic certificate.

`ResponsibilityAssignment` is discriminated by `resource_kind/owner_service: EXCURSION_REVISION|OCCURRENCE → excursion-service; BOOKING_GROUP → booking-service`; one authoritative resource owner version-binds the requirement/path to exact resource/segment/time window and stores only signed cross-service subject/artifact refs. Organization/site-owned obligation is referenced through its own owner receipt, never written into booking/excursion DB. A quantitative requirement binds a complete assignment set, not one reusable checkbox; one subject/credential cannot count twice unless the current rule explicitly permits it, and an assignment counts only during its actual overlapping segment/time.

User path selection and owner acceptance are separate. `ResponsibilityAcceptance/OwnerObligationReceipt` contains responsible owner/role, authority proof, scope, deadline, accepted/rejected/revoked/expired generation and signature; CO_GUIDE/ORGANIZATION/SITE_OPERATOR requires explicit authorised acceptance, while FLYFY can be assigned only by policy-created internal obligation. A public actor cannot self-confirm another party or choose FLYFY/site owner directly. Assignment remains `DRAFT|AWAITING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE` until current RequirementDefinition permits the alternative and all required receipts exist. Changed/moved/resized booking group, group size, duration, co-guide/org/route/site/date/resource, owner rejection/revoke/timeout or overlapping occurrence invalidates it and recomputes the complete set. User can switch a lawful alternative without re-uploading unrelated evidence, but cannot assign an ineligible or non-accepting subject.

Alternative availability requires a reachable authorised accepter. `ResponsibilityAcceptanceInvitation` reuses the scanner-safe one-time token/handoff primitive from OrganizationAffiliationInvitation: digest-only token, fragment/app-bound handoff→no-store POST exchange, preview that cannot accept, intended owner/contact HMAC, role/scope/deadline, resend rotation, revoke/replay/no-enumeration and minimal co-guide/organization representative verification. Lifecycle `ISSUED → VIEWED_NON_AUTHORISING → ACCEPTED | DECLINED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`, with reminder/timeout and alternate/support path. If a site operator has no approved integration/onboarding route, the alternative is not offered: only a pre-existing signed SiteAuthorization/OwnerObligationReceipt can satisfy it. FLYFY obligation has no public invite and is created only by policy owner.

`RequirementEvaluation` is immutable per ComplianceAssessment+requirement version+responsibility path: applicability, selected/available alternatives, fulfilment state, formula inputs, computed `required_count`, distinct current `qualifying_assignment_ids`, overlap proof, role/segment coverage matrix, assignment owner-service/resource generation, current ResponsibilityAcceptance/OwnerObligationReceipt generations, exact claim/attestation/binding/input generations, missing/invalid reason, responsible owner, due/next action, explanation snapshot and supersession. Assessment emits a complete evaluation set/hash; ALLOW requires every mandatory composition/cardinality group satisfied or inapplicable by current rule. Group-size/date/time/segment changes, guide removal/revoke/expiry, overlapping allocation, owner receipt revoke/timeout or assignment switch recompute the whole set and revoke stale ALLOW. Mobile only renders evaluations and explains “нужно N, подтверждено M”, “ожидаем подтверждение от …” with ETA and lawful alternatives; chronology remains auditable.

`GuidePresenceAllocation` is the cross-resource single-writer schedule boundary in excursion-service for every guide/co-guide used by an excursion, occurrence or booking-group requirement. It stores guide, resource-owner/type/ref/generation, legal timezone, start/end, route/segment and travel/safety buffer, exclusivity/overlap policy, acceptance/assignment refs and append-only state generations. Any resource owner must Reserve through this boundary before assignment can count; a signed receipt/current availability epoch is pinned in ResponsibilityAssignment/Evaluation/Authorization.

| Current | Command/evidence | Next |
|---|---|---|
| RESERVED | Activate | ACTIVE |
| RESERVED | Release / Expire / Revoke | RELEASED / EXPIRED / REVOKED |
| ACTIVE | PrepareConsume | CONSUME_PENDING |
| ACTIVE | proven pre-start Release / Revoke | RELEASED / REVOKED |
| CONSUME_PENDING | authoritative start receipt | CONSUMED |
| CONSUME_PENDING | proven no-start, assignment current | ACTIVE |
| CONSUME_PENDING | proven no-start + cancellation | RELEASED |
| CONSUME_PENDING | start outcome unknown | RECONCILING |
| RECONCILING | current start/no-start proof | CONSUMED / ACTIVE / RELEASED / REVOKED |
| RECONCILING | conflicting evidence | CONFLICT_MANUAL |
| CONFLICT_MANUAL | signed maker/checker resolution | RECONCILING |
| CONSUMED / RELEASED / EXPIRED / REVOKED | none | terminal audit fact; reassign through a new generation |

The interval exclusion covers RESERVED, ACTIVE, CONSUME_PENDING, RECONCILING and unresolved CONFLICT_MANUAL; terminal mutation is forbidden and expected-generation CAS enforces every edge. Deterministic lock order prevents the same guide counting in incompatible simultaneous resources across services. Schedule/timezone/buffer change, revoke or late external commitment invalidates affected evaluations and offers another guide/time/route; offline start consumes only its exact current allocation receipt. Ambiguous legacy/impossible states enter RECONCILING and retain the interval rather than silently freeing capacity.

### 6.9 ComplianceAssessment

Assessment lifecycle:

- CALCULATING;
- READY;
- REVIEW_QUEUED;
- IN_REVIEW;
- NEEDS_INFO;
- RESOLVED;
- STALE;
- SUPERSEDED;
- ERROR.

Allowed edges are closed: `CALCULATING → READY | REVIEW_QUEUED | ERROR | STALE | SUPERSEDED`; `REVIEW_QUEUED → IN_REVIEW | STALE | SUPERSEDED`; `IN_REVIEW → NEEDS_INFO | RESOLVED | STALE | SUPERSEDED`; `NEEDS_INFO → IN_REVIEW | STALE | SUPERSEDED` only after a new information revision; `READY | RESOLVED → STALE | SUPERSEDED`. ERROR retry and any correction after a terminal generation create a linked CALCULATING successor. DB transition matrix, command guard, API enum, compatibility mapping and model-based test are generated from the same versioned state catalog.

Assessment содержит:

- requested action;
- actor и subjects;
- resource revision;
- context snapshot/hash;
- ruleset, DSL schema, evaluator/compiler versions;
- fact snapshot versions;
- coverage assertions;
- applied rules и reason graph;
- requirement satisfaction;
- decision outcome;
- valid_until;
- user-safe explanations;
- explanation_view_snapshot_ids;
- internal legal explanation.

### 6.10 AuthorizationDecision

Immutable authorization разрешает ровно одно действие над одной версией ресурса:

- authorization_id;
- action;
- actor_type: USER_DELEGATED либо SERVICE_OWNED, principal/service reference и actor audience;
- для USER_DELEGATED — roles_version, delegated_principal_hash, auth_context_version и principal_expires_at;
- для SERVICE_OWNED — purpose-bound service authority reference и required subject/account/restriction/trust/credential/merchant/tax/mandate epochs без фиктивной user session;
- resource reference/version;
- occurrence reference, если применимо;
- context_hash;
- outcome и obligations;
- reason references;
- policy_set, DSL/compiler/evaluator versions;
- fact watermarks;
- exact RequirementDefinition set manifest/count/version hash, current ResponsibilityAssignment generation set and committed complete RequirementEvaluation set/count/hash; omitted, mixed-version or uncommitted member makes the decision non-ALLOW;
- required identity/legal-capacity/credential-holder/organization-affiliation/permit-usage/insurance/cross-border assertion generations and revocation epochs; only requirements selected by exact reason graph are included;
- AuthorizationScopePartition ID and exact policy/revocation member epochs plus fence generation;
- LaunchDependencyRegistry scope_set_epoch and ordered matched dependency member IDs/member epochs/predicate receipt versions/exact consumer-provider interface digests; global registry root retained only for audit;
- issued_at и expires_at;
- actor/authority expiry; decision expires_at никогда не позже применимого actor expiry;
- audience;
- nonce/replay protection;
- server signature;
- superseded/revoked marker.

AuthorizationDecision не является универсальным статусом гида и не переносится между actions, occurrences или resource revisions.

### 6.11 ManualReviewCase, RestrictionDecision, ComplianceAppeal и RestorationPlan

`ManualReviewCase` is an append-only compliance-service aggregate, not an admin-panel row. It stores stable case/generation/prior/current, subject/resource/action/requirement, originating assessment/decision/evidence-set hashes, reason taxonomy, policy/source/copy epochs, current information-request/reply revision, queue/owner/priority, `sla_due_at`, non-pausable `absolute_due_at`, legal timezone/calendar, approved pause class/start/deadline, last/next update, reviewer authority/conflict declarations, human-decision requirement, decision generation, appeal route and idempotency/audit. Its explicit lifecycle is:

    QUEUED → TRIAGED | CANCELLED
    TRIAGED → IN_REVIEW | CANCELLED
    IN_REVIEW → NEEDS_INFO | ESCALATED | APPROVED | DENIED | CANCELLED
    NEEDS_INFO → IN_REVIEW | CLOSED_INCOMPLETE | CANCELLED
    ESCALATED → IN_REVIEW | APPROVED | DENIED | CANCELLED

Claim/renew/release uses a hashed lease token, lease generation and expected case generation. NEEDS_INFO reply, reassignment, policy/evidence change or lease expiry bumps claim generation and clears the old lease; a stale worker cannot resolve. Resolve transaction rechecks lease, complete evidence set, policy/source/revocation epochs, reviewer conflict and maker/checker where adverse/material, then atomically appends immutable `ManualReviewDecisionGeneration`, optional exact-scope RestrictionDecision and outbox. `CLOSED_INCOMPLETE` is non-adverse; a later resubmission creates a linked new case. Correction/revoke never rewrites the original decision.

Любое delisting, suspension или capability restriction создаёт RestrictionDecision:

- affected user/resource/action;
- фактические причины;
- legal, contractual или platform basis;
- territory и duration;
- effective_at;
- consumer impact;
- statement-of-reasons delivery;
- appeal deadline и channel;
- restoration conditions;
- reviewer и audit;
- applicable procedural regime и legal clocks;
- human_decision_id и pre-decision review evidence, когда этого требует Platform Work или иной режим.

Restriction has stable append-only generation/current pointer, exact originating decision/version, affected-scope manifest/count/hash, current policy/resource epochs, notice/copy receipt and state `ACTIVE | STAYED | SUPERSEDED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`. One active generation exists per exact effect; a generic account flag cannot replace it. `RestorationTaskGeneration` binds plan/owner/resource/effect, expected restriction/resource/data versions, state `PENDING | DISPATCHED | APPLIED | BLOCKED | NOT_APPLICABLE` and signed owner result/version/hash. `REINSTATED` requires an exact complete task-manifest count/hash and every qualifying receipt; stale restoration never removes a newer independent restriction or lawful deletion.

`ComplianceAppeal` является discriminated aggregate: `MANUAL_REVIEW_DECISION | RESTRICTION_DECISION | PROFESSIONAL_VERIFICATION_DECISION(subtype=PERSON_CREDENTIAL|ORGANIZATION_REGISTRATION|PERMIT_SITE_AUTHORIZATION|INSURANCE|PROVIDER_LEGAL_STATUS|WORK_AUTHORIZATION|PROFESSIONAL_RECOGNITION) | IDENTITY_ASSURANCE_DECISION | IDENTITY_MIGRATION_DECISION | LEGAL_CAPACITY_DECISION | COVERAGE_CORRECTION_DECISION`. Он принимает только FlyFy-owned decisions и хранит appealed subject/decision/version, subtype/authoritative owner, grounds, submitted evidence revisions, legal/procedural basis, deadline/timezone, independent reviewer, conflicts, status, due/absolute due, outcome, remedy/restoration link и durable receipts. DB/API validates subtype→owner→decision FK/reference; generic client `decision_kind` cannot route to another owner.

Every adverse result publishes `decision_authority` and `route_kind: FLYFY_INTERNAL_APPEAL | DATA_CORRECTION_OR_DISPUTE | COUNTERPARTY_RECONFIRMATION | EXTERNAL_ISSUER_APPEAL_INFO`, recipient, effect/deadline and evidence semantics. FlyFy verification denial and upheld coverage correction can create ComplianceAppeal without fake RestrictionDecision. Organization refusal to confirm affiliation, issuer/authority permit/recognition refusal, registry source correction or external legal remedy never masquerades as FlyFy appeal: UI offers re-invite/correction/external route, and only a newer signed external receipt can create a new verification/assertion generation. If FlyFy denial also restricts capability, appeal links to separate actual RestrictionDecision. Partial unique permits one active parent proceeding per `(decision_owner,decision_id,decision_version,appellant)`; new/different grounds and evidence are append-only subclaim revisions consolidated under one reviewer/outcome/restoration plan. Concurrent different-ground submit joins/replays the same case, not conflicting appeals.

Appeal lifecycle:

    SUBMITTED → TRIAGED → IN_REVIEW ↔ NEEDS_INFO
      → UPHELD
      → OVERTURNED | PARTIALLY_OVERTURNED → RESTORING ↔ RESTORATION_BLOCKED → REINSTATED

Appeal остаётся каналом двустороннего уточнения facts/circumstances, а не только upload-формой. При OVERTURNED/PARTIALLY_OVERTURNED compliance-service атомарно фиксирует versioned RestorationPlan: overturned restriction/effect ID и version, supersession chain, affected capabilities/data scopes, base resource/data versions, authoritative owners, expected receipts, legal priority, `restore_by`, user-visible interim state и compensation/escalation rules.

Каждая restoration command содержит expected restriction/resource versions и снимает только отменённый effect. Owner выполняет CAS и fresh eligibility/account/restriction/credential/policy/retention/deletion-tombstone checks; новая независимая restriction, expired credential или lawful deletion не перезаписывается старым appeal и возвращает scoped RESTORATION_BLOCKED/NOT_RESTORABLE receipt с безопасной причиной и новым remedy. Удаление, вызванное именно отменённым restriction, не может быть задним числом названо independent lawful deletion.

Каждый owner идемпотентно восстанавливает допустимый scope и подписывает receipt с resulting resource version/checksum; orchestrator сверяет manifest с актуальным impact graph. `REINSTATED` — производное завершённое состояние только при полном наборе RESTORED либо юридически утверждённых independently-not-applicable receipts для отменённого effect. Ошибка одного owner оставляет `RESTORATION_BLOCKED`, создаёт incident и уведомление, но не откатывает уже восстановленные безопасные scopes. Для PARTIALLY_OVERTURNED пользователь отдельно видит, что восстановлено, что остаётся ограниченным и почему.

Подача appeal сама по себе не означает stay. Derived `AppealEffectProjection` читает current restriction/stay decision и имеет closed status `NO_STAY | STAY_REQUESTED | STAYED | PARTIALLY_STAYED | STAY_DENIED | STAY_EXPIRED | SUPERSEDED`. Она хранит appeal/restriction generations, per-action/market `ACTIVE | STAYED` effects, basis, requested/decided/effective/expires timestamps, continuing deadlines/timers и copy version. Projection ничего не авторизует: только current RestrictionDecision generation создаёт/снимает stay. UX одновременно показывает, что ограничено, что временно восстановлено, до какого срока и продолжаются ли procedural deadlines.

Путь прочитать решение и воспользоваться средствами защиты не отключается account suspension/termination/security closure и не ждёт publication outage. Compliance-service owns owner-local `GuideRightsRecoveryAttempt`, `GuideAppealRecoveryAuthorityGeneration` and minimal `GuideRightsWorkspaceCase`. Intake accepts either opaque locator from a published source notice or the exact signed source restriction/effect locator created atomically with an emergency effect; both resolve to one stable rights-case identity and the later notice only enriches it. Generic accountless recovery may discover the current case only after proportional verification; login/error response and pre-verification API use uniform anti-enumeration shape/timing and never reveal whether an account, effect or notice exists. Lost phone/email/device always has staffed recovery. Lifecycle: `REQUESTED → VERIFICATION_PENDING | LOCKED_ABUSE | EXPIRED`; pending → `VERIFIED | VERIFICATION_FAILED_SAFE | LOCKED_ABUSE | EXPIRED`; failed/locked may retry only after policy cooldown or signed human unlock. Verification never restores the account.

VERIFIED mints a digest-only, short-lived, audience/device-bound, one-case authority with exact person/case/decision/restriction/effect/appeal generations, current optional notice generation and, when the original notice is an Article 31 possible match, exact response-case/check generations; it carries JTI, allowed operations and current pointer. Allowed set is closed: `READ_EMERGENCY_INTERIM_STATUS | READ_NOTICE | READ_RESTRICTION | SUBMIT_APPEAL | READ_APPEAL | READ_APPEAL_EFFECT | REQUEST_STAY | SUBMIT_INFORMATION | READ_RESTORATION | READ_ART31_RESPONSE_CASE | SAVE_ART31_RESPONSE_DRAFT | SUBMIT_ART31_RESPONSE | READ_ART31_RESPONSE_RECEIPT | REQUEST_SUPPORT`. `READ_EMERGENCY_INTERIM_STATUS` is emitted only from the exact source effect binding and exposes no draft notice or secret safety evidence. `REQUEST_STAY` is emitted only where the current policy/legal rule exposes a requestable stay and is bound to exact appeal/restriction/action generations; Article 31 operations are emitted only for the exact response case/check from the original opaque recovery locator. Elsewhere the workspace can only read applicable status. It cannot authenticate a normal session, publish/sell/start, change contact/payment, withdraw funds, see sampling seed/population/raw registry query or access another case. Authority lifecycle `ACTIVE → CONSUMED_PURPOSE | SUPERSEDED_RENEWED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`; compromise revokes a token, never the rights-recovery route. Workspace interim status, linked notice, Article 31 response, appeal submission, stay request/effect and restoration status remain available to locked/former/terminated/migrated accounts with immutable original deadline and the same owner-side server commit receipt. Expiry/re-exchange or later notice publication does not reset case, draft, response revision, appeal or deadline.

`CancelManualReviewCase` is allowed through current QUEUED/TRIAGED/IN_REVIEW/NEEDS_INFO/ESCALATED state before durable final decision. It requires case-generation CAS and idempotency, releases the reviewer lease, appends `CANCELLED_BY_USER` receipt and never creates denial/restriction or deletes evidence. Impact preview shows affected future actions, existing-booking behavior, retention/deletion route and reapplication path; cancellation reason is optional. If cancel commits first, stale reviewer decision fails; if decision commits first, cancel returns typed conflict plus appeal route. Reapplication creates a linked new case.

### 6.12 PurposeRetentionLedger

Retention назначается полю/копии по purpose, legal basis и jurisdiction. Один атрибут может иметь DSA и tax purpose с разными сроками, но хранится в логически разделённых datasets и доступен разным ролям.

Append-only audit не означает вечное хранение PII. Audit records псевдонимизируются или очищаются по утверждённому сроку; legal hold имеет отдельное основание, scope и expiry.

Consent-withdrawal recovery claims/challenge payload имеют короткий отдельный retention и удаляются после verification/expiry; долговременно сохраняются только минимальные attempt outcome, controller/purpose/target binding, anti-abuse signal, authority consumption и withdrawal receipt, если это необходимо для accountability/dispute. Эти записи не используются для marketing, identity enrichment или нового account profile.

ADR platform/body/stop receipts, authority histories, ExecutionObligation/manifests/plans, result/discovery/task-binding/assessment/contribution/deficit/incident generations, observations/instances/aliases/lineages, canonicalization/identity/validity/cross-referral/global-reassessment/exposure, intervening-order, projection-set, case/item/successor records разделяют consumer-dispute, accounting, fraud/security и legal-claim purposes. Raw body/provider evidence, communications и minimized audit имеют отдельные retention/hold rules и purpose ABAC; journal хранит нужные refs/hashes, не complaint narrative. Удаление raw evidence не удаляет до approved replay horizon минимальные required-source/finality/slot/net/conservation/exposure watermarks, fingerprints/hashes, alias→instance→group/lineage generations, allocation/assessment/deficit/disposition/projection checksums, skip edges, stop membership, idempotency tombstones и cryptographic causation chain, необходимые доказать three-axis chronology, correction/reopen и отсутствие lost/double effect; затем данные удаляются/анонимизируются при отсутствии scoped hold.

### 6.12.1 ProcessingRestrictionGeneration

GDPR restriction of processing is not a generic request status and never reuses product `RestrictionDecision`. Privacy-service is the single writer of one current `ProcessingRestrictionGeneration` per atomic scope cell `(controller_legal_entity_id, opaque_subject_binding, purpose_id, canonical_dataset_partition_id)`. A multi-purpose/dataset PrivacyRequest composes several cells through a complete expected/observed owner-task manifest. Each generation pins request/original submitted_at, applicable law/source/counsel, current processing-topology epoch, exact dataset/copy lineage and field scope, monotonic `restriction_epoch`, ordered processing-fence key count/hash, owner/processor/subprocessor and Article 19 recipient manifests, exception authorities, pre-lift notice receipt, prior/current pointer, owner/due/next/absolute due and safe projection.

Grounds are an append-only active member set, so resolving one never lifts another intersecting ground: `ACCURACY_CONTESTED | UNLAWFUL_PROCESSING_ERASURE_OPPOSED | CONTROLLER_NO_LONGER_NEEDS_SUBJECT_NEEDS_LEGAL_CLAIMS | ARTICLE21_OBJECTION_PENDING_BALANCING | NON_EU_EXACT_GROUND`. Lifecycle is closed: `APPLYING → APPLYING_RECONCILING → ACTIVE`; `ACTIVE → APPLYING_RECONCILING` on topology/member drift; `ACTIVE | APPLYING_RECONCILING → PRE_LIFT_NOTICE_DUE → PRE_LIFT_NOTICE_PUBLISHED → LIFT_PREPARED → LIFTING → LIFTING_RECONCILING → LIFTED`; a new ground or aborted lift from any pre-commit lift state returns to APPLYING_RECONCILING. `LIFTED` is immutable; a later restriction is a linked successor. There is no fail-open FAILED state, and restriction/retention/legal hold/deletion remain independent axes.

The privacy fencing namespace has hierarchical keys `PROCESSING_PURPOSE(controller,subject,purpose)` and `PROCESSING_DATASET(controller,subject,purpose,dataset_partition)` with lifecycle `OPEN(epoch n) → DRAINING_APPLY(epoch n+1) → RESTRICTED(epoch n+1) → PREPARING_LIFT(epoch n+2) → OPEN(epoch n+2)`. Governed operation class is closed: `STORAGE_ONLY | READ_USE | MUTATE | PROFILE | INDEX_SEARCH | MODEL_TRAINING | DISCLOSE | EXPORT | DELETE | RESTORE | PROCESSOR_DISPATCH`. STORAGE_ONLY means preservation, integrity and backup containment only; analytics, search, personalization, model use, public projection, disclosure and restore into active use are non-storage. Every HTTP handler, worker, OCR/AI job, indexer, ranking/recommendation/analytics/marketing path, public projector, vendor export and restore flow acquires a bounded local lease and repeats the exact epoch/intersection check in its authoritative transaction. Apply and normal-processing Mark serialize on the same fence CAS; a winning apply prohibits new/renewed intersecting non-storage work immediately. Already STARTED work is never called no-effect by timeout and must return a factual outcome receipt while the restriction stays reconciling. Backup restore loads current epochs before workers start.

Owner manifest comes from the processing-purpose/RoPA matrix, live lineage and processor/subprocessor registry. Every `INTERNAL_OWNER | PROCESSOR | SUBPROCESSOR` member receives a monotonic controller instruction and returns a signed receipt bound to restriction/scope/fence/topology generations, exact operation classes and disposition `APPLIED | NO_DATA_PROVEN | ISOLATED_NO_NEW_PROCESSING | UNKNOWN_RECONCILING`. `NO_DATA_PROVEN` requires an authoritative lookup manifest; missing callback is not proof. An unconfirmed processor/subprocessor is isolated from new flows and keeps the aggregate reconciling; Article 19 “impossible/disproportionate” cannot substitute contractual enforcement. A newly discovered subprocessor under an active restriction is default-blocked until it joins the manifest and applies the current sequence. Events are recovery/observability transport, never the correctness fence.

Non-storage processing requires one-use `RestrictedProcessingExceptionAuthority` bound to restriction/fence epoch, exact operation/dataset/fields/purpose/recipient/minimization, execute-before, JTI, outcome receipt and closed exception `GDPR_ART18_2_DATA_SUBJECT_CONSENT | GDPR_ART18_2_LEGAL_CLAIMS | GDPR_ART18_2_RIGHTS_OF_ANOTHER | GDPR_ART18_2_IMPORTANT_PUBLIC_INTEREST_EU_OR_MS | GDPR_ART23_EXACT_LEGISLATIVE_RESTRICTION | NON_EU_EXACT_EXCEPTION`. Consent needs a separate specific informed affirmative receipt; legal claims need an exact case/necessity scope; another person's rights need documented necessity/proportionality and Legal/DPO approval. Generic contract, fraud, security, support, legal-obligation label or admin override is not an exception.
