Authority never lifts the restriction, cannot cross scope/recipient or replay, and a started authority cannot expire/revoke into false no-effect.

`GDPR_ART23_EXACT_LEGISLATIVE_RESTRICTION` additionally requires a current `Article23DeterminationGeneration`, never a free-text source reference. It pins controller/processor, exact EU or Member-State legislative measure/source/version/effective interval, exact restricted Articles 12–22/34 obligation or right and corresponding Article 5 provision where applicable, Article 23(1)(a)–(j) objective, respect for the essence of fundamental rights, necessity/proportionality analysis and relevant Article 23(2)(a)–(h) particulars: purposes/categories, restriction scope, anti-abuse/unlawful-access safeguards, controller(s), storage periods/safeguards, data-subject risks and subject-information rules. It also contains exact operation/scope applicability, counsel, maker/checker, review/expiry and a subject-notice determination `REQUIRED | WITHHELD_AS_PREJUDICIAL` with reason and next review. Lifecycle is `DRAFT → LEGAL_REVIEW → APPROVED → EXPIRED | REVOKED | SUPERSEDED`; only a current APPROVED generation may be pinned, and an execution authority cannot exceed it. Missing element, generic policy, wrong controller/operation, expired source or withheld-notice rationale makes the path unavailable.

Before lift, active ground count must be zero and no newer request/appeal/stay may intersect. Existing durable-notice infrastructure publishes subtype `PRIVACY_PROCESSING_RESTRICTION_PRE_LIFT` with exact scope, intended resumed processing, safe reason, planned time, support/objection/appeal and accessible accountless route. A queued/provider-accepted callback alone is insufficient; the current counsel-approved satisfaction receipt must precede lift. Owners/processors/subprocessors first acknowledge LIFT_PREPARED while continuing enforcement, then one privacy CAS opens the central epoch, and local owners accept only the matching signed lift receipt. A new apply before that CAS aborts lift; after it, a successor restriction wins a newer epoch. Delayed vendor/local lift with stale sequence is rejected.

`Article19RecipientManifest` is built from the authoritative disclosure ledger, separately from active processor enforcement. Every actual recipient member is `DUE → PREPARED → DISPATCHED_CONFIRMED | DISPATCHED_RECONCILING`, or receives per-recipient `IMPOSSIBLE_APPROVED | DISPROPORTIONATE_EFFORT_APPROVED` with evidence, alternative measure, review date and DPO/Legal maker-checker; blanket category exemption is invalid. A late-discovered historical recipient appends a successor manifest and reopens recipient reconciliation without undoing the effective restriction. On subject request the API returns the privacy-safe actual recipient list and status. PrivacyRequest cannot claim FULFILLED, restriction cannot claim ACTIVE, and lift cannot claim LIFTED from incomplete manifests applicable to those respective states.

Official legal baseline: [GDPR Articles 4(3), 18, 19, 23 and Recital 67](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2016/679/oj/eng). The product targets above operationalize restriction and recipient communication; local counsel must still compile any Member-State or non-EU scope, exception and deadline rather than treating the EU model as universal.

### 6.13 AIUseCaseInventory и AIActAssessment

AIUseCaseInventory является single source of truth для AI-enabled features и хранит owner, system/model/vendor/version, intended purpose, affected users, data categories, markets, integration points, autonomy, fallback, status и material-change triggers.

Immutable AIActAssessment хранит legal role, prohibited-practice screening, risk classification, applicable obligations/dates, evidence links, vendor assessment, DPIA/FRIA references, human-oversight design, test cohorts/results, approved_at/review_due и superseding version. Production feature flag не может включить AI use case без актуального APPROVED assessment; выключение AI оставляет deterministic/manual fallback и не теряет пользовательские данные или appeal path.

### 6.14 FinancialExecutionAuthority

`FinancialExecutionAuthority` is one canonical payment-service aggregate and the only credential that may cross the PSP/bank provider boundary. Booking-service emits signed `BookingFinancialOperationIntent`, complaint-service — `ADRFinancialOperationIntent`, payout use case — `PayoutOperationIntent`; these owner-local intents cannot invoke a provider and payment-service validates their exact current source generations before minting authority in its own transaction. `financial_authority_source_intent_uq` permits at most one authority per exact source intent/plan/slot/operation generation; `financial_authority_provider_operation_uq` permits one provider identity. Source-service DB roles have no write privilege to the authority store. Discriminator is closed: `BOOKING_PAYMENT | REFUND | PAYOUT | ADR_REMEDY | ADR_REMEDIATION | RESTITUTION`; mutually exclusive subtype fields are DB/schema-enforced. Lifecycle is `ISSUED → RESERVED → STARTED → CONSUMED`; `ISSUED → EXPIRED | REVOKED`; `RESERVED → ABORTED | EXPIRED`; `STARTED → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → RECONCILED_CONSUMED | RECONCILED_NO_EFFECT`. Started generation is never superseded/expired and reconciliation uses the same provider idempotency identity.

FinancialExecutionAuthority разрешает ровно одну внешнюю provider operation и содержит:

- authority_id и kind: USER_DELEGATED_PRE_OBLIGATION либо SERVICE_OBLIGATION;
- source authorization_id либо immutable ContractObligationRecord/ContractFormationObservation/BOOKING_COMMITTED/consumer-remedy/ADRRemedyExecutionAuthority/ADRRemediationExecutionAuthority/payout/payable-ledger + PayoutMandate reference;
- operation, payment aggregate, booking_attempt_id и payment/payout generation;
- для повторной booking payment operation — exact predecessor/descendant payment generations, current `PaymentRetrySafetyFenceGeneration`, signed one-use `MarkPaymentRetryChargeStartedReceipt`, immutable signed `ProviderOutcomeLookupManifest` ID/hash, complete expected/observed member count+ordered hash, pinned `PaymentProviderOutcomeCapability` generation/digest для каждого provider account/API/operation kind и stable shared charge-exposure key; authority без этих bindings, с incomplete/stale/ambiguous lookup member либо с fence не в `RETRY_CHARGE_STARTED` не может перейти в STARTED;
- amount, currency, merchant/account/destination;
- context, contract, quote, payment-role, funds-flow, tax и provider-config hashes;
- expected aggregate state/version;
- для любой FlyFy-initiated operation, которая создаёт/корректирует consumer benefit, booking/service state, refund/credit/goodwill/tax/dispute effect либо может пересечься с другой command, — mandatory `effect_exposure_scope` с stable measure_dimension/cap_scope, typed action_class/direction, approved provisional-policy version, AttemptEffectPlan либо эквивалентным immutable operation plan/hash, current ledger epoch и single-use token; `exposure_not_applicable` допустим только по versioned approved operation-class policy, а не по отсутствующему полю;
- для ADR-derived operation дополнительно — discriminated `adr_authority_kind: OUTCOME_REMEDY | EFFECT_REMEDIATION`, authority id/version, referral, exact current `external_order_resolution_version`, planned EffectAttemptKey, base `ExecutionObligation` kind/id/generation, `ObligationEffectManifest` ID/hash и slot, immutable `AttemptEffectPlan` ID/hash, required-source policy/hash. OUTCOME_REMEDY несёт outcome/party-decision/remedy versions и `adr_remedy_authority_epoch`; EFFECT_REMEDIATION — `adr_remediation_epoch`, target `EXISTING_EFFECT_LINEAGE` с canonical lineage/group/member-set generations либо `EXPECTED_EFFECT_DEFICIT` без искусственных source/group IDs, current result/discovery/assessment/deficit/identity/validity/incident/allocation/global-reassessment/net/case/item versions, correction generation, action class `HARMFUL | CONSUMER_PROTECTIVE_INTERIM | FINAL_REMEDY`, lawful amount/currency и cap. Оба вида несут authoritative owner;
- issued_at, execute_before, audience, command_id/idempotency key, signature и consumed/provider-operation reference.

Он не продлевает legal authorization: pre-obligation authority expires вместе с source decision; service-obligation authority доказывает ограниченное исполнение уже возникшего obligation и не разрешает новый purchase. Для любой governed FlyFy-initiated operation handler до local/provider boundary вызывает независимый `execution-control-service.ReserveExposure`, затем immediately-before-effect `MarkExposureStarted`; ADR path поверх этого вызывает authority-specific Reserve/Mark. Для booking retry payment-service непосредственно перед STARTED дополнительно обязан получить current signed `MarkPaymentRetryChargeStartedReceipt`; reserve либо созданная PSP session сами по себе не дают права вызвать provider. Late-capture safety correction, выигравшая booking CAS до этого receipt, может отозвать только ISSUED/RESERVED authority; STARTED authority никогда не retro-revoke-ится и остаётся OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/reconciliation с тем же idempotency identity. Если поздний provider effect обнаружен после terminal/no-effect/refund projection, payment-service также переоткрывает exact shared exposure как `EXTERNAL_UNRESERVED_DISCOVERED` (либо over-cap), а booking lineage остаётся frozen до полного disposition всех generations.

Owner атомарно со своим local/provider receipt пишет outbox; execution-control idempotently применяет receipt и Consume/Release, а complaint/другой source owner хранит только signed refs/receipts. Crash/partition оставляет STARTED_RESIDUAL без нового headroom, а lookup/reconciliation завершает результат — cross-service atomic commit не предполагается. Provider/bank-initiated effect, который FlyFy объективно не мог pre-reserve, немедленно materialize-ится как `EXTERNAL_UNRESERVED_DISCOVERED` exposure+incident/freeze и reconciliation evidence; он не masquerade-ится pre-authorized и не игнорируется. OUTCOME_REMEDY сверяет current order/remedy epoch, obligation/manifest/slot/plan/attempt/required-source/assessment generations; EFFECT_REMEDIATION — current order/remediation epoch, target и весь discovery/result/identity/validity/incident/deficit/allocation/global-reassessment/net/item/plan/financial envelope. Stale data, wrong target/action/cap, phantom lineage, incomplete payload, alias conflict, revoked authority, missing/stale exposure token или timeout отклоняются до FlyFy-initiated effect без cached fallback.

### 6.15 PayoutAccount и PayoutMethod

PayoutAccount отделён от конкретной Payout и хранит seller/legal-entity binding, enabled rails/currencies, provider account reference, onboarding/KYB state, active method token/reference, masked presentation, beneficiary-match assertion, PayoutMandate/schedule reference, configuration hash/version и audit. Raw bank/card credentials не проходят через FlyFy, если PSP-hosted/tokenized integration позволяет этого избежать.

Lifecycle настройки:

    PayoutAccount generation:
      NOT_CONFIGURED → PENDING_VERIFICATION → ACTIVE ↔ SUSPENDED
      ACTIVE | SUSPENDED → CLOSING → CLOSED

    PayoutMethodAttempt:
      CREATED → ONBOARDING → VERIFYING → VERIFIED → COOLDOWN → ACTIVATED
      ONBOARDING | VERIFYING → FAILED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED
      COOLDOWN → REVERTED
      FAILED | CANCELLED | EXPIRED → NEW_GENERATION_CREATED

Каждая onboarding/update попытка имеет immutable attempt_id/generation; FAILED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED не переоткрывается, а explicit retry создаёт новую generation с новым one-time provider session и ссылкой на прежний результат. Для update старый ACTIVE method остаётся неизменным до ACTIVATED; REVERTED/CANCELLED сохраняют его. Для first setup PayoutAccount остаётся NOT_CONFIGURED до activation.

Candidate method не заменяет active method до verification, cooldown и effective_at. На каждом переходе явно фиксируется судьба SCHEDULED payouts: остаться на подтверждённом старом rail, перейти в HELD либо дождаться нового method; решение следует approved market/PSP risk policy и заранее показывается пользователю. Setup/update требует recent step-up auth, owner/tenant binding, one-time PSP-hosted session, idempotency и reconciliation. Смена инициирует уведомления по старому и новому verified channel, cooling-off window, cancel/revert path и anti-takeover escalation. Support не может мгновенно подменить destination: high-risk override требует independent verification, two-person approval и immutable audit.

`CLOSED` is terminal for that account generation and is not forfeiture or loss of access. Close requires no PROCESSING/unknown provider operation, immutable payable/held/returned/reversed inventory and an approved ExistingFundsCapacityDisposition/settlement route for every non-zero amount; scheduled mandate is stopped without cancelling already owed funds. Closure writes reason-safe receipt and read-only recovery authority. Active, locked, former or deleted-account payee can still access balance, disposition, payout/return receipts, export, appeal/support through proportional account-recovery. “Reopen” creates a linked new PayoutAccount generation/current pointer after current capacity/identity/rail checks and never transitions the CLOSED generation; where reopen is unavailable, verified new destination, lawful representative/organization or manual restitution route settles remaining funds. No close command can erase ledger principal, redirect PROCESSING generation or require restoration of the old account merely to receive owed funds.

PayoutMandate versioned фиксирует MANUAL_REQUEST либо SCHEDULED mode, cadence/timezone, minimum threshold, currencies/rail, ACTIVE destination snapshot rule, effective_at и user-visible terms/receipt. Смена schedule не перенаправляет уже PROCESSING generation; pause/closure не превращает seller payable в доход FlyFy и запускает lawful settlement/remediation. EXECUTE_SCHEDULED_PAYOUT всегда ссылается на current mandate version.

### 6.16 ConsumerComplaint и ADRReferral

ConsumerComplaint является отдельным case, а не свободным support ticket. Он хранит complainant, booking/transaction, respondent/contracting party, issue/remedy taxonomy, safe free-text/evidence, submitted/acknowledged/due/next_update timestamps, language/accessibility needs, durable communications, resolution и linked cancellation/refund/payment/restriction cases.

`ExternalIntakeAuthorityAssessment` запрещает считать платформенный submit юридическим эффектом по умолчанию. В этом programme executable kinds ограничены `CONSUMER_COMPLAINT | CANCELLATION`; `SELLER_NOTICE` и generic `CLAIM` не входят в enum/command/API до отдельного approved vertical. Assessment versioned фиксирует contracting recipient, уполномочена ли FlyFy договором/законом принимать сообщение с external effect, recognised channel, exact event making it effective, statutory/contract deadline и source/counsel approval. `ExternalIntakeAttempt` имеет stable ID, kind/resource/party, append-only generation/prior/current pointer, assessment/source versions, separate timestamps `platform_received_at`, `external_dispatched_at`, `recipient_received_at`, `legal_effective_at`, effect `EVIDENCE_ONLY | LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE | UNRESOLVED`, delivery generation/evidence, retry key, owner/next/absolute due и corrected receipt. Partial unique обеспечивает one current attempt generation per resource+intent, а external idempotency identity не меняется при safe retry. Platform receipt всегда durable и сохраняет пользовательское намерение, но deadline/отмена/жалоба считаются effective только при current assessment+required evidence. Unknown/failed delivery оставляет service/booking legal state неизменным, показывает urgent assisted/direct-recipient route и не дублирует command; later correction supersede-ит receipt и запускает governed remediation.

`AssistedDeadlineCase` makes that fallback executable. It is resource-owner local (`booking-service` for cancellation, `complaint-service` for complaint) and stores stable case ID, owner-bound party/resource/intent, assessment/attempt/platform receipt, recipient/channel, external legal timezone/deadline, status `OPEN | ASSISTING | USER_EVIDENCE_SUBMITTED | VERIFYING | AUTHORITATIVELY_DELIVERED | EVIDENCE_ONLY_UNRESOLVED | FAILED | CLOSED`, support owner, created/due/next/absolute due, account-recovery/accessibility path, external idempotency identity and immutable receipts. A purpose-bound user external receipt is recorded immediately as EVIDENCE_ONLY, scanned/verified through authoritative lookup, then may supersede delivery/effect and suppress duplicate FlyFy dispatch only after proof. Failure preserves intent and nearest deadline; no status promises filing/tolling before current rule+evidence. Every state has one safe next action, escalation and corrected receipt.

`AssistedDeadlineRecoveryAuthorityAttempt` makes locked/former/accountless access explicit and remains owner-local: booking-service for cancellation and complaint-service for complaint. Public intake accepts an opaque recovery locator issued with the original platform receipt or a minimized reference plus verification channel. Lifecycle is closed: `REQUESTED→VERIFICATION_PENDING|LOCKED_ABUSE|EXPIRED`; `VERIFICATION_PENDING→VERIFIED|VERIFICATION_FAILED_SAFE|LOCKED_ABUSE|EXPIRED`; `VERIFICATION_FAILED_SAFE→VERIFICATION_PENDING|LOCKED_ABUSE|EXPIRED`; `LOCKED_ABUSE→VERIFICATION_PENDING|EXPIRED` only after policy cooldown or signed human unlock. Before VERIFIED every existent/non-existent path returns the same HTTP status/schema/body-size bucket and bounded timing class. Selector/contact values are keyed-HMAC only; no case/account existence, recipient, owner or deadline is disclosed. Verification is proportional, accessible and never biometric-only; identity-service may return a signed verification receipt but cannot mint resource authority. Failed/abuse states always expose a safe retry time or human accessibility route without requiring account restoration.

After VERIFIED, the resource owner mints append-only `AssistedDeadlineRecoveryAuthorityGeneration`: `ACTIVE → SUPERSEDED_RENEWED | REVOKED | EXPIRED | PURPOSE_COMPLETED`. A digest-only one-time exchange returns a short-lived audience-bound token with opaque authority root/generation/jti, exact party/resource/intent/case generations, verification receipt/strength, allowed operations, expiry and `cnf` device/DPoP binding where available. Allowed operations are only `READ_CASE_STATUS | DOWNLOAD_PURPOSE_BUNDLE | SUBMIT_INFORMATION | SUBMIT_EXTERNAL_RECEIPT | REQUEST_ACCESSIBLE_CALLBACK`; cancellation creation, complaint withdrawal, settlement acceptance, payment/contact change and another resource are impossible. Every request checks current authority/case generation. Renewal preserves subject/resource/intent/action set, rotates and supersedes the old generation and re-verifies when proof freshness/risk changed. Expiry/revoke never deletes the platform receipt, resets the deadline or restores the account.

ComplaintApplicabilitySnapshot фиксирует market, seller/FlyFy responsibility routing, applicable complaint clocks, обязательность/добровольность ADR, competent ADR body/cross-border channel, disclosure template/version, versioned ADRWithdrawalRule, ADRDeadlineAssessment и supersession dates. ADRDeadlineAssessment хранит source/version, `limitation_or_filing_deadline`, legal timezone, `tolling_status: CONTINUES | ENDS_AT | RESUMES_AT | UNKNOWN`, соответствующие ends/resumes timestamps, recognised intake channel, required_next_action и evidence confidence. UNKNOWN не превращается в безопасное предположение. Внутренняя complaint и внешний ADR не используют один перегруженный status. Lifecycle ConsumerComplaint:

    DRAFT → SUBMITTED → ROUTED → ACKNOWLEDGED → IN_REVIEW ↔ NEEDS_INFO
    IN_REVIEW → RESOLUTION_PROPOSED → AWAITING_DECISION
    AWAITING_DECISION → ACCEPTED → REMEDY_PENDING → COMPLIED → RESOLVED → CLOSED
    AWAITING_DECISION → DECLINED | EXPIRED → IN_REVIEW | DEADLOCKED
    IN_REVIEW → UNCONDITIONAL_REMEDY_PENDING → COMPLIED → RESOLVED → CLOSED
    IN_REVIEW | NEEDS_INFO | DEADLOCKED → WITHDRAWN → CLOSED
    IN_REVIEW → DEADLOCKED → ADR_ELIGIBLE → ADR_IN_PROGRESS
    ADR_IN_PROGRESS → DEADLOCKED | REMEDY_PENDING
    COMPLIED | RESOLVED | CLOSED(closed_reason=REMEDY_FULFILLED)
      → REMEDY_REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED → REMEDY_PENDING
      только при current fulfilment invalidation/reopen

Primary adjudication lifecycle связанного ADRReferral:

    REFERRED → EXTERNAL_PENDING
    REFERRED | EXTERNAL_PENDING → ADR_OUTCOME_RECEIVED
    ADR_OUTCOME_RECEIVED → BINDING_FINAL → REMEDY_PENDING
    ADR_OUTCOME_RECEIVED → AWAITING_PARTY_ACCEPTANCE
    AWAITING_PARTY_ACCEPTANCE → ACCEPTED → REMEDY_PENDING
    AWAITING_PARTY_ACCEPTANCE → DECLINED → CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT(closed_reason=PARTY_DECLINED)
    ADRWithdrawalRule.allowed_stages current non-final state → ADR_WITHDRAWN
      только после rule-sufficient effect + current EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL order resolution
    ADR_WITHDRAWN → CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT(closed_reason=WITHDRAWAL_EFFECTIVE)
    REMEDY_PENDING → COMPLIED → CLOSED
    REMEDY_PENDING → NONCOMPLIANT → ENFORCEMENT_ESCALATED → CLOSED
    BINDING_FINAL | REMEDY_PENDING → CHALLENGED → EXTERNAL_PENDING
    COMPLIED | CLOSED(closed_reason=REMEDY_FULFILLED)
      → REMEDY_REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED → REMEDY_PENDING
    ADR_WITHDRAWN | CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT(closed_reason=WITHDRAWAL_EFFECTIVE) → ADR_OUTCOME_RECEIVED
      только через superseding EFFECTIVE_OUTCOME reclassification и safe reopening

Current complaint/referral state является pointer на append-only `ComplaintResolutionStateGeneration` с discriminator `subject_kind: CONSUMER_COMPLAINT | ADR_REFERRAL`, subject_id, subject-specific state/transition constraint, prior generation, cause, closure_reason, current obligation/assessment/projection-set versions, original compliance/final receipt, reopened_at, owner/due/next/absolute due и corrected notice. Partial unique гарантирует ровно один current generation на `(subject_kind,subject_id)`; complaint-only state не может попасть в referral и наоборот. Fulfilment FULL→PARTIAL/NONE/ASSESSMENT_PENDING одной transaction append-ит две причинно связанные generations — historical `REMEDY_REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED`, затем единственную current `REMEDY_PENDING` — с shared transition_correlation_id, fences stale closure/authorities and preserves prior receipt. Если меняются оба subjects, та же transaction/outbox связывает два независимых generation chains, не создавая общий status. Reopen допускается только для remedy-derived COMPLIED/RESOLVED/CLOSED; WITHDRAWN, PARTY_DECLINED, WITHDRAWAL_EFFECTIVE и unrelated closure reasons не переписываются. Consumer/tourist UI показывает «решение переоткрыто после новой информации», а не исчезновение прошлого success.

`ADRRespondentSubmission` имеет stable submission_id per referral/respondent, append-only response revision/current pointer, states `DRAFT | SUBMITTED_PENDING_SCAN | ACCEPTED | ACCEPTED_WITH_QUARANTINED_ATTACHMENTS | NEEDS_INFO | REJECTED_UNSAFE_UNSEPARABLE | SUPERSEDED`, issue-level structured answers, per-attachment `PENDING_SCAN | ACCEPTED | QUARANTINED | REJECTED` refs, redaction-safe platform receipt, `platform_received_at`, response deadline, owner/next update and command idempotency. Platform receipt committed до asynchronous scan и доказывает своевременное обращение в FlyFy, но не объявляет внешнюю юридическую доставку/сохранение срока. Небезопасный attachment карантинится отдельно: safe structured answer/другие attachments и original receipt сохраняются, пользователь получает точную причину, cure window и безопасную replacement/direct-channel возможность. Whole submission `REJECTED_UNSAFE_UNSEPARABLE` допустим только когда опасный content технически нельзя отделить, с human escalation и без потери chronology. Concurrent stale If-Match cannot overwrite newer draft/accepted response; resubmit creates new revision and preserves chronology.

Для route, где FlyFy должен доставить response внешнему ADR body, `ADRRespondentResponseDeliveryAttempt` имеет stable attempt/generation, submission revision, recognised channel/rule/deadline versions, states `PLATFORM_ONLY | DISPATCHING | EXTERNALLY_DELIVERED | UNRESOLVED | FAILED`, external_dispatched_at/body_received_at, `receipt_effect: EVIDENCE_ONLY | LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE | UNRESOLVED`, tolling/deadline treatment, evidence hash, retry generation, owner/due/next/absolute due и immutable receipts. Lifecycle: `PLATFORM_ONLY→DISPATCHING|UNRESOLVED`; `DISPATCHING→EXTERNALLY_DELIVERED|UNRESOLVED|FAILED`; `UNRESOLVED|FAILED→DISPATCHING|EXTERNALLY_DELIVERED`; `EXTERNALLY_DELIVERED→UNRESOLVED` только по newer signed invalidation/correction с durable corrected notice. Scan/adapter delay никогда не превращает platform receipt в legal-effective proof. До authoritative EXTERNALLY_DELIVERED UI показывает ближайший внешний срок, что FlyFy ещё не подтвердил доставку, urgent assisted/direct-body fallback и downloadable response bundle; approved rule определяет, считается ли platform intake timely. Same-key retry не дублирует response, а external rejection/unknown сохраняет chronology и escalation.

`ADRRespondentDisclosureRequest` закрывает чрезмерную redaction: stable request_id, referral/respondent, requested evidence/item and redaction snapshot/hash, reason, party/procedure/rule versions, submitted_at and lifecycle `SUBMITTED → TRIAGED`; `TRIAGED → DISCLOSED | PARTIALLY_DISCLOSED | REDACTION_UPHELD | NEEDS_INFO | ESCALATED`; `NEEDS_INFO | ESCALATED → TRIAGED`; decision terminals `DISCLOSED | PARTIALLY_DISCLOSED | REDACTION_UPHELD → REOPENED → TRIAGED`. Каждый generation хранит decision basis, disclosed replacement snapshot, reviewer/maker-checker where sensitive, due/next/absolute due, deadline-treatment assessment and durable receipt/appeal. Response/reflection deadline tolling или extension не предполагается: применяется только по approved rule; иначе Ops обеспечивает expedited review/assisted response and records external deadline separately. ABAC/minimization prevents disclosure of claimant/third-party data beyond what is necessary for meaningful response.

Withdrawal не захватывает primary status до доказанного legal effect; это ортогональный versioned ADRWithdrawalAttempt:

    NOT_REQUESTED → ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED → ADR_WITHDRAWAL_DISPATCHED
    ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED | ADR_WITHDRAWAL_DISPATCHED → ADR_WITHDRAWAL_EFFECTIVE
    ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED | ADR_WITHDRAWAL_DISPATCHED
      → ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REJECTED | ADR_WITHDRAWAL_NOT_EFFECTIVE | ADR_WITHDRAWAL_ACK_UNKNOWN
    ADR_WITHDRAWAL_ACK_UNKNOWN
      → ADR_WITHDRAWAL_EFFECTIVE | ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REJECTED | ADR_WITHDRAWAL_NOT_EFFECTIVE
    ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REJECTED | ADR_WITHDRAWAL_NOT_EFFECTIVE
      → NEW_ATTEMPT_CREATED, если право ещё доступно

`ExitADR` является единственным orchestration contract для пользовательского «Выйти из ADR» на любой разрешённой стадии. Одна complaint-service CAS-транзакция создаёт либо продолжает ADRWithdrawalAttempt; если current ADR outcome уже существует, она одновременно добавляет связанный immutable `ADRPartyDecisionReceipt(WITHDRAW)` со статусом `RECORDED_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL_EFFECT`. Этот party receipt доказывает выбор пользователя, но сам по себе не делает withdrawal effective и не закрывает ADR. Дублирующий post-outcome decision endpoint не создаёт второй withdrawal path.

Пока attempt ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REQUESTED/ADR_WITHDRAWAL_DISPATCHED/ADR_WITHDRAWAL_ACK_UNKNOWN, primary adjudication может независимо получить ADR_OUTCOME_RECEIVED. `ADR_WITHDRAWN` и следующий `CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT` являются производными states для current resolution version и допустимы только когда immutable WithdrawalEffectEvidence удовлетворяет ADRWithdrawalRule, а current ADRExternalOrderResolution классифицирует `EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL`. ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REJECTED/ADR_WITHDRAWAL_NOT_EFFECTIVE оставляют primary state неизменным, а underlying ConsumerComplaint — открытой.

Versioned ADRExternalOrderResolution является третьей ортогональной lane:

    NOT_EVALUATED → EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL | EFFECTIVE_OUTCOME | ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED
    EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL | EFFECTIVE_OUTCOME | ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED
      → EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL | EFFECTIVE_OUTCOME | ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED
      только новой superseding version при новом authoritative receipt/rule evidence

Каждая классификация ссылается на обе receipt versions, authoritative-input watermark, ADRWithdrawalRule, resolver version и signed/manual resolution evidence; изменение выполняется CAS и создаёт superseding receipt, а не переписывает историю. Primary state, current resolution version и order-resolution version материализуются атомарно. `ADR_WITHDRAWN/CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT` при current `EFFECTIVE_OUTCOME` и outcome/acceptance/remedy state при current `EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL` являются invariant violation, а не допустимой eventual consistency.

Поздний authoritative receipt может supersede даже ранее EFFECTIVE classification. Переход EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL → EFFECTIVE_OUTCOME безопасно reopen-ит ADR_WITHDRAWN либо CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT только с `closed_reason=WITHDRAWAL_EFFECTIVE` в ADR_OUTCOME_RECEIVED и затем в рассчитанный outcome substate; PARTY_DECLINED closure он не переписывает. Одна complaint-service transaction атомарно сохраняет superseding resolution, открывает primary state, восстанавливает platform response window не короче заново раскрытого reasonable reflection period и создаёт ровно одну current `ADRCorrectedNoticeIntentGeneration` вместе с complaint outbox. Notification-service отдельно и идемпотентно публикует `DurableInboxNotice`, а complaint-service помечает публикацию подтверждённой только после проверки exact `NoticePublicationReceipt`; недоступность notification-service или потеря ACK не откатывает tracker и не даёт права писать пользователю «уведомление доставлено». External body/court deadline при этом не переписывается FlyFy: если authority не продлевает его, включается срочный assisted submission и consumer-remediation review.

`ADRCorrectedNoticeIntentGeneration` has lifecycle `PREPARED → DISPATCHED | PUBLICATION_ESCALATED | SUPERSEDED`; `DISPATCHED → PUBLICATION_CONFIRMED | PUBLICATION_RECONCILING | PUBLICATION_ESCALATED | SUPERSEDED`; `PUBLICATION_RECONCILING → PUBLICATION_CONFIRMED | PUBLICATION_ESCALATED | SUPERSEDED`; `PUBLICATION_ESCALATED → PUBLICATION_CONFIRMED | SUPERSEDED`. Escalation creates an immutable signed missed-deadline milestone, but the intent state remains non-terminal, user-visible `PUBLICATION_PENDING` and never implies channel effect. `PUBLICATION_RECONCILING` is legal only after an actual publication attempt for an existing intent. Live reopening atomically creates intent+outbox. For migration-only legacy reopened records, `LegacyADRPublicationReconciliationCaseGeneration` is temporarily bound instead: `OPEN → INPUTS_RECONCILING`; then `INTENT_READY | NO_NOTICE_REQUIRED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED`; `INTENT_READY → INTENT_CREATED | INPUTS_RECONCILING | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED`. The three legacy-case terminals are immutable for that generation. `NO_NOTICE_REQUIRED` requires an exact current signed legal-determination receipt; `MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED` requires a durable linked legal-review case, accountable owner, due/next-update clocks and reason-safe copy. A later legal decision never mutates that terminal: it creates a successor legacy generation with the original earliest/lower-bound age and decision receipt, then reaches `NO_NOTICE_REQUIRED` or `INTENT_READY`; only `INTENT_READY→INTENT_CREATED` atomically creates intent+outbox and swaps binding. No receipt/publication state is fabricated.

Current `contract:ADR-STATE-01:v3` keeps v1/v2 immutable and contains `schema:complaint.ADRCorrectedNoticeIntent.v2`, `schema:complaint.LegacyADRPublicationReconciliationCase.v1`, `schema:complaint.ADRCorrectedNoticePublicationEscalationReceipt.v1`, `schema:notice.NoticePublicationReceipt.v1`; `api:complaint.ReconcileADRExternalOrder.v3`, `api:complaint.OpenLegacyADRPublicationReconciliationCase.v1`, `api:complaint.RecordLegacyADRPublicationEvidence.v1`, `api:complaint.CreateADRCorrectedNoticeIntentFromLegacyCase.v1`, `api:complaint.ResolveLegacyADRNoNoticeRequired.v1`, `api:complaint.RequireLegacyADRManualLegalReview.v1`, `api:complaint.GetLegacyADRPublicationReconciliation.v1`, `api:complaint.RefreshADRCorrectedNoticeNextUpdate.v1`, `api:complaint.EscalateADRCorrectedNoticePublication.v1`, `api:notice.PublishCorrectedDurableNotice.v1`, `api:notice.GetNoticePublicationOutcome.v1`, `api:complaint.ApplyADRCorrectedNoticePublicationReceipt.v2`; `event:complaint.adr_external_order_reconciled.v3`, `event:complaint.adr_legacy_publication_reconciliation_changed.v1`, `event:complaint.adr_corrected_notice_intent_changed.v2`, `event:complaint.adr_corrected_notice_publication_escalated.v1`, `event:notice.durable_notice_published.v1`; `db:adr_corrected_notice_intent_transition_guard_v2`, `db:adr_external_order_reopen_notice_intent_atomic_ck`, `db:adr_corrected_notice_intent_current_uq`, `db:adr_corrected_notice_publication_receipt_match_ck`, `db:durable_notice_intent_recipient_copy_uq`, `db:adr_legacy_publication_reconciliation_transition_guard`, `db:adr_legacy_publication_reconciliation_current_uq`, `db:adr_legacy_case_migration_origin_ck`, `db:adr_reopen_requires_intent_or_legacy_case_ck`, `db:adr_legacy_intent_inputs_complete_ck`, `db:adr_legacy_case_to_intent_outbox_atomic_ck`, `db:adr_legacy_no_notice_determination_receipt_ck`, `db:adr_legacy_manual_legal_case_binding_ck`, `db:adr_legacy_manual_successor_preserves_age_ck`, `db:adr_publication_reconciling_requires_intent_ck`, `db:adr_corrected_notice_publication_deadline_ck`, `db:adr_corrected_notice_next_update_monotonic_ck`, `db:adr_corrected_notice_escalation_receipt_ck`. Notification publication remains independently receipt-backed through the exact manifest of `ARTIFACT-EDGE-ADR-CORRECTED-NOTICE-01`; its event pairs are wake-up/projection signals only and never publication-finality evidence.

User projection is deliberately coarser than transport internals and has terminal-specific copy. Only `OPEN | INPUTS_RECONCILING | INTENT_READY` uses «Статус уже исправлен. Мы уточняем, требуется ли отдельное уведомление. Актуальный статус доступен сейчас. Следующее обновление: [absolute time]». `NO_NOTICE_REQUIRED` uses «Статус уже исправлен. По текущему юридическому решению отдельное уведомление не требуется» and shows determination date/basis label, correction/support route and no publication claim. `MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED` uses «Статус уже исправлен. Требуется юридическая проверка, нужно ли отдельное уведомление. Актуальный статус доступен сейчас» and shows accountable owner, last update, absolute next update/due and support; it never looks complete merely because the migration generation is terminal. `INTENT_CREATED` immediately switches to the intent projection. After an intent but before exact receipt the copy is «Статус уже исправлен. Публикация отдельного уведомления ещё не подтверждена». `PREPARED | DISPATCHED | PUBLICATION_RECONCILING | PUBLICATION_ESCALATED → PUBLICATION_PENDING`; `PUBLICATION_CONFIRMED → PUBLISHED`; `SUPERSEDED → REPLACED_BY_NEWER_CORRECTION`. No UI, analytics or support macro says «уведомление отправляется», derives PUBLISHED from outbox/attempt/time or hides the tracker. `next_update_at` is at most 15 minutes away before the 30-minute hard escalation and is refreshed at least hourly afterwards, or sooner for the nearest legal deadline.

Любая новая superseding classification, включая EFFECTIVE_OUTCOME, EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL и ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED, в той же complaint-service transaction повышает monotonic `adr_remedy_authority_epoch` и `adr_remediation_epoch`, отзывает все не начатые outcome-remedy/remediation authorities, создаёт immutable stop manifest со всеми revoked authorities, supersede-ит несовместимые obligations/assessments/deficits/plans и публикует fencing events. Owner обязан пройти authority-specific Reserve, а непосредственно перед необратимым local transition/provider call — authority-specific MarkEffectStarted; все CAS и reclassification сериализуются по одному referral aggregate. Если reclassification победила, stale command не исполняется. Если EFFECT_STARTED либо current `OwnerEffectResultGeneration=OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` выигрывает первым без actual instance, новая classification добавляет к тому же stable `EffectOutcomeLookupTask` revoked/case binding, но не клонирует work root и не создаёт phantom lineage/item. Current-valid actual observations атомарно materialize per-referral current item для каждой allocated root/collateral lineage; pre-existing target lineage получает ровно один linked successor независимо от factual result технической attempt. Ни одна reclassification не стирает уже исполненный effect, возраст lookup/SLA или underlying ConsumerComplaint.

Complaint submission выдаёт immutable platform receipt немедленно и не требует отказаться от chargeback, court, regulator, statutory cancellation или иного remedy. Routing к seller, FlyFy или обоим выполняется по Market Operating Model; ошибочная маршрутизация не сбрасывает original `platform_received_at`, но внешний respondent/statutory clock считается preserved только по current ExternalIntakeAuthorityAssessment и recognised delivery/effect evidence. Иначе status `EVIDENCE_ONLY/UNRESOLVED`, nearest external deadline и assisted/direct-recipient route остаются видимыми. `DEADLOCKED` не маскируется как resolved и активирует применимый ADR disclosure/referral без устаревшей EU ODR ссылки.

ComplaintResolutionProposal — immutable versioned предложение внутреннего урегулирования. Оно хранит complaint/respondent/issues, точный refund/compensation/correction/other action, amount/currency/tax treatment, ожидаемый срок исполнения, юридический эффект без скрытого waiver, `requires_acceptance`, response deadline/legal timezone, `proposal_version`, supersedes/superseded_by и current linked cancellation/refund/payment versions. Если market-specific counsel допускает settlement terms, каждый versioned SettlementTerm имеет term_id/type, отдельный plain-language effect/copy, applicable-law basis и `requires_specific_confirmation`; по умолчанию список пуст, а недопустимый general release отклоняется policy validator. ComplaintResolutionDecision хранит ACCEPT/DECLINE, proposal/version, отдельно подтверждённые settlement_term_ids, показанную ExplanationView/term-copy versions, decided_at, idempotency key и durable receipt. Решение применяется только одной complaint-service CAS-транзакцией по expected complaint/proposal version; stale, superseded либо replayed proposal не меняет case и не создаёт финансовую команду.

Accepted proposal переходит в REMEDY_PENDING, а затем в COMPLIED только по подписанным receipt authoritative owners — например booking, payment/refund или seller-operations. Безусловно выгодное пользователю исправление, которое не требует от него отказа от права или принятия новых условий, может перейти прямо в UNCONDITIONAL_REMEDY_PENDING и исполняться без acceptance; это не даёт права пометить complaint RESOLVED/CLOSED до фактического owner receipt. Concurrent cancellation/refund/chargeback/new proposal/ADR referral разрешается детерминированно по aggregate versions: уже исполненная сумма не дублируется, новый proposal supersedes старый, а начало ADR не стирает внутреннее предложение и его evidence trail.

Expiry выполняет service-owned deadline command по сохранённой legal timezone и proposal/complaint CAS; late client decision получает current status, а не переписывает EXPIRED. Scheduled command не создаёт acceptance, waiver или remedy, а переводит case в заранее раскрытый IN_REVIEW/DEADLOCKED path и сохраняет доступные права.

ADR outcome сохраняется как immutable receipt с authority/body, case/reference, issued/received dates, procedure_kind: PROPOSED, IMPOSED либо AMICABLE_SETTLEMENT, outcome/remedy, party-specific binding_scope, binding_basis/source_version, proof предварительного disclosure, required_party_set, reasonable reflection_deadline, implementation deadline и challenge/court route.

Для proposed/non-binding solution каждая сторона заранее видит применимые именно к ней права согласиться/отказаться, суд, юридический эффект и reflection period; право выйти показывается только party/stage, для которых current ADRWithdrawalRule его доказывает, и ни один control не preselected. Immutable ADRPartyDecisionReceipt хранит party, outcome/version, ACCEPT/DECLINE/WITHDRAW, disclosures version, decided_at и classification. ACCEPT/DECLINE создаются outcome-decision command; WITHDRAW создаётся только `ExitADR`, всегда связан с ADRWithdrawalAttempt и проходит `RECORDED_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL_EFFECT` → при competing unresolved receipts `RECORDED_PENDING_EXTERNAL_ORDER` → `OPERATIVE | NON_OPERATIVE` по current external-order resolution. Для imposed outcome BINDING_FINAL допускается только при доказуемом актуальном national-law trader-binding predicate либо advance disclosure + specific acceptance всех сторон, которых решение связывает. Consumer-only/trader-only binding моделируется раздельно и не расширяется на другую сторону.

Выход из ADR технически отделён от `WITHDRAWN` underlying complaint, но до и после outcome использует один `ExitADR` command. Он доступен, если ADRWithdrawalRule даёт mandatory national-law entitlement текущей party либо affirmative approved procedure/body entitlement; body config не может подавить statutory right. CAS создаёт/продолжает ADRWithdrawalAttempt и отправляет idempotent external request. Attempt хранит party, rule/source version, allowed stage, request/dispatched/body-received/acknowledged timestamps, external sequence/reference, effect_class: EFFECTIVE/REJECTED/NOT_EFFECTIVE/UNKNOWN, evidence и linked outcome/party-decision versions. Объяснение причины не запрашивается там, где право безусловно.

Любой referral/exit submission сначала возвращает immutable `PLATFORM_INTENT_RECEIPT` с `platform_received_at`. Отдельная versioned effect projection содержит `external_dispatched_at`, `body_received_at`, `legal_effective_at`, `receipt_effect: EVIDENCE_ONLY | LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE | UNRESOLVED`, `tolling_status`, `limitation_or_filing_deadline`, `required_next_action`, source/rule/evidence versions и next_update_at. Только LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE при recognised intake channel и rule-sufficient authoritative evidence позволяет UI сказать «подано» либо «выход вступил в силу»; EVIDENCE_ONLY/UNRESOLVED всегда показывают, что external action ещё требуется или проверяется.

Rule supersession создаёт новый applicability snapshot; уже поданный intent сохраняет request-time rule/evidence и original timestamp, а resolver применяет effective-date/transition semantics вместо ретроактивного стирания права или молчаливого расширения party scope.

`withdrawal_effective_at` и `body_acknowledged_at` разделены. ADR_WITHDRAWN фиксируется по тому evidence, которое ADRWithdrawalRule считает юридически конститутивным: authoritative dispatch/delivery/body-received receipt либо acknowledgement. Acknowledgement не задерживает effect, если применимое правило делает withdrawal effective раньше; если оно обязательно, ADR_WITHDRAWAL_ACK_UNKNOWN остаётся pending с next_update/escalation. ADR_WITHDRAWAL_REJECTED/ADR_WITHDRAWAL_NOT_EFFECTIVE — внешний результат, а не право body отменить statute: если rule уже делает notice effective, primary остаётся ADR_WITHDRAWN, а contrary response создаёт BODY_RULE_CONFLICT. Иначе negative result имеет immutable receipt, безопасную причину, retry/correction/support path и никогда не закрывает underlying ConsumerComplaint.

Outcome-versus-withdrawal resolver сохраняет оба inbox receipt и применяет rule-defined legal precedence. Сначала используется authoritative external sequence/revision; затем — доказанный legal_effective_at по ADRWithdrawalRule; provider/body received_at используется только когда rule придаёт ему значение. Platform received_at/event_id детерминирует storage/replay order, но не изобретает legal effect. При равных/отсутствующих authoritative values без rule-defined tie-breaker выставляется `ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED`: outcome, withdrawal, platform intent и ближайшие известные external deadlines остаются видимыми, remedy/terminal close не исполняются, а Ops выполняет authoritative lookup. Submitted ACCEPT/DECLINE/WITHDRAW сохраняется как immutable `RECORDED_PENDING_EXTERNAL_ORDER` receipt с original submitted_at; после reconciliation оно CAS-классифицируется `OPERATIVE` либо `NON_OPERATIVE`, сохраняя доказательство timely platform intent, но не объявляя external legal timeliness без rule/evidence reconciliation и не исполняясь дважды. Outcome, доказанно operative первым, идёт по обычным binding/acceptance rules; withdrawal, доказанно effective первым либо остающийся допустимым после proposed outcome, делает outcome non-operative evidence. CAS не допускает двойного terminal effect, но не отбрасывает позднее событие и допускает versioned superseding reclassification.

ADRRemedyExecutionAuthority принадлежит complaint-service и содержит referral/outcome/required-acceptance/remedy versions, current external-order resolution/version, monotonic remedy-authority epoch, exact owner/action/amount/currency, execute_before, idempotency key и status:

    ISSUED → DELIVERED → EFFECT_RESERVED → EFFECT_STARTED
    ISSUED | DELIVERED | EFFECT_RESERVED → REVOKED

Прямой `EFFECT_RESERVED → result` отсутствует по design: любое local/provider изменение требует same-key EFFECT_STARTED, а execution authority не кодирует позднюю certainty. Она остаётся EFFECT_STARTED с `last_result_generation`; фактическая truth живёт только в append-only `OwnerEffectResultGeneration`: `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED | ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED | NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION`, result/discovery/validity generation и cause. Authority status никогда не читается как certainty/finality. Partial/full относятся не к attempt, а к obligation-level FulfilmentAssessmentGeneration: wrong-only честно остаётся ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED + fulfilment NONE + variance, а full+extra — ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED + fulfilment FULL + variance. Newer discovery, finality reopen и terminal evidence retraction создают новые result generations и могут возвращать certainty в OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; ordinary owner replay/operator не понижает result. Если authority/order уже superseded, correction остаётся historical и CAS-пересчитывает current obligations/deficits/net plan; stale order никогда не получает COMPLIED.

Любое control reassessment с revoked authorities создаёт `ADRRemedyStopManifest` с manifest_id/version, referral, `cause_kind: EXTERNAL_ORDER_RECLASSIFICATION | IDENTITY_CANONICALIZATION | EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION | EXECUTION_INCIDENT_REASSESSMENT | EXPECTED_DEFICIT_REASSESSMENT | CROSS_REFERRAL_ALLOCATION | LEGACY_MIGRATION_UNRESOLVED`, cause id/version, current external-order version, resulting remedy/remediation epoch и immutable expected closure set; только external-order cause также несёт superseding external-order version. `ADRRemedyStopRequest` создаётся на каждую `(authority_kind, authority_id, authority_version, stop_request_generation)` и хранит original authority order/epoch, cause binding, owner и server-owned state: `PENDING → NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED | EFFECT_FOUND`; `NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED → EFFECT_FOUND` только по newer authoritative proof; `EFFECT_FOUND → FOUND_RETRACTED_NO_EFFECT` допускается исключительно по terminal EffectEvidenceValidityResolution всех supports + complete final-no-effect discovery/net reconciliation. Historical FOUND не переписывается, ordinary no-effect receipt не вызывает retraction. OWNER_NO_EFFECT требует empty current-valid observations + complete STOP_REQUEST EffectDiscoveryManifest generation/hash; NOT_DISPATCHED — signed policy-valid DispatchAbsenceProof; FOUND — non-empty current-valid causally-bound observations и recovered/started attempt независимо от referral allocation. Allocation определяет per-referral remediation/fulfilment contribution, но не factual FOUND revoked authority. Owner lookup-complete boolean не является proof, invalid/stale/cross-entry receipt остаётся history-only. Carry-forward добавляет только membership current manifest и не меняет request state/generation/opened_at/age/deadline/dispatch count. Новый manifest атомарно включает ссылки на все unresolved requests предыдущих manifests плюс newly revoked authorities; DB unique `(manifest_id, stop_request_id)` и reconciliation invariant запрещают потерять outstanding request между reassessments:

Один лосси-статус `remedy_stop_status` запрещён как source of truth: одновременно могут быть true «у revoked A найден effect», «по B ещё ждём proof», «current remedy исполнено частично» и «найденный collateral effect ещё устраняется». Authoritative read model хранит три ортогональные projections и их counts/oldest/next_update:

1. `RevokedAuthorityCheckProjection.status: NOT_APPLICABLE | CHECKING | ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT | EFFECT_FOUND`. Он считает expected/pending/no_effect_confirmed/effect_found/retracted requests. EFFECT_FOUND может сосуществовать с pending_count > 0 и выводится из current-valid actual fact, causally bound к revoked authority, независимо от последующего referral allocation. ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT допустим только при полном current/carry-forward closure set, empty current-valid causally-bound FOUND ledger и no-actual terminal set для каждой attempt/task именно этого closure set, плюс no-effect terminal каждого request. Concurrent current-order remedy attempt не входит в эту квантификацию. Retraction не удаляет chronology и требует corrected notice.
2. `FoundEffectRemediationProjection.summary_status: NOT_APPLICABLE | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | ALLOCATION_REVIEW_PENDING | REMEDIATION_OPEN | RESOLVED`. Он выводится из current-valid/current-allocated actual lineages, active lookup bindings, current claim appeal/reopen, items/net positions и terminal identity/validity/execution-incident/allocation/global-convergence records. Projection хранит `open_lineage_count`, `unknown_lookup_count`, `allocation_review_pending_count`, oldest/next update, protection status и per-disposition records `REMEDIATED | LAWFULLY_RETAINED | RETRACTED_CORRECTED | NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED | CLAIM_ALLOCATION_APPEALED`. Первые три ссылаются на remediation item; NO_LOCAL/APPEALED выводятся только из signed referral-scoped `ReferralEffectClaimDispositionGeneration/Appeal` и не создают phantom item. Precedence: REMEDIATION_OPEN при open lineage/incident; затем ALLOCATION_REVIEW_PENDING; затем OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; RESOLVED только при terminal no-pending set. Counts всегда сохраняются, поэтому один higher state не скрывает остальные. Mixed terminal outcomes не схлопываются; RETRACTED_CORRECTED общий только без current-valid allocated lineage. NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED даёт privacy-safe terminal audit/appeal след без PII другой claim, а поданная appeal немедленно убирает false RESOLVED. Deficit remediation не изобретает FOUND без actual effect; она сохраняет открытой существующую target lineage.
3. `RemedyFulfilmentProjection.level: NOT_APPLICABLE | NOT_STARTED | ASSESSMENT_PENDING | NONE | PARTIAL | FULFILLED | SUPERSEDED_NOT_OPERATIVE`. Он выводится из current-order RemedyObligation/current FulfilmentAssessmentGeneration и отдельно хранит `unknown_attempt_count`, `assessment_pending` как derived compatibility boolean, pending reason/missing inputs, oldest/next update, expected manifest и due dates; fulfilled/missing/excess amount/quantity, current deficits и final receipt присутствуют только при ASSESSED. `ASSESSMENT_PENDING` имеет precedence над NONE/PARTIAL/FULFILLED: slot result и deficit execution CTA не публикуются до ASSESSED. После ASSESSED PARTIAL + unknown_attempt_count>0 честно означает «частично исполнено; оставшаяся операция проверяется». Только FULFILLED с qualifying terminal dispositions and safety gates может двигать complaint в COMPLIED; ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT по старой authority не означает, что current remedy исполнено.

Все три projection публикуются одним atomic `projection_set_version/as_of`; mixed-version read даёт unavailable/resync, а не склеенную truth. Каждая projection server-derived, versioned и fail-safe: orphan group, missing generation, projection gap или invariant violation дают CHECKING/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/temporarily-unavailable + incident/resync, но не NOT_APPLICABLE, ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT или FULFILLED. `deprecated_compat` для old clients — только output-only conservative view: при любой pending/open/ambiguous оси он не выдаёт STOP_CONFIRMED/FULFILLED/RESOLVED, никогда не принимается в command/If-Match/finality и не имеет bijective reverse mapping. Response несёт `projection_schema_version`, `minimum_supported_client_version` и `upgrade_required`. Incompatible app можно блокировать только от command, семантику которого он не может безопасно показать; status, chronology, evidence receipt, deadlines, support и ExitADR route всегда остаются доступны через conservative read-only payload, durable inbox и accessible server-rendered web/deep-link fallback с forced-update explanation. Complaint/ADR rights никогда не зависят от app-store update.

`ADRExecutionProjectionSetManifest` имеет referral/set version, prior/current pointer, `input_generation_set_hash`, exactly three required member kinds+projection versions+content hashes, as_of, schema/client compatibility и committed_at. DB transaction inserts three immutable members and manifest commit marker together; partial unique гарантирует exactly one current committed set. Outbox emits member events plus final set-manifest/commit event. Downstream projectors buffer/reorder members by set version and publish only after matching committed manifest/count/hashes; timeout/missing/duplicate hash triggers resync and never exposes partial set. Compatibility view is derived only from a committed set.

ADRRemedyStopReceipt хранит manifest/entry id+version, cause kind/id/version, current и nullable superseding external-order version, authority kind/id/version + original/current epoch, `stop_request_generation`, owner, proof_kind: NOT_DISPATCHED либо OWNER_NO_EFFECT/OWNER_EFFECT_FOUND, nullable attempt ID, EffectDiscoveryManifest generation/hash и `effect_observations[]` с claimed slot/actual aliases, authoritative sequence/watermark, inbox/local-resource/provider-operation versions, checked_at, resulting entry state и signature. Owner-provided lookup-complete/finality flag является input evidence, но не закрывает request: NOT_DISPATCHED/OWNER_NO_EFFECT применяется только к active matching entry, empty current-valid observations и server-verified complete discovery manifest; OWNER_EFFECT_FOUND требует non-empty current-valid causally-bound observations. Любой late valid receipt сохраняется history, но stale no-effect не подтверждает новый manifest. Newer OWNER_EFFECT_FOUND safety-corrects даже ранее показанный `ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT`: атомарно обновляет attempt/discovery/result generation, materializes applicable canonical groups and allocated root-or-target-lineage items, пересчитывает весь projection set и выдаёт corrected durable notice; incident создаётся лишь при plan/cardinality/cap/fence violation. Если control-plane authority была ISSUED/DELIVERED/EFFECT_RESERVED и Mark не создал attempt, receipt создаёт recovered `FENCE_BYPASS_DISCOVERED` attempt/manifests/observations/items + severity incident без forbidden authority terminal transition. Ordinary no-effect не понижает FOUND; retraction идёт только через EffectEvidenceValidityResolution. До полного closure-manifest resolution `RevokedAuthorityCheckProjection=CHECKING`, если current-valid effect не найден; forged/stale/cross-entry receipt не подтверждает stop.

Если OWNER_EFFECT_FOUND впервые приходит спустя несколько external-order versions и historical item ещё не существовал, complaint-service под referral lock сохраняет batch discovery на origin manifest/order, оценивает все intervening classifications в immutable `InterveningOrderAssessmentManifest` и одной transaction создаёт по одному item на каждую discovered canonical lineage в фактически current order. Manifest header хранит referral/attempt, origin manifest/request/receipt, discovery evidence watermark, contiguous `from_order_version..through_order_version`, каждую assessed resolution/version с classification/input watermark, reason code, assessor policy version, created_at и signed assessment receipt; immutable entries хранят source instance/canonical group+lineage, current `CrossReferralEffectAllocation` claim generation/share, выбранный current target order/case/item и skip-edge hash. DB требует unique `(referral_id, effect_attempt_id, discovery_generation)`, unique entry `(assessment_manifest_id, referral_id, canonical_effect_group_id, allocation_claim_generation)`, contiguous FK-chain к ADRExternalOrderResolution и referral-scoped unique `(referral_id, canonical_lineage_id, current_order_version)` target/unique `(case_id, canonical_lineage_id)` current item; global lineage может иметь ALLOCATED_SHARED items в нескольких referrals, но не два item одной referral/case. Изменение старого manifest запрещено, новая authoritative информация создаёт superseding assessment generation. Каждый item имеет version-range skip edge `discovered_from_order_version → current_order_version` с manifest entry ID/hash, а не фиктивную цепь пустых cases. Если concurrent reclassification выигрывает CAS, receipt остаётся history, а `ReconcileADRLateEffectDiscovery` повторяет assessment уже к новому current order; если materialization выигрывает, reclassification наследует items обычным successor rule. Ни один intermediate stale plan не исполняется.

`ReserveADRRemedyEffect` — первая линейная граница: complaint-service одной CAS-транзакцией проверяет current EFFECTIVE_OUTCOME, acceptance/BINDING_FINAL gate, authority epoch/order/remedy versions, execute_before и ещё не зарезервированный operation key, после чего фиксирует EFFECT_RESERVED. Booking/payment/seller owner не выполняет effect по одной доставленной outbox-команде. `MarkADRRemedyEffectStarted` является второй CAS-границей непосредственно перед local commit либо provider network call и повторно проверяет current order/epoch; только успешный EFFECT_STARTED разрешает effect. Для provider он также фиксирует stable provider idempotency key. Если reclassification выигрывает до этой CAS, local/provider effect запрещён; если EFFECT_STARTED выигрывает первым, последующая reclassification обязана открыть remediation case, даже когда фактический owner/provider result придёт позже. Complaint-service timeout/unavailability на любой gate fail closed без cached bypass; retry использует тот же authority/operation key. Provider timeout не разрешает повтор с новым key, а идёт в authoritative lookup.

ADREffectRemediationCase также принадлежит complaint-service. Одна unique case на `(referral_id, superseding_external_order_resolution_version)` создаётся, когда classification затрагивает фактически начатую/неопределённую попытку, confirmed effect либо supersede-ит существующий effect-remediation plan. `EffectOutcomeLookupTask` — complaint-owned stable work root с unconditional unique `(effect_attempt_id)`: terminal task reopen-ится append-only task-state generation, но никогда не клонируется и не теряет original opened_at/age/history. Для STOP_REQUEST без attempt используется отдельный stable subject/root по `(stop_request_id, planned_operation_key)`. Task хранит lease_owner/lease_until/claim_version, expected source/discovery generation, `active_binding_set_version` и command idempotency, но не один mutable purpose/case или юридический SLA. Append-only `EffectOutcomeLookupBindingGeneration` даёт 1..N active memberships `REVOKED_AUTHORITY_CHECK | OUTCOME_REMEDY_FULFILMENT | EFFECT_LINEAGE_REMEDIATION | DEFICIT_COMPLETION` с authority/execution-obligation/deficit/case/item/current-order/closure-manifest binding, predecessor/successor, effective_from/to, owner, opened_at, due_at, next_update_at, absolute_due_at и applicable deadline source/version. Root work deadline выводится как минимум всех active legally applicable binding deadlines; изменение membership/SLA создаёт binding generation, bump-ит `active_binding_set_version` и `claim_version`, fencing-ит/очищает старую lease и не переписывает task age. Ordinary current OUTCOME_REMEDY uncertainty имеет obligation binding без fake case; later reclassification добавляет revoked/case binding к тому же work root без clone/reset и не стирает исходную membership. `ClaimEffectOutcomeLookup` и `ApplyEffectOutcomeLookupEvidence` проверяют lease + task/source generation + exact active binding set version; expired/stale worker не коммитит result и не пропускает новую ось.

Task lifecycle: `OPEN → LOOKUP_IN_PROGRESS ↔ OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED | EFFECTS_MATERIALIZED`; `NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED → EFFECTS_MATERIALIZED` разрешён только newer discovery, `EFFECTS_MATERIALIZED → NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION` — только terminal invalidation всех supports + final no-effect/net reconciliation, а `NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION → EFFECTS_MATERIALIZED` — только ещё более новая authoritative generation. Любой terminal state может перейти `→ OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → LOOKUP_IN_PROGRESS` при reopen required-source/support finality. Stable `task_root_id`, attempt/stop subject, opened_at и age не меняются; каждое state/reopen append-ит новую task-state generation, а membership-only change — новую binding generation + claim/binding-set version. Все correction transitions пересчитывают current projections/notices. Root owner/deadline выводится из active binding SLA generations. Final no-effect закрывает work root без EffectRemediationItem; 1..N effects создают current-allocated item per applicable canonical/collateral lineage. ISSUED/DELIVERED/EFFECT_RESERVED без Mark отзывается без phantom attempt/item; FENCE_BYPASS_DISCOVERED либо signed FOUND создаёт recovered attempt/items+incident при fence/plan violation. Projection membership выводится из active binding set: OUTCOME_REMEDY/its deficit uncertainty увеличивает `RemedyFulfilmentProjection.unknown_attempt_count`; revoked/collateral/EFFECT_LINEAGE_REMEDIATION binding — `FoundEffectRemediationProjection.unknown_lookup_count`; один work root может честно влиять на две оси. ALL_STOPPED квантифицирует только active closure-manifest bindings, а не concurrent attempts без такой membership.

Исполнение моделируется на уровне обязательства, а не одной технической попытки. Abstract `ExecutionObligation.kind: OUTCOME_REMEDY | EFFECT_LINEAGE_REMEDIATION` обобщает stable obligation_id + append-only generation, immutable `ObligationEffectManifest`, slot/cap/assessment/deficit mechanics и kind-specific target. Natural key `(referral_id, current_order_version, kind, remedy_id_or_canonical_lineage_target)` имеет ровно один current pointer и partial unique current `OPERATIVE|FULFILLED|REOPENED`; `CreateExecutionObligation` требует command idempotency key + expected current pointer, поэтому concurrent create не может породить два obligation_id/authority chains. `RemedyObligation` связан с outcome/acceptance/remedy/beneficiary/respondent и двигает complaint fulfilment; `EffectRemediationObligation` связан с canonical lineage/case/item/net plan и двигает found-effect remediation. Общие states — `DRAFT | OPERATIVE | FULFILLED | REOPENED | SUPERSEDED_NOT_OPERATIVE`, due/next/absolute due, prior/current pointer, input hash и predecessor/successor. Manifest хранит 1..N slots с kind/action, normalized resource/party, amount/currency либо typed quantity, lawful cardinality, partial-accumulation rule, per-slot/global cap и explicit contribution-sharing policy. Попытки 40+60, retry после final zero и deficit completion могут вместе исполнить один obligation; ни одна поздняя попытка не переписывает факт предыдущей. FULFILLED→REOPENED→OPERATIVE допустим только новой canonicalization/validity/allocation/contribution generation: он возвращает kind-specific projection, fences stale plans, сохраняет original receipt и создаёт corrected notice/deadline assessment. New order создаёт superseding obligation generation, а не мутирует старую; correction plan не изобретает OUTCOME_REMEDY ради hosting deficit.

Идентичность попытки и фактического effect разделена. `EffectAttempt` имеет role `ROOT_OUTCOME_EFFECT(execution_obligation_kind/id/generation, slot_id) | REMEDIATION_EFFECT(target)`, где target — discriminated `EXISTING_EFFECT_LINEAGE(canonical_lineage_id, group_generation) | EXPECTED_EFFECT_DEFICIT(deficit_id, deficit_generation, execution_obligation_kind/id/generation, slot_id)`, unique authority-independent `EffectAttemptKey (tenant, owner_service, resource_type/id, operation_kind, planned_operation_id, stable_generation)`, exact authority/obligation/slot causation, origin `MARK_STARTED | FENCE_BYPASS_DISCOVERED`, started_at и result-generation pointer. Deficit target не требует fake source instance/group: successful OUTCOME_REMEDY_FULFILMENT создаёт новую root group/lineage contribution; successful EFFECT_REMEDIATION_COMPLETION создаёт auditable matching correction instance/group membership в existing target lineage/net position. Только wrong-target/kind/resource/party/currency actual получает отдельную COLLATERAL_VARIANCE_EFFECT lineage; UNKNOWN/NO_EFFECT оставляет lookup/deficit open.

Одна EffectAttempt + FinancialExecutionAuthority разрешают ровно одну provider boundary, один stable provider idempotency key и один immutable `AttemptEffectPlan`, но не предполагают cross-service atomicity. Plan хранит plan_id/generation, execution-obligation kind/id/generation + slot/sub-operation, planned kind/action/resource/party, amount/quantity/currency, allowed per-attempt cardinality, per-attempt cap, required-source policy/hash и predecessor/supersession pointer. Complaint-service одной owner-local transaction создаёт plan + planned_operation_id/generation, собственную ADRRemedyExecutionAuthority/ADRRemediationExecutionAuthority, signed `ADRFinancialOperationIntent` и outbox; эти объекты не являются provider credential и не дают права вызвать PSP. Payment-service отдельно валидирует exact current ADR authority/order/epoch/plan/exposure intent, затем только своей transaction mint-ит canonical FinancialExecutionAuthority и pin-ит external plan ID/hash plus provider operation/idempotency identity. Непосредственно перед PSP boundary должны успешно пройти complaint-owned `MarkADRRemedyEffectStarted` либо `MarkADRRemediationEffectStarted`, execution-control `MarkExposureStarted` и payment-owned FinancialExecutionAuthority STARTED; stale/mismatched source или timeout fail closed. Complaint-service не имеет DB credentials к FinancialExecutionAuthority и не может его pin/mutate. Reserve/Mark проверяют exact plan and create/get attempt; started plan/key никогда не supersede-ится внутри attempt, change требует new plan+source intent+payment authority+operation generation. FENCE_BYPASS/legacy может получить deterministic recovered plan из authority/source alias + recovery generation только с incident; collision идёт в manual conflict. Lawful multi-slot/composite remedy выдаёт отдельные intents/authorities/attempt keys по slot; crash after k-of-N безопасно replay-ит только неначатые keys. Неожиданные 2..N actual operations сохраняются как факты, но открывают incident при нарушении plan/cardinality/cap. Planned key доказывает попытку, но не фактический результат.

`InFlightEffectExposureLedger` — strongly consistent command-side aggregate с единственным authoritative sync owner/API, а не eventual projector. Complaint/payment/cancellation/dispute/tax owners не пишут его БД напрямую: они вызывают idempotent Reserve/MarkStarted/Consume/Release/Reconcile по S2S authority, а inbox events служат recovery evidence. Stable key включает `(beneficiary, normalized resource, effect kind, global_cap_scope, measure_dimension_id)`, где dimension задаёт MONEY+currency, QUANTITY+unit либо typed NON_FINANCIAL measure; unit/currency и normalization policy — versioned fields, не новый cap. Policy change fences scope and signed-migrates epoch; FX/incompatible units не auto-convert. Reservation generation имеет immutable operation plan/hash, action_class `CONSUMER_BENEFIT | CONSUMER_HARM | NEUTRAL_STATE_CHANGE`, direction, worst-case measure, source owner/operation, prior/current pointer и exactly one current per operation key.

Допустимые bucket transitions разделены: `RESERVED_UNSTARTED → STARTED_RESIDUAL | RELEASED_REVOKED_UNSTARTED`; только `STARTED_RESIDUAL → CONFIRMED_CONSUMED | RELEASED_FINAL_NO_EFFECT`; `RELEASED_FINAL_NO_EFFECT → REOPENED_RESIDUAL | REOPENED_OVER_CAP_FROZEN` при finality reopen; `REOPENED_RESIDUAL → CONFIRMED_CONSUMED | RELEASED_FINAL_NO_EFFECT | REOPENED_OVER_CAP_FROZEN`. Verified provider/bank-initiated evidence создаёт `EXTERNAL_UNRESERVED_DISCOVERED → EXTERNAL_RECONCILING → CONFIRMED_CONSUMED | RELEASED_EXTERNAL_NO_EFFECT_OR_ALREADY_ACCOUNTED | REOPENED_OVER_CAP_FROZEN`; release требует signed terminal no-effect либо conserved attribution к уже counted operation, а `RELEASED_EXTERNAL_NO_EFFECT_OR_ALREADY_ACCOUNTED → REOPENED_RESIDUAL | REOPENED_OVER_CAP_FROZEN` по newer proof. Revoked-unstarted никогда не проходит через STARTED и не освобождает started effect; fence-bypass actual создаёт external/recovered incident. Stale/replayed release или invalidated duplicate link не освобождает newer/current exposure.

Exposure formula использует action-class-aware non-negative current exposure: qualifying benefit net clamp-ится минимум к 0, harmful negative не создаёт headroom; over-correction учитывается отдельно до signed disposition. Confirmed bucket уменьшается только terminal validity/net/reconciliation generation. К нему добавляются per started/reopened plan `unresolved_residual_max=max(0, plan.max_exposure-current_attributed_canonical_exposure)`, reserved-unstarted, external-unreserved worst-case и provisional relief. Safety-critical `PlanExposureAttributionGeneration` хранит stable plan/exposure-scope ID, generation/prior/current pointer/hash, complete canonical group/lineage member set and versions, signed conserved typed shares, action class/direction, source evidence refs, cause/receipt and exactly one current per plan+scope. Sum current shares per canonical effect across plans ≤ current non-negative canonical exposure; per-plan attribution ≤ observed/max exposure. Change only through fenced reconciliation/global reassessment. Поэтому provider+ledger proof/shared causation не уменьшают residual дважды. В normal current state сумма ≤ cap.

Если final-no-effect позже reopened после reuse cap, ledger append-ит `REOPENED_OVER_CAP_FROZEN → RECONCILING → WITHIN_CAP | RESOLVED_LAWFUL_EXCESS | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED`; каждый state имеет owner/opened/due/next/absolute due, incident, expected exposure/global-reassessment versions и signed disposition/final receipt. Scope freeze снимается только после current canonical discovery, conserved attribution, all affected plan reconciliation и Finance/Legal-approved disposition; statutory consumer protection может продолжаться только отдельным approved capped path. Correction сохраняет доказуемую breach chronology, не фальсифицирует исторический invariant и не запускает automatic clawback. Reclassification не обнуляет exposure старой started attempt; release допустим только по signed revoke-before-start либо current final no-effect, а consumed final discovery переносит residual в confirmed bucket. New ordinary/deficit authority при in-flight exposure ждёт lookup либо retry-ит тот же key. Plan/authority/result/correction/global reassessment CAS всегда несёт expected exposure version; late old effect может получить signed ObligationContributionAllocation к current obligation, но не duplicate satisfaction. RPO 0 reconciliation после failover блокирует new Reserve до сверки с provider/ledger plans/results.

`EffectDiscoveryManifest` является immutable generation с discriminated subject `ATTEMPT(effect_attempt_id) | STOP_REQUEST(stop_request_id, planned_operation_key)`. Он содержит versioned required-source set/namespaces из owner/rail/operation policy, source lookup statuses, as-of/evidence watermarks, observation IDs, policy version, opened_at и signed finality receipt. Server выводит FINAL только когда все required LOCAL/PROVIDER/LEDGER sources достигли rule-sufficient terminal watermark и correlations проверены; owner boolean не доверяется. Новый/исправленный source proof создаёт superseding generation и `FINAL → REOPENED → FINAL`, не мутируя старую. Для DELIVERED/EFFECT_RESERVED без successful Mark lookup живёт на STOP_REQUEST и не создаёт phantom attempt: FOUND атомарно создаёт FENCE_BYPASS_DISCOVERED attempt и переносит causation/observations, NO_EFFECT закрывает entry без attempt. NOT_DISPATCHED для доказанно unpublished ISSUED authority может вместо source lookup использовать signed `DispatchAbsenceProof` только по versioned policy. Поэтому zero observations означает NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED лишь при полном current manifest либо допустимом dispatch-absence proof, а lagging source оставляет pending/unknown.

`EffectAttempt.execution_status=EFFECT_STARTED` фиксирует факт прохождения execution gate и не смешивается с результатом. Current factual result выводится из append-only `OwnerEffectResultGeneration`:

    <none> → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED
      | ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED
    OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED
      | ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED
    NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED → ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED
      только по newer authoritative discovery generation
    NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
      при reopen/withdrawal finality proof либо expanded required-source policy
    ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED → ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED
      при новой current-valid observation; discovery FINAL ↔ REOPENED
    ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
      когда все current supports removed/reviewing, а replacement discovery ещё не final
    ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED → NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION
      только при terminal invalidation всех supporting observations,
      final no-effect discovery и reconciled net position
    NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION → ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED
      только по ещё более новому authoritative proof
    NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
      при reopen finality до нового terminal proof

`EffectObservation` — immutable causation join с attempt и nullable `claimed_slot_id`, authority/owner receipt, evidence sequence/watermark, observed outcome, source alias, nullable actual instance, discovery generation, `source_observation_hash` и recorded_at. Claimed slot — лишь намерение owner, а не authoritative assignment. Unique `(owner, receipt_id, evidence_sequence, observation_index)` делает replay идемпотентным; один actual instance может быть подтверждён observations нескольких attempts/authorities, а новая causation никогда не мутирует instance. NO_EFFECT observation не имеет instance/alias и может подтвердить no-actual result только при server-derived final discovery manifest; contradictory later proof создаёт новую observation/result generation и safety correction.

`FulfilmentAssessmentGeneration` — единственный authoritative slot assignment для obligation/current order. Он имеет `assessment_id`, monotonic generation, prior generation, current pointer/hash, complete `input_generation_set_hash`, cause/command idempotency, expected prior assessment/current-obligation/global-fence versions, created_at и exactly one current generation по `(referral_id, execution_obligation_kind, execution_obligation_id, obligation_generation, current_order_version)`. CAS проигравшая concurrent assessment остаётся non-current audit и никогда не участвует в COMPLIED. State `PENDING_INPUTS | ASSESSED`; PENDING_INPUTS перечисляет missing/ambiguous result/discovery/net/allocation/canonical/global inputs, owner/due/next/absolute due, запрещает FULFILLED, creation/execution of deficit authority и finality. Только ASSESSED выводит NONE/PARTIAL/FULL.

Assessment агрегирует не gross roots, а current-valid/current-allocated signed `LineageNetContributionGeneration` с group/source provenance. Этот append-only net contract имеет key `(canonical_lineage_id, allocation_scope_id, generation)`, prior generation, current pointer/hash, order/allocation/policy/validity/canonicalization versions, signed set root/correction/reversal member instances, typed amount/quantity+currency, effective sign/net state, cause/receipt/created_at и exactly one current generation на lineage+allocation scope. Matching reversal/correction в той же lineage уменьшает effective contribution и может reopen FULL→PARTIAL/NONE+deficit, а misdirected reversal становится collateral incident и не уменьшает target net.

Contribution может исполнить obligation только при (a) прямой attempt→obligation/slot causation либо (b) current `ObligationContributionAllocationGeneration` для pre-existing/other-purpose effect. Stable allocation имеет allocation_id, append-only generation/prior/current pointer, state `ACTIVE | SUPERSEDED | REVOKED`, source purpose, legal/economic discharge basis, source lineage-net/current-order/cross-referral-allocation versions, target obligation/slot, allocated typed measure, partition/residual owner, no-double-satisfaction proof, maker/checker where material, cause/receipt/idempotency и exactly one current generation. Reallocate/revoke atomically supersede old generation through GlobalEffectReassessment; only current ACTIVE shares enter assessment and their sum cannot exceed current signed lineage net. Одинаковые kind/resource/party/currency/amount без direct causation/current allocation дают UNALLOCATED/MANUAL и никогда не COMPLIED.

Assessment проверяет normalized kind/resource/party/currency, signed lineage net amount/quantity, allocation claim generation/share и выводит `NONE | PARTIAL | FULL`, per-slot fulfilled/missing/positive_excess/negative_excess vector, deficits и execution incidents. Для amount slot: `fulfilled=clamp(qualifying_signed_net, 0, expected)`, `missing=expected-fulfilled`; net выше expected даёт FULL + positive-excess incident, net ниже нуля даёт NONE + missing=expected и отдельный harmful over-correction amount, но не фиктивный outcome deficit `expected-net`. Contribution хранит effective_slot_id либо reason `UNPLANNED | MISDIRECTED | INCOMPATIBLE | UNALLOCATED`; FK на claimed_slot_id ничего не исполняет. Default запрещает одной net contribution удовлетворить два slots/referrals/obligations; explicit manifest/allocation может лишь разделить amount/quantity по deterministic shares в пределах cap. Conservation доказывается и на gross group allocation, и на signed lineage net; minor-unit rounding и residual owner заданы policy. MERGE/SPLIT/REASSIGN, reversal/net change, evidence validity, cross-referral/allocation-of-contribution, late proof и execution-incident resolution одной fenced generation атомарно пересчитывают contributions, NONE/PARTIAL/FULL, deficits, fulfilment, net items и corrected notices; stale assessment не участвует в COMPLIED/finality. Obligation PARTIAL сам по себе не execution incident: если $40 AttemptEffectPlan дал $40 в $100 obligation, это valid contribution + $60 deficit; если тот же plan дал $30, это under-plan incident + $70 deficit. Variance сравнивает actual с AttemptEffectPlan, а fulfilment — accumulated lawful signed net с ObligationEffectManifest.
