Каждый фактический side effect получает отдельный immutable source `effect_instance_id` только по actual canonical source alias: LOCAL_COMMIT `(tenant, owner_service, resource_type/id, operation_kind, commit_reference)`, PROVIDER `(provider_account, provider_operation_reference)` либо LEDGER `(legal_entity, journal/economic_reference)`. Instance хранит immutable normalized economic-effect fingerprint: effect kind/action, normalized affected resource и subject-safe party refs, amount/currency в canonical minor units либо typed non-financial effect, effective_at/correlation bucket по versioned `EffectNormalizationPolicy`, initial observation и recorded_at. Source-specific refs/statuses/raw timestamps/versions/watermarks входят в отдельный source-observation hash. Policy не допускает FX-based merge; resource/kind/party/currency должны совпасть, amount — после deterministic minor-unit/tax-rounding normalization, а effective time — в approved owner/provider correlation window. Mismatch либо policy-version ambiguity создаёт CONFLICT_MANUAL.

`EffectIdentityAlias` имеет unique `(alias_kind, namespace, canonical_value)` и навсегда ссылается ровно на один immutable source instance; authority/attempt IDs являются только causation. Replay того же alias идемпотентен лишь при совпавших source_observation_hash и normalized fingerprint; changed facts/amount/currency/resource под тем же alias создают CONFLICT_MANUAL + security/financial incident, никогда overwrite либо silent success. Разные provider-operation либо ledger-economic references по умолчанию создают разные source instances; их нельзя схлопнуть по общей authority/attempt. Несколько source instances признаются одним economic effect лишь по signed authoritative same-effect correlation с compatible normalized fingerprints.

Позднее сопоставление не мутирует и не удаляет source instances/aliases/lineages. Append-only `EffectCanonicalizationGeneration` имеет kind `MERGE | SPLIT | REASSIGN` и хранит expected source/group/lineage versions, signed correlation-validity/resolution receipt, resulting canonical groups, member instances, canonical lineages и convergence/divergence links. Current economic count вычисляется по current groups, а alias effective mapping проходит alias→source instance→current group. Newer authoritative proof может supersede ошибочный merge через SPLIT/REASSIGN: prior groups/items остаются history, новые per-lineage items materialize-ятся атомарно, ни один actual effect не теряется. Любой MERGE/SPLIT/REASSIGN атомарно пересчитывает group→allocation-claim→obligation-slot contributions, accumulated amounts, NONE/PARTIAL/FULL, deficits, execution incidents и net items; одна group не используется дважды без explicit partition/conservation policy.

Поскольку source/group может быть глобально разделён между referrals и exposure scopes, canonicalization, evidence validity, incident и allocation change не могут коммититься только в одной complaint. `GlobalEffectReassessmentGeneration` имеет stable reassessment ID, monotonic generation/prior/current pointer, cause, complete member manifest/hash and exactly one current nonterminal generation per global source/cause scope. Immutable member table использует `member_kind: REFERRAL | EXECUTION_CONTROL_SCOPE`, unique `(reassessment_generation,member_kind,member_id)` и pin-ит full input watermark. Referral member включает order/epochs, obligation/manifest/plan, result/discovery/task-state+active-binding-set, observation/group/lineage/net, contribution-allocation/assessment/deficit/incident, claim disposition/item/case и projection-set versions; execution-control member включает scope epoch/version, reservations/buckets, external-unreserved facts, current PlanExposureAttribution и freeze/reconciliation generation. Per-member commit receipt unique by member+generation carries before/after hashes; CONVERGED barrier требует exact member count/hash, every referral receipt и linearizable execution-control compare-and-fence receipt/token для каждого scope.

Coordinator durable-фиксирует PREPARING manifest; каждый referral CAS bump-ит epoch, supersede-ит incompatible generations, revokes unstarted authorities, creates stop manifest, recomputes projections and receipt; каждый execution-control scope linearizably prepares exact epoch/input hash и возвращает single-use fence token. Any Apply owner/stop/lookup evidence or new observation/allocation during PREPARING/FENCING/COMMITTING must present current global-fence generation; if it changes pinned inputs/affected set, transaction supersede-ит generation and starts a new complete manifest rather than converging stale graph. `RecordExternalUnreservedEffect` никогда не блокируется prepared fence: он атомарно записывает safety fact, bump-ит scope epoch, invalidates prepared token и заставляет coordinator restart; если linearizes после CONVERGED, он создаёт новую reopen/reassessment generation и corrected notice. Final barrier сравнивает текущий scope epoch с prepared token непосредственно в execution-control, поэтому async event/предварительный GET не закрывает TOCTOU window. Until all members converge, harmful/final actions and closure fail closed; capped interim protection shares global cap. Started attempts stay in lookup/net reconciliation; immutable effects undergo over/under reconciliation without double compensation/clawback. Concurrent external-order reclassification CAS-retries on current global/referral versions.

Exact same alias+facts всегда dedupe-ится в один global source instance, даже если его наблюдают разные complaint referrals; это не сливает complaints и не определяет, кому принадлежит remedy. `CrossReferralEffectAllocation` хранит global group/net-position/economic cap, referral-scoped claims/observations/items, legal/financial allocation basis, expected referral-order/remediation-epoch/item/plan versions, maker/checker и signed allocation receipt:

    OPEN → INVESTIGATING → ALLOCATED_SINGLE | ALLOCATED_SHARED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED
    MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED
      → INVESTIGATING | ALLOCATED_SINGLE | ALLOCATED_SHARED | NO_CLAIM_ALLOCATED
    ALLOCATED_SINGLE | ALLOCATED_SHARED | NO_CLAIM_ALLOCATED
      → REOPENED → INVESTIGATING

Allocation хранит owner/due_at/next_update_at/absolute_due_at и per-referral claim decision/receipt; NO_CLAIM_ALLOCATED требует signed Legal/Finance basis и сохраняет appeal. Finality доступна только когда каждая referral claim allocated либо reasoned-rejected, не из одного global label. Одна orchestrated CAS по всем affected referrals повышает каждый `adr_remediation_epoch`, supersede-ит plans, отзывает unstarted remediation authorities через cause-bound stop manifests и создаёт current per-referral items/limits; cross-referral DB transaction не имитируется — coordinator использует prepared allocation record, per-referral fenced commits, outbox и reconciliation-before-effect. До terminal allocation запрещены consumer-harmful debit/clawback и duplicate final compensation; approved interim relief делит один global cap и per-instance idempotency. Каждая complaint сохраняет собственные rights/timeline/appeal, а global ledger предотвращает двойное возмещение одного economic effect.

`ReferralEffectClaimDispositionGeneration` имеет stable claim-disposition id, referral/global group+lineage/allocation claim, append-only generation/prior/current pointer, state `ALLOCATED_TO_LOCAL_CLAIM | NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED | APPEALED | REOPENED`, signed basis, maker/checker where material, user-safe reason/appeal deadline/channel, order/allocation/global-reassessment versions и exactly one current per `(referral_id, canonical_lineage_id, allocation_claim_generation)`. `ReferralEffectClaimAppeal` хранит appellant/owner binding, appealed disposition/version, ground/evidence revisions, original receipt, independent reviewer, due/absolute due, decision и supersession. Lifecycle `NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED → APPEALED → REOPENED → ALLOCATED_TO_LOCAL_CLAIM | NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED`; final no-local после review требует new reasoned generation. ALLOCATED разрешает materialize current remediation item; NO_LOCAL закрывает только referral claim record и projection disposition без item. Appeal/reopen/allocation transfer проходит global coordinator, fences finality, публикует ALLOCATION_REVIEW_PENDING и corrected notice.

`EffectExecutionIncident` заменяет два недоопределённых «duplicate/variance» объекта одним discriminated contract. `kind: DUPLICATE_ACTUAL | OVER_AMOUNT | UNDER_AMOUNT_WITH_ACTUAL | WRONG_KIND | WRONG_RESOURCE | WRONG_PARTY | WRONG_CURRENCY | EXTRA_CARDINALITY | UNPLANNED_EFFECT | LATE_ORIGINAL_AFTER_DEFICIT_COMPENSATION | CORRECTION_OVER_CAP | OTHER_MANUAL`, severity/action class, obligation/slot/attempt/claimed-versus-effective assignment, affected groups/lineages, current allocation/assessment/order/epoch/net/cap versions, owner, opened_at/due_at/next_update_at/absolute_due_at и signed generations:

    OPEN → IDENTITY_RESOLVING | ASSESSING
    IDENTITY_RESOLVING | ASSESSING
      → MERGED_REPRESENTATION | CONFIRMED_INCIDENT
      | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED
    CONFIRMED_INCIDENT → REMEDIATING | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED
    REMEDIATING → RESOLVED_REMEDIATED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED
    MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED
      → ASSESSING | REMEDIATING
      | RESOLVED_LAWFUL_EFFECT_RETAINED
      | RESOLVED_ALTERNATIVE_REMEDY
    MERGED_REPRESENTATION → RESOLVED_NO_DUPLICATE
    любое terminal → REOPENED → ASSESSING

Для ROOT_OUTCOME_EFFECT каждый distinct valid canonical group получает отдельную root либо `COLLATERAL_VARIANCE_EFFECT` lineage/item; incident открывается только когда current contribution нарушает obligation manifest/cardinality/cap, а не по самому N>1. Для REMEDIATION_EFFECT лишь normalized-matching kind/resource/party/currency correction instances входят в target lineage и её net position. Misdirected/wrong-kind/party/resource/currency operation создаёт отдельную COLLATERAL_VARIANCE_EFFECT root lineage/item, а исходная target остаётся under-corrected/deficit. Unresolved incident блокирует consumer-harmful debit/clawback/recovery/retain и final closure, но не market-approved reversible consumer-protective hold/provisional credit/refund: interim authority имеет per-group/slot idempotency, общий economic cap, legal approval и отдельный finalization receipt; provisional benefit не clawback-ится автоматически. Terminal lawful-retained/alternative outcome сохраняет user-safe explanation/appeal и не выдаётся за автоматическое исправление.

`GlobalEffectReassessmentGeneration` имеет явный lifecycle `PREPARING → FENCING → COMMITTING → RECONCILING → CONVERGED`; любой nonterminal может перейти в MANUAL_RECOVERY, а `MANUAL_RECOVERY → FENCING | COMMITTING | RECONCILING → CONVERGED` по idempotent REFERRAL/EXECUTION_CONTROL_SCOPE member receipts и current affected-member generation. Record хранит owner/opened/due/next/absolute due, retry generation и last safe checkpoint. Новая affected referral/exposure scope/source fact supersede-ит незавершённую generation, создаёт новый complete checksummed member set и заново fences every referral plus linearizable execution-control scope; partial A-committed/B-failed state не разрешает final/harmful action.

Legacy с неполным authority history не фабрикует expected_count. `LegacyADRStopReconciliationCase` создаёт unresolved sentinel closure entry, привязанный к source snapshot/checksum, known/missing ranges, owner/due/next/absolute due и resolution receipt; RevokedAuthorityCheck остаётся CHECKING, пока membership не восстановлена authoritative replay либо не получила signed maker/checker manual terminal resolution. Одни known entries не могут дать ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT.

`ExpectedEffectDeficit` создаётся не на attempt, а на каждый unfulfilled slot current-order `ExecutionObligation` при FulfilmentAssessment NONE/PARTIAL, не изобретая EffectInstance. Final zero attempt по всё ещё OPERATIVE obligation открывает deficits по всем missing slots и retry/escalation; по superseded/non-operative obligation эти же missing facts атомарно переходят в `RESOLVED(disposition=SUPERSEDED_NOT_OPERATIVE)` с predecessor/successor audit link и не порождают execution authority:

    OPEN → REMEDIATION_PLANNED → REMEDIATING → RESOLVED
    OPEN | REMEDIATION_PLANNED | REMEDIATING
      → MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED | SUPERSEDED_REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED
    MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED → REMEDIATION_PLANNED | RESOLVED
    SUPERSEDED_REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED
      → RESOLVED(disposition=SUPERSEDED_NOT_OPERATIVE)
      → linked current successor deficit, если новая obligation ещё OPERATIVE
    RESOLVED → REOPENED → REMEDIATION_PLANNED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED

Deficit имеет `purpose: OUTCOME_REMEDY_FULFILMENT | EFFECT_REMEDIATION_COMPLETION`, deficit_id/generation, referral/current-order/remediation-epoch, `execution_obligation_kind/id/generation`, manifest/fulfilment-assessment generation, slot/expected-versus-current-allocated contribution, kind-specific nullable target lineage, predecessor/successor, case/item/plan versions, cap, `in_flight_unknown_contribution`, `execution_eligibility: BLOCKED_IN_FLIGHT_UNKNOWN | ELIGIBLE | PROVISIONAL_ONLY`, owner/due/next/absolute due и signed final receipt. DB допускает ровно один current deficit на `(referral_id, execution_obligation_kind, execution_obligation_id, obligation_generation, slot_id)` с CHECK/FK: OUTCOME purpose ссылается только на RemedyObligation, remediation purpose — только на EffectRemediationObligation+target lineage. Missing amount можно показать в UI при original OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, но REMEDIATION_PLANNED/Reserve/Mark запрещены до final no-effect либо idempotent retry того же provider key; PROVISIONAL_ONLY требует separate approval и worst-case exposure cap. New order/assessment создаёт immutable successor с continuity `CARRY_FORWARD_EQUIVALENT | MODIFIED_CARRY_FORWARD | NEW_OBLIGATION`: earliest `unmet_since` сохраняется только для equivalent carried share, legal due_at пересчитывается по new order, а UI показывает original unmet date и current deadline. ADRRemediationExecutionAuthority для deficit несёт target discriminant, exact deficit/execution-obligation/slot/assessment/exposure/current-order versions и cap, но не source-instance/lineage set; Reserve/Mark CAS отклоняет stale/superseded/blocked deficit.

Каждый `RESOLVED` deficit обязан иметь immutable disposition `FULFILLED_BY_ORIGINAL_EFFECT | FULFILLED_BY_DEFICIT_REMEDIATION | ALTERNATIVE_REMEDY_SATISFIED | SUPERSEDED_NOT_OPERATIVE | RETRACTED_ERROR`, source receipt/current-order/assessment generation и, где нужно, specific user/Legal acceptance. Только первые три disposition при current OPERATIVE obligation входят в FULFILLED/COMPLIED; SUPERSEDED_NOT_OPERATIVE и RETRACTED_ERROR закрывают лишь stale/audit record и не притворяются доставленным refund/correction. OUTCOME_REMEDY_FULFILMENT deficit двигает ось RemedyFulfilment NONE/PARTIAL, но сам по себе не означает FOUND; EFFECT_REMEDIATION_COMPLETION держит открытой уже существующую target lineage. Late original slot fulfilment после already completed deficit remediation не reopen-ит missing deficit и не даёт новую deficit authority: deficit остаётся RESOLVED, новый assessment фиксирует excess, bump-ит epoch, fences stale plan и создаёт `LATE_ORIGINAL_AFTER_DEFICIT_COMPENSATION` incident/net reconciliation+corrected notice. Deficit REOPENED только если qualifying contribution была invalidated/removed и current missing > 0; automatic clawback запрещён. UI показывает expected, выполнено, осталось, reconciliation/plan/deadline и disposition раздельно.

Только actual EffectInstance с хотя бы одной current-valid supporting observation входит в global factual ledger. RevokedAuthorityCheck factual EFFECT_FOUND требует causation к revoked authority, но не local claim; referral-level remediation/fulfilment contribution требует current allocation claim. Attempt без instance создаёт видимый shared lookup work root, а active bindings определяют ось: OUTCOME_REMEDY/its deficit → RemedyFulfilment unknown_attempt_count; revoked/collateral/EFFECT_LINEAGE_REMEDIATION → FoundEffectRemediation unknown_lookup_count; одна attempt может иметь оба binding. Это не утверждает, что действие произошло. Newer proof может safety-correct NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED/ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT в ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED/EFFECT_FOUND: одна global+referral fenced generation materializes groups/lineages/items, recomputes all three projections, deficits/net plan и corrected notices, не исполняя stale plan. Обычный NO_EFFECT proof не понижает confirmed instance.

Ошибочный ранее authoritative FOUND исправляется только append-only `EffectEvidenceValidityResolutionGeneration` с state machine `OPEN → INVESTIGATING → CONFIRMED_VALID | RETRACTED_FALSE_POSITIVE | CONFLICT_MANUAL; CONFLICT_MANUAL → INVESTIGATING | CONFIRMED_VALID | RETRACTED_FALSE_POSITIVE; terminal → REOPENED → INVESTIGATING`. Он хранит affected observations/groups/referrals, newer signed source sequence/watermark, owner/opened/due/next/absolute due, distinct maker/checker, Finance/Legal approval, reason, current global/referral versions и signed receipt. CONFLICT не terminal и не dead end. Source instance/evidence остаются immutable; лишь terminal invalidation всех current supports выводит group из current-valid ledger. Partial invalidation может понизить obligation FULL→PARTIAL/NONE и открыть deficits; all-support invalidation + final no-effect/net reconciliation может перевести factual result в NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION. Любая validity generation идёт через GlobalEffectReassessmentGeneration, fences все affected referral и execution-control-scope members, пересчитывает contributions/deficits/incidents/net/exposure attribution/projections и отправляет durable corrected notice. Newer valid evidence после retraction создаёт REOPENED/CONFIRMED_VALID generation и полную обратную safety correction; prior chronology не мутируется. Case finality требует terminal discovery/identity/validity/execution-incident/allocation/global-convergence records.

Correction symmetry обязательна: `ADRRemedyStopRequest FOUND_RETRACTED_NO_EFFECT → EFFECT_FOUND` и `EffectOutcomeLookupTask NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION → EFFECTS_MATERIALIZED` допустимы только по ещё более новой authoritative validity/discovery generation. Каждый такой transition атомарно reopen-ит current lineages/obligations/projections/deficits/net plan, fences stale authorities и выдаёт новое corrected notice, не мутируя prior retraction.

Для OUTCOME_REMEDY current `RemedyFulfilment=FULFILLED` необходим, но не всегда достаточен для COMPLIED/CLOSED. Если та же execution chain создала wrong/extra/collateral harmful effect, complaint не закрывается, пока FoundEffectRemediation не RESOLVED, все material EffectExecutionIncident/GlobalEffectReassessment не terminal и user не получил final receipt. Benign consumer-protective excess может завершиться signed `RESOLVED_LAWFUL_EFFECT_RETAINED`; открытая second axis никогда не скрывается под лейблом «жалоба закрыта».

`ADRRemedyStopRequestEvidenceGeneration` разрешает append-only finality reopen: `NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED | EFFECT_FOUND | FOUND_RETRACTED_NO_EFFECT → PROOF_REOPENED → PENDING → NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED | EFFECT_FOUND`. Reopen допустим только по invalidated proof, expanded required-source policy либо newer discovery generation, сохраняет prior chronology/opened_at/age/deadline и сразу делает RevokedAuthorityCheck=CHECKING. Если current actual supports уже сняты, но replacement discovery ещё не final, historical FOUND не переписывается, но current projection показывает CHECKING/FoundEffect unknown, а не EFFECT_FOUND или ALL_STOPPED.

`EffectOutcomeLookupTask NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED | NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED_AFTER_RETRACTION | EFFECTS_MATERIALIZED → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → LOOKUP_IN_PROGRESS` разрешён только при reopen required-source/support finality. Work root, age и active bindings сохраняются; transaction атомарно fences dependent actions, пересчитывает оси и создаёт corrected notice.

Все FlyFy-initiated causally relevant owners — ADR, cancellation/refund, dispute adjustment, goodwill, tax correction и provider operation — обязаны до side effect вызвать тот же authoritative synchronous exposure API по typed beneficiary/resource/kind/cap-scope/measure key, затем MarkStarted/Consume/Release/Reconcile; event ingestion является только recovery evidence и не открывает gate. Provider/bank-initiated chargeback/reversal, который нельзя pre-gate, после verified callback/lookup сразу проходит RecordExternalUnreservedEffect, удерживает conservative exposure/freeze и incident до reconciliation. Unknown pre-existing operation не исчезает из cap: policy ждёт finality либо при statutory deadline использует separately approved provisional path с no automatic clawback и corrected late-effect reconciliation.

EffectIdentityResolution не является техническим dead end:

    PROVISIONAL → RESOLVING → RESOLVED | CONFLICT_MANUAL
    CONFLICT_MANUAL → RESOLVING | RESOLVED
    RESOLVED → REOPENED → RESOLVING

Resolution хранит immutable resolution_id/generation, affected attempts/observations/aliases/source instances/canonical groups/authorities/referrals, expected attempt/alias/instance/group/lineage/item/plan/current-order/remediation-epoch versions, authoritative lookups, same-effect correlation proof и evidence watermarks, owner, due_at/next_update_at/absolute_due_at, legal/financial impact, distinct maker/checker principals, correlate-or-keep-separate decision, canonical target, reason и signed resolution receipt. `maker_id != checker_id` и independent Finance/Legal approval обязательны для high-impact canonicalization, evidence invalidation и cross-referral allocation. `ResolveADREffectIdentityConflict` идемпотентен по resolution generation + command key, locks all affected records в deterministic order и повторно проверяет uniqueness/current versions; same-referral sources сходятся только новой EffectCanonicalizationGeneration при authoritative proof и compatible normalized fingerprints. Cross-referral/provider-account conflict никогда не auto-correlate-ится и требует security/financial resolution. Пока status не RESOLVED, consumer-harmful debit/clawback/recovery/retain, item CLOSED, case RESOLVED и complaint COMPLIED/CLOSED запрещены; market-approved capped consumer-protective interim relief остаётся доступным. При breach absolute_due_at создаётся incident, daily user update и human escalation; пользователь видит только «проверяем операцию», ETA и support/appeal path, без provider/ledger identifiers.

Каждый source root instance получает immutable source lineage, а current canonical_effect_group указывает canonical lineage. Каждая correction/reversal является отдельным auditable instance: normalized-matching correction входит в target canonical lineage, а wrong kind/resource/party/currency — в отдельную COLLATERAL_VARIANCE_EFFECT lineage. EffectLineageConvergence не переписывает source histories, а supersede-ит current projections signed generation. В одной referral case действует unique `(case_id, canonical_lineage_id)` current item, а ALLOCATED_SHARED global lineage может иметь по одному item в разных referrals. Different actual refs остаются distinct groups без signed same-effect proof; unexpected duplicate matching corrections идут в target net position с incident, collateral — в свою lineage. Concurrent receipts/repeated flip создают ровно один successor item на referral+canonical lineage и не допускают lost/double compensation. Это lifecycle одного `EffectRemediationItem`, а не всей case:

    OPENED → EFFECT_OUTCOME_LOOKUP | IMPACT_ASSESSED
    EFFECT_OUTCOME_LOOKUP ↔ EFFECT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
    EFFECT_OUTCOME_LOOKUP | EFFECT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
      → IMPACT_ASSESSED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REMEDY_REQUIRED
    IMPACT_ASSESSED → COMPENSATION_PLANNED | RECONCILED
    COMPENSATION_PLANNED → COMPENSATING
    COMPENSATING ↔ EFFECT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
    COMPENSATING → RECONCILED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REMEDY_REQUIRED
    MANUAL_LEGAL_REMEDY_REQUIRED
      → EFFECT_OUTCOME_LOOKUP | COMPENSATION_PLANNED | COMPENSATING | RECONCILED
    RECONCILED → REMEDIATED | LAWFUL_EFFECT_RETAINED
      | RETRACTED_CORRECTED → CLOSED
    CLOSED → REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED → REOPENED
      → EFFECT_OUTCOME_LOOKUP | IMPACT_ASSESSED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REMEDY_REQUIRED
    любое незавершённое состояние → SUPERSEDED_REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED
      → linked successor case/item для новой external-order version

Case хранит append-only summary generations `OPEN | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | RESOLVED`; correction/late discovery/validity reopen допускает `RESOLVED → OPEN | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` с новым generation, corrected notice и сохранением prior final receipt. Он также хранит open/unknown/per-disposition counts, current claim-disposition refs, old/new/current order versions, epochs, supersession, lookup bindings, unique lineage/item mapping, obligations/attempts/discovery/observations, canonicalization/assessment/contribution, validity/identity/incidents, lawful correction basis, deadlines/notices/receipts. RESOLVED требует terminal только для causally bound items/tasks/receipts и current referral claim dispositions; unrelated revoked request остаётся CHECKING и не блокирует remediation. Mixed item and NO_LOCAL claim dispositions сохраняются counts; общий RETRACTED_CORRECTED возможен только без current-valid allocated lineage. Late receipt append-ит history/current successors by allocation, but never stale COMPLIED/plan.

Любая retain/reversal/recovery/compensation/deficit-completion side-effect команда получает отдельную ADRRemediationExecutionAuthority с exact current external-order version/remediation epoch и target discriminant `EXISTING_EFFECT_LINEAGE(canonical_lineage/group generation, member source set) | EXPECTED_EFFECT_DEFICIT(deficit/execution-obligation/slot/assessment generation)`. Authority несёт current ExecutionObligation/ObligationEffectManifest/AttemptEffectPlan, EffectAttemptKey, discovery/result/fulfilment/identity/validity/execution-incident/allocation/global-reassessment/exposure watermarks, case/item/plan/net, owner/action/amount/currency/cap, resource/financial versions, execute_before и lifecycle `ISSUED → DELIVERED → EFFECT_RESERVED → EFFECT_STARTED`; unstarted states могут REVOKED. Как и outcome authority, она не кодирует certainty: current result только в OwnerEffectResultGeneration/lookup bindings, direct RESERVED→result запрещён. Для deficit target source instance/group set отсутствует и не фабрикуется.

`ReserveADRRemediationEffect` и immediately-before-effect `MarkADRRemediationEffectStarted` повторно проверяют current order/epoch/target/obligation/assessment/deficit/incident/allocation/global convergence/case/item/plan и action-sensitive safety gates; Mark creates/gets одну atomic REMEDIATION_EFFECT attempt. Signed receipt append-ит observations/result generation; server assignment кладёт только matching corrections в target lineage, а misdirected actuals — в COLLATERAL_VARIANCE_EFFECT lineage+incident. UNKNOWN оставляет purpose-routed lookup; timeout/unresolved safety fence blocks harmful action without cache, но approved capped consumer-protective interim authority имеет отдельный safe path. Reclassification/reassessment отзывает unstarted authority и добавляет RevokedAuthorityCheck CHECKING entry; started/unknown task carry-forward-ится без clone/reset, а current allocated target/collateral lineage получает один referral-scoped successor item.

Financial history исправляется reversal/compensating postings, а не mutation. FlyFy не списывает обратно уже полученный consumer refund/benefit автоматически: LAWFUL_EFFECT_RETAINED либо recovery возможны только по approved legal basis, proportionality review и безопасному notice. Item `CLOSED` требует terminal evidence своего lineage; case `RESOLVED` — reconciliation всех items, lookup bindings и owner/stop receipts, causally bound к этой case/её lineages; unrelated revoked-authority check живёт в своей оси и не блокирует case. Complaint `CLOSED` дополнительно требует current RemedyFulfilment=FULFILLED и все связанные safety gates. Пользователь получает понятный final receipt; MANUAL_LEGAL_REMEDY_REQUIRED всегда сохраняет next_update/escalation и имеет явные resolution transitions.

REMEDY_PENDING и idempotent booking/payment/refund/subledger commands создаются только после полного required acceptance set либо BINDING_FINAL gate и несут current ADRRemedyExecutionAuthority. DECLINED non-binding outcome не является NONCOMPLIANT и закрывается как CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT; выход из ADR достигает того же state только через `ExitADR` + rule-sufficient effect + current EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL classification. Оба пути сохраняют court/other remedies и не закрывают ConsumerComplaint. `CLOSED` недоступен, пока принятый/обязательный outcome не исполнен (`COMPLIED`) либо применимый challenge/finality/enforcement process документирован; `NONCOMPLIANT` возможен только после нарушения binding/accepted implementation deadline, а `CHALLENGED` возвращается в EXTERNAL_PENDING с новой version. Open ADREffectRemediationCase остаётся отдельным видимым obligation и не теряется при ADR primary closure.

Complaint-service хранит current/superseded external-order resolutions, обе authority/Reserve/EffectStarted histories и epoch, ExecutionObligations/ObligationEffectManifests/AttemptEffectPlans/OwnerEffectResultGenerations/FulfilmentAssessmentGenerations/ObligationContributionAllocations/ExpectedEffectDeficits, EffectAttempts/DiscoveryManifests/OutcomeLookupTasks/Observations, immutable source instances/aliases/lineages, canonical groups/generations/convergence, identity/evidence-validity/EffectExecutionIncident/CrossReferralAllocation/GlobalEffectReassessment receipts, InterveningOrderAssessment/skip edges, LegacyADRStopReconciliationCase, stop manifests/requests, three-projection sets, corrections/notices, case/item/plan predecessor/successor links и только immutable refs/receipts внешнего exposure owner в RPO 0 single-region multi-AZ control tier. После AZ failover all effect gates и COMPLIED/CLOSED остаются fail closed до проверки contiguous obligation/plan/result/discovery/observation/canonicalization/assessment/contribution/deficit/identity/validity/incident/allocation/global-convergence/intervening-order/manifest/projection-set/outbox state и synchronous reconciliation с execution-control, owner/provider/financial receipts; cross-service delivery восстанавливается inbox/outbox + idempotent lookup.

### 6.17 FinancialSubledger, settlement и dispute

Payment/Refund/Payout state machine не является бухгалтерским источником истины. Payment-service владеет append-only double-entry FinancialSubledger:

- LedgerAccount разделён по FlyFy legal entity, provider account, owner/beneficiary, currency, safeguarding/client-funds perimeter и purpose: PSP/bank cash or receivable, consumer refund liability, seller payable, platform fee, tax, reserve, chargeback/dispute и suspense;
- JournalEntry атомарно содержит минимум два Posting; внутри одной legal entity/currency сумма debit равна credit, cross-currency движение оформляется связанными balanced entries с FX rate/source/rounding posting;
- entry хранит immutable economic event type, effective_at/recorded_at, source aggregate/version, provider/bank references, settlement batch, payment/refund/payout/dispute generation, correlation/causation и reversal_of;
- update/delete финансовой истории запрещены; correction выполняется только compensating/reversal entry с новой причиной и approval;
- unique economic-reference contract предотвращает двойное отражение одного provider/bank event, но различает authorize/capture/fee/refund/chargeback/payout/return/reversal и partial operations;
- balances, available payout, reserve, refund liability и client-funds reconciliation вычисляются только из posted journal, а не из UI/event counters.

Dispute/Chargeback является отдельным aggregate с versioned DisputeRound:

    OPENED → EVIDENCE_REQUIRED → REPRESENTMENT_SUBMITTED → PROVIDER_REVIEW
      → PROVISIONAL_OUTCOME(WON | LOST | PARTIAL)
      → FINALIZED → SETTLED
    PROVISIONAL_OUTCOME → PRE_ARBITRATION | ARBITRATION | REOPENED → PROVIDER_REVIEW

Каждый DisputeRound имеет kind, round_version, provider/network reference, evidence window/deadline, amount/currency, submissions, provisional/final outcome и postings. Late scheme event идемпотентно открывает REOPENED/new round и компенсирует provisional posting; reserve/payout освобождается только по rail-specific finality rule, а не по промежуточному WON/LOST. Aggregate хранит reason-safe category, evidence manifest, affected reserve/payouts и challenge path. Raw fraud/network details доступны только purpose-bound roles; гид/турист получает безопасное объяснение и финансовое влияние.

Continuous reconciliation выполняет three-way match FinancialSubledger ↔ authoritative PSP balance/transactions/settlements ↔ bank statement. Любой unmatched/amount/currency/legal-entity break идёт в suspense/reconciliation case, блокирует только затронутую сумму/rail и не закрывается без balancing entry и owner receipt. Для committed journal target — RPO 0 при потере AZ за счёт synchronous multi-AZ quorum; cross-region DR восстанавливает журнал из immutable WAL/PITR и обязательно replay/reconciles PSP/bank records до reopening payouts. Accounting period close, privileged posting, suspense release и reconciliation override требуют separation of duties и audit.

Financial consistency envelope: payment-service одной DB-транзакцией сохраняет provider inbox deduplication/ProviderOperationReceipt, Payment/Refund/Payout/Dispute transition, все balanced JournalEntry/Posting, ContractFormationObservation при применимости и transactional outbox. Ни balance availability, ни contract progression не видят частичный transition. Если будущая физическая декомпозиция ledger неизбежна, operational aggregate остаётся `PENDING_POSTING` и не продвигается до durable signed journal receipt; эта схема требует отдельного ADR и тех же crash invariants.

RPO 0 consistency tier распространяется не только на journal, но и на payment provider inbox/receipts, operation-idempotency records, ContractFormationObservation и financial outbox. Booking-service тем же tier защищает BookingAttempt/idempotency tombstone, seat commitment, ContractObligationRecord и booking outbox/inbox. Cross-service атомарность не имитируется: durable outbox + idempotent materialization + reconciliation закрывают bridge.

### 6.18 PaymentProviderSession и asynchronous SCA

PSP-hosted page, mobile SDK/client secret и asynchronous SCA являются отдельной trust boundary. PaymentProviderSession содержит provider_account, booking_attempt_id/payment_generation, operation kind, amount/currency, merchant, seat-hold/fencing token, quote/contract/context hashes, provider object reference, pinned provider-config и `PaymentProviderOutcomeCapability` generations/digests, one-time client capability fingerprint, created_at, session_create_execute_before, sca_complete_by, provider_expires_at и terminal status. `PaymentProviderOutcomeCapability` is a typed section of the versioned provider configuration, keyed by provider account/API contract/operation kind, and declares authoritative lookup coverage, canonical physical-effect identity scheme, sequence/order domain and comparator, reversal/finality coverage, pagination/completeness rule, maximum freshness, effective interval and digest; `UNSUPPORTED`, incomparable ordering or an identity scheme unable to distinguish physical effects is an explicit safety result, never an implicit fallback to cached state.

Short-lived INITIATE_PAYMENT authority разрешает только создание bound PSP session до `session_create_execute_before`; она не обязана завершить весь bank challenge за две минуты. `sca_complete_by` задаёт реалистичное, доступное пользователю challenge window и не позже seat-hold/quote/provider expiry; hold/quote изначально резервируются на approved SCA window либо продлеваются атомарно до начала challenge. Client capability attempt-bound, non-reusable и не сохраняется в generic offline storage/logs/analytics.

Где PSP позволяет, confirmation server-mediated. При authoritative completion до `sca_complete_by` booking-service выполняет свежий FINAL_COMPLIANCE_RECHECK, проверяет current hold/fencing token, quote, amount/merchant/context epochs и только затем CAS-commit; успешный challenge не компенсируется лишь из-за истечения session-create authority. Client completion/redirect только инициирует authoritative lookup.

Если completion пришёл после sca_complete_by либо до него, но hold/quote/context уже drifted и fresh final authorization не пройден, результат не игнорируется и не превращается в booking success: verified fact записывается как `LATE_AUTHORIZED`/`LATE_CAPTURED`/`OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, capacity не commit-ится, а deterministic service-owned void/refund/remediation запускается из durable provider receipt. Cancel/expire intent отправляется по фактическому cutoff; cancel-versus-complete race решается authoritative lookup и monotonic state machine. UI показывает проверку/возврат и запрещает второй платёж.

### 6.19 ContractFormationObservation

Если approved Market Operating Model связывает contract formation с внешним PSP authorization/capture, payment-service в одной транзакции с verified payment transition сохраняет immutable ContractFormationObservation и ProviderOperationReceipt, а также outbox event. Observation содержит booking_attempt/payment aggregate, trigger kind, provider effective timestamp, verified_at, amount/currency/merchant, contract/quote/tax/disclosure hashes, market operating-model version и provider evidence hash.

Booking-service идемпотентно materializes ContractObligationRecord с исходным effective timestamp и возвращает receipt. До materialization observation имеет `OBSERVED_PENDING_MATERIALIZATION`, reconciliation/alert и не теряется при booking DB/broker outage. Ограниченная service-obligation authority может ссылаться на cryptographically verified observation только для операций, заранее разрешённых operating model — например void/refund либо необходимого fulfilment capture — и никогда для новой покупки/изменённой суммы. Предпочтительный trigger, где это юридически и продуктово корректно, остаётся локальный BOOKING_COMMITTED; внешняя модель включается только после chaos-tested ADR и reconciliation bridge.

### 6.19.1 CancellationTermEnforceabilityAssessment

Cancellation fee не считается допустимым потому, что он записан в seller terms. Immutable assessment pin-ит booking/contract/term-copy version, market/consumer habitual-residence facts where lawful, package/leisure/time-specific classification, mandatory withdrawal/cancellation/refund rights, unfair-term/penalty/proportionality test, actual-cost evidence либо statutory formula/cap, tax treatment, authority graph/sources, counsel decision, result `ENFORCEABLE | PARTIALLY_ENFORCEABLE | UNENFORCEABLE | UNCERTAIN`, maximum lawful amount/formula, reason, valid_until и supersession. Mandatory rights имеют priority над seller terms; `UNCERTAIN`/stale assessment запрещает collect/deduct fee, даёт no-fee safe hold либо assisted legal review according to approved policy и не мешает подать cancellation intent. CancellationQuote ссылается на current assessment, показывает расчёт/rule и не может превысить lawful cap независимо от configured term.

Источник для EU unfair-term gate: [Council Directive 93/13/EEC, Article 3 and Annex point 1(e)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/1993/13/oj/eng); national/package/leisure rules and case law remain separately scoped.

### 6.20 MerchantTaxProfile и MerchantTaxReadiness

MerchantTaxProfile хранит user-owned declarations и минимальные verified assertions для legal entity/individual seller: trader status, organization/beneficial-owner/representative binding, DSA trader traceability, DAC7 due-diligence attributes, TIN/VAT/tax registrations, invoice/withholding settings, KYB/AML/sanctions readiness и PSP merchant reference. Raw evidence остаётся у purpose-authoritative owner; profile связывает только scoped references/provenance.

MerchantTaxReadiness — versioned projection/assessment по server-derived ReadinessScope: seller/legal entity, target market, paid action, contracting/merchant model, currency/rail и effective dates. Scope ID создаётся из authoritative Market Operating Model/context и не позволяет client подменить legal entity/market. Lifecycle каждой purpose lane и composite:

    NOT_STARTED → IN_PROGRESS → SUBMITTED → VERIFYING
      → READY | ACTION_REQUIRED | IN_REVIEW | REJECTED | EXPIRED
    VERIFYING | IN_REVIEW → NEEDS_INFO → IN_PROGRESS → SUBMITTED

Purpose lanes DSA, DAC7, KYB/payment и tax не сливаются в одну «KYC-анкету». Каждый field показывает purpose, controller/recipient, legal basis, retention, источник, возможность reuse/correction и обязательность для конкретного action. Existing organization/PSP/registry assertion переиспользуется только если subject/scope/freshness/purpose совместимы; иначе запрашивается минимальное дополнение. `NOT_APPLICABLE` является обоснованным scoped conclusion, а не пустым значением.

READY всегда scope/version/valid_until-bound. Изменение seller model, legal entity, market, merchant account, TIN/VAT status, tax determination или PSP config делает только зависимые lanes ACTION_REQUIRED/EXPIRED. Пользователь может save/resume, исправить declaration, ответить NEEDS_INFO и оспорить неверный result; private draft и неплатные независимые actions не блокируются.

### 6.20.0 DSAEnterpriseSizeDetermination и DSASectionApplicabilityDetermination

Compliance Legal является единственным writer четырёх связанных append-only aggregates stable control `DSA-SIZE-APPLICABILITY-01`: enterprise size, formal VLOP designation, Section applicability and transition impact. Finance/Corporate предоставляет signed accounting/ownership evidence, но не присваивает legal outcome.

`DSAEnterpriseSizeDeterminationGeneration` хранит provider legal entity/enterprise, assessment_as_of, exact Recommendation 2003/361/EC и применимых Commission interpretation source versions/checksums, current `EnterpriseRelationshipGraphGeneration`, два последних relevant approved accounting-period generations либо approved new-enterprise estimate, maker/checker/counsel, review_due, invalidation triggers и prior/current pointer. Для каждого периода сохраняются account-closure date, annualisation method, AWU member manifest/fractions/inclusion basis, turnover excluding VAT/other indirect taxes, balance-sheet total в EUR, source currency/conversion evidence, approved/provisional status и complete evidence manifest. Provisional accounts дают только UNRESOLVED; bona-fide estimate разрешён исключительно newly established enterprise до первых approved accounts.

Relationship graph содержит exact capital/voting percentages and cross-holdings; autonomous/partner/linked classification at the `24.99%/25%` boundary; majority voting/board/dominant-influence/shareholder-agreement and indirect/natural-person linkage; public-body control; exact investor-exception kind/threshold/non-linkage/non-management proof; same/adjacent-market basis; upstream/downstream direction and consolidation provenance. Recursive Article 6 calculation manifest доказывает proportional immediate-partner aggregation по большей capital/voting доле, 100% direct/indirect linked aggregation, linked-of-partner and partner-of-linked rules, consolidated inclusion floor, cycle detection, complete visited-member count/hash и отсутствие double count. Каждый merger, acquisition, divestiture или suspected lasting control change создаёт immutable `EnterpriseStatusChangeGeneration` с `status_change_cause: ORGANIC_THRESHOLD_CHANGE | MERGER | ACQUISITION | DIVESTITURE | LASTING_CONTROL_CHANGE | OTHER_STRUCTURAL | UNRESOLVED`, direction, pre/post relationship-graph generations, transaction instrument/registry evidence, announced/closing/registration/effective timestamps, acquired/lost control rights, affected entities и evidence freshness. Legal отдельно утверждает `change_treatment: ARTICLE_4_2_TWO_PERIOD | STRUCTURAL_IMMEDIATE | NO_STATUS_CHANGE | UNRESOLVED`; название сделки, admin flag или само изменение shareholder percentage не выбирает treatment.

Period result closed как `MICRO | SMALL | NOT_MICRO_OR_SMALL | UNRESOLVED`; ordinary threshold acquisition/loss использует Article 4(2) two-consecutive-approved-period rule только при approved `ARTICLE_4_2_TWO_PERIOD`, а newly established enterprise — Article 4(3) bona-fide estimate с mandatory reassessment после первых approved accounts. Approved `STRUCTURAL_IMMEDIATE` applies the resulting relationship/group calculation from `transaction_effective_at`; в частности, confirmed acquisition/merger into a larger group cannot retain SME status for two periods. Divestiture или иной обратный/сложный structural change не mint-ит SME status автоматически: exact source/counsel determination выбирает treatment, иначе current result is UNRESOLVED. Aggregate хранит status_acquired_at/status_lost_at, status-change generation/cause/treatment/effective timestamp and `dsa_loss_grace_eligibility: ELIGIBLE_ARTICLE_4_2 | NOT_ELIGIBLE_CURRENT_STATUS | NOT_ELIGIBLE_STRUCTURAL_CHANGE | UNRESOLVED`. `dsa_loss_grace_end_at` non-null only for `ELIGIBLE_ARTICLE_4_2`, с approved proof `loss_pursuant_to_article_4_2=true` и calculation в 12 calendar months; structural-immediate loss физически не может получить эту grace. Lifecycle: `DRAFT → ASSESSING → REVIEWED → APPROVED → STALE | INVALIDATED | SUPERSEDED`; terminal generations immutable. Missing/conflicting/stale relationship, transaction, control, effective-date, period, FX or source evidence остаётся UNRESOLVED.

`DSAVLOPDesignationGeneration` scope равен exact provider legal entity + named online-platform/search-engine service/interface designated by the Commission, а не всем сервисам enterprise. Он хранит closed result `DESIGNATED | DESIGNATION_CEASED | NOT_DESIGNATED_CURRENT_SEARCH | UNRESOLVED`, exact Article 33 Commission decision/cessation or complete official-search manifest, decision/service identifiers, source URL/version/checksum, `as_of`, effective/designated/ceased timestamps, freshness/review_due, maker/checker, invalidation reason and prior/current pointer. DESIGNATED возможен только по authoritative Commission decision; MAU estimate или внутренний label не заменяет designation. Lifecycle: `DRAFT → ASSESSING → REVIEWED → APPROVED → STALE | INVALIDATED | SUPERSEDED`; cessation создаёт superseding APPROVED `DESIGNATION_CEASED` generation with exact source, never edits history. Exactly one current generation exists per exact provider+service scope.

`DSASectionApplicabilityDeterminationGeneration` scope равен provider + exact service/interface + feature + target market + effective interval и pin-ит RegulatoryRoleDetermination, enterprise-size generation, same-service VLOP designation, exact Article 19/29 sources, online-platform role, distance-contract marketplace feature and substantial-connection facts. Он хранит независимо:

- `section3_result: APPLICABLE | EXCLUDED_CURRENT_MICRO_SMALL | EXCLUDED_LOSS_GRACE_12M | NOT_APPLICABLE_ROLE | UNRESOLVED`;
- `article24_3_result: APPLICABLE | NOT_APPLICABLE_ROLE | UNRESOLVED`;
- `section4_result: APPLICABLE | EXCLUDED_CURRENT_MICRO_SMALL | EXCLUDED_LOSS_GRACE_12M | NOT_APPLICABLE_ROLE_OR_FEATURE | UNRESOLVED`.

`EXCLUDED_LOSS_GRACE_12M` requires the exact current approved size generation to carry `ELIGIBLE_ARTICLE_4_2`, `loss_pursuant_to_article_4_2=true`, current time before the legal-calendar grace end and no structural-immediate cause; absence or conflict yields UNRESOLVED, not grace. VLOP designation принудительно делает применимые role/feature layers того же exact designated service APPLICABLE независимо от size/grace и не переносится на другой сервис legal entity. Article 19 exclusion никогда не выключает Article 24(3), Article 29 касается только Section 4, а Article 18 остаётся hosting-role control. Lifecycle Section determination: `DRAFT → ASSESSING → REVIEWED → APPROVED → STALE | INVALIDATED | SUPERSEDED`; exactly one current generation существует на exact scope. Change legal entity, transaction/ownership/control/group graph, approved accounts, FX method, service/interface, distance-contract feature, target market, source rule or Commission designation invalidates only affected scope and atomically opens a transition impact generation effective from the legally approved change time; historical impact is reconciled, never silently backdated away.

`DSASectionTransitionImpactManifest` фиксирует every affected Article 30 dataset/projection, Article 31 offer/check/response case, Article 32 case, owner, expected/observed member count/ordered hash, lawful keep/delete/pause/republish action и signed receipt. Lifecycle: `OPEN → MEMBERS_FROZEN → OWNER_RECONCILING → COMPLETE | MANUAL_RECOVERY`; member-set change supersedes/restarts generation, COMPLETE requires exact expected=observed receipt manifest and no unresolved harmful action. `section4_result=UNRESOLVED` или stale сохраняет private draft/correction/waitlist, но запрещает DSA-based collection/publication/check/remediation mint. EXCLUDED не означает освобождение от иных consumer, safety, tax, P2B или platform-policy duties. Corporate size/ownership/accounting evidence доступно только Legal/Finance через purpose ABAC/JIT и не раскрывается guide/tourist.

For each public-profile surface revision, the same determination scope adds a counsel-approved `article30_use_classification: PROMOTE_MESSAGES | OFFER | NEITHER | UNRESOLVED`, `surface_schema_revision`, complete feature-manifest hash, consumer market/location scope, target interface/resource kind and effective interval. Any service description, remuneration/availability, CTA, booking/deep link, search/recommendation/SEO promotion or similar commercial feature invalidates a prior `NEITHER`; absence of one booking button never proves NEITHER. `Article30PromotionReadiness` is a derived/materialized projection `UNRESOLVED | NOT_APPLICABLE | INPUT_REQUIRED | ASSESSING | READY | CORRECTION_REQUIRED | STALE`, not a user-set aggregate. For exact EU consumers + Section 4 APPLICABLE + trader + `PROMOTE_MESSAGES | OFFER`, `PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY` requires READY and a current target-bound PublicTraderDisclosure. `UNRESOLVED` invokes the private-profile fallback and cannot trigger Article 30 collection; an actually `EXCLUDED`/`NEITHER` surface likewise must not collect those data solely under DSA.

### 6.20.0a DSAArticle13Applicability и legal representative readiness

Compliance Legal is single writer `DSAArticle13ApplicabilityDeterminationGeneration`, `DSALegalRepresentativeDesignationGeneration`, `DSAArticle13DSCNotificationGeneration`, `PublicDSALegalRepresentativeContact`, derived `DSAArticle13Readiness` and `DSAArticle13RouteBindingGeneration`; Privacy is sole writer of `Article13PublicContactProcessingPurposeGeneration`, and authorization coordinator alone writes the cross-owner action fence. The exact fields, predicates and independent state axes are defined in §4.9. One current generation exists per provider+service+effective interval; provider/service/offered-market/establishment/designation/mandate/contact/DSC/privacy-purpose status drift opens invalidation fencing and invalidates only matching readiness/route/public projections. `PublicDSALegalRepresentativeContact` is a closed name/postal/email/telephone DTO without arbitrary metadata or identity-document fields and has an exact current privacy-purpose FK whenever any field is personal data.

`DSAArticle13ActionFenceGeneration` reuses the §8.5 authorization fence protocol for exact provider/service/market partitions and actions `PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY`, `PUBLISH_EXCURSION`, `ACCEPT_BOOKING`, `CONFIRM_BOOKING`. Lifecycle is `REQUESTED → PARTITIONS_DRAINING → OWNER_FENCES_CONFIRMED → SOURCE_INVALIDATED → PROJECTIONS_RECONCILING → COMPLETE`, with `PARTITIONS_DRAINING | PROJECTIONS_RECONCILING → BLOCKED_MANUAL` and a controlled return to reconciliation. The coordinator's owner-local `PARTITIONS_DRAINING` transaction is the new-action linearization point: it increments the partition epoch and rejects new Reserve/Mark; every guide/booking final commit must live-check and Mark that exact coordinator epoch, never trust a cached readiness projection. Existing `COMMIT_STARTED` owners reconcile to one signed outcome before `OWNER_FENCES_CONFIRMED`; Compliance may derive `INVALIDATED`/terminal designation revocation only after that receipt, so no action can commit on the old epoch after the source terminal.

Revocation/supersession command first durably creates intent, then synchronously begins the coordinator fence. If the coordinator cannot prove `PARTITIONS_DRAINING`, affected new actions fail closed because final Mark is unavailable and UI shows `INVALIDATION_FENCE_PENDING`; private drafts, existing-booking service, cancellation/refund, complaints/appeals/privacy/safety and alternate Article 18 routing remain available. After `SOURCE_INVALIDATED`, outbox/inbox drives search/CDN/old-client/contact/route projections; their 30-second convergence SLO never represents authorization cutoff. No cross-DB atomicity is claimed: signed coordinator/owner/source receipts and exact epochs close each leg.

Guards `dsa_article13_applicability_current_scope_uq`, `dsa_article13_representative_member_state_offered_fk`, `dsa_article13_written_mandate_powers_resources_ck`, `dsa_article13_public_contact_processing_purpose_fk`, `dsa_article13_privacy_notice_before_publish_ck`, `dsa_article13_dsc_receipt_before_active_ck`, `dsa_article13_public_contact_before_active_ck`, `dsa_article13_action_fence_epoch_guard`, `dsa_article13_readiness_launch_guard` and `dsa_article18_legal_rep_route_active_fk` prevent partial designation/privacy/fence state from becoming ACTIVE or an Article 18 route. Revocation never blocks the independent imminent-safety fallback route.

### 6.20.1 DSAArticle18IncidentAssessment и DSAArticle18ReportAttempt

`DSAArticle18IncidentAssessment` хранит incident/context/hosting-role generations, immutable awareness evidence, offence-suspicion basis, threat-to-life-or-safety conclusion, temporal predicate, concerned-Member-State determinations, Article10Applicability, reviewer/emergency-policy, result, prompt_due_at и supersession. `Article18AvailableInformationSourceManifest` inventories every approved incident-relevant source owner and retrieval receipt at `information_available_as_of`; `AllRelevantAvailableInformationManifest` contains complete expected/observed item count/hash and per-item `INCLUDED | IRRELEVANT | DUPLICATE | LEGALLY_WITHHELD`. DUPLICATE references a canonical INCLUDED item. LEGALLY_WITHHELD requires a concrete conflicting prohibition/privilege source and Legal+Privacy approval; generic confidentiality, payload size or minimization alone is insufficient.

`DSAArticle18ReportAttempt` stores assessment, closed recipient-route and completed manifest generations, exact INCLUDED payload hash, external idempotency, dispatch/delivery/reconciliation. A known potentially relevant available item cannot be silently excluded; for imminent safety it is included conservatively absent explicit lawful withholding. Technical source outage never delays prompt reporting of all actually available relevant information: it opens an incident and `Article18SupplementAssessment` for later-arriving data, which itself requires current legal/routing assessment before any supplement. One assessment may have N recipient attempts; exact retry uses the same external identity and manifest.

### 6.20.2 TraderTraceabilityRecord и PublicTraderDisclosure

`TraderTraceabilityRecord` — private purpose-owned aggregate Article 30. Raw identity/payment values не дублируются в generic merchant profile: используются purpose-bound evidence/vault references. Каждое поле Article 30(1)(a)–(e) имеет source, declaration/assertion generation, completeness/reliability result, checked_at, correction state и relationship period.

`PublicTraderDisclosure` — отдельная generated table/DTO/proto без JSON catch-all и только с Article 30(1)(a), (d), (e) fields, source-record generation, target market/interface/surface discriminator `COMMERCIAL_GUIDE_PROFILE | EXCURSION_OFFER | CONTRACT_SNAPSHOT`, copy version, preview acknowledgement and published/valid/revoked timestamps. One-current projection exists only with a current complete source and current exact Section-4-applicable commercial surface. A public commercial guide profile composes this projection before discoverability even when no excursion offer is yet published; a demonstrably private/non-commercial workspace remains outside public discovery, and `UNRESOLVED` never becomes a non-commercial bypass. Profile/offer/contract snapshots preserve the exact shown version; private record, identity/eID evidence and payment-account vault are unserialisable in every client family.

`Article30PrivateDisclosureDecision` is the sole basis for outbound third-party disclosure, while ordinary internal Article 30 processing remains separate purpose ABAC. Aggregate stores request/recipient authority, exact applicable-law obligation/order/source, field allowlist, purpose, channel, maker/checker and outcome `NEEDS_INFORMATION | APPROVED_REQUIRED_BY_APPLICABLE_LAW | DENIED_NO_CONFIRMED_LEGAL_REQUIREMENT | CONFLICTED_LEGAL_REVIEW | EXPIRED | REVOKED`. Approval mints one-use `Article30PrivateDisclosureExecutionAuthority` bound to exact private-record generation, recipient legal identity/competence, law/order, purpose, fields, channel, execute_before and digest. Merchant owner forms the extract and signs `Article30PrivateDisclosureExecutionReceipt`; compliance never reads/copies raw record. Generic support/vendor/emergency label or recipient self-assertion cannot approve, and every internal/private access remains separately audited.

### 6.20.2a DSA Article 30(4), Article 20 complaint и Article 21 ODS

`DSAArticle30ServiceDecisionGeneration` accepts only trigger `ARTICLE30_1_REFUSAL | ARTICLE30_3_SUSPENSION`, pins trader/provider/service/interface/market, current Section-4 applicability, traceability/correction generations, facts/effect and exact `RestrictionDecision` for suspension. `DecisionRemedyRouteSetGeneration` is a complete concurrent manifest of `ARTICLE20_INTERNAL_COMPLAINT | ARTICLE21_CERTIFIED_ODS | JUDICIAL_PROCEEDINGS_INFO`; missing member or an exhaustion dependency blocks the decision commit.

`DSAArticle20ComplaintProfile` is a 1:1 typed subtype of `ComplianceAppeal` with discriminator `DSA_ART30_SERVICE_DECISION` and lifecycle `SUBMITTED → TRIAGED → IN_REVIEW ↔ NEEDS_INFO → UPHELD | OVERTURNED | PARTIALLY_OVERTURNED`; reversal continues `RESTORING → REINSTATED | RESTORATION_BLOCKED`. One current complaint exists per decision generation+appellant, new evidence is an immutable input revision, and the six-calendar-month access window uses an approved legal-calendar version. Finality requires reasoned-decision copy, qualified-human-supervision receipt, no solely automated resolution and current route set. `REINSTATED` requires a complete RestorationPlan owner-receipt manifest.

`DSAArticle21BodyRegistryGeneration` carries official-source version/fetched_at, current certified body identity, certification interval/status, expertise, languages, fees/cost rules and accessible routes. `DSAArticle21ProceedingGeneration` follows `ROUTE_PRESENTED → USER_SELECTED`; selection may move to `USER_FILING_EVIDENCE_ONLY` or directly to `BODY_INTAKE_CONFIRMED`, and a later authenticated body receipt moves `USER_FILING_EVIDENCE_ONLY → BODY_INTAKE_CONFIRMED` without a new case. Confirmed intake continues `PLATFORM_ENGAGING_GOOD_FAITH → BODY_DECISION_RECEIVED → IMPLEMENTATION_RECORDED`, with separate pre-intake `CERTIFICATION_INVALIDATED | ROUTE_UNRESOLVED` outcomes and a linked successor if the user chooses another current body. Body selection is user-controlled; changed/revoked certification fences new selection and moves any not-yet-confirmed intake to `CERTIFICATION_INVALIDATED`, while preserving received evidence/chronology and never removing official-directory/court access. Locked/former guides use exact Guide Rights operations `READ_ART30_DECISION`, `SUBMIT_ART20_COMPLAINT`, `READ_ART20_COMPLAINT`, `READ_ART21_ROUTE`, `SELECT_ART21_BODY`, `SUBMIT_ART21_RECEIPT`, `READ_ART21_PROCEEDING` without restoring account privileges.

#### Article 21(5) fee and reimbursement execution

Stable control `DSA-ART21-COST-ENTITLEMENT-01` is applicable only to an exact provider/service generation classified as `ONLINE_PLATFORM`, with current Section-3 result `APPLICABLE`, a proceeding actually submitted to a currently certified Article 21 body and an authenticated body outcome. Neither an admin label, a user-uploaded decision, a generic ADR case nor a platform-computed “winner” satisfies the predicate. The current body fee schedule or calculation mechanism is snapshotted and disclosed before engagement; choice, filing, internal complaint, court access and substantive reversal/restoration remain available if the fee or cost subsystem is unavailable or disputed.

Finance is sole writer of `DSAArticle21CostCaseGeneration`, `DSAArticle21ExpenseClaimGeneration`, `DSAArticle21CostEntitlementGeneration` and its settlement ledger; DSA integration authenticates the body outcome and fee-schedule evidence but cannot choose amounts. Cost case lifecycle is `OPEN → OUTCOME_AUTHENTICATED → EVIDENCE_COLLECTION → ENTITLEMENT_CALCULATED → HUMAN_REVIEWED → APPROVED → PAYMENT_PENDING → PARTIALLY_SETTLED | SETTLED → CLOSED`, with `OUTCOME_AUTHENTICATED → LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED → ENTITLEMENT_CALCULATED`, and `PAYMENT_PENDING | PARTIALLY_SETTLED → RECONCILING | FAILED_RETRYING`. Expense lines follow `SUBMITTED → VALIDATING → ACCEPTED | PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED | REJECTED`; every reduced/rejected item has an accessible item-level reason, while an undisputed accepted amount can be paid without waiting for the disputed remainder.

The statutory branch table is closed:

| Authenticated body outcome | Engine result |
|---|---|
| `RECIPIENT_FAVOUR` | FlyFy allocates all body fees to the platform, reimburses any body fee paid by the recipient and reimburses every other accepted reasonable expense paid in relation to the proceeding. |
| `PROVIDER_FAVOUR`, no authenticated manifest-bad-faith finding | `recipient_liability=0`; the recipient never reimburses platform fees or expenses. |
| `PROVIDER_FAVOUR` plus the body’s explicit authenticated finding that the recipient manifestly acted in bad faith | Only `POTENTIALLY_RECOVERABLE`: a separate exact lawful basis, amount, notice and Legal+Finance human approval are required. The finding alone never creates debt, balance set-off, payout hold or auto-debit. |
| `PARTIAL \| MIXED \| UNCLEAR` | No home-grown prorating. The body supplies an authenticated party-favour classification or Legal resolves the branch; until then `recipient_liability=0`. |
| `NO_DECISION \| WITHDRAWN \| SETTLED` | No automatic Article 21(5) allocation beyond an authenticated settlement or other separately applicable basis; FlyFy does not invoice the recipient by inference. |

Body charges to FlyFy must be reasonable and no higher than authenticated body costs; recipient access through FlyFy is free and any charge by the body is only free/nominal under its pre-disclosed schedule. A cap or schedule inconsistency opens an incident and legal review, never blocks the user’s ODS route. `RecordArticle21CostDisposition` accepts only a current engine-generated entitlement/version ID. Every mutation uses authenticated actor/body, `Idempotency-Key`, expected version, evidence hash and audit correlation; settlement consumes one-use `FinancialExecutionAuthority` and `SETTLED` requires an exact entitlement-ledger/payment-ledger receipt match. Direct table writes, in-place entitlement edits and automatic recovery from a recipient are denied by DB role and transition guards.

#### Article 24(1)(a) ODS transparency reporting

Stable control `DSA-ART24-ODS-REPORT-01` builds the Article 24(1)(a) section inside FlyFy’s canonical Article 15/24 report, not a free-form standalone JSON. Applicability is `ONLINE_PLATFORM AND DSA_SECTION_3=APPLICABLE` for the exact service/period; the Article 19 micro/small exclusion and its transition/grace treatment are taken from the current reviewed `DSASectionApplicabilityDeterminationGeneration`, while an Article 33 VLOP designation overrides the size exclusion. `UNRESOLVED` does not fabricate a report exemption and is escalated before the publication deadline.

Compliance Reporting is sole writer of `DSAArticle24ODSTransparencyReportGeneration`. It pins service, applicability/VLOP generations, official template `EU-2024-2835` source/digest, legal calendar/timezone, reporting period and complete frozen Article 21 source manifest. Ordinary services use `01-01..12-31`; designated VLOP/VLOSE use `01-01..06-30` and `07-01..12-31`; publication is due no later than two calendar months after period end. The chosen public machine-readable artifact is the official-template UTF-8 RFC-4180 CSV, accompanied by an accessible human-readable summary; all versions, correction dates and hashes remain public for at least five years.

The report computes the exact official fields for the ODS section: `total_disputes_submitted`, `decisions_upheld`, `decisions_partially_reversed`, `decisions_reversed`, `decisions_omitted`, `median_completion_time_hours` and `percentage_outcomes_implemented`. Total is distinct Article 21 disputes sent to a body in the period. `OMITTED` means the initial platform decision did not lead to a body decision, for example withdrawal after an out-of-system agreement; a still-pending proceeding is `PENDING_AT_SNAPSHOT`, not omitted. Median runs from `dispute_sent_to_body_at` through `decision_notified_to_provider_at`, in hours, under one approved methodology; omitted cases may be consistently excluded. The implementation denominator is `REVERSED + PARTIALLY_REVERSED`, and the numerator is the subset followed and implemented by FlyFy.

`percentage_outcomes_implemented` is a server-derived exact decimal fraction in the inclusive range `[0,1]`, never percentage points: `1 / 2` is serialized in the official artifact as `0.5`, not `50`. The owner stores numerator and denominator, derives the decimal with exact decimal arithmetic under the current official-template precision/rounding generation and rejects any client-supplied derived value. For an applicable zero denominator the official value is `0` with the required contextual explanation; blank, `NaN`, binary floating-point drift, division by zero and conversion of pending to omitted are prohibited. Human-readable UI renders the same canonical `0.5` as localized `50%`, while CSV remains `0.5`. Outcome subtotals need not equal total while a documented pending cohort remains. Source: [Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2835, Annex II general instructions](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2024/2835/oj/eng).

Lifecycle is `SCHEDULED → PERIOD_OPEN → PERIOD_CLOSED → FACTS_FROZEN → RECONCILING → RECONCILED → GENERATED → SCHEMA_VALIDATED → LEGAL_DATA_APPROVED → PUBLISHED → RETAINED`, with `RECONCILING → RECONCILIATION_FAILED → RECONCILING` and the exact correction branch defined below. The frozen manifest records expected/observed source events, duplicate/orphan/late events, unclassified outcomes, missing body receipts/end timestamps and every exclusion with reason. Count/hash mismatch, orphan or unclassified outcome blocks report publication only. A correction always creates a public successor version and never overwrites prior data.

Every report family uses the shared immutable `TransparencyReportCorrectionMetadata` required by Annex II §5 of the [Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2835](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2024/2835/oj/eng): `is_updated_version`, `supersedes_report_version_id`, `changes_made_at`, `correction_reason`, `rectification_methodology`, ordered `change_manifest[]` and `change_manifest_hash`. Each manifest member identifies official template section/indicator/scope, old/new canonical value hashes and a public-safe change description. The original has `is_updated_version=false` and all correction-only fields null/empty; every correction has them all non-null, points to an immutable predecessor for the same provider/service/period/template family, covers every canonical diff exactly once, forms no cycle, and satisfies `changes_made_at <= published_at`. A successor cannot alter provider/service/period identity, erase an older version or introduce PII.

The correction workflow is closed: `CORRECTION_DRAFT_OPEN → CORRECTION_METADATA_COMPLETE → CORRECTION_RECONCILING → CORRECTION_RECONCILED → CORRECTION_SCHEMA_VALIDATED → CORRECTION_LEGAL_DATA_APPROVED → CORRECTION_PUBLISHED`, with `CORRECTION_RECONCILING → CORRECTION_RECONCILIATION_FAILED → CORRECTION_RECONCILING`; any source or manifest drift returns it to reconciliation rather than editing an approved version. Current correction commands remain `api:dsa.OpenArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.UpdateArticle24CorrectionMetadata.v1`, `api:dsa.ReconcileArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.ValidateArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.ApproveArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.PublishArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`; public reads are `api:dsa.GetPublicArticle24Report.v2` and `api:dsa.GetPublicArticle24ReportVersions.v2`. Maker/checker separates data reconciliation from Legal approval. The public page marks the current version «Обновлено», shows correction date/reason/methodology, offers an accessible field-level change view and every signed CSV/version hash, and keeps all versions directly public for at least five years. `db:dsa_article24_correction_metadata_complete_ck`, `db:dsa_article24_correction_same_report_family_fk`, `db:dsa_article24_correction_diff_manifest_complete_ck`, `db:dsa_article24_correction_no_cycle_ck` and `db:dsa_article24_version_immutable_ck` enforce the contract.

These additions are the immutable current `contract:DSA-ART24-ODS-REPORT-01:v3`; `v1` and `v2` remain read-only predecessors and are never mutated or aliased. The v3 delta replaces `schema:dsa.Article24ODSTransparencyReport.v2` with `schema:dsa.Article24ODSTransparencyReport.v3`, adds `schema:dsa.Article24PercentageMetric.v1`, `api:dsa.GenerateArticle24Report.v2`, `api:dsa.ValidateArticle24OfficialTemplate.v2`, `api:dsa.PublishArticle24Report.v2`, `api:dsa.GetPublicArticle24Report.v2`, `api:dsa.GetPublicArticle24ReportVersions.v2` and `event:dsa.article24_report_published.v2`, and pins fraction scale, numerator, denominator, exact rounding and HTML/CSV parity. A v1/v2 producer or consumer cannot satisfy the v3 gate merely because the base fields parse. DB guards `db:dsa_article24_percentage_fraction_range_ck`, `db:dsa_article24_percentage_derived_from_counts_ck` and `db:dsa_article24_zero_denominator_context_ck` reject negative, `>1`, percentage-point and unexplained zero-denominator values.

Rights-path isolation is architectural: Article 20/21 filing, outcome, implementation, restoration and cost commits complete with their transactional outbox before any asynchronous Article 24 consumer. Reporting is a rebuildable read model and may not participate synchronously in those commands. A total reporting outage, reconciliation failure or missed internal target cannot block ODS selection, complaints, court information, restoration or reimbursement; it creates only a reporting incident, deadline escalation and truthful publication status.

#### Article 42 VLOP/VLOSE transparency and audit publication

Stable control `DSA-ART42-REPORT-01` is conditional on a formal current Commission Article 33 designation for the exact provider legal entity and named service; MAU estimates, group-company status or an internal risk label never activate it for another service. `DSAArticle42ApplicabilityGeneration` pins designation decision/source, notification date, service, `VLOP | VLOSE`, Section-5 effective date four months after notification, any termination decision and its effective date, and result `NOT_DESIGNATED | NOT_YET_EFFECTIVE | APPLICABLE_VLOP | APPLICABLE_VLOSE | CESSATION_PENDING | NOT_APPLICABLE | UNRESOLVED`. `UNRESOLVED` escalates reporting readiness but never fabricates designation or blocks user complaint, booking, payment, privacy or safety rights. Source: [DSA Articles 33 and 42](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2065/oj/eng).

The control has two independent aggregates and deadlines. `DSAArticle42TemplateReportGeneration` is scheduled from a closed `DSAArticle42ReportingObligationWindow`, not only from semester rows. `trigger` is `INITIAL_AFTER_SECTION5_APPLICATION | HARMONISED_HALF_YEAR`. For an exact current designation, `section5_application_at` is calculated under Article 33(6) as four calendar months after Commission notification; exactly one initial obligation is created with `due_at = section5_application_at + 2 calendar months`. Subsequent obligations use the current approved Article 42/Implementing-Regulation reporting-calendar generation and are due no later than two calendar months after the applicable reporting period. Coverage dates and any conclusion that one publication may satisfy both an initial and a harmonised-period obligation require a current `Article42TransitionRuleGeneration` with source, rationale and EU Legal approval. Missing or conflicting transition treatment is `UNRESOLVED`, pages Legal/Reporting and cannot remove, postpone or silently replace the initial statutory deadline. The obligation manifest stores every satisfied obligation ID; one report cannot silently close two clocks.

Each obligation covers Article 42(1)–(3) plus the harmonised Article 15/24 template, one exact designated service, the official CSV/XLSX schema, a mandatory public Open Document Format CSV conforming to RFC 4180 in UTF-8, and the shared correction/five-year-public-version contract above. XLSX may be an authoring/template representation but never substitutes for the required public CSV artifact. Article 42(1) applies to both VLOP and VLOSE.

Article 42(2) data is accepted only for a VLOP and uses two non-interchangeable complete manifests. `Article42HumanResourcesLanguageManifest` has one canonical row for each applicable official language of the Member States in which the exact service is offered, derived from current offered-Member-State and official-language registry generations. `Article42AccuracyLanguageManifest` has one canonical row for each official language required by the current Article 42(2)(c) official template and is not reduced to languages of the offered Member States. Each manifest stores its own expected/observed count and ordered hash; equality between the two language sets is never assumed. Human-resource rows contain internal/external moderator FTE methodology, qualification level under EQF or a documented approved equivalent, linguistic-expertise assessment, training type/frequency/content, mental and physical support measures and the methodology used to compute human resources. The Annex II CEFR B2 `Understanding` threshold is used only to classify sufficient linguistic expertise for this reporting indicator; it is not a universal employment, guide-licensing or certificate requirement. Blank rows are prohibited; typed N/A/unavailable explanation is accepted only where the current official template and approved interpretation permit it. Moderator names, employee IDs and individual performance are not representable. Article 42(3) records average monthly active recipients for each Member State. The public report is available in at least one official language of a Member State; localization cannot change the underlying numeric/schema version. Source: [DSA Article 42(1)–(3)](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2065/oj/eng) and [Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2835, Annexes I–II](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_impl/2024/2835/oj/eng).

`DSAArticle42AuditPublicationBundleGeneration` independently covers Article 42(4)–(5). For each audit cycle it freezes a complete manifest of the Article 34 risk-assessment report, Article 35 mitigation measures, Article 37(4) audit report, Article 37(6) audit-implementation report and consultation information where applicable. Transmission of the complete unredacted bundle to the Commission and DSC is tracked separately and occurs without undue delay; public publication has a hard legal-calendar deadline no later than three months after receipt of the audit report. A missing consultation member must be an approved `NOT_APPLICABLE` conclusion, not omission. Each public redaction has field/section, exact closed Article 42(5) ground, necessity/proportionality rationale, approvers and public placeholder; commercial-confidentiality or security-risk grounds cannot become a generic whole-document hide. The unredacted bundle and reasons for removals remain available to the Commission/DSC. Public and authority transmission receipts are independent—one cannot satisfy the other. The unredacted authority bundle lives in a separate non-public object-store partition as KMS envelope-encrypted ciphertext with immutable content/manifest digests; purpose-bound ABAC, JIT access, MFA, maker/checker and an append-only access/export audit are mandatory. Public-report/CDN roles have an explicit deny and cannot obtain its object key, plaintext or signed authority URL. Decryption is allowed only for the exact authority transmission or approved regulator-response purpose, in isolated memory, with short-lived recipient-bound delivery authority and a separately verified recipient receipt.

Template-report lifecycle is `OBLIGATION_WINDOW_CREATED → SCHEDULED → PERIOD_OPEN → PERIOD_CLOSED → FACTS_FROZEN → RECONCILING → RECONCILED → TEMPLATE_VALIDATED → LEGAL_DATA_APPROVED → PUBLISHED → RETAINED`, with `RECONCILING → RECONCILIATION_FAILED → RECONCILING` and immutable correction successors following the full shared Annex II metadata/reconcile/validate/approve/publish branch. `PUBLISHED` requires a complete satisfied-obligation manifest and never closes an initial window through a semester row without the current transition rule. Audit-bundle lifecycle reaches either `AUTHORITY_TRANSMITTED` or `TRANSMISSION_RECONCILING` after `AUDIT_REPORT_RECEIVED → MEMBER_MANIFEST_FROZEN → AUTHORITY_TRANSMISSION_DUE`; independently, the publication branch reaches either `PUBLICATION_PUBLISHED` or `PUBLICATION_OVERDUE` after `PUBLICATION_PREPARING → REDACTION_REVIEW → PUBLICATION_APPROVED`. Neither branch may falsely close the other. A published audit bundle is immutable but not an uncorrectable dead end: `AUDIT_CORRECTION_DRAFT_OPEN → AUDIT_CORRECTION_METADATA_COMPLETE → AUDIT_CORRECTION_RECONCILING → AUDIT_CORRECTION_RECONCILED → AUDIT_CORRECTION_SECURITY_LEGAL_APPROVED → AUDIT_CORRECTION_PUBLISHED`, with a typed failed-reconcile loop. `Article42AuditPublicationCorrectionMetadata` records predecessor, change timestamp/reason, complete canonical diff and redaction-decision diff, and exactly one correction class: `PUBLIC_PRESENTATION_OR_REDACTION_ONLY` or `UNDERLYING_REPORT_CHANGED`. An underlying-report change requires a new restricted bundle digest and separate corrected Commission/DSC transmission plus recipient receipts before public successor publication; a presentation/redaction-only correction may not change the restricted bundle digest. All public predecessors remain directly accessible for five years. This audit-correction chain is a FlyFy integrity/safety control and does not assert that Annex II §5 itself governs Article 42(4) audit-bundle corrections.
