Every generation stores legal-calendar version, expected/observed member count+ordered hash, source versions, maker/checker, publication languages, public/private digests, receipt timestamps and correction lineage.

Compliance Reporting is the only writer. Current `contract:DSA-ART42-REPORT-01:v2` has immutable v1 as predecessor and contains `schema:dsa.Article42Applicability.v1`, `schema:dsa.Article42ReportingObligationWindow.v1`, `schema:dsa.Article42TransitionRuleGeneration.v1`, `schema:dsa.Article42TemplateReport.v2`, `schema:dsa.Article42HumanResourcesLanguageManifest.v1`, `schema:dsa.Article42AccuracyLanguageManifest.v1`, `schema:dsa.Article42ModeratorQualificationSummary.v1`, `schema:dsa.Article42AuditPublicationBundle.v1`, `schema:dsa.TransparencyReportCorrectionMetadata.v1`, `schema:dsa.Article42AuditPublicationCorrectionMetadata.v1`; APIs `api:dsa.DetermineArticle42Applicability.v1`, `api:dsa.CreateArticle42ReportingObligationWindow.v1`, `api:dsa.CreateArticle42ReportPeriod.v2`, `api:dsa.FreezeArticle42TemplateFacts.v2`, `api:dsa.ReconcileArticle42TemplateReport.v2`, `api:dsa.ValidateArticle42OfficialTemplate.v2`, `api:dsa.ApproveArticle42TemplateReport.v2`, `api:dsa.PublishArticle42TemplateReport.v2`, `api:dsa.OpenArticle42ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.UpdateArticle42CorrectionMetadata.v1`, `api:dsa.ReconcileArticle42ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.ValidateArticle42ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.ApproveArticle42ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.PublishArticle42ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.RecordArticle42AuditReportReceipt.v1`, `api:dsa.OpenArticle42AuditPublicationBundle.v1`, `api:dsa.FreezeArticle42AuditMemberManifest.v1`, `api:dsa.RecordArticle42AuthorityTransmission.v1`, `api:dsa.RecordArticle42AuthorityRecipientReceipt.v1`, `api:dsa.ReviewArticle42PublicRedactions.v1`, `api:dsa.PublishArticle42AuditBundle.v1`, `api:dsa.OpenArticle42AuditPublicationCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.UpdateArticle42AuditPublicationCorrectionMetadata.v1`, `api:dsa.ReconcileArticle42AuditPublicationCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.ReviewArticle42AuditCorrectionRedactions.v1`, `api:dsa.ApproveArticle42AuditPublicationCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.PublishArticle42AuditPublicationCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.GetPublicArticle42Reports.v2`, `api:dsa.GetPublicArticle42ReportVersions.v2`. Its exact events are `event:dsa.article42_applicability_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_reporting_obligation_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_reporting_deadline_risk_detected.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_language_manifest_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_language_manifest_gap_detected.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_template_period_changed.v2`, `event:dsa.article42_template_facts_frozen.v2`, `event:dsa.article42_template_reconciliation_changed.v2`, `event:dsa.article42_template_source_gap_detected.v2`, `event:dsa.article42_template_report_published.v2`, `event:dsa.article42_report_correction_workflow_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_report_correction_published.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_public_version_index_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_audit_report_receipt_recorded.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_audit_member_manifest_frozen.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_audit_authority_transmission_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_audit_authority_recipient_receipt_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_public_redaction_review_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_audit_publication_changed.v1`, `event:dsa.article42_audit_correction_workflow_changed.v1` and `event:dsa.article42_audit_correction_published.v1`. Each event is an exact `EventArtifactPair` whose explicit `payload_schema_id`, version and digest are stored in the registry contract manifest; no suffix inference, implicit v1 or family alias is allowed. Template correction requires complete Annex II metadata, reconciliation, template validation and Legal/Data approval. Audit correction independently requires complete class/content/redaction diffs, reconciliation, Security+Legal approval and any corrected recipient receipts required by its class; neither workflow has a direct Open→Publish shortcut.

DB and storage-policy guards enforce exact service/designation/effective-period FK; one initial obligation per designation; Article 33(6) and two-calendar-month calculations; trigger-field and approved transition-rule completeness; complete satisfied-obligation manifest; VLOP-only Article 42(2) columns; separate complete human-resource applicable-language and all-official-language accuracy manifests; CEFR `Understanding` classification and complete EQF/equivalent, training, support and calculation-methodology semantics; every-Member-State MAU manifest; no same-family period overlap; complete audit member set; distinct Commission/DSC/public receipts; ciphertext-only restricted authority objects; public-role deny and immutable access-audit linkage; closed redaction grounds; three-month deadline; no PII in public aggregates; template and audit-correction metadata completeness; same-family complete diffs; no cycles; correct underlying-change recipient receipts; immutability and five-year availability. Admin UX shows three non-conflated cards—«Первый отчёт после назначения», «Полугодовой отчёт» and «Публикация аудита»—with application date, source completeness, legal deadline/timezone, blockers, owner, maker/checker and exact next action. Human-resource and accuracy sections have separate captions, completeness indicators and blockers; a green aggregate is forbidden if either is incomplete. The audit card exposes a separate correction action only after immutable predecessor selection, classified impact preview and warning when corrected Commission/DSC transmission is required; no edit-in-place control exists. Public UX provides accessible HTML summaries plus official downloads, service/period/designation source, methodology/language, version/correction history and audit redaction explanations without exposing confidential or personal data.

`test:DSA-ART42-REPORT-01` covers VLOP/VLOSE/non-designated/wrong-service and four-month activation/termination boundaries; initial notification/application/due dates at month-end, leap day and every semester boundary; exactly-one initial obligation, late ingestion, cessation/redesignation and initial-to-recurring transition; a single publication satisfying two obligations only through an approved mapping; half-year row never suppressing the initial deadline; Article 42(2) VLOP-only separate language manifests with offered-France versus full accuracy-language set, shared languages, registry change, B1/B2 and wrong CEFR component, missing EQF/equivalent/training/support/methodology, zero-versus-missing and VLOSE rejection; Article 42(3) every-Member-State denominator; duplicate/late/gapped facts; official schema/localization; complete audit bundle, consultation N/A proof, Commission/DSC receipt independence, public-transmission independence, three-month boundary, every allowed/forbidden redaction, template correction and both audit-correction classes, wrong-family/incomplete-diff/cycle/timestamp negatives, underlying-change corrected-recipient receipts and five-year predecessor availability. Security cases deny public/CDN/reporting-reader access to the unredacted key/object, reject cross-cycle or cross-recipient delivery authority, and prove that events, logs, traces and analytics contain only opaque generation/digest/status data—never raw audit content, redaction rationale text or moderator HR details. Reporting outage must block only the affected report/transmission/publication finality. SLO/dashboard/runbook are `dash:dsa_article42_reporting`, `alert:dsa_article42_designation_or_period_gap`, `alert:dsa_article42_initial_deadline_risk`, `alert:dsa_article42_obligation_window_gap`, `alert:dsa_article42_hr_language_gap`, `alert:dsa_article42_accuracy_language_gap`, `alert:dsa_article42_language_semantics_gap`, `alert:dsa_article42_language_manifest_conflation`, `alert:dsa_article42_audit_bundle_or_transmission_gap`, `alert:dsa_article42_publication_deadline_risk`, `alert:dsa_article42_redaction_or_five_year_gap`, `alert:dsa_article42_unredacted_access_violation`, `rb:dsa-article42-reporting`; product measurement is `metric:DSA-ART42-REPORT-01` with `GOVERNANCE_ONLY` applicability and no user conversion cohort.

### 6.20.3 Article30RetentionSchedule

Schedule хранит immutable `relationship_period_id`, authoritative start/end event, legal timezone/calendar-rule version, `retention_end_at`, deletion state `SCHEDULED | DUE | DELETING | DELETED | FAILED`, purpose-binding manifest, owner, due/absolute due и deletion receipts owners/backups/vendors. Ровно на `retention_end_at` Article 30 purpose-access/key grant отключается и deletion job становится DUE; physical primary/replica/vendor purge запускается немедленно и остаётся incident-visible до signed manifest. Исправление relationship end создаёт superseding generation и никогда молча не продлевает срок. Public projection lifetime и private six-calendar-month retention независимы.

### 6.20.4 DSAArticle31Applicability и offer compliance-by-design

Compliance-service является single writer `DSAArticle31ApplicabilityGeneration`, `Article31InterfaceCapabilityManifest`, `Article31OfferComplianceAssessment`, `Article31OfficialDatabaseEligibilityAssertion`, `Article31RandomCheckBatch`, `Article31OfficialDatabaseCheckGeneration` and `Article31TraderResponseCaseGeneration`; excursion-service remains writer offer revision/typed trader input. Applicability pins RegulatoryRoleDetermination, exact current DSASectionApplicability/enterprise-size/VLOP generations, distance-contract marketplace feature, target interface/market, trader/consumer contract model, applicable Union pre-contractual/product-or-service-safety requirement set and valid interval. `NOT_APPLICABLE` always has basis/source/expiry; missing/stale applicability gives no public offer but preserves private draft/correction and does not authorize new DSA-specific data collection.

Interface capability manifest maps each applicable Article 31(1), 31(2)(a), (b), and where applicable (c) information requirement to typed input, validation owner, public surface, durable contract field, locale/accessibility evidence and schema/code version with expected/observed count/hash. `Article31OfferInformationManifest` uses closed field state `PRESENT | NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_BASIS | MISSING | UNCERTAIN`; arbitrary JSON is forbidden. `PublicArticle31OfferDisclosure` is a closed projection of approved required fields only and excludes Article30(b)/(c), sampling/match status, reviewer notes and raw registry response.

Offer assessment stores exact excursion/offer revision, trader/public-disclosure generation, required-field expected/observed manifest/hash, Article 31 provision/completeness result, separately labelled optional platform consistency/reliability checks, approved copy/schema versions, correction tasks, valid_until and lifecycle:

    INPUT_REQUIRED → ASSESSING → READY_TO_OFFER
      |                 ↘ POSSIBLE_ILLEGAL_MATCH_REVIEW → READY_TO_OFFER | BLOCKED_NONCOMPLIANT
      └────────────────────────────────────────────────→ BLOCKED_NONCOMPLIANT
    any non-terminal current result → STALE | SUPERSEDED

`READY_TO_OFFER` означает только пройденный best-efforts Article 31 gate для exact revision; не гарантирует законность/качество и не заменяет иные authorization requirements. Excursion publish CAS требует current READY_TO_OFFER when applicable. Closed DTO физически запрещает missing required field, arbitrary metadata catch-all и client-supplied assessment status.

After trader is allowed to offer, independent of awareness/complaint, `Article31RandomCheckBatch` stores complete eligible population count/hash, sampling window/policy/version, pre-selection seed commitment, selected count/hash and immutable selection receipt. Source eligibility is `ELIGIBLE | NOT_ELIGIBLE | NO_APPLICABLE_SOURCE_IDENTIFIED | STALE` with official-owner, freely-accessible and machine-readable proof. Each selected-offer check stores minimized query/hash and `SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE | NO_MATCH | POSSIBLE_MATCH | OFFICIAL_ILLEGAL_IDENTIFICATION_CONFIRMED`. Seller sees no seed before closure; protected traits, private Article30(b)/(c), residential-contact classification and manipulable seller signal cannot select/query. SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE/no source is never NO_MATCH. POSSIBLE_MATCH atomарно открывает fenced human review plus exactly one current `Article31TraderResponseCaseGeneration` and neutral durable notice; only current human-confirmed official identification plus independent RestrictionDecision can block/unpublish. Offer/source/rule revision supersedes dependent check and case.

`Article31TraderResponseCaseGeneration`, stable control `DSA-ART31-TRADER-RESPONSE-01`, stores exact offer/check/source/applicability generations, safe match summary and source/date, requested facts, accepted purpose-bound evidence kinds, current append-only response revision/disposition, owner, due_at, non-pausable absolute_due_at, next_update_at, locale/copy and notice/receipt refs. Lifecycle is closed:

    OPEN → AWAITING_RESPONSE | IN_REVIEW
    AWAITING_RESPONSE → RESPONSE_RECEIVED | RESPONSE_WINDOW_EXPIRED | SUPERSEDED
    RESPONSE_RECEIVED → IN_REVIEW | NEEDS_INFO | SUPERSEDED
    NEEDS_INFO → RESPONSE_RECEIVED | RESPONSE_WINDOW_EXPIRED | SUPERSEDED
    RESPONSE_WINDOW_EXPIRED → IN_REVIEW
    IN_REVIEW → CLEARED_NO_CONFIRMED_MATCH
              | CONFIRMED_OFFICIAL_IDENTIFICATION
              | INCONCLUSIVE_RECHECK_SCHEDULED
              | NEEDS_INFO
    any non-terminal → SUPERSEDED

Silence, expiry or missing attachment is never admission, fraud finding, DENY or CONFIRMED. Typed response revisions and response-vs-review race use case-generation CAS; reviewer decision pins current response/disposition generation and stale review fails. Evidence enters only through purpose-bound EvidenceUpload/ProfessionalEvidenceBinding, never raw registry payload. `CONFIRMED_OFFICIAL_IDENTIFICATION` itself has no pause/unpublish power; a separate human RestrictionDecision with notice/appeal is mandatory. Decision before response deadline is allowed only by a versioned legal/safety exception with exact reason, maker/checker, notice and appeal. Guide never sees seed/population, raw query/registry response, Article30(b)/(c), residential-contact classification or another case. Locked/former/terminated access uses the same case and immutable submit receipt through Guide Rights; re-exchange never resets response/deadline.

### 6.20.5 DSA statement-of-reasons и Article 32 remediation

Compliance-service owns `DSAStatementOfReasonsSubmissionGeneration`; booking/notification boundary jointly executes `DSAArticle32RemediationCase` through signed owner receipts. Statement submission lifecycle is `DUE → REDACTING → VALIDATED → DISPATCHING → RECEIPT_CONFIRMED | DELIVERY_UNRESOLVED | FAILED_RETRYING | SUPERSEDED`, with exact source restriction/decision/copy, de-identification manifest, Commission schema version, external idempotency identity, due/absolute due and receipt reconciliation. PII-bearing or schema-invalid payload cannot dispatch; failure never changes the underlying user decision or appeal right.

Article 32 case is created only from a current Section 4 APPLICABLE `DSASectionApplicabilityDeterminationGeneration`, exact statutory-condition assessment and immutable affected-offer/trader/buyer manifest. Branch selection is explicit: every contactable buyer in the applicable six-calendar-month lookback gets a direct durable notice; when contact details of all concerned consumers are unavailable, a public/easily-accessible notice is also published. Both branches carry the required illegal product/service fact, trader identity and relevant redress, with minimized data, copy/version, recipient/publication receipts, availability monitoring, correction/supersession/removal and owner/due/absolute due. Neither external provider acceptance nor a public draft proves completion; applicability transition cannot erase an already independent consumer-remedy obligation.

### 6.21 RemediationProposal и TouristRemedyDecision

Booking-service владеет immutable versioned RemediationProposal:

- booking/contract/current state и before snapshot;
- proposed guide/route/date/price/terms и after snapshot;
- materiality/basis, affected obligations и safe explanation;
- доступные ACCEPT_CHANGE, CHOOSE_ALTERNATIVE, CANCEL_REFUND, CONTACT_SUPPORT choices;
- refund/fee/tax consequences, response deadline/legal timezone, expires_at и proposal_version;
- supersedes/superseded_by и default lawful action при отсутствии ответа, который никогда не называется consent.

TouristRemedyDecision содержит proposal/version, selected choice, user-delegated authorization, viewed ExplanationView/contract diff, decided_at, idempotency key и durable receipt. Lifecycle:

    PROPOSED → VIEWED → ACCEPTED | DECLINED | EXPIRED | SUPERSEDED
    ACCEPTED → PAYMENT_REQUIRED | APPLYING → APPLIED | REMEDIATION_FAILED
    PAYMENT_REQUIRED → APPLYING | EXPIRED

Decision применяется одной booking-service CAS-транзакцией только к expected booking/proposal/contract version. Cancellation/refund/check-in/new remediation race даёт deterministic conflict/current status; старое или replayed consent не меняет booking. Молчание, push open и продолжение использования приложения не считаются ACCEPTED. Существенная замена вступает в силу только после explicit decision; иначе срабатывает заранее раскрытый lawful cancellation/refund/alternative path.

TouristRemedyDecision не разрешает скрытый дополнительный charge: price increase требует отдельной current quote/payment authorization/SCA, а price decrease создаёт transparent refund/credit-note obligation. Если дополнительный платёж не завершён, исходное решение остаётся PAYMENT_REQUIRED/alternative-remedy state, но не считается применённой заменой.

### 6.22 ConsentGrant и ConsentWithdrawalReceipt

Privacy/consent context владеет append-only consent ledger. ConsentGrant хранит subject, controller/legal entity, exact purpose, processing/data categories/recipients, Article 9/22 explicit-consent marker при применимости, approved notice/message/copy version/hash/locale, presentation/distinguishability proof, affirmative action/channel, granted_at/effective_at/expires_at, service-conditioning assessment и consent_epoch. Когда применим GDPR Article 8 либо иной child-consent rule, grant дополнительно pin-ит current MinorProtectionApplicability, rule/threshold/source generation, privacy-minimal age-assurance claim и — только если требуется — proportional parental-responsibility verification method/risk/`reasonable_efforts_result`, scope/expiry/revocation. Для COPPA path grant/processing authority отдельно pin-ит current COPPAApplicability, audience classification, VPC purpose, recipient/third-party-disclosure/targeted-advertising policy epoch and approved exception or parental notice/consent generation. Audience/VPC/purpose/recipient-policy change immediately supersedes dependent grant/processing authority; ordinary Article 7 or general-purpose parental receipt is insufficient. Full guardian ID/civil-status document не является default; exact law/risk may require minimum proof, with accessible recovery/manual route. Majority transition supersede-ит dependent grant/authority without retaining unnecessary guardian data.

Grant действителен только если purpose granular, language intelligible, choice freely given, consent отделён от прочих terms, checkbox/toggle не preselected, отказ не блокирует ненужным образом service и до действия ясно показана equal-ease withdrawal. Bundled «согласие на всё», молчание и inferred clickstream запрещены. Article 22(2)(c) или Article 9 explicit-consent gateway принимает только current qualifying grant receipt; legal-obligation/contract processing не маскируется consent.

Grant API валидирует short-lived signed presentation_token, bound к subject/session, purpose/controller, exact approved copy/hash/locale и expiry; token одноразовый и не позволяет client заявить, что была показана другая версия. Повтор с тем же idempotency key возвращает прежний receipt, а changed purpose/copy конфликтует.

Withdrawal создаёт immutable ConsentWithdrawalReceipt с subject, controller_legal_entity_id, purpose, target grant_id либо ALL_ACTIVE_GRANTS, expected/current consent_epoch, effective_at и command/idempotency proof. Consent epoch монотонен на subject + controller + purpose; withdrawal и concurrent grant сериализуются CAS, поэтому stale expected epoch конфликтует, а не отзывается чрезмерно и не оставляет новый grant незамеченным. С effective_at targeted processing запрещено. Service owners получают только signed minimal controller/purpose-scoped grant/withdrawal projection. Renewal/material purpose change создаёт новый grant, не переписывает прежний. Legacy consent без доказуемого provenance не мигрируется как valid: processing останавливается до valid re-permission либо переводится на независимо подтверждённое lawful basis с новым notice.

Authenticated owner session остаётся основным путём, но не единственным. ConsentWithdrawalAuthorityAttempt даёт locked, former, deleted-account и accountless subject безопасный recovery path без восстановления аккаунта. Attempt хранит opaque non-enumerable ID, controller_legal_entity_id, purpose, target grant_id/ALL_ACTIVE_GRANTS, requested_at, verification method/status, minimized verified subject reference, expires_at и audit; lifecycle:

    CREATED → VERIFICATION_REQUIRED
    VERIFICATION_REQUIRED → VERIFIED | NEEDS_INFO | EXPIRED | CANCELLED
    NEEDS_INFO → VERIFICATION_REQUIRED | EXPIRED | CANCELLED
    VERIFIED → CONSUMED | EXPIRED

Intake rate-limited и отвечает одинаково независимо от существования аккаунта/grant. Проверка использует только пропорциональные ранее известные contact/transaction/receipt claims, short-lived challenges и доступную non-biometric/human alternative; полный identity document не является default. VERIFIED выдаёт single-use short-lived withdrawal authority, криптографически bound к subject, controller, purpose, target grants и expected consent_epoch. Withdrawal endpoint принимает либо live owner session, либо эту authority, атомарно потребляет её и выполняет тот же consent-epoch CAS с немедленным effective receipt. Replay, cross-controller, changed-purpose и broader-target попытки отклоняются. При безопасном epoch conflict server возвращает только после verification новый current-scope preview; пока attempt остаётся VERIFIED и subject/controller/purpose не изменились, пользователь может получить replacement single-use authority после повторного explicit confirmation без повторной identity proof. Новый grant или более широкий target никогда не отзывается молча. Для deleted account retained consent-ledger references используются только в разрешённом retention perimeter, чтобы остановить ещё активную consent-based обработку у owners/vendors без воссоздания профиля. Recovery не превращается в DSAR queue и не добавляет искусственную задержку после успешной проверки.

### 6.23 NotificationDisclosureProfile и durable delivery

Compliance/legal-content is the single writer of `NotificationDisclosureProfileGeneration`: purpose/notice class, mandatory/optional classification, allowed channels, full durable-inbox copy/locale/fallback, generic external subject/body schemas and hashes, sensitivity, recipient/controller/retention and escalation policy, effective interval, maker/checker, current/revoke generation. Source services create only idempotent source intents; they cannot mark notification publication or delivery.

Notification-service owns `DurableInboxNotice`, `ChannelDeliveryAttempt`, `DeliveryEvidence` and `NoticeEscalationGeneration`. Notice stores stable `notice_intent_id`, opaque recipient, source aggregate/action/decision/version, profile/copy/locale generation, immutable full-content hash/ref, published/superseded/expired timestamps and separate read/acknowledgement receipt. External delivery state is `QUEUED → DISPATCHED → PROVIDER_ACCEPTED | PROVIDER_REJECTED | UNKNOWN`; trustworthy device delivery, where available, is a separate evidence generation. Provider acceptance is not device delivery, escalation is not delivery, and channel preference never suppresses a mandatory durable-inbox publication.

One notice exists per `(notice_intent_id, recipient, copy_generation)`. Durable publication precedes external dispatch; retry preserves one notice identity, and supersession never mutates history. External lock-screen/email/SMS schemas physically exclude sensitive fields and use approved generic copy. Every attempt has provider/contact-binding hash, due/next/absolute due, sequence/idempotency and receipt; mandatory notice reconciliation never invents delivery from a provider callback.

Mandatory adverse/restrictive notice uses an explicit prepare/publish/consume saga rather than pretending cross-service ACID. Source-owned `RestrictionIntent.mode` is closed: `ORDINARY | EMERGENCY`. Ordinary lifecycle is `PREPARED → NOTICE_PREPARING → NOTICE_PUBLISHED → EFFECT_COMMITTING → EFFECTIVE`, with failure `CANCELLED | NOTICE_WITHDRAWAL_REQUIRED | RECONCILING`. Emergency lifecycle is separate: before Start, `PREPARED → EMERGENCY_AUTHORIZED → EFFECT_STARTING → EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED`; after Start, `EFFECT_STARTING → EFFECT_COMMITTING → EMERGENCY_EFFECTIVE_PENDING_NOTICE → NOTICE_PUBLISHED → EFFECT_CONFIRMED`, and any uncertainty after Start/effect goes to RECONCILING. The two unstarted terminals require the matching source execution terminal and both closure receipts in the protocol below; they are not cancellation/no-effect of an applied restriction. Source intent stores expected resource/policy/copy generations but has no ordinary adverse effect before publication.

Notification-owned `MandatoryNotice` is mode-discriminated and the schemas/states cannot cross. ORDINARY transitions are `ORDINARY_PREPARED → ORDINARY_PUBLISHED_PENDING_EFFECT | ORDINARY_WITHDRAWN | ORDINARY_RECONCILING`; `ORDINARY_PUBLISHED_PENDING_EFFECT → ORDINARY_EFFECT_CONFIRMED | ORDINARY_CORRECTED | ORDINARY_WITHDRAWN | ORDINARY_RECONCILING`; reconciliation may reach only the same ordinary terminals from authoritative source/publication receipts. EMERGENCY notice is materialized only from the signed source `EmergencyEffectCommittedReceipt` directly in `EMERGENCY_EFFECT_COMMITTED_PENDING_PUBLICATION`; it moves to `EMERGENCY_PUBLISHED_CONFIRMED | EMERGENCY_RECONCILING`, and reconciliation may reach `EMERGENCY_PUBLISHED_CONFIRMED | EMERGENCY_CORRECTED`. Correction/withdrawal is an append-only linked notice generation with original chronology, never an in-place rewrite. `EMERGENCY_*` can never enter `ORDINARY_PREPARED` or `ORDINARY_PUBLISHED_PENDING_EFFECT`, and `PUBLISHED_PENDING_EFFECT` is not a generic state.

Notification-service publishes the exact approved immutable notice to durable inbox and returns signed `NoticePublicationReceipt`. For ORDINARY, source owner then rechecks resource/policy versions and one local CAS transaction consumes that receipt, makes only the matching restriction effective and writes outbox; DB requires publication receipt and `effective_at >= published_at`. If source CAS fails after publication, notice is promptly corrected/withdrawn and visibly says the planned action did not take effect; no ghost adverse status is inferred. Ack loss is reconciled by the same source/notice idempotency key.

EMERGENCY requires a one-use `EmergencyRestrictionAuthorityGeneration` with exact closed legal/safety basis, subject/resource/action/scope, incident, policy/resource/copy generations, source owner/service/shard audience, source execution generation/hash, JTI, issued_at/execute_before, `notice_due_at`, authorized role and maker/checker or pre-approved emergency policy. Approved emergency copy must already exist. До authority source owner локально создаёт `RestrictionIntent(PREPARED)` и one-current `EmergencyRestrictionExecutionGeneration(PENDING)` with exact intended effect/hash, stable rights-case reference, digest-only opaque recovery locator, owner/next update and outbox. Compliance approval is bound to that signed row; it cannot be replayed in another service, shard, resource, intent or effect generation.

Immediately before effect source calls linearizable `StartEmergencyRestrictionAuthority`. Compliance coordinator CASes `ISSUED → EFFECT_STARTED`, pins the exact source row/JTI/audience/generations and returns signed `EmergencyEffectStartedReceipt`. Before Start only coordinator DB time or a current cancellation/drain may win `ISSUED → EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED`; that same coordinator transaction writes an immutable signed coordinator-owned `EmergencyUnstartedClosureReceipt(authority/source-execution/JTI/audience/effect-hash, closure_kind, coordinator_generation, closed_at, signature_epoch)` and outbox.

Source applies the coordinator receipt idempotently in its own DB with exact-row CAS `PENDING → EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED`. The same source-local transaction moves the matching emergency RestrictionIntent to the identical unstarted terminal, proves absence of Start/tombstone/effect/outcome/rights/notice artifacts, writes outbox and creates a distinct signed source-owned `EmergencySourceUnstartedClosureReceipt` containing coordinator receipt ID/hash, authority/JTI/audience, execution+intent generations, terminal kind, source owner/shard, source aggregate version, committed_at and signature epoch. Source then calls `ApplyEmergencyRestrictionSourceClosureReceipt`; the coordinator authenticates the source owner/audience/signature, pins the exact receipt ID/hash/generations and moves only its acknowledgement projection `UNSTARTED_CLOSURE_RECONCILING → SOURCE_CLOSURE_CONFIRMED` without mutating the immutable authority terminal. Start and closure race on the same coordinator CAS; source closure additionally requires absence of a Start receipt/tombstone/effect/outcome, so a delayed worker cannot apply effect after closure. Ack loss replays each owner-specific receipt, and a reconciliation worker queries both owners until the source acknowledgement is confirmed. A successor authority for the same intent/effect key remains blocked until that confirmation; after Start neither expiry nor revoke can claim no effect.

If Start wins, source uses one local transaction to verify the Start receipt and current bound facts, CAS execution `PENDING | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → EFFECT_COMMITTED`, insert immutable unique `EmergencyRestrictionAuthorityConsumeTombstone(authority_id, authority_generation, JTI, source_owner, execution_generation)`, make only the bound effect, and write `EmergencyEffectCommittedReceipt(effect_committed_at, effect_generation, authority/start/execution generations, copy_hash, notice_due_at, rights_case_ref/locator_hash)` plus pending notice intent/outbox. This source-local transaction is the one-use/effect atomic boundary; the plan never claims that a source DB constraint consumes a compliance-DB row.

If Start committed but source cannot establish effect, execution becomes `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with owner/deadline. Only an authoritative source-local transaction proving no business mutation may CAS `PENDING | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → NO_EFFECT_FINAL` and emit a signed started-terminal receipt; timeout, absent event or compliance clock cannot. Source lifecycle is mode-separated: before Start, execution and intent move together to `EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED` only from the matching signed coordinator closure; after Start, execution moves `PENDING → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | EFFECT_COMMITTED | NO_EFFECT_FINAL`, `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → EFFECT_COMMITTED | NO_EFFECT_FINAL`. All terminals are immutable/exclusive, and an unstarted closure is never accepted as `NO_EFFECT_FINAL`. Coordinator lifecycle is `ISSUED → EFFECT_STARTED | EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED`; `EFFECT_STARTED → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | CONSUMED | NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED`, `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → CONSUMED | NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED`. CONSUMED/NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED require the matching signed started source terminal; acknowledgement loss replays the same receipt and never repeats effect.

For the unstarted branch, Ops projection is `UNSTARTED_CLOSURE_RECONCILING` while only the coordinator closure exists: «Start не зафиксирован. Подтверждаем закрытие исходной записи без эффекта». It becomes `CLOSED_UNSTARTED_CONFIRMED` only from the complete coordinator+source receipt manifest: «Start не зафиксирован; исходная запись закрыта без эффекта. Ограничение пользователю не применялось. Новая мера требует нового полномочия». Discovery of any Start/effect artifact routes to `START_EVIDENCE_RECONCILING` and the started emergency/rights flow; it can never be suppressed by the unstarted receipt. Operators may replay exact reconciliation and open the runbook, but cannot manually mint no-effect, notice/appeal or successor eligibility. In every valid unstarted state user mobile/web/inbox/push/email/CDN artifacts remain zero; copy never says «ограничение отменено».

Notification-service signature-verifies only `EFFECT_COMMITTED` receipt and materializes the one current emergency notice with the same `effect_committed_at` and rights-case binding; publish transaction writes `published_at`, durable content hash/receipt and `EMERGENCY_PUBLISHED_CONFIRMED`. Expected/observed authority-start/source-outcome/tombstone/effect-intent-notice-publication count/hash stays open until every applicable member matches. DB permits no generic bypass flag: ordinary timeout, notification outage or operator label cannot mint authority/Start. Emergency started/effective state never expires into false no-effect, overdue creates 24/7 incident, and publish/correction retains full chronology. Guide Rights Workspace can open the source-effect interim case before notice publication and later reads the linked published notice without changing case/appeal/deadline identity, even when account access is terminated.

### 6.24 OfflineOccurrenceAuthorizationBundle и OfflineStartAssistanceCase

Excursion-service is the single writer of `OfflineOccurrenceAuthorizationBundleGeneration`, `OfflineBundleDeviceBinding`, `OfflineStartDeviceReceipt`, `OfflineStartReconciliationGeneration` and `OfflineBundleConsumeTombstone`, because it owns occurrence/check-in/start. Bundle stores stable generation/current pointer, exact occurrence/resource revision, guides/seller/action, complete pinned authorization-input manifest/hash, account/device/app audience, device public-key thumbprint and attestation method, nonce hash, signing-key ID/epoch, trusted-time anchor/boot binding, issued/not-before/expires/skew, immutable payload/signature and state `ISSUED | REVOKED_UNCONSUMED | EXPIRED_UNCONSUMED | SUPERSEDED_UNCONSUMED | RECONCILING | CONSUMED_ACCEPTED | CONFLICT_MANUAL | RECONCILED_NOT_ACCEPTED`.

There is at most one live bundle per occurrence+guide+action and one accepted consume/tombstone per nonce/key epoch. Replacement supersedes the old generation; tombstone outlives the maximum restore/replay horizon. A signed device receipt records bundle/nonce/action, device key/boot, monotonic delta/time anchor, durable local sequence/hash, observed start facts and reconnect time. Reconciliation accepts the offline fact once, materializes occurrence state+consume receipt+outbox in one excursion transaction, or opens CONFLICT_MANUAL/remediation; revoke discovered after an offline action never erases the fact or silently blames the guide.

Every issued bundle creates an owner-local STANDBY assistance bootstrap/case root with opaque reference code, occurrence/guide/booking-impact refs, safe failure taxonomy, approved channel-capability manifest, cached localized safety instructions, 24/7 queue/owner, due/absolute due, last/next update and immutable contact/remedy receipts. `CONTACT_REQUESTED | LOCAL_ONLY | NOT_SENT_OFFLINE` are device presentation states, never server receipt states; `server_received_at` exists only after owner DB `CASE_COMMITTED` and remains separate from `local_recorded_at`.

`OfflineAssistanceChannelAttemptGeneration` has typed evidence chronology `LOCAL_INTENT_ONLY → TRANSPORT_INITIATED → PROVIDER_ACCEPTED | PLATFORM_INGRESS_RECEIVED | FAILED | UNKNOWN`; valid platform ingress may produce `CASE_COMMITTED`, followed separately by `HUMAN_ACKNOWLEDGED`. Only CASE_COMMITTED creates RECEIVED/server_received_at. For data this is owner-DB case+outbox commit; for SMS it requires authenticated inbound webhook, exact case binding and that same commit; for voice it requires IVR/agent intent+case commit. Composer open, call initiation/ringing/carrier answer and SMS/voice provider acceptance never mean FlyFy received the request. Duplicate/late callbacks preserve one client_assistance_id/case generation and immutable evidence history.

Allowed transitions are closed and generation-fenced:

| Aggregate/state | Allowed next state |
|---|---|
| bundle `ISSUED` | `REVOKED_UNCONSUMED`, `EXPIRED_UNCONSUMED`, `SUPERSEDED_UNCONSUMED` or `RECONCILING` |
| bundle `RECONCILING` | `CONSUMED_ACCEPTED` or `CONFLICT_MANUAL` |
| bundle `CONFLICT_MANUAL` | `RECONCILING`, `CONSUMED_ACCEPTED` or `RECONCILED_NOT_ACCEPTED` with signed adjudication/remediation receipt |
| bundle terminal states | none; correction appends a replacement/reconciliation generation |
| assistance `STANDBY` | `RECEIVED` or `PROACTIVE_OPENED` |
| `RECEIVED` or `PROACTIVE_OPENED` | `ASSISTING` |
| `ASSISTING` | `RESTORING_AUTHORIZATION`, `ARRANGING_REPLACEMENT`, `ARRANGING_SAFE_REMEDY`, `CANCEL_REFUND_PENDING` or `UNRESOLVED_ESCALATED` |
| any arranging/restoring state | its matching `AUTHORIZATION_RESTORED`, `REPLACEMENT_CONFIRMED` or `REMEDY_CONFIRMED`; alternatively `ASSISTING` or `UNRESOLVED_ESCALATED` |
| `UNRESOLVED_ESCALATED` | `ASSISTING`; it cannot be closed merely because the SLA expired |
| receipt-backed confirmed state | `CLOSED` after final user notice/handoff receipt |
| `CLOSED` | none; new evidence opens a linked new generation/case, never rewrites closure |

The downloaded package contains the case code and approved voice/SMS/deep-link/local-emergency options available for that market/device. Zero data but usable voice/SMS exposes native Call/SMS plus the cached plan. With zero connectivity, UI shows `NOT_SENT_OFFLINE`, the local timestamp, cached safety steps and explicit no-start instruction; it never claims FlyFy received a request. `AUTHORIZATION_RESTORED` requires a fresh online AuthorizationDecision/bundle receipt, `REPLACEMENT_CONFIRMED` requires current assignment/presence/permit receipts, and `REMEDY_CONFIRMED` requires authoritative booking/payment receipts. Support/gateways can record contact but cannot override start gates or choose an unapproved financial remedy.

### 6.25 LaunchDependencyRegistry

`LaunchDependencyRegistryGeneration` — versioned release-governance audit root, который делает зависимость GUIDE-CORE от соседних programmes исполнимой, а не декларативной. Compliance release-governance module is single writer; CI/release controller reads only signed committed data. Runtime correctness uses scoped members rather than this global root. Each `LaunchDependencyMember` contains:

- stable `dependency_member_id`, `consumer_programme_id`, `consumer_action_id` and `scope_partition_id = action + CoverageScope partition + operating_model + transaction_archetype`;
- versioned activation predicate и его current evaluated result;
- exact `source_requirement_registry_generation_id/hash`; human-table provider requirement IDs are compile-time inputs only, and each is resolved by a total single-valued lookup to exactly one current `contract:<requirement>:vN`, immutable contract-manifest digest, expected member count/ordered hash and exact provider interface member digests stored on this member—never to a runtime `latest`/minimum alias;
- `criticality = HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE | SOFT_OBSERVABILITY | NONE`, fail-safe mode, reusable `fallback_family_id` and exact action-bound fallback instance ID+version+digest;
- `member_epoch`, consumer/provider/accountable owners, evidence artifact IDs, valid interval, generation/prior/current pointer and member hash.

Each partition stores `scope_set_epoch`, expected/observed member count, ordered member-set hash and approval receipt. Global generation stores the union hash, maker/checker, environment and release candidate only for audit/promotion. `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` blocks only exact consumer action/partition when predicate=true; predicate=false/NONE requires reproducible receipt. Adding/changing a member bumps only matching partitions. A paid booking change in one market cannot invalidate free booking or another jurisdiction.

`FallbackArtifactGeneration` is first-class and immutable. A catalog `FB-*` value is a reusable policy/content family only; compilation creates an action-bound runtime instance with stable ID `<fallback_family_id>:<dependency_member_id>:<consumer_action_id>:<scope_partition_hash>`, exact member/action/partition, trigger taxonomy, allowed/prohibited commands, rights-preserving paths, approved UX-template digest, owner/escalation, maximum duration, automated test ID, SLI/alert/runbook, approval/effective/expiry and state `READY | ACTIVATED | RECOVERING | RETIRED`. Every expanded dependency member pins exactly one instance ID/version/digest. The family may share copy structure, but one runtime instance can never serve two actions or scopes. A prose-only family, missing instance, current command not explicitly forbidden, member/action/scope mismatch or group-level receipt is invalid. `fallback_artifact_exact_member_scope_uq` and `launch_dependency_member_fallback_exact_fk` enforce this bijection. CI builds the bidirectional graph from action/API/event/schema catalogs, dependency members and compiled fallback instances; interface without member, `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` member without exact version or executable instance, orphan/duplicate ownership, unregistered call or hash mismatch blocks promotion. Runtime pins only exact `scope_set_epoch`, ordered member epochs/digests and instance digests; unknown/stale true `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` activates only its own tested safe alternative/owner/next update for that partition.

### 6.26 StateMachineCatalog и LegalTemplateRegistry

`StateMachineCatalogGeneration` is the only definition source for safety-critical aggregate states/transitions, outcome↔reason compatibility and old-client mapping. Each entry contains aggregate/discriminator, state/command/guard IDs, allowed prior→next edges, terminal/successor rules, DB constraint/check digest, API/protobuf enum digest, Go/Flutter generated-code digest, user-safe copy requirement and model-test ID. Generated DB guards and service checks both enforce it; runtime or schema drift blocks promotion. This catalog includes at minimum UserAccount without exclusive persona state; AccountAccessEffect/Notice/Appeal with proposal, activation, notice, appeal, revoke/expire and restoration semantics; GuideWorkspace including terminal/successor semantics; GuideOnboardingContinuation including pre-auth cancel/expiry, one-use subject binding and consume/cancel/expire races; GuideOnboardingDestinationAttempt and every registry-defined owner plan; Coverage, ComplianceAssessment, branch-aware ServiceabilityPrecheckEvaluation, bounded branch presentation, PrecheckResultExport, local/server AnonymousPrecheckHandoff and cross-device pairing, LegalCapacity, VerificationCase, Affiliation, OrganizationRepresentativeMembership/invitation/invite-acceptance-authority/transfer/recovery-case/recovery-authority/legacy-migration/failover, ManualReview, product Restriction/Appeal/Stay/Restoration, privacy ProcessingRestriction/fence/exception/lift, Article23Determination, ExternalPrivacyRemedyDetermination, COPPA audience/internal-operations/VPC routing and separate AgeVerificationStatementReliance, AuthorizationGrant/Fence, ordinary/emergency/started-versus-two-owner-unstarted-closure Notification saga, SaleAdmissionFence/cause/attempt disposition, BookingAttempt/PaymentOperation/PaymentAttemptOutcomeBridge/PaymentRetrySafetyFence including closed-successor rules/PaymentRetryExecution/PaymentGenerationConflict, privacy-owned SensitiveIngress disposal/triage/revocation-coordinator/hold authorities plus file-owned admission fence/byte lease/disposition/hold fence/deletion, PayoutAccount, Article 13 applicability/designation/notification/privacy-purpose/contact/readiness/invalidation/action-fence/route binding, Article 30 promotion/readiness/urgent suppression/successor notice/redress, Article 20 complaint, Article 21 ODS/cost entitlement, Article 24 report/frozen facts/correction, Article 42 designation applicability/template report/template correction/audit authority-transmission/publication/redaction/audit-publication correction, Article 31/32, AccessibilityConformanceEvidence and every action-bound fallback lifecycle.

`LegalTemplateRegistryGeneration` is the single metadata/approval registry for guide disclosure, user-facing labels, policy-impact, consent/capacity, P2B terms/restriction/termination, complaint/ADR, remediation proposal, adverse-action, DSA direct/public notice and rights-preserving fallback copy. Every template has stable family/context/action/jurisdiction/audience/channel, locale and separately approved fallback locale, typed semantic schema, legal source/counsel refs, content hash, required/prohibited fields, redaction/accessibility metadata, effective interval, maker/checker and rollback predecessor. Lifecycle: `DRAFT → COMPILED → REVIEWED → APPROVED → SCHEDULED → ACTIVE → SUPERSEDED | REVOKED | EXPIRED`. Runtime pins exact version/hash and immutable `LegalCopySnapshot`; no in-place edit, raw enum, literal reusable date, unresolved placeholder or unapproved locale fallback. Missing active template for a true `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` action activates the exact scoped rights-preserving fallback, not a blanket outage.

Catalog coverage also includes `RegionalDisasterRecoveryProfileGeneration`, failover/failback attempts and `RightsContinuityRouteGeneration`; receipt trust-profile/key/issuance-attempt/checkpoint-membership/consumer-fence/compromise-impact states; telemetry policy/manifest/edge-admission/drift/owner-enforcement/disposition states; `HandoffSecretSealEnrollmentGeneration` and `HandoffCryptoForwardGeneration`; and `ADRCorrectedNoticeIntentGeneration`, publication-escalation and `LegacyADRPublicationReconciliationCaseGeneration`. Generated server, DB and old-client mappings must agree for each. A prose lifecycle without exact catalog member, command for every permitted edge, transition guard, forbidden-edge test and conservative old-client mapping blocks promotion.

### 6.27 RequirementArtifactRegistry и regulatory vertical catalog

Trace matrix is a generated human view, not source of truth. `RequirementArtifactRegistryGeneration` normalizes `RequirementDefinition`, `ArtifactDefinition`, `EventArtifactPair`, `RequirementArtifactEdge`, `ArtifactObservation`, `ProductMetricDefinition`, `RolloutCohortGate` and signed `ReleaseEvidenceGeneration`. Each requirement entry explicitly contains requirement/version/safety/status/legal source/effective period; aggregate and authoritative writer/use-case; store/constraint/migration; exact command/API/event schemas; action/scope partition/state catalog/dependency/fallback; UX flow/template; programme/stage/release gate; unit/contract/integration/race/chaos/migration/E2E tests; SLI/dashboard/alert/runbook; product metric/cohort applicability; DoD clause; owner/reviewer; production-like evidence URI/hash/environment/build. Any non-exact family alias, bare document-section reference or prose group name in place of an artifact ID is invalid.

Artifact IDs use one version-aware canonical grammar. `schema:<context>.<Name>.v<N>`, `api:<context>.<Command>.v<N>` and `contract:<requirement>:v<N>` require a positive integer `N`; `v1`, `v2` and later versions are equally valid and never parsed by a v1-only allowlist. `EventArtifactPair` stores an exact `event_id`, physical broker `runtime_topic`, `payload_schema_id`, schema version/digest and compatibility mode. A terminal `.v<N>` in a versioned event ID is reused—not duplicated—in the schema ID: `event:dsa.example_changed.v2` pairs with `schema:event.dsa.example_changed.v2`. An unversioned legacy event ID may pair only through its explicit registry `payload_schema_id`; naming inference, implicit v1 and a wildcard are forbidden. Runtime topics shown bare in §9.3 are a non-normative transport inventory; the generated event-pair catalog is the sole contract source. The remaining forms are `db:<constraint_or_trigger>`, `mig:<requirement>`, `test:<requirement_or_named_fixture>`, `metric:<requirement>`, `cohort:<requirement>`, `dash:<id>`, `alert:<id>`, `rb:<id>`, `gate:<requirement>`, `dod:<requirement>` and `evidence:<requirement>`.

Cross-service sagas that do not themselves authorize a §5.1 user/platform action use a stable `ARTIFACT-EDGE-<domain-purpose>` record. It must enumerate the current producer contract and exact API/schema/event member digests, consumer API, binding guards, criticality, timeout/reconciliation behavior, owner and evidence edge. It is deliberately excluded from `LaunchDependencyMember` action expansion; an `ARTIFACT-EDGE-*` may never be disguised as `DEP-…:<unregistered-action>`, and any saga that does gate a §5.1 action must additionally have the normal action-bound dependency member and fallback.

Every `ProductMetricDefinition` has mandatory `cohort_applicability: COHORT_OBSERVABLE | OPERATIONAL_INTEGRITY_ONLY | GOVERNANCE_ONLY`, `cohort_not_applicable_reason`, `privacy_dimension_policy` and `approved_by`. Only `COHORT_OBSERVABLE` may reference `cohort:<requirement>`, conversion targets or experiment assignment. The compiler rejects a cohort edge, user/account dimension or conversion optimization for `OPERATIONAL_INTEGRITY_ONLY` and `GOVERNANCE_ONLY`; those modes retain only aggregate integrity/governance evidence under their approved minimization policy.

Every contract manifest is an immutable sorted set of all exact API members and exact `EventArtifactPair` members, each expanded to both its event-artifact and payload-schema-artifact edges, with expected count/ordered hash. A contract version greater than one additionally stores `predecessor_contract_id/digest`, additive/breaking compatibility classification and exact added/removed/replaced member delta; publishing it never mutates or silently aliases v1 or another predecessor. Registry stores incoming requirement edges to the contract and every expanded member, so a group-level green cannot conceal a renamed/missing schema. Parser/generator golden tests cover v1/v2/vN, zero/negative/malformed versions, terminal-version reuse, explicit unversioned-legacy pairs, schema IDs, immutable predecessor lookup and member-order/hash drift. Every compact comma-separated event cell below expands through exact `EventArtifactPair` records to individual event+schema ArtifactDefinition/edge rows; an aggregate receipt cannot satisfy a missing member.

Compiler verifies exact artifact existence and digest in OpenAPI/protobuf/AsyncAPI, migrations/constraints, test-run receipts, observability/config catalog, approved template registry and production-like evidence store. Event catalog↔pair registry↔AsyncAPI channel↔payload schema↔contract membership is bidirectional: a topic without a schema, schema without a topic, mismatched terminal version/digest, bare inferred version or contract edge to only one half blocks promotion. Every safety-critical API/event/state/constraint/template/fallback must have an incoming requirement edge; every requirement must reach delivery stage, DoD and release evidence. Expected/observed member count and ordered hash must match. Manual edit of the generated §21.1 view fails CI. Stable control is `TRACE-ARTIFACT-01` with `test:TRACE-ARTIFACT-01`, `dash:trace_artifact_integrity`, `alert:trace_artifact_gap`, `rb:trace-artifact-promotion-block`, `dod:TRACE-ARTIFACT-01`.

Every artifact marked `signed_domain_receipt=true` creates an exact compile-time dependency edge to current `contract:SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01:v2`, its receipt type/purpose, producer key/issuance profile, required checkpoint-inclusion class and complete consumer-verification/fence manifest. Wildcard consumers, transport-auth-only evidence, unsigned legacy aliases and a group receipt standing in for one missing consumer are invalid. The compiler requires producer-local issuance-attempt ownership, one terminal sequence leaf, consumer-local membership/replay state and the complete compromise-impact consumer-fence manifest before a key can be retired or an incident closed. Immutable v1 evidence is history-only and cannot satisfy a v2 promotion edge.

Every permitted edge has an exact command; permitted and forbidden edges are generated from one catalog entry, checked in DB and tested. Generic setters, prose aliases, service-only validation or old digests cannot satisfy closure.

## 7. Архитектура bounded contexts

| Контекст | Владелец истины |
|---|---|
| user/account/auth | Universal UserAccount, AccountAccessEffect, common signup/sign-in и GuideOnboardingContinuation; не professional qualification и не guide authorization |
| identity | Identity result, legacy import classification, legal-capacity и minimal assertions |
| guide | Additive private GuideWorkspace, presentation profile/readiness, PersonCredential/personal permit/insurance/provider/work/recognition declarations и legacy guide-application migration; не account owner |
| organization/merchant | OrganizationRegistration, authoritative OrganizationRepresentativeMembership roster/transfer/recovery, MerchantTaxProfile, organization permit/insurance/provider/recognition declarations, private TraderTraceabilityRecord и seller/trader/merchant claims |
| compliance | Evidence metadata, verification cases/attestations/assertions, sources/authority graph, legal-change/policy releases, coverage/requests, assessments, MerchantTaxReadiness, DSA governance, notification profiles, reviews, restrictions и appeals; never source declarations |
| place | Stable official place IDs, hierarchy, boundary candidates, site categories |
| excursion | Draft, route, occurrences, assigned guides, site-authorization declaration, insurance allocation and CrossBorderServiceDeclaration composition, RemunerationProfile, GuidePresence, offline authorization/assistance и decision snapshot |
| booking | Seat hold, booking state, consumer contract, PaymentOperationRequest/capture intent/outcome bridge, append-only retry-safety fence/execution/conflict lineage и remediation proposal/decision snapshots |
| payment | Internal payment aggregate after verified provider event/lookup, double-entry subledger, settlement/dispute, payout account/readiness и refunds |
| consumer complaint / ADR execution | ConsumerComplaint, respondent submissions/disclosure requests, ADR referral/order/authorities, ExecutionObligations/manifests/plans/results/assessments/deficits/incidents, discovery/identity/validity/allocation/global reassessment, stop evidence, remediation cases/items/three-projection sets |
| economic-effect safety / execution control | Global governed-effect `InFlightEffectExposureLedger`, reservation/start/consume/release/reopen/freeze generations и `PlanExposureAttributionGeneration` для ADR, cancellation/refund, goodwill, dispute и tax owner commands |
| file manager | EvidenceUploadSession, blob ingress/disposal/security-isolation/access-grant lifecycle; до first byte требует exact signed disposal/triage/full-processing authority и исполняет TTL/receipt, но не создаёт legal basis/Article 9/10 condition и не превращает quarantine/deletion в разрешение |
| privacy/consent | RetentionRule, PrivacyRequest orchestration, ConsentGrant/withdrawal ledger, withdrawal-authority attempts, Article23Determination, ExternalPrivacyRemedyDetermination и fulfilment receipts |
| notification | DurableInboxNotice, channel attempts/device evidence, reminders и escalation receipts; не legal effect source |
| resilience control | Regional DR profiles, failover/failback coordinator epochs and `RightsContinuityRoute`; never writes domain resources or promotes an intake receipt into domain truth |
| security trust / transparency | Trust/key public metadata, checkpoint chain, inclusion proofs and compromise impact; never writes domain effects or stores exportable private keys |
| privacy telemetry governance | Policy/manifest/edge-admission/drift/disposition metadata and owner-receipt refs; never reads raw sink content or performs a cross-DB quarantine/delete |
| handoff crypto | Web seal enrollment, wrapped-secret vault, forward authorization/start/outcome and shred receipts; never owns guide draft/claim truth and never exposes decrypted payload to BFF |
| release governance | committed LaunchDependencyRegistry generations, cross-programme interface predicates/evidence и promotion decision receipts; не domain/business fact source |
| admin/legal ops | Только UI/application layer над authoritative APIs; не владеет domain aggregates |

### 7.1 Single-writer ownership matrix

| Aggregate | Authoritative service/DB | Единственный command writer | Emitted projection/assertion |
|---|---|---|---|
| RegionalDisasterRecoveryProfileGeneration, RegionalFailoverAttempt, RegionalFailbackAttempt and recovery epoch | resilience-control-service DB | exact profile lifecycle and fenced failover/failback step commands under expected state/profile epoch/manifest hash | signed recovery status and complete owner-receipt manifest; domain rows remain owner-local |
| RightsContinuityRouteGeneration | resilience-control-service DB | register/test/change-state route for exact `(profile_generation, operation_kind, subject_access_mode, destination)` | current READY/DEGRADED/UNAVAILABLE route manifest; intake evidence never becomes an authoritative domain receipt |
| RegionalRecoveryOwnerReceipt and restored domain resource | each exact domain owner DB | owner-local restore/verify/fence/open command under current recovery epoch | signed resource-class recovery receipt only; no resilience-control write into domain DB |
| ReceiptTrustProfile, ReceiptSigningKey and ReceiptCompromiseImpact | security-trust-service DB | exact trust/key lifecycle, emergency revocation epoch and compromise reconciliation | signed bounded trust snapshot, key status and complete consumer-fence/impact manifest; no domain effect write |
| ReceiptIssuanceAttemptGeneration and issuer sequence partition | each exact producer domain DB | reserve/sign/atomic-effect-commit or source-proven void command | signed core and exactly one committed/void sequence leaf; Security Trust cannot fabricate producer no-effect |
| ReceiptIssuanceCheckpointGeneration and inclusion proof | security-trust-service DB | accept leaf/seal contiguous checkpoint/get proof commands | immutable chain/root/proof; signed core references only a prior checkpoint anchor |
| ReceiptCheckpointMembershipGeneration, replay tombstone and ReceiptConsumerFenceReceipt | each exact consumer DB | local verify/include/fork/fence acknowledgement with domain-transition CAS | local membership/fence projection; no group receipt substitutes for a consumer |
| TelemetryDataClassPolicyGeneration, TelemetrySinkManifestGeneration, EdgeAdmissionManifest, TelemetrySinkDrift and TelemetryDisposition | privacy-governance DB | classify/review/activate/open-drift/request-owner-action/apply exact owner receipt/reconcile metadata use cases | signed policy/admission/drift/disposition metadata; no raw telemetry ownership or direct quarantine/read privilege |
| TelemetryEdgeAdmissionGeneration | each exact producer/sink owner DB before exporter/sink persistence | apply signed admission manifest, fence stale/revoked manifest and reconcile outcome | signed state-bound admission receipt for `ACTIVE \| FENCED \| MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED`; missing/unknown gate disables only the exact optional emitter and never implies data disposition |
| TelemetrySinkEnforcementGeneration and sink data | each exact application/security/infrastructure sink owner DB | owner-local begin/apply/reconcile enforcement command under current policy+manifest epoch | signed enforcement/no-effect receipt; Privacy Governance cannot directly quarantine, delete or rewrite an owner sink |
| HandoffSecretSealEnrollmentGeneration, HandoffCryptoForwardGeneration, one-use capability and crypto-shred receipt | handoff-crypto-service isolated vault/DB | begin/commit/reconcile seal; authorize, persist Start before outbound, decrypt/forward, query guide and shred | signed seal, authorization/start and transport-reconciliation/shred receipts only; terminal Preview/Commit/no-effect is accepted solely from guide-signed receipt or authoritative guide lookup; BFF is selector-only |
| ADRCorrectedNoticeIntentGeneration | complaint-service DB | live atomic external-order reconciliation/reopen+intent/outbox, legacy-case-to-intent conversion and apply-publication-receipt commands | current tracker and notice-intent/publication status; no notice row mutation |
| LegacyADRPublicationReconciliationCaseGeneration | complaint-service DB | migration-origin-only open/reconcile/resolve/create-intent commands | temporary current legacy binding until exact intent or terminal no-notice/manual-legal result; never `PUBLICATION_RECONCILING` without intent |
| Corrected ADR DurableInboxNotice and NoticePublicationReceipt | notification-service DB | idempotent materialize/publish/outcome commands | recipient/copy/generation-bound publication receipt; no complaint state mutation |
| UserAccount, AccountAccessEffect/Notice/Appeal | user/auth-service | common signup/sign-in plus exact account-access proposal/apply/revoke/expire/notice/appeal/restoration use cases | universal account capabilities and exact account-access lifecycle; never global guide approval |
| GuideOnboardingContinuation, PostAuthDestinationRegistry, GuideOnboardingDestinationAttempt | user/auth-service | one-use post-auth binding/orchestration/outcome reconciliation only | root/attempt state and owner receipts; destination effects remain in guide/excursion/organization owners |
| IdentityVerificationAttempt, IdentityAssertion, CanonicalPersonSubjectBinding, LegacyIdentityImportRecord, LegalCapacityAssessment, LegalCapacityAssertion | user/identity-service | identity/person-binding/capacity use case | minimal identity/person-binding/capacity assertion and reverification fact |
| Identity raw EvidenceBinding | user/identity-service | identity evidence use case | только минимальные verified claims |
| GuideWorkspace, GuideProfile, GuideOnboardingReadinessView, GuideHomeProjection, LegacyGuideApplicationMigration | guide-service | workspace/profile/migration use case | non-authoritative private workspace/presentation/readiness/migration facts; no account type or public-action authority |
| PersonCredential declaration | guide-service | credential use case | credential declaration/version |
| RemunerationProfileGeneration/SourceManifest/CompositionReceipt | excursion-service | canonical remuneration composition use case over signed source facts | complete/incomplete canonical component-set generation |

| OrganizationRepresentativeInvitationGeneration, InviteAcceptanceAuthority, RecoveryCase/Authority, LegacyMigration and RosterFailoverFence | organization-service only | closed v3 invitation/authority/recovery/legacy/failover commands; terminal/successor CAS | opaque non-authorising invitation/recovery state and signed roster receipts |

Инварианты:

- у aggregate ровно один authoritative writer;
- file-manager не решает юридическую пригодность файла;
- admin panel не пишет domain DB напрямую;
- compliance не изменяет guide/excursion/booking/payment aggregates;
- service owner исполняет retention/deletion для собственных данных и возвращает signed receipt privacy orchestrator;
- PermitOrSiteAuthorizationDeclaration/Assertion, VerificationAttestation и назначение permit на ресурс — разные aggregates;
- межсервисное изменение проходит API либо versioned event, никогда shared table.

`execution-control-service` — самостоятельный bounded context и production deployment, а не модуль complaint-service: complaint является таким же клиентом, как booking/payment/dispute/tax. Он хранит только opaque subject/resource/operation references и минимизированные typed measures, имеет отдельные DB credentials, ABAC/audit, release train, multi-AZ RPO 0 tier, capacity/error budget и on-call. Это исключает зависимость всех refunds/cancellations от complaint deploy/store и уменьшает privacy/blast radius. Масштабирование выполняется cell/shard по tenant+global_cap_scope с deterministic home-cell routing и single leader per exposure key; split/rehoming запрещает Reserve до signed epoch transfer и reconciliation. Его outage fail closed для нового potentially duplicating effect, но не скрывает status/receipt/support и не блокирует заранее approved, independently capped statutory consumer-protective provisional path. Cross-cell global cap без доказуемого single-writer route не запускается.

### 7.2 Решение о compliance-service

Перед созданием отдельного deployable сервиса ADR сравнивает:

1. модуль внутри существующего сервиса;
2. отдельный deployable component;
3. самостоятельный compliance-service.

Целевой вариант — самостоятельный bounded context с API и собственным хранилищем, если подтверждены независимый lifecycle правил, несколько consumers и операционная команда. Независимо от deployment запрещены cross-service database reads.

### 7.3 Fact projections

Compliance получает versioned facts через signed assertions, synchronous provider interfaces или локальные projections.

Для каждого fact определяются:

- authoritative owner;
- schema/version;
- freshness SLA;
- invalidation event;
- fallback;
- sensitivity;
- допустимость кеширования;
- поведение при конфликте.

FactProjection содержит source, subject, schema_version, source_aggregate_version, projection_stream_id, contiguous projection_stream_version, source_event_id, effective_at, observed_at, valid_until и payload hash. Projection stream имеет независимую последовательность только compliance-relevant изменений; пропуск unrelated aggregate update не создаёт ложный gap.

FactSnapshot является content-addressed, schema-versioned и минимизированным immutable decision-input bundle. Он хранит canonical typed values, refs, per-source watermarks, source content hashes, created_at и canonical hash, достаточные для deterministic replay даже после supersession исходной projection.

Projection producer/consumer contract:

- authoritative owner атомарно присваивает projection_stream_version каждому emitted compliance event; snapshot endpoint возвращает тот же stream_id/version и checksum;
- применяет событие только при projection_stream_version = last_applied_stream_version + 1;
- deduplicates уже применённый event_id/stream version и сохраняет source_aggregate_version только для provenance/CAS;
- обнаруженный gap переводит source/subject projection в GAPPED;
- блокирует ALLOW для actions, зависящих от неполного watermark;
- при входе в GAPPED фиксирует monotonic resync_generation, last_applied watermark и durable buffer новых events, не подтверждая inbox receipt до записи buffer/apply;
- запрашивает authoritative owner snapshot с stream_id/resync_generation; install выполняется одной CAS-транзакцией только при совпадении ожидаемых GAPPED state/generation/watermark, валидном checksum и snapshot version не ниже current watermark;
- поздний или overlapping snapshot не может уменьшить version либо перезаписать более новый resync: CAS failure отбрасывает ответ и запускает новый запрос;
- после snapshot N consumer replay-ит buffered events строго с N+1, затем атомарно переводит projection в READY; gap/duplicate во время replay оставляет GAPPED;
- сохраняет gap/resync audit.

Для каждого action заданы required source watermarks и hard_max_fact_age. После hard maximum ALLOW невозможен независимо от p99 SLO. Assessment сохраняет использованный bundle; удаление source data не разрушает минимальный lawful replay record, а retention memo определяет его допустимый состав и срок.

Примеры facts: identity assurance, trader status, guide assignment, organization affiliation, registry claim, route revision, site classification, occurrence time.

### 7.4 География

- stable official IDs приоритетнее координат;
- PostGIS определяет candidate jurisdictions;
- boundary содержит authority, source, version, valid period и confidence;
- disputed/overlapping boundaries создают ambiguity;
- route разбивается на GUIDING, TRANSIT и SITE_ENTRY segments;
- карта дублируется доступным текстовым списком;
- authorized override имеет reason, reviewer и expiry.

### 7.5 Persistence и data ownership

Физические таблицы располагаются только в БД authoritative owner. Рекомендуемые logical stores:

- legal_sources и legal_source_versions;

The unredacted authority bundle is ciphertext-only in a separate restricted object/key partition with KMS envelope encryption, immutable digest, purpose ABAC/JIT/MFA/maker-checker and append-only access/export audit; Commission and DSC delivery authorities/receipts are recipient-specific. Public reader/CDN/report roles are explicitly denied its object and key, and report/audit DB roles have no guide, booking, payment, complaint, ODS, privacy-rights or safety command privilege;

Web BFF keeps only a short-lived opaque cookie selector/digest and is denied ciphertext, broker vault, KMS decrypt, plaintext and direct guide mutation. `handoff-crypto-service` alone keeps short-lived target-bound wrapped secret/capabilities in a separately permissioned non-backup vault, decrypts only in volatile memory and forwards over exact allowlisted guide Preview/Commit routes. Guide payload deletion, broker crypto-shred and native/local tombstone are separate owner receipts; none determines or rewrites atomic claim outcome. No service persists a plaintext content key beside its ciphertext. Claimed legacy receipt linkage, if lawfully retained, is quarantined in a privacy-only legacy perimeter and never exposed to account/workspace joins;

Source owners keep only intent/effect generations plus signed booking receipt refs. Failover/recovery cannot reopen a scope from a stale projection: affected sale commits remain closed until current epochs, complete active-cause count/hash, in-flight dispositions and source acknowledgements reconcile;

Bridge may consume only signed payment-owner outcome receipts: matching current capture intent becomes CAPTURED_EXPECTED, anomaly becomes remediation, and no provider/contract effect is inferred. Free branch stores current remuneration generation/manifest FK and explicitly has no PaymentOperationRequest/PaymentOperation/PSP/bridge FK;

ORDINARY adverse effect requires matching PUBLISHED receipt and `effective_at >= published_at`. For EMERGENCY, compliance `emergency_restriction_authority_one_use_ck` governs only ISSUED/Start/terminal projection and exact signed owner reference; it never pretends to share a source transaction. Source DB requires a pre-Start PENDING execution row. `emergency_restriction_source_unstarted_closure_guard` permits execution and intent `PENDING/PREPARED → EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED` only from the exact signed coordinator closure and only with no Start/tombstone/effect/outcome. `emergency_unstarted_intent_close_atomic_ck` requires execution+intent terminals, outbox and signed `EmergencySourceUnstartedClosureReceipt` in one source transaction; `emergency_source_unstarted_closure_receipt_uq` prevents duplicate acknowledgement, and coordinator `emergency_source_unstarted_closure_ack_guard` permits `SOURCE_CLOSURE_CONFIRMED` only for the exact authenticated receipt/generations. Successor authority stays blocked until this acknowledgement. If Start won, source requires the signed matching Start receipt, unique `(authority,generation,JTI,source owner)` tombstone and `emergency_restriction_effect_receipt_intent_atomic_ck`, so tombstone+exact effect+signed outcome+rights binding+intent+outbox commit together. `emergency_restriction_started_no_expiry_guard` forbids expiry/revoke after Start and `emergency_restriction_owner_outcome_exclusive_ck` forbids unstarted/effect/no-effect dual terminal. Notification row requires exact EFFECT_COMMITTED receipt and starts only as `EMERGENCY_EFFECT_COMMITTED_PENDING_PUBLICATION`, with `effect_committed_at <= published_at` once published. It can never use `ORDINARY_PUBLISHED_PENDING_EFFECT`. `emergency_notice_effect_publication_manifest_ck` reconciles authority-start-source-outcome-tombstone-effect-intent-notice-publication only for a started branch; the separate unstarted manifest closes only on both owner receipts. A generic bypass flag is schema-impossible. Stale ordinary source CAS must correct/withdraw notice. Provider acceptance/device delivery/escalation are distinct and preference cannot suppress mandatory inbox;
- AuthorizationGrant Reserve/Mark and epoch activation serialize over exact ordered FenceKeySet. DRAINING forbids both. Every resource DB creates the PENDING owner row before Mark and enforces `authorization_owner_outcome_exclusive_ck`: one row per `(grant_id,commit_token)`. Before Mark only matching signed coordinator receipt may CAS it to `EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED`; after Mark only `PENDING → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → EFFECT_COMMITTED | NO_EFFECT_FINAL` or direct post-Mark terminal is legal. All terminals are mutually exclusive/immutable, and effect plus EFFECT_COMMITTED commit in the same owner transaction. A delayed worker cannot commit after any terminal. Coordinator accepts CONSUMED/NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED only from the matching signed terminal owner generation; absence, timeout or coordinator inference remains COMMIT_STARTED/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. Started/unknown cannot expire/revoke/free a fence, and activation requires a complete zero-unresolved started manifest. CAPTURED_EXPECTED requires exact current BOOKING_COMMITTED capture intent and never opens remediation; only unbound/late/contradictory capture does. A strictly newer actual capture after `TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT | VOIDED`, a distinct/additional capture or invalidated binding after `CAPTURED_EXPECTED`, and a refund reversal after `REFUNDED_REMEDIATED` append `CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED`; a newer receipt for the same already-bound physical capture keeps the business state and only enriches immutable evidence. Terminal immutability cannot discard contradictory money evidence: after a closed fence/conflict the corrected bridge, linked frozen fence/conflict successors, current-pointer swap, capability removal and outbox are one booking transaction, while a concurrent new `CLEAR` successor uses the same expected-current-pointer CAS. Retry creation stores a complete predecessor/descendant manifest. Every provider-bound member has one current capability-bound lookup member or signed never-crossed-boundary proof; count/hash mismatch, missing middle member, stale capability/fetch, incomparable sequence or ambiguous physical-effect identity atomically freezes the lineage and opens conflict. The owner-local one-use Start CAS is mutually exclusive with correction and lookup-safety freeze. Authority cannot START without the exact complete lookup-manifest/fence receipt; an already STARTED authority cannot be retro-revoked. Conflict closure requires complete current dispositions for every descendant plus provider/subledger/contract/booking/capacity/shared-exposure receipts. A paid attempt cannot leave payment reconciliation for cancel/retry/hold release without exact signed terminal-no-effect/void or the stricter refunded+explicit-retry manifest, and ContractFormationObservation never aliases capture. Booking CONFIRMED can enter CANCELLATION_PENDING; REMEDIATION_REQUIRED has APPLYING/RECONCILING recovery to CONFIRMED only from complete APPLIED receipts; QUEUED review can cancel; every unknown/late/void/refund result has a reconciliation edge;

- Privacy-side authority/hold state and one-current guards plus file-side disposition/inbox/outbox/state guards make a current exact disposal authority a prerequisite for enabling the channel and accepting every byte; missing authority physically rejects before ingress and cannot create a blob or deletion job. Expected `SPECIAL_CATEGORY_EXPECTED | ARTICLE10_EXPECTED` upload still requires stronger full assessment and Article 6 plus Article 9(2)/Article 10 or non-EU condition; retained triage requires current ACTIVE stronger authority, hard `quarantine_delete_at` and no generic OCR/AI/search/reviewer/vendor/reuse. Hold must be exact and active before due; release/revoke/expiry must produce file-owned `DELETE_DUE | AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED` through resume guard. Object+per-object-key deletion receipts bind the applied authority and complete manifest. Privacy DB role cannot write file disposition, file DB role cannot write authority/hold, and stale/duplicate/reordered inbox generation cannot reopen or delete. Only a minimised assertion created under a new full assessment may leave isolation; legacy metadata cannot invent authority or inspect content;
- organization guards require closed command-authority discriminator: ordinary commands use current ACTIVE membership, accept/decline use exact self-bound one-use invite authority, and recovery resolution uses exact one-use pre-approved delta. Both consume authority+roster pointer/audit/notice/outbox atomically; maker/checker, non-widening, expected roster, last-admin and monotonic revocation guards apply. Legacy record states never enter membership enum. Failover gate blocks mutations/privileged commands until complete RPO0 manifest and signed reopen;
- accessibility evidence guards require both build-bound native-200 and web-320CSS/400%-zoom profiles across the complete launch manifest; any missing/failed/stale member blocks promotion and cannot be waived by an experiment cohort;
- exclusion/partial unique constraints для одной active policy/attestation версии;
- optimistic aggregate_version;
- индексы по subject, action, status, sla_due_at, absolute_due_at, valid_until и queue priority;
- GiST только для versioned boundary candidates;
- immutable decision/policy rows, corrections через superseding version;
- partitioning assessments/audit/events по времени после измерения объёма;
- automated retention/deletion и backup tombstone tracking;
- zero-downtime expand/contract migrations;
- никакой shared schema между сервисами.

## 8. Decision engine и серверная авторизация

### 8.1 Typed DSL

DSL имеет:

- dsl_schema_version;
- compiler_version;
- evaluator_version;
- typed facts и operators;
- schema validation;
- compile-time conflict checks;
- statutory entitlement precedence: lower body/procedure layer не может скомпилировать DENY для REQUIRED party/stage, а конфликт материализуется как BODY_RULE_CONFLICT;
- deterministic evaluation;
- golden tests;
- simulation against production snapshots;
- human-readable explanation template;
- localization keys.

Legal team может менять значения и комбинации в пределах поддержанного DSL без backend release. Новый fact, operator, registry adapter или schema version требует инженерного релиза и миграции.

### 8.2 Context binding

Context hash включает:

- tenant/market;
- requested action;
- actor, delegated_principal_hash и auth_context_version;
- guide/co-guides;
- seller/operator, OrganizationRegistration и confirmed Affiliation generations;
- excursion/occurrence/booking IDs;
- resource revisions;
