- route segments and sites plus jurisdiction-boundary, site-classification, activity-taxonomy and resolver-algorithm generation IDs;
- activity, language, current COMPLETE server-derived RemunerationProfile generation, expected/observed source-manifest count/hash, canonical component-set/hash and every value/beneficiary/payer/conditionality/bundle/source generation, transport and group-size/composition revision;
- RequirementDefinition complete-set manifest/count/version hash, every selected ResponsibilityAssignment owner-service/resource generation, current ResponsibilityAcceptance/OwnerObligationReceipt and GuidePresenceAllocation generations, and the committed complete RequirementEvaluation set/count/hash;
- evidence artifact/verification attestation IDs/versions и exact declaration evidence-set hash;
- IdentityAssertion, LegacyIdentityImport/reverification requirement и LegalCapacityAssertion versions/epochs;
- current CanonicalPersonSubjectBinding generation and explicit PERSON|ACCOUNT|RESOURCE effect-scope generation for every subject-bound fact/restriction;
- CapacityLawDetermination version for cross-border capacity-sensitive actions;
- EqualTreatmentAssessment and MinorProtectionApplicability versions; for every child-PI/age-screen/third-party-disclosure/ads action — current COPPAApplicability, audience classification, VPC purpose/recipient-policy epoch and parental/exception generation; any remote age-verification collection under the FTC 2026 statement additionally pins a current exact `COPPAAgeVerificationStatementRelianceGeneration`, its all-condition manifest and statement-status epoch, never the Rule internal-operations authority. For any expected or discovered special-category/Article 10 bytes or claim — exact channel/first-byte/collection/ingress/storage/classification/triage/access/deletion action, current full SpecialCategoryProcessingAssessment or separately applicable SensitiveIngressDisposalAuthority/SensitiveIngressTriageAuthority generation, Article 6 plus Article 9(2)/Article 10 or non-EU condition, closed permitted-operation set, minimised-assertion schema, hard TTL, authority-bound deletion receipt and any item-scoped legal-hold generation; for START_BIOMETRIC_CAPTURE — exact BiometricProcessingAssessment/dataflow/notice-release versions; for screening — BackgroundScreeningApplicability/acquisition/adverse-action generation;
- PersonCredential revision и current CredentialHolderBinding generation;
- current `PermitOrSiteAuthorizationAssertion`, PermitAssignment and PermitUsageLedger reservation/consumption generations; a declaration revision never satisfies this slot;
- current `InsuranceCoverageAssertion`, ProviderLegalStatusAssertion, WorkAuthorizationAssertion and ProfessionalRecognitionAssertion generations/revocation epochs; an InsuranceCoverageDeclaration never satisfies this slot;
- merchant/tax assertion versions;
- payment regulatory determination и funds-flow configuration versions для financial actions;
- coverage scope/assertion, LocalCounselRequirementDecision и PolicyRelease/activation epoch versions;
- SignificantDecisionInventory path/complete-manifest/epoch and current AutomatedDecisionAssessment/safeguard generation whenever the path predicate may be true;
- ExternalIntakeAuthorityAssessment/Attempt generation для complaint/cancellation actions;
- CancellationTermEnforceabilityAssessment/term-copy/formula version для quote/cancel/refund fee actions;
- для ADR actions — referral/outcome/withdrawal attempt, ADRWithdrawalRule/source/party-scope, ADRDeadlineAssessment, effect receipt, external-order version, remedy/remediation authority epochs, stop receipt и remediation case/item/plan versions;
- ruleset, compiler/evaluator, exact `AuthorizationScopePartition` and its policy/revocation epoch members; global policy root is audit-only;
- exact LaunchDependencyRegistry `scope_partition_id`, `scope_set_epoch`, ordered matched `(dependency_member_id, member_epoch, predicate_receipt, consumer/provider interface digest)` set; global registry root is release-audit only and never invalidates unrelated partitions;
- for policy-enabled offline CHECK_IN/START only — exact OfflineOccurrenceAuthorizationBundle/nonce/signing-key/trusted-time/device generation; no other action accepts this authority;
- evaluated_at и expires_at.

Любое изменение входа делает старое решение непригодным для нового действия.

### 8.3 DelegatedPrincipal и confused-deputy protection

Actor не принимается из business payload. Gateway/auth layer формирует подписанный DelegatedPrincipal:

- iss, sub и tenant;
- azp/caller service;
- aud;
- session_id и token_jti;
- auth_time и acr;
- scopes;
- roles_version;
- issued_at/expires_at.

Каждый internal caller имеет allowlist действий, для которых он вправе делегировать principal. Compliance проверяет signature, issuer, audience, caller azp, delegation scope, session/role freshness и tenant binding. S2S identity без DelegatedPrincipal допускается только для явно service-owned actions и не может подменять пользователя.

Canonical serialization полного DelegatedPrincipal, включая scopes, roles_version, session_id, token_jti, azp, tenant и expiry, образует delegated_principal_hash. Auth-service выдаёт monotonic auth_context_version на изменение session status, token revocation, roles или scopes. Для USER_DELEGATED action оба значения входят в assessment/context hash и AuthorizationDecision; decision validity ограничивается самым ранним из principal expiry, action TTL и остальных compliance deadlines. Для явно SERVICE_OWNED action вместо вымышленной user session decision содержит service_principal/audience, purpose-bound authority и action-specific subject/account/restriction/trust/credential epochs. Logout пользователя сам по себе не скрывает законно опубликованный профиль и не останавливает исполнение уже возникшего refund/contract obligation.

### 8.4 AuthorizeAction

Публичные clients не вызывают внутренний compliance engine как источник разрешения. Resource-owning service вызывает server-side:

    AuthorizeAction(actor_context: DelegatedPrincipal | ServicePrincipal, action, resource_revision, authoritative_context)

Ответ:

- assessment_id;
- outcome;
- authorization token/reference, audience-bound к вызывающему сервису;
- context_hash;
- valid_until;
- obligations;
- safe explanation;
- retry/review metadata.

Client-supplied assessment_id используется только как optimistic hint. Он не является bearer permission.

### 8.5 Atomicity, one-time consumption и TOCTOU

Correctness не опирается на «последний read epoch перед commit». `AuthorizationFenceCoordinator` в compliance boundary сериализует action execution и policy/revocation activation по complete ordered `FenceKeySet` with expected/observed count/hash. Keys разделены по оси, чтобы revoke не блокировал посторонних пользователей:

- `POLICY_DEPENDENCY = action + CoverageScope + operating model + transaction archetype + resource class + policy domain`;
- `SUBJECT_REVOCATION = action + opaque keyed person/account/credential/attestation binding + revocation domain`;
- `RESOURCE_REVOCATION = action + opaque resource/assignment/occurrence generation + revocation domain`.

Каждый key хранит exact member epochs, `OPEN | DRAINING`, pending activation, generation и effective_at. Subject revoke drains only matching subject keys, resource revoke — matching resources, shared policy update — matching policy partitions. Opaque keys не содержат PII. Grant pin-ит весь relevant set; addition/removal/member drift меняет ordered hash и invalidates grant. Reserve/commit-start serializable-lock all keys in deterministic order, so a revoked credential cannot close the whole market/action partition and multi-key deadlock is testable. Global policy/registry hash остаётся audit root.

Action protocol:

1. resource owner повторно собирает authoritative facts и локальной транзакцией создаёт immutable action intent state `COMPLIANCE_COMMIT_PENDING` с exact resource revision, context hash, idempotency key и outbox; пользовательский/public effect ещё не применён;
2. `AuthorizeAction` выдаёт short-lived one-use `AuthorizationGrant` со state `ISSUED`, exact FenceKeySet/member epochs, action/resource/intent hash, nonce, audience and not_after;
3. owner calls `ReserveAuthorizationGrant`. Coordinator одной serializable transaction locks the ordered key set, checks every fence OPEN, current exact members/epochs, signature/principal/session/action/resource/context/TTL/nonce and moves `ISSUED → RESERVED`; concurrent reserve is deterministic conflict;
4. до Mark resource owner локальной транзакцией создаёт один `AuthorizationOwnerOutcomeGeneration` с уникальным `(grant_id, commit_token)`, state `PENDING`, exact intent/resource/action/context hash и outbox, затем подписывает `OwnerOutcomePreparedReceipt`. Crash до этой строки оставляет только RESERVED grant; crash после неё — доказанно unstarted local row;
5. immediately before any owner-local effect owner calls `MarkAuthorizationCommitStarted`, передавая exact prepared receipt. This is the only execution linearization boundary: one coordinator transaction again locks every key, requires all fences OPEN, exact current intent/grant/set, signature-valid PENDING owner row and DB time `< not_after`, then moves `RESERVED → COMMIT_STARTED` and returns signed one-use `CommitStartedReceipt`, pinning `commit_token`, owner generation/hash and signature epoch. `OPEN → DRAINING` forbids both new Reserve and new Mark; a local clock/read cannot replace this CAS;
6. owner-local effect transaction требует exact signed `CommitStartedReceipt`, matching current intent/outcome generation и выполняет один CAS `PENDING | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → EFFECT_COMMITTED`; сам business effect, terminal outcome row, immutable owner receipt и outbox коммитятся в одной DB transaction. Повтор/late worker после любого terminal outcome получает CAS conflict и не применяет effect. External provider side effect не вызывается лишь по этому grant: для него действует отдельный owner operation-intent/authority protocol;
7. отсутствие эффекта после Mark подтверждает только owner-local authoritative reconciliation. Одной owner DB transaction оно фиксирует evidence manifest/hash и CAS `PENDING | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → NO_EFFECT_FINAL`; timeout, пустой query result, coordinator clock или отсутствие события не являются доказательством. Если owner не может установить исход, он переводит row в `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`, сохраняет owner/deadline и продолжает reconciliation. `EFFECT_COMMITTED` и `NO_EFFECT_FINAL` взаимоисключающие, immutable и никогда не supersede друг друга для того же `(grant_id, commit_token)`;
8. coordinator принимает только подписанную owner service terminal generation с совпадающими grant/commit token, owner audience, intent/outcome generation/hash и signature key epoch: `EFFECT_COMMITTED` даёт `COMMIT_STARTED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → CONSUMED`, `NO_EFFECT_FINAL` — `→ NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED`. Non-terminal/отсутствующий/просроченный receipt оставляет `COMMIT_STARTED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`; coordinator не mint-ит и не выводит terminal result. Ack loss повторно доставляет ту же generation;
9. если Mark не выиграл, единственные closures — exact idempotent `ExpireUnstartedAuthorizationGrant` по coordinator DB time `>= not_after` либо `RevokeUnstartedAuthorizationGrant` по cancellation/drift/drain. Та же serializable key-set transaction делает CAS `ISSUED | RESERVED → EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED` и возвращает signed `UnstartedGrantClosureReceipt`; Mark and closure взаимно конфликтуют. При существующей owner row resource owner применяет этот receipt локальным CAS `PENDING → EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED` с outbox. Без matching signed coordinator receipt, либо после COMMIT_STARTED, такой local terminal невозможен; timeout/тишина не становятся `NO_EFFECT_FINAL`. Ack loss reconciles the same closure receipt, а delayed effect worker проигрывает terminal CAS;
10. retry with original actor/resource/idempotency key returns stored intent/grant/start/owner outcome/closure/result; no second commit token, nonce or effect is created.

#### 8.5.1 Канонический trust contract для signed domain receipts

Stable control `SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01` applies to every safety-critical persisted inter-service receipt. mTLS/S2S JWT authenticates live transport and never substitutes durable verification. `ReceiptCore.v2` is deterministic CBOR signed as COSE_Sign1 in `SignedReceiptCoreEnvelope.v2`; its protected fields bind exact nested payload schema/version/digest and payload hash, receipt type/purpose, command/idempotency/JTI, issuer workload, tenant/trust domain, audience, opaque aggregate generation/effect, causation/correlation, issue/validity mode, monotonic issuer sequence, algorithm, key epoch and trust-profile generation. The core may contain only `prior_checkpoint_anchor_id/hash` whose sealed range ends before this sequence. It never contains the future checkpoint that will include it, its Merkle root or its inclusion proof; this removes the otherwise circular requirement to sign a hash that depends on the signature itself. Keys are non-exportable HSM/KMS handles, and algorithm/key selection outside the protected envelope or current allowlist is rejected.

The producer domain is sole writer of `ReceiptIssuanceAttemptGeneration` and its sequence partition. Lifecycle is `RESERVED → SIGNED_PREPARED → COMMITTED`, with `RESERVED | SIGNED_PREPARED → VOIDED`; `COMMITTED` and `VOIDED` are immutable terminals. The `SIGNED_PREPARED → COMMITTED` producer transaction atomically commits the business effect, terminal owner outcome, signed core, receipt row and outbox. `VOIDED` requires source-proven no-effect evidence; timeout, silence or an empty projection never qualifies. Exactly one checkpoint leaf exists per allocated sequence: either `COMMITTED_RECEIPT = hash(kind, issuer, key_epoch, sequence, receipt_core_hash, effect_commit_receipt_hash)` or `VOID_SEQUENCE = hash(kind, issuer, key_epoch, sequence, issuance_attempt_id, no_effect_evidence_hash)`. Commit/void races serialize by CAS, so gaps cannot be concealed and a forged void against a committed receipt creates a detectable fork.

Security Trust is sole writer of the append-only `ReceiptIssuanceCheckpointGeneration` chain and `ReceiptCheckpointInclusionProof`; a checkpoint seals a contiguous sequence range, Merkle root, prior checkpoint hash and trusted recorded-at. Each consumer is sole writer of its immutable membership generations and replay tombstone: `PENDING → INCLUDED | OVERDUE | FORKED`, `OVERDUE → INCLUDED | FORKED`, `INCLUDED → FORKED`. `OVERDUE` is derived from DB time and `max_checkpoint_lag_ms`. A new safety-critical dependent effect requires `INCLUDED`; read/status/history may show `PENDING`, while `OVERDUE/FORKED` fences only the dependent effect and keeps status, appeal, cancellation/refund and privacy routes available. First-seen time, proof path/root, sequence, key epoch and exact checkpoint chain are persisted atomically with consumer verification.

`ReceiptTrustProfileGeneration` lifecycle is `DRAFT → REVIEWED → ACTIVE → SUSPENDED | SUPERSEDED`; `SUSPENDED → ACTIVE | SUPERSEDED`. Signing keys follow `PENDING → ACTIVE | CANCELLED_UNACTIVATED | COMPROMISED_UNACTIVATED`, `ACTIVE → RETIRING | COMPROMISED`, `RETIRING → RETIRED_VERIFIABLE | COMPROMISED`, `RETIRED_VERIFIABLE → COMPROMISED`. An unactivated terminal requires a matching HSM destroy/disable receipt; public verification metadata and an audit tombstone remain. A signed effect-enabling trust snapshot has `valid_until-issued_at ≤ 60s`, refresh target p99≤10s and monotonic `revocation_sequence`; `max_stale_at` is read/status/history-only with global cap 24h. Compromise/revocation adoption target is p99≤15s, warning at 15s, page at 30s and mandatory local hard fence of affected new effects by 60s even if event delivery failed. Every exact consumer acknowledges the new fence epoch with `ReceiptConsumerFenceReceipt`; epoch rollback/gap is rejected.

Compromise never rewrites history or turns uncertainty into «no effect». `ReceiptCompromiseImpactGeneration` follows `OPEN → CONSUMER_FENCING → RECONCILING → NO_INVALID_RECEIPTS | CORRECTED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED`. A receipt first seen after the compromise cutoff and absent from a pre-cutoff checkpoint is `REVIEW_REQUIRED_COMPROMISE_WINDOW | UNRESOLVED` regardless of asserted issue time. User copy says «Проверяем подтверждение операции. Не повторяйте действие», preserves the original request/deadline and never disables independent rights. Incident closure requires the complete expected/observed consumer-fence manifest; a receipt observed inside the propagation window is reconciled rather than automatically declared invalid or no-effect.

Current `contract:SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01:v2` is breaking from immutable v1. Its immutable manifest pins every exact schema, API, event, guard and digest listed in the `SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01` row of §6.27, including `api:security.ReactivateReceiptTrustProfile.v1`; `predecessor_contract_id=contract:SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01:v1` and the breaking-compatibility delta are mandatory. A family alias such as “profile APIs v2”, a section reference or an omitted member cannot satisfy the current gate. `mig:SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01` first inventories exact producer×consumer×type×purpose and shadows v2 issuance, inclusion and fence epochs; enforcement starts only at 100% coverage. For every allocated v2 sequence it proves exactly one terminal leaf: source-proven `COMMITTED_RECEIPT` or source-proven `VOID_SEQUENCE`; a missing outcome remains unresolved and blocks only the dependent effect, never becoming a fabricated void/no-effect. Pending legacy keys cannot enter `CANCELLED_UNACTIVATED | COMPROMISED_UNACTIVATED` without the matching HSM disable/destroy receipt. Legacy evidence remains `LEGACY_TRUST_UNRESOLVED`, never retro-signed or treated as included.

Policy/revocation activation uses the same ordered key sequence: transaction changes OPEN→DRAINING and rejects new Reserve/Mark. If Mark won first, drain must retain the old key generation until the coordinator consumes a signed immutable owner terminal generation `EFFECT_COMMITTED | NO_EFFECT_FINAL`; coordinator state alone, timeout or projection silence is insufficient. COMMIT_STARTED/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN never expire, revoke or free the fence. If DRAINING won first, remaining ISSUED/RESERVED grants close only through signed `EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED` receipts and cannot effect. Activation guard requires a complete expected/observed drain manifest with zero unresolved coordinator grants and zero non-terminal/missing owner-outcome generations, then one transaction installs new epochs, sets effective_at and reopens. Therefore a commit under the old epoch cannot occur after the new effective epoch. Emergency activation immediately drains matching keys and revokes only unstarted grants; it cannot fabricate no-effect or an earlier effective_at. Propagation events/cache SLO are observability/projection mechanisms, never the correctness barrier.

AuthorizationGrant lifecycle is closed: `ISSUED → RESERVED | EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED`; `RESERVED → COMMIT_STARTED | EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED`; `COMMIT_STARTED → CONSUMED | NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`; `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → CONSUMED | NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED`; terminals immutable. Owner-local outcome lifecycle is independently closed and mode-separated: before Mark, `PENDING → EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED` only from matching signed coordinator closure; after Mark, `PENDING → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | EFFECT_COMMITTED | NO_EFFECT_FINAL` and `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → EFFECT_COMMITTED | NO_EFFECT_FINAL`. All terminals are immutable/mutually exclusive for the pair; an unstarted closure can never be treated as owner no-effect evidence. Coordinator started terminals must reference the exact signed owner terminal generation and cannot precede it. `not_after` applies only before Mark; after Mark safety comes from conservative drain/reconciliation, not wall-clock expiry. USER_DELEGATED Reserve/Mark validates active session/non-revoked JTI/current auth context; SERVICE_OWNED validates exact service authority without inventing a user session. Launch-dependency comparison uses only the pinned key-set/member epochs; unknown/stale true `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` member activates its named tested fallback only for that action/scope. Transactional outbox/inbox/deduplication protects every local boundary, and all crash points are reconciled without distributed-ACID claims.

### 8.6 Failure/degraded modes

Authorization expires_at вычисляется как минимум из action_max_ttl, срока policy/coverage, ближайшего expiry attestation, official-registry freshness, matched dependency-member validity, fence reservation budget и fact freshness. Cache никогда не продлевает исходную validity. Подтверждённый revoke, changed matched `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` dependency member or emergency scoped fence сильнее любого ранее кешированного ALLOW.

Safety cutoff использует exact action-specific partition/member epoch set. Для user-delegated publish/booking/payment/REQUEST_PAYOUT/occurrence commands это current auth_context_version плюс relevant scoped policy/subject/evidence members. Для SERVICE_OWNED PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY, rendered protected title и EXECUTE_SCHEDULED_PAYOUT это service authority плюс action-specific account-status/restriction/trust/credential/merchant/tax/payout-mandate/policy members, но не active login session. Logout не скрывает опубликованный профиль и не останавливает законно назначенную выплату. Revoke/restriction hides/holds affected scope not later than cutoff. Authorizer/enforcing owner that cannot synchronously reserve against current required fence does not consume ALLOW; the 60-second event/edge cutoff controls projections, not transactional correctness. Unrelated market/action partitions remain executable.

Edge delivery входит в тот же cutoff. Gated public profile/title/booking CTA отдаётся отдельным epoch-aware fragment/response с `s-maxage` не более 60 секунд, `stale-if-error=0` и без stale-while-revalidate за пределом cutoff; page shell не содержит автономной stale копии регулируемого offer. Account/restriction/credential/policy revoke публикует surrogate-key purge, а TTL является независимым hard backstop при purge/CDN outage. Origin и edge synthetic checks доказывают hide ≤ 60 секунд. Для внешних search-engine caches FlyFy не обещает невозможную мгновенную очистку: canonical URL немедленно возвращает safe unavailable/404/410 state, запускаются de-index/removal workflows, а cached snippet никогда не является основанием booking authorization.

Remote/outdoor start имеет отдельный risk-tiered offline contract. Пока online, owner может выдать `OfflineOccurrenceAuthorizationBundle` только если current policy/coverage explicitly allows offline start. Signed one-time bundle pin-ит tenant, exact occurrence/route/resource revision, guide/co-guides, seller, LegalCapacity/credential-holder/affiliation/permit-assignment+usage/insurance/cross-border/policy/revocation epochs, device/app audience, nonce, issued/valid interval, max clock skew, permitted `CHECK_IN_OCCURRENCE | START_OCCURRENCE_IN_APP` boundary и delayed-sync obligations. It is encrypted in hardware-backed secure storage where available, cannot be exported, and is invalid for route/date/language/group/site/seller/guide change. High-risk/live-registry/emergency-revoked scopes require online gate or staffed assisted emergency channel and never silently downgrade.

Offline validity never trusts `DateTime.now` alone. `TrustedTimeCapability` binds server-signed time anchor to monotonic-clock/boot-session identifier, key/device/app attestation where available, anchor age and narrow download→start window. Bundle eligibility requires supported monotonic continuity; reboot, app backup/restore, missing anchor, keystore loss, unsupported device capability or excessive drift makes it fail closed to a predeclared online/assisted/replacement route. Device attestation is risk input, not universal legal truth, and no brand-specific assumption is made.

Mobile shows last authoritative sync, exact expiry/local legal timezone, offline eligibility, whether reboot/keystore loss will invalidate it, download readiness and reminder before departure. One-time consume is durable on device before UI success; app kill/retry within same trusted boot session reuses same nonce. On reconnect server reconciles device receipt, time anchor/boot/key/revocation epochs and PermitUsage CONSUME_PENDING/occurrence state. Revocation after download but before offline start creates auditable conflict/remediation and tourist/support notice; it does not fabricate that the server knew or silently punish the guide. Clock forward/back, timezone/DST change, replay on another device/account, rotated/revoked signing key, expired bundle or missing permit usage stays blocked with assisted path. Offline bundle never permits publish/new booking/payment/change of participant or route.

| Действие | Поведение |
|---|---|
| Private draft | всегда сохраняется локально/на сервере при доступности excursion API |
| Preflight | bounded stale cache допустим с явной отметкой, не является authorization |
| Publish/new booking | fail closed, если нет актуального approved assessment |
| Registry outage | использовать неистёкшую attestation; иначе retry или manual verification |
| Confirmed booking | не отменять автоматически; открыть remediation case |
| Check-in/start | online current gate либо заранее downloaded policy-approved one-time OfflineOccurrenceAuthorizationBundle; при critical revoke/invalid bundle блокировать и дать assisted emergency support |
| Legal source monitor outage | не меняет активные правила, создаёт operational alert |

Kill switch:

- scoped по market/action/activity;
- two-person approval;
- TTL;
- impact preview;
- immutable audit;
- обязательный post-incident review.

### 8.7 Identity provider adapter contract

Identity provider является отдельной trust boundary:

- identity-service создаёт attempt и provider session server-side; state/nonce одноразовые, attempt/subject/tenant/redirect bound, а PKCE применяется там, где поддерживается flow;
- client SDK completion, deep link, redirect parameters и mobile callback считаются только сигналом для resume/status lookup и никогда не подтверждают identity;
- authoritative result принимается только как signed server-to-server callback с allowlisted issuer/key либо через authenticated provider API lookup;
- callback проверяется по raw payload signature, algorithm/key allowlist, issuer, audience, timestamp window, event ID, provider account, subject/provider reference, attempt/session binding и expected method;
- event ID и provider transition version дедуплицируются; monotonic state machine безопасно обрабатывает replay, duplicate, late и out-of-order events;
- key/secret rotation имеет overlap/revocation procedure, synthetic monitoring и owner; неизвестный key fail closed;
- result lookup/reconciliation подтверждает застрявшие PROVIDER_PENDING/VERIFYING attempts и обнаруживает callback loss без доверия клиенту;
- IdentityAssertion создаётся идемпотентно только после authoritative confirmation, совпадения subject/attempt и проверки assurance/claims; cross-attempt или cross-account substitution отклоняется;
- provider outage, unsupported device/camera permission, cancellation, timeout и accessibility barrier имеют resume/retry/manual/eID fallback без потери private draft;
- logs/metrics не содержат raw document, biometric payload, state/nonce или provider token.

### 8.8 Official registry adapter contract

Каждый adapter имеет:

- documented legal/contractual permission to access and cache;
- allowlisted endpoint и isolated egress;
- explicit connect/request timeout budget;
- retries с jitter только для безопасных idempotent requests;
- circuit breaker, bulkhead и provider rate limit;
- normalized result schema и raw-response integrity hash;
- authentication/secret rotation;
- registry timezone и freshness TTL;
- response signature verification, если поддерживается;
- no-match/ambiguous/revoked semantics;
- manual fallback;
- synthetic monitoring без PII;
- vendor/source change owner и deprecation runbook.

Scraping не используется, если он запрещён terms или создаёт ненадёжную юридическую проверку. Adapter никогда не продлевает validity после отсутствия связи с registry.

### 8.9 ADR body adapter contract

Каждый автоматизированный ADR route является внешней trust boundary и имеет:

- approved body/procedure/market identifier и capability metadata, которые не могут сузить ADRWithdrawalRule;
- contractual/legal basis, DPA/transfer/retention allocation и purpose-minimized case bundle;
- authenticated submission/status/withdrawal API либо approved durable channel с stable external case/attempt reference и явным признаком, является ли FlyFy recognised intake channel;
- platform idempotency key ↔ external reference mapping и отдельную deduplication для referral, withdrawal, acknowledgement и outcome;
- signed webhook с key rotation либо authoritative polling; client email/screenshot сам по себе не меняет state;
- external sequence/revision и раздельные platform_received_at, external_dispatched_at, issued_at, body_received_at, acknowledged_at, legal_effective_at/withdrawal_effective_at; adapter не синтезирует legal effective time;
- mapping `receipt_effect: EVIDENCE_ONLY | LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE | UNRESOLVED`, `tolling_status: CONTINUES | ENDS_AT | RESUMES_AT | UNKNOWN`, limitation_or_filing_deadline и required_next_action только из approved rule + authoritative evidence;
- typed EFFECTIVE/REJECTED/NOT_EFFECTIVE/ACK_UNKNOWN и raw-evidence integrity hash без лишнего PII;
- timeout, safe retry, circuit breaker, backpressure, DLQ и periodic reconciliation застрявших attempts;
- schema/capability drift detection: narrowing/missing withdrawal signal создаёт BODY_RULE_CONFLICT и паузу defective auto-route с alternative/manual path;
- accessible user receipt/status mapping, которое никогда не маркирует EVIDENCE_ONLY intent как submitted/deadline-preserving, и vendor outage/deprecation incident owner.

### 8.10 Capacity и disaster recovery

- multi-AZ for all authoritative policy/assessment/control metadata;
- point-in-time recovery и зашифрованные backups;
- guide-compliance safety/current-pointer control tier — policy activation/rollback epochs, Coverage/RequirementDefinition complete-set manifests, declaration submission/decision receipts, VerificationAttestation/assertion/holder/affiliation/permit/insurance/cross-border current+revoke generations, organization membership/current pointers, invitations, invite/recovery authorities, transfer/recovery cases, revocation epochs, roster idempotency tombstones, audit/notice receipts and inbox/outbox, permit reservation/consume, authorization/restriction/appeal/restoration epochs and transactional outbox — commits synchronously multi-AZ with RPO 0 for supported AZ failure and RTO ≤ 5 minutes. Failover cannot issue/consume ALLOW, accept an invite, resolve recovery or execute a privileged organization command until contiguous epochs/receipts, current-pointer/roster hashes, revocation generations, complete-set hashes, quota conservation and owner projections reconcile through `OrganizationRosterFailoverReconciliationGeneration`;
- organization authoritative command success after a committed revoke is zero; organization-service evaluates the current revocation epoch synchronously and fails closed on stale replica/session/cache. Downstream cache/projection adoption target is p99 ≤ 5 seconds and hard maximum 30 seconds for privileged authorization, with warning at 15 seconds and page/hard incident by 30 seconds; the broader affected-resource reconciliation remains hard maximum 60 seconds but can never authorize from cache;
- `alert:organization_revocation_lag` measures only the synchronous authorization gate and warns at 15 seconds/pages at 30 seconds. Independent `alert:organization_resource_reconciliation_lag` warns at 45 seconds/pages at 60 seconds for non-authorising affected-resource projections; the latter never marks authorization healthy or unhealthy;
- sensitive-ingress current authority/admission epoch, byte leases, hold/deletion current pointer and tombstones; Article13 readiness/action epochs/owner-fence manifest; organization terminal/successor generations; handoff one-use/terminal tombstones; Article21 cost execution idempotency/ledger; Article24 frozen/correction/public-version receipts; Article42 applicability/current pointers, frozen language/MAU/audit manifests, unredacted authority receipt index, redaction approvals, authority/public receipts and immutable public-version index; suppression successor/notice outbox and every associated inbox/outbox/owner receipt are in the RPO0 control tier. After failover an unknown byte lease keeps ingress `DRAINING`, an incomplete hold remains deletion-blocking, an incomplete Article13 manifest stays fenced, a missing handoff tombstone denies replay, a cost mismatch stays reconciling, and any Article24/42 manifest or receipt uncertainty blocks only the affected report/transmission/publication finality. It never fabricates designation, erases a prior public/authority receipt or blocks user rights; a missing suppression notice cannot yield silent completion;
- blobs, derived OCR/search indexes and rebuildable caches may use RPO ≤ 5 minutes/RTO ≤ 60 minutes only when FileObject checksum/object-version and durable user receipt remain RPO 0 and a lost derivative is rebuilt without resubmission or false status;
- cross-region continuity is never inferred from multi-AZ, backups or prose. Current `contract:DR-REGION-01:v2` requires one profile per `(environment, launch_region, service_cell, control_tier, data_class)` with approved replica jurisdictions/transfer decision, numeric RPO/RTO/maximum-tolerable-downtime, source/target fences, KMS/IAM/object/broker/DNS/dependency manifests, affected-action set, exact rights routes, tests and effective interval. A production ACTIVE v2 profile permits only `ACTIVE_PASSIVE_HOT | ACTIVE_PASSIVE_WARM`. Legacy `ACTIVE_ACTIVE` is `MIGRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED`; `BACKUP_RESTORE_ONLY` is non-launch restore evidence and cannot activate. Profile lifecycle remains `DRAFT → REVIEWED → TESTED → ACTIVE → SUSPENDED | SUPERSEDED | EXPIRED`; no migration auto-promotes v1 or reuses its test receipt;
- every `RightsContinuityRouteGeneration` is keyed by `(profile_generation, operation_kind, subject_access_mode, destination)` and has the closed lifecycle `DRAFT→TESTED | REJECTED`; `TESTED→READY | REJECTED`; `READY→DEGRADED | UNAVAILABLE | SUPERSEDED | EXPIRED`; `DEGRADED→READY | UNAVAILABLE | SUPERSEDED | EXPIRED`; `UNAVAILABLE→TESTED | SUPERSEDED | EXPIRED`; all terminal generations are immutable. `RIGHTS_CONTINUITY_READY` requires a complete fresh manifest of READY routes for status, complaint/appeal, cancellation/refund, privacy and safety intake. A locally stored or external-channel intake remains only typed evidence and never becomes an authoritative owner receipt;
- `RegionalFailoverAttemptGeneration` is `OPENED → SOURCE_WRITE_FENCED → TARGET_PROMOTED → RECONCILING → RIGHTS_CONTINUITY_READY → REGULATED_WRITES_READY → STABILIZED`; failback is `OPENED → RECOVERY_WRITE_FENCED → HOME_PROMOTED → RECONCILING → RIGHTS_CONTINUITY_READY → REGULATED_WRITES_READY → COMPLETED`. Each edge has a named command carrying attempt/profile epoch, expected state, manifest hash, idempotency key and signed evidence ref. Any nonterminal may enter immutable `MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED`; recovery creates a successor. Domain owners alone write local `RegionalRecoveryOwnerReceipt`; coordinator never cross-writes. Regulated writes reopen only after complete owner, current-pointer, inbox/outbox, key, dependency, rights-route and no-dual-writer manifests; unrelated partitions stay available;
- user status carries `receipt_ui_state = LOCAL_ONLY | NOT_RECEIVED | RECEIPT_RECORDED | PROCESSING_DELAYED`, `receipt_class = NONE | AUTHORITATIVE_DOMAIN_COMMIT | APPEND_ONLY_EMERGENCY_INTAKE | EXTERNAL_CHANNEL_EVIDENCE` and `effect = NONE | PLATFORM_INTAKE_RECORDED | AUTHORITATIVE_DOMAIN_STATE_COMMITTED | EXTERNAL_RECIPIENT_CONFIRMED`. The closed matrix is `NONE→NONE`; `AUTHORITATIVE_DOMAIN_COMMIT→AUTHORITATIVE_DOMAIN_STATE_COMMITTED`; `APPEND_ONLY_EMERGENCY_INTAKE→PLATFORM_INTAKE_RECORDED`; `EXTERNAL_CHANNEL_EVIDENCE→NONE | EXTERNAL_RECIPIENT_CONFIRMED`, where confirmation requires an exact recipient-bound receipt. `LOCAL_ONLY | NOT_RECEIVED` requires `NONE/NONE`; `RECEIPT_RECORDED` requires a non-NONE class; `PROCESSING_DELAYED` preserves the last compatible pair and can never upgrade it. `db:regional_recovery_receipt_class_effect_compat_ck` rejects every other combination. External confirmation never by itself means legal filing/effect, completed export/deletion or authoritative balance recovery; old clients remain conservative;
- financial consistency tier — payment provider inbox/receipts, journal, operation idempotency, observations/outbox и booking attempt/idempotency/commitment/obligation/outbox — имеет RPO 0 для committed records при supported AZ failure и отдельный cross-service reconciliation-before-reopen gate;
- ADR financial/remedy control tier — external-order resolution/input watermark; both authority epochs/reservations/started states; base ExecutionObligations и subtype rows, ObligationEffectManifests/slots, AttemptEffectPlans, OwnerEffectResult/FulfilmentAssessment/LineageNetContribution/ObligationContributionAllocation generations и ExpectedEffectDeficits; attempts/discovery manifests/stable lookup roots+binding/SLA generations/observations; source instances/aliases/lineages; canonicalization/identity/validity/EffectExecutionIncident/cross-referral-allocation/global-reassessment/intervening-order generations; cause-bound stop manifests/requests/evidence generations; atomic three-projection sets; corrections/notices/cases/items/outbox — имеет RPO 0. Failover не открывает Reserve/Mark/COMPLIED/CLOSED и не показывает ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT/RESOLVED/FULFILLED до contiguous-generation checksums, projection-set equality, required-source finality, contribution conservation и owner/provider/financial/execution-control/global-convergence reconciliation;
- economic-effect-safety tier — operation plans, reservation/start/consume/release generations, external-unreserved facts, PlanExposureAttribution, cap epochs/freeze/reconciliation/outbox — имеет отдельные RPO 0/RTO≤5 минут, ≥3× peak load и failover reconciliation gate. Во время failover новый Reserve закрыт, same-key status/replay остаётся доступен из quorum, а owner не обходит Mark; ADR/complaint outage не останавливает сам tier;
- evidence storage recovery соответствует более строгому privacy/retention contract;
- quarterly component backup/PITR/key restore drill; pre-launch and at least semiannual production-like full-region failover **and failback** exercise for every ACTIVE profile, repeated after material topology, residency, KMS/IAM, broker, DNS or dependency change;
- load test минимум на 3× прогнозного peak authorization traffic;
- reassessment pipeline выдерживает 10× обычный burst после массового rule/revocation event без потери ordering/deduplication;
- backpressure защищает booking path от bulk reassessment;
- validated cache работает только внутри исходного TTL и policy epoch.

## 9. API, события и state consistency

### 9.1 External/resource APIs

- common signup/sign-in implement `api:auth.RegisterUniversalAccount.v1` and `api:auth.AuthenticateUniversalAccount.v1` for every entry point; neither accepts an authoritative persona/account type. GET `/me/account-capabilities` and GET `/me/bootstrap` return the universal account plus additive feature surfaces; DTO has no exclusive `TOURIST|GUIDE` account type, `guide_approved` or client-authoritative role. Trusted internal `api:user.ApplyAccountAccessEffect.v1`, `api:user.RevokeAccountAccessEffect.v1`, `api:user.ExpireAccountAccessEffect.v1` plus exact GET/notice/appeal APIs from §6.27 implement the separate AccountAccess lifecycle; no wildcard/generic update contract exists, and tourist capability loss never derives from guide review/workspace state;
- PUT `/guides/me/workspace` maps to `api:guide.OpenGuideWorkspace.v1`, requires `Idempotency-Key` and creates or returns the one current OPEN workspace without KYC/certificate/trader/tax input. GET `/guides/me/workspace`, GET `/guides/me/bootstrap` and GET `/guides/me/onboarding-readiness` return private workspace/profile/drafts/scoped tasks only; none returns a global approval;
- GET `/guides/me/workspace/archive-impact-preview` returns public surfaces, future bookings/obligations, messages, disputes, payouts, rights and exact explicit pause/hide/unpublish commands required by current policy. POST `/guides/me/workspace/archive`, `/reopen` and `/close` require current ETag/`If-Match` plus `Idempotency-Key`; archive/close never imply publication, cancellation, refund, payout hold or account deletion, and reopen never republishes. GET/PATCH `/guides/me/profile` remains private until separate PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY authorization;
- POST `/auth/guide-onboarding-continuations`, GET `/{opaque_id}`, POST `/{opaque_id}/bind`, `/consume` and `/cancel` implement `api:auth.*GuideOnboardingContinuation.v1`. Request accepts only closed intent kind, current destination-plan version, allowlisted opaque target ref and locale/entry point; arbitrary `return_url`, client guide status, PII, documents and legal answers are rejected. `ISSUED` may cancel/expire before auth; bind/cancel/expire and consume/cancel/expire races use CAS. Consume dispatches only through `PostAuthDestinationRegistry`: guide-service owns workspace outcome APIs, excursion-service owns private-draft outcome APIs, organization-service owns invite-membership outcome APIs. Auth stores coordinator attempts/receipts only, marks CONSUMED after the full owner plan commits and reconciles timeout/ACK loss through owner GET outcome; it never cross-writes destination stores or auto-opens a personal workspace from an organization invite;
- GET `/compliance/action-domain-catalog` exposes only current signed action→`TOURIST|GUIDE|SHARED_ACCOUNT_SECURITY|RIGHTS` metadata needed for safe clients; server/resource owners never trust client mode. Internal `AuthorizeAccountAction` rejects a guide restriction that attempts tourist/rights effects and requires an independent AccountAccess authority for shared-account security effect;
- Signed `PrecheckAgeRoutePolicy` and static under-13 guidance ship in the versioned client/content bundle before interaction; the neutral age response is evaluated locally and under-13/local-only triggers no request, telemetry, cookie/SDK event or server receipt. `ResolvePrecheckMaterialQuestions` returns only rule-triggered questions; `RunBranchAwareServiceabilityPrecheck` accepts only an eligible adult/other-approved-minor route or VPC/exact-exception authority, minimized body, stable client_request_id, current `PrecheckPrivacyNotice` generation/hash/locale, coarse-vs-exact geometry, `AS_OF_NOW | SERVICE_DATE | SERVICE_DATE_RANGE | DATE_UNDECIDED`, optional date/range+legal timezone and explicit unknown dispositions, with `Cache-Control: no-store` and no URL query route/site data. It returns immutable `ServiceabilityPrecheckEvaluationGeneration` plus `ServiceabilityPrecheckReceipt`, exact branch results and required clarifications; missing material fact/branch/date coverage, stale notice/COPPA authority, inconsistent discriminator or legacy no-PII claim blocks aggregate SUPPORTED;
- optional account continuation begins with a randomized `PrecheckResultExportEnvelope`, never a source receipt. Native uses app-bound authorization-code+PKCE; cross-device uses independently confirmed PAKE wrapping; web first performs `Begin|CommitWebHandoffSealEnrollment` through a dedicated reverse-proxy body path directly to `handoff-crypto-service`. The broker generates/uses the content secret only in isolated volatile memory, writes wrapped-secret metadata, transfers ciphertext to guide and returns only a signed seal outcome; BFF has an opaque `__Host-` selector and cannot read the body, ciphertext, vault, KMS or plaintext. Seal ACK loss is resolved by its outcome endpoint before retry. URI/fragment, JS storage, clipboard telemetry, generic egress and reusable bearer are forbidden, and all mutation/status endpoints are no-store;
- for authenticated web Preview/Commit, broker persists an exact authorization plus `HandoffCryptoForwardStartedReceipt` before outbound. Guide validates authorization+started receipt and atomically consumes their JTI with the read-only preview or claim transaction; it never requires a post-call broker outcome receipt. Preview returns 0/1/N drafts and plan revision. Claim locks handoff/idempotency/target revisions and either commits exactly one allowlisted private-draft revision+guide outcome+outbox or a signed zero-effect conflict. Broker records `OUTCOME_CONFIRMED` only from that guide receipt/lookup. Timeout after Start becomes `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`; lookup starts within 1s, duplicate Commit remains fenced, and only source-proven `NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED` permits a successor. Payload deletion, broker shred and client key destruction are independent cleanup truths. Client claim pending/unknown resolves the guide idempotency outcome; logout, TTL or cleanup never implies no effect. Handoff/export grants no identity, KYC, credential or action authority and never blocks local/no-account precheck;
- GET /excursions/{id}/remuneration-profile returns current COMPLETE|INCOMPLETE generation, component-safe summary/source freshness and affected actions; user edits underlying price/benefit settings, never manifest/hash/derived gratuitous fields;
- POST /market-coverage-requests с Idempotency-Key, coarse_scope_hash/channel/locale и минимальным account/contact binding; никакие identity/professional documents не принимаются;
- GET /market-coverage-requests/{id} и POST /market-coverage-requests/{id}/withdraw с owner-bound opaque reference, Cache-Control: no-store и immutable unsubscribe/deletion receipt;
- POST /coverage-correction-requests с challenged decision/scope/source/boundary versions, coarse official IDs/reason/evidence link и Idempotency-Key; GET /coverage-correction-requests/{opaque_id} и POST `/information` с no-enumeration/If-Match return owner/due/next update/corrected notice without KYC requirement;
- POST /identity-verification-attempts с Idempotency-Key;
- GET /identity-verification-attempts/{id};
- POST /identity-verification-attempts/{id}/resume — выдаёт новую short-lived provider session только после owner/state check;
- POST /identity-verification-attempts/{id}/manual-fallback;
- GET /identity/me/assurance — current IdentityAssertion, LegacyIdentityImportRecord-safe classification, exact reverification requirements/methods/impact и correction/appeal links;
- GET /identity/me/person-binding-status returns only this account's safe current/correction/appeal/recovery state; no cross-account existence/count. POST /identity/person-binding-corrections with current binding version and Idempotency-Key opens human merge/split review without exposing another account;
- POST /guides/me/legal-capacity-assessments с readiness_scope_id/action и Idempotency-Key; GET /guides/me/legal-capacity-assessments/{id} возвращает minimum claim/status/next step/representative-or-organization route/appeal без unnecessary birth date; POST `/information` с If-Match+Idempotency-Key. Только identity-service verifier mint-ит LegalCapacityAssertion;
- GET /guides/me/compliance-governance-status?readiness_scope_id=... returns only applicable user-facing outcomes EqualTreatment/MinorProtection/COPPA/BackgroundScreening/BiometricProcessing/SpecialCategoryProcessing/CapacityLaw, freshness, exact-action effect, non-discriminatory/non-biometric/non-sensitive/lawful-representative alternatives, owner/due/next step and correction/appeal links; raw connecting factors, protected characteristics, diagnoses, screening facts and biometric templates never appear;
- POST /identity/biometric-capture-authorizations с exact verification attempt, device method/vendor/dataflow and notice/release presentation tokens maps to `START_BIOMETRIC_CAPTURE`; response is one-purpose/single-use/short-lived or provides an equally reachable non-biometric route, and no SDK initialization/camera/sample/vendor transfer may precede it;
- POST /guides/me/background-screening-sessions с exact approved applicability/purpose/relationship generation, disclosure presentation, written-authorisation receipt where required and Idempotency-Key; disabled/unassessed scope returns non-screening alternative and cannot acquire a report;
- POST /evidence-upload-sessions с Idempotency-Key, exact subject/declaration/revision/purpose/checksum/size/MIME and current disposal-or-stronger privacy authority first asks file-manager to open the exact channel admission fence and issue a short-lived byte lease. If authority/fence is missing, stale, `DRAINING` or `FENCED`, no upload URL/object key is minted and the API returns structured/registry/manual non-sensitive alternatives. Presigned URLs carry only opaque lease binding, cannot outlive the lease and are rejected by the storage gateway after fence/epoch change;
- GET /evidence-upload-sessions/{id}; PUT /evidence-upload-sessions/{id}/parts/{part_number} validates session, byte lease, fence/authority epochs, remaining byte budget and checksum before accepting each part; POST /evidence-upload-sessions/{id}/finalize с If-Match и Idempotency-Key revalidates closed manifest and current disposition; POST /evidence-upload-sessions/{id}/cancel с Idempotency-Key drains the lease. Revocation moves admission `OPEN → DRAINING → FENCED`, waits for admitted leases, and never relies only on eventual events;
- GET /guides/me/evidence-reuse-candidates?requirement_id=... возвращает minimum claim/scope/purpose preview без raw blob; POST /guides/me/professional-evidence-bindings с source artifact/attestation revision, target requirement/declaration/purpose, authority/grant и Idempotency-Key; GET /guides/me/professional-evidence-bindings/{id}; POST `/revoke` с If-Match+Idempotency-Key и immutable receipt;
- GET /guides/me/credentials?cursor=...; POST /guides/me/credentials с Idempotency-Key; GET/PATCH /guides/me/credentials/{id} с ETag/If-Match; POST /guides/me/credentials/{id}/submit и `/information` с If-Match+Idempotency-Key; POST `/replace` и `/withdraw`; DELETE создаёт retention-aware deletion request/receipt, но не мутирует audit;
- GET /organizations/{organization_id}/representatives shows the current scoped roster only to authorised members. Current-member commands create invitations, change scope, suspend/revoke, transfer ownership and read audit with closed role/action scope, expected roster/organization version, recent step-up and maker/checker where material. Invite acceptance instead consumes one exact `OrganizationRepresentativeInviteAcceptanceAuthorityGeneration`; accountless recovery opens through a uniform public `OrganizationRepresentativeRecoveryCaseGeneration` intake and later consumes its one-use resolution authority—neither circularly requires prior membership. Last-active-owner/admin removal conflicts without side effect and every change returns a durable receipt. GET /organizations/{organization_id}/registrations; POST /organizations/{organization_id}/registrations; GET/PATCH /organizations/{organization_id}/registrations/{id}; POST `/evidence`, `/submit`, `/information`, `/replace`, `/withdraw` — все ordinary organization writes require current organization representative generation, exact role/scope/audience, ETag/If-Match и Idempotency-Key;
- POST /guides/me/affiliations с organization/role/scope и Idempotency-Key; POST /guides/me/affiliations/{id}/withdraw; POST /guides/me/organization-affiliation-invitations для ещё не onboarded organization, GET `/invitations/{id}` и POST `/resend|revoke`; public opaque invite acceptance создаёт minimal organization/representative verification attempt с no-enumeration/rate limits. GET /organizations/{organization_id}/affiliations; POST /organizations/{organization_id}/affiliations/{id}/confirm|reject|revoke с If-Match+Idempotency-Key и запретом proposer self-confirmation;
- GET/POST /guides/me/permits и /organizations/{organization_id}/permits управляют только `PermitOrSiteAuthorizationDeclaration`; every organization path requires current authorised representative membership generation, role/scope/audience and organization ETag, with owner/tenant/IDOR checks. GET/PATCH /permits/{id} rejects, rather than ignores, any attestation/verifier/status/verified-validity field, and GET /permits/{id}/assertion returns a separately signed minimized current assertion or NOT_VERIFIED; POST /permits/{id}/evidence|submit|information|replace|withdraw; POST /excursions/{id}/permit-assignments, /occurrences/{id}/permit-assignments и /booking-groups/{id}/permit-assignments с resource If-Match, exact assertion/permit revision/scope и Idempotency-Key; DELETE assignment создаёт versioned REMOVED generation;
- GET/POST /guides/me/insurance-coverages и /organizations/{organization_id}/insurance-coverages управляют только `InsuranceCoverageDeclaration`; organization calls require the same current representative membership/role/scope/audience/ETag and confused-deputy protections. GET/PATCH /insurance-coverages/{id} rejects, rather than ignores, any attestation/verifier/status/verified-validity field, and GET /insurance-coverages/{id}/assertion returns a separately signed minimized assertion; POST /insurance-coverages/{id}/evidence|submit|information|replace|withdraw с теми же version/purpose/idempotency contracts;
- GET /guides/me/cross-border-requirements/{readiness_scope_id}; POST/GET/PATCH /guides/me/provider-legal-status-declarations, /work-authorization-declarations и /professional-recognition-declarations; evidence/submit/information/replace/withdraw paths используют exact requirement/purpose, ETag и Idempotency-Key. Safe GET readiness может вернуть отдельно minted current assertion reference; public actor не создаёт/patch-ит verified assertion/status/source/validity;
- POST /guides/me/merchant-tax-readiness/scopes/resolve с authoritative seller/excursion/market/action references и Idempotency-Key — создаёт либо возвращает canonical scope_id;
- GET /guides/me/merchant-tax-readiness/{scope_id};
- PATCH /guides/me/merchant-tax-readiness/{scope_id}/lanes/{lane} с If-Match — purpose-scoped save/correction;
- POST /guides/me/merchant-tax-readiness/{scope_id}/evidence с Idempotency-Key и explicit purpose binding;
- POST /guides/me/merchant-tax-readiness/{scope_id}/submit с If-Match и Idempotency-Key;
- POST /guides/me/merchant-tax-readiness/{scope_id}/lanes/{lane}/information с If-Match и Idempotency-Key — отвечает на NEEDS_INFO и resubmit-ит новую revision;
- POST /guides/me/merchant-tax-readiness/{scope_id}/disputes с Idempotency-Key;
- GET /guides/me/reviews/{id};
- POST /guides/me/reviews/{id}/information с If-Match, expected review/NEEDS_INFO revision и Idempotency-Key;
- GET /guides/me/reviews/{id}/cancel-impact-preview and POST /guides/me/reviews/{id}/cancel with If-Match+Idempotency-Key expose action/existing-booking/retention/reapply impact and create non-adverse immutable receipt; POST `/resubmit` returns a linked new case and never mutates terminal decision;
- POST /guides/me/restrictions/{id}/appeals с If-Match, expected restriction/decision version и Idempotency-Key; это compatibility alias единственного ComplianceAppeal command, не отдельный weaker path;
- GET /guides/me/appeals/{id} — status, clarification history и per-scope restoration progress;
- POST /guides/me/appeals/{id}/information с Idempotency-Key — facts/circumstances/evidence clarification;
- GET /guides/me/compliance-appeals/{id}/effect and POST `/stay-requests` where applicable expose current per-action `ACTIVE|STAYED`, basis, effective/expiry, continuing deadlines and do not infer stay from appeal submission;
- POST /guides/me/compliance-decisions/{decision_id}/appeals с server-issued decision_version, ground и Idempotency-Key; server resolves authoritative owner/subtype from signed decision registry and rejects client routing hints. It covers exactly the discriminated FlyFy-owned kinds in §6.11: manual review, restriction, professional verification subtypes, identity assurance/migration, legal capacity and coverage-correction decisions. Holder/data mismatch, evidence reuse/retention and public-disclosure preview use authoritative DATA_CORRECTION_OR_DISPUTE/privacy route; external issuer, organization reconfirmation, registry correction and statutory remedies return their authority-specific route instead of opening a fake FlyFy appeal. GET /guides/me/compliance-appeals/{id}; POST /guides/me/compliance-appeals/{id}/information с If-Match+Idempotency-Key;
- POST/GET/verify/exchange /guide-rights-recovery/attempts and POST /guide-rights-recovery/authorities/{id}/revoke are no-store, uniform anti-enumeration endpoints; exact-case authority grants only the closed rights operation set. GET /guide-rights/cases/{opaque_ref}/notice|restriction|restoration, POST `/appeals|information-submissions|support-requests`, GET `/appeals/{id}|appeals/{id}/effect` and, only where requestable, POST `/appeals/{id}/stay-requests` work without restoring account access. Article 31 case uses GET `/article31-response`, PUT `/article31-response/draft`, POST `/article31-responses` and GET `/article31-responses/{response_id}/receipt`. Article 30 case adds exact operations/endpoints for decision read, Article 20 complaint submit/read/information and Article 21 route/body selection/receipt/proceeding read; all three redress routes remain concurrent. Each requires its exact READ/SAVE/SUBMIT/RECEIPT operation and current source generations, If-Match where mutable and Idempotency-Key for writes, and returns the same owner-side state/immutable receipt as authenticated flow. Stay request requires exact authority operation, current appeal/restriction generations and Idempotency-Key, returns an immutable server receipt, preserves original deadline and never directly changes an effect;
- GET /guides/me/business-notices;
- GET /guides/me/public-profile-disclosures, GET /public/guides/{id}/profile-compliance-disclosure?market=..., GET /public/guides/{id}/protected-title-disclosures and GET /public/excursions/{id}/compliance-disclosure return closed discriminator-specific projections; corrections route to authoritative data/coverage case. Profile endpoints reject route/date, excursion endpoints require them. In an affected EU commercial-profile scope the public guide endpoint is emitted only when the exact current Article 30 `PublicTraderDisclosure` is composition-bound; otherwise it is absent at API/CDN/old-client level while authenticated preview/correction stays reachable;
- GET /guides/me/trader-disclosures/{id}/preview and POST `/corrections` expose only the Article 30 public field set and authoritative correction route; GET `/guides/{id}/public-trader-disclosure?market=...` and `/excursions/{id}/public-trader-disclosure` return only the current allowlisted surface-bound projection/version used by commercial profile, listing and contract snapshots;
- GET /guides/me/trader-disclosures/{id}/public-contact-preview and POST `/public-contact-preview-acknowledgements` with expected projection/copy generation show exact public (a) values, lawful business-contact/correction route and no-store receipt; acknowledgement is not consent/waiver and contains no private fields;
- GET /excursions/{id}/dsa-article31-readiness, PUT `/dsa-offer-information` with If-Match+Idempotency-Key and GET `/public-article31-offer-disclosure` expose typed trader fields/readiness/current closed projection but never accept applicability, assessment, sample/match or READY from client;
- GET `/guides/me/dsa/article31/response-cases/{id}`, PUT `/{id}/draft`, POST `/{id}/responses`, GET `/{id}/responses/{response_id}/receipt` and POST `/{id}/information` expose only the guide's safe match summary/source/date, typed requested facts, accepted evidence bindings, owner/deadlines/status and immutable receipts. Draft save and submit are distinct state-preserving commands; writes require exact case/check/response generation, `If-Match` and `Idempotency-Key`; arbitrary registry payload, seed/population and raw Article30 fields are rejected;
- GET `/guides/me/dsa/article30/service-decisions/{id}` and POST `/{id}/article20-complaints`, GET/POST `/guides/me/dsa/article20-complaints/{id}[/information]`, GET `/guides/me/dsa/article21/bodies?decision_id=&language=`, POST `/guides/me/dsa/article21/proceedings`, POST `/{id}/body-receipts` and GET `/{id}` expose the exact concurrent redress set, six-calendar-month complaint deadline, current certified body source/status/expertise/languages/fees, non-binding effect and court availability. ODS selection is never preselected and a user upload is labelled filing evidence until verified body intake;
- GET `/guides/me/dsa/article21/proceedings/{id}/fee-schedule`, POST `/{id}/expense-claims`, GET `/{id}/cost-entitlement` and GET `/cost-entitlements/{id}/settlement-receipt` expose the pre-engagement schedule, item-level accepted/reduced/rejected reasons, statutory branch, body/platform/recipient allocation, undisputed payment ETA and ledger-backed receipt. They never expose an automatic debit control and remain separately available when the ODS route or remedy is already complete; cost API outage cannot affect Article 20/21/court/restoration authorization;
- GET `/public/compliance/dsa/legal-representative` returns only the current closed Article 13 public contact projection and covered service; absence/stale is not replaced by a generic company contact or another-regime representative. GET `/guides/me/dsa/article13/public-contact-preview` shows exact fields/source/public surfaces/privacy notice and correction route before publication; it has no consent toggle. POST correction/unpublication commands require current purpose/contact generation and If-Match;
- GET `/public/compliance/dsa/transparency-reports?service=&period=` and GET `/public/compliance/dsa/transparency-reports/{version}` return accessible HTML metadata/summary and official-template artifact link, exact service/period/source date/methodology/hash/version/correction chronology. Public DTO is no-PII and cache/CDN retention honours the five-year public interval; unavailable/late reports return truthful reporting status without redirecting or disabling individual complaint/ODS rights;
- GET /guides/me/business-notices/{id}/durable-copy;
- POST /guides/me/terms-changes/{id}/waive с explicit confirmation и Idempotency-Key;
- POST /guides/me/terms-changes/{id}/terminate с Idempotency-Key;
- POST /privacy/requests, including `type=RESTRICTION`, one of the exact applicable grounds and requested purpose/dataset scope; intake remains available during account lock/outage and never requires a processing-action dependency to receive the request;
- POST /privacy/requests/{id}/verification с Idempotency-Key — risk-based session/accountless/representative/alternative proof;
- POST /privacy/requests/{id}/information and `/appeals` with current request/restriction generations and Idempotency-Key;
- GET /privacy/requests/{id} returns request status separately from effective restriction state/scope/epoch, owner progress, exception chronology, pre-lift notice, next update and receipt; GET `/privacy/requests/{id}/restriction/recipients` returns the privacy-safe actual Article 19 recipient/status list after proportional authorization;
- GET /privacy/requests/{id}/export с step-up auth и short-lived delivery;
- GET /privacy/consents?controller_legal_entity_id=... — controller/purpose status, current consent_epoch и immutable receipt history;
- POST /privacy/consent-presentations с controller_legal_entity_id, purpose и requested_locale, `Cache-Control: no-store` — атомарно возвращает approved copy/hash/locale/controller/purpose, presentation_token и expires_at;
- POST /privacy/controllers/{controller_legal_entity_id}/consents/{purpose}/grants с short-lived presentation_token, expected consent_epoch и Idempotency-Key;
- POST /privacy/consent-withdrawal-authorities с controller_legal_entity_id, purpose и target grant_id/ALL_ACTIVE_GRANTS, `Cache-Control: no-store` — rate-limited anti-enumeration intake, возвращающий только opaque attempt ID;
- GET /privacy/consent-withdrawal-authorities/{opaque_id} с `Cache-Control: no-store` — одинаковый privacy-safe status и response envelope/timing class независимо от наличия аккаунта/grant;
- POST /privacy/consent-withdrawal-authorities/{opaque_id}/verification с Idempotency-Key и `Cache-Control: no-store` — proportional account-recovery/accountless/accessible verification, а для ещё VERIFIED attempt — scope-preserving token renewal после current preview;
- POST /privacy/controllers/{controller_legal_entity_id}/consents/{purpose}/withdrawals с target grant_id либо ALL_ACTIVE_GRANTS, expected consent_epoch, Idempotency-Key, `Cache-Control: no-store` и live owner session либо withdrawal authority — немедленный controller-scoped receipt/suppression event;
- GET /me/durable-notices?cursor=..., GET /me/durable-notices/{id} and POST /me/durable-notices/{id}/acknowledgements expose publication/copy chronology separately from channel delivery; GET/PATCH /me/notification-preferences never suppresses mandatory inbox publication;
- GET /admin/release-dependencies/{release_candidate} returns the committed/draft generation, predicate evaluations, exact consumer/provider interface versions, fallback-test evidence and blocking reasons. POST `/drafts|validate|commit|supersede` uses RBAC, If-Match, Idempotency-Key and maker/checker; no endpoint can waive a true hard dependency or edit released history in place;
- GET/POST /admin/explanation-copy-versions and POST `/{id}/compile|approve|supersede|revoke|preview` require Legal Content RBAC, If-Match, Idempotency-Key and maker/checker; compile returns required-field/literal-date/placeholder/context/locale results, and preview uses a complete typed fixture without activating copy;
- GET/POST /admin/legal-template-registry and `/user-facing-label-registry`, plus compile/review/approve/schedule/activate/supersede/revoke/render operations, require maker/checker and exact source/schema/hash. Missing label, raw enum, wrong context or unapproved fallback locale cannot activate;
- GET/POST `/admin/dsa/enterprise-size-determinations`, GET `/{provider}`, POST `/{id}/submit-review|approve|invalidate|supersede`; GET/POST `/admin/dsa/vlop-designations`, GET `/{provider}/{service}`, POST `/{id}/record|invalidate|supersede`; GET `/admin/dsa/section-applicability` and POST `/admin/dsa/section-applicability/resolve`, `/{id}/invalidate|supersede`; GET `/admin/dsa/section-transition-impacts/{id}` and POST `/{id}/reconcile` require Legal/Finance RBAC, maker/checker, If-Match, Idempotency-Key, exact provider+designated-service binding, Commission decision/search source and relationship/period/Section generations;
- GET /admin/dsa/article31/random-check-batches and /checks/{id}, POST `/checks/{id}/review`; review requires exact current response-case/revision/disposition generation and rejects stale response. GET /admin/dsa/article30/private-disclosure-requests/{id} and POST `/review|approve|deny|revoke` use closed field identifiers, exact generations and maker/checker; no raw arbitrary export field list exists;
- GET/POST `/admin/dsa/article13/applicability|designations|dsc-notifications|public-contact|route-bindings` and their review/execute/reconcile/revoke/supersede commands require exact provider/service/offered-market, written mandate/acceptance/powers/resources, maker/checker and authoritative receipts. Privacy-only Article 13 purpose/notice/transfer/retention/DSAR commands are separate and public-contact publication cannot bypass them; readiness invalidation bumps the shared action epoch and reconciles every exact owner member. Article 20 admin queue/resolve requires qualified reviewer and reasoned decision. Article 21 admin refresh/approve/invalidate body registry and verify body notice/outcome; only Finance can decide/recalculate/approve cost entitlement and record settlement under maker/checker, and no admin can select a body for the user, invent bad faith or condition court/restoration. Article 24 period/freeze/reconcile/generate/schema-validate/approve/publish and open/update/reconcile/validate/approve/publish-correction commands use Compliance Reporting roles, exact current versions and dual approval, and never write Article 20/21 owner state. `/admin/dsa/article42` renders separate `template-reports` and `audit-publications` queues: applicability/period/freeze/reconcile/template-validate/approve/publish/correct operations cannot mutate the audit branch, while record-audit-receipt/audit-open/freeze-manifest/record-authority-transmission/record-recipient-receipt/review-redactions/approve/publish and open/update/reconcile/review/approve/publish-audit-correction operations cannot satisfy the template branch. Audit correction requires a predecessor, typed class and exact diff; an underlying change cannot publish before new Commission and DSC receipts, while a presentation/redaction-only correction cannot change the restricted digest. Commission and DSC receipt actions are separate, and restricted-bundle decrypt/export requires its own recipient-bound JIT/MFA/maker-checker authority unavailable to ordinary report admins; all mutations require exact service/designation/calendar, If-Match, Idempotency-Key and maker/checker;
- GET `/transparency/dsa/article24/reports`, `/transparency/dsa/article24/reports/{report_id}/versions`, `/transparency/dsa/article42/template-reports`, `/transparency/dsa/article42/template-reports/{report_id}/versions`, `/transparency/dsa/article42/audit-publications/{audit_cycle_id}` and `/transparency/dsa/article42/audit-publications/{audit_cycle_id}/versions` are unauthenticated, accessible, cache-safe public reads over immutable no-PII projections. They expose exact service/period/source date, methodology/language, current and prior signed hashes, separate template/audit correction reason/class/diff, audit redaction explanations and truthful late/unavailable status; they never expose unredacted authority bundles, internal blockers or imply that an individual right is unavailable;
- GET /admin/requirement-artifact-registry/{release_candidate} returns expected/observed artifacts, digests, stage/DoD/evidence and orphan gaps; validate/commit is generated-only and cannot waive missing safety artifact;
- GET /excursions/{id}/compliance-preflight;
- PUT /excursions/{id}/responsibility-assignments/{requirement_id}, PUT /occurrences/{id}/responsibility-assignments/{requirement_id} and PUT /booking-groups/{id}/responsibility-assignments/{requirement_id} run only in the authoritative resource owner with If-Match, exact requirement/path/subject/segment/group-size/owner generations и Idempotency-Key; public payload cannot select FLYFY/SITE_OPERATOR directly or self-confirm another owner, and response returns recomputed immutable requirement-evaluation set/diff;
- POST /responsibility-assignments/{id}/accept|reject and POST /responsibility-assignments/{id}/revoke are owner-authority-bound aliases to the responsible owner service, with If-Match/Idempotency-Key and immutable receipt; GET status exposes awaiting owner/ETA/alternative without private owner data;
- POST /responsibility-assignments/{id}/invitations, `/resend|revoke`, public non-authorising preview and no-store token exchange follow the scanner-safe handoff contract; endpoint refuses SITE_OPERATOR without approved integration and never offers a public FLYFY acceptance;
- POST /guide-presence-allocations/reservations, `/activate|prepare-consume|apply-consume-receipt|release` are resource-owner S2S commands exposed through owner-scoped orchestration; guide-facing GET returns conflict-safe availability/alternatives without another booking/customer identity;
- GET /occurrences/{id}/offline-start-readiness; POST /occurrences/{id}/offline-start-bundles with If-Match, exact device key/capability generations and Idempotency-Key returns encrypted bundle plus non-authorising cached assistance bootstrap. GET `/current`, POST /offline-start-bundles/{id}/download-receipts|revoke|replace|consume-receipts and GET `/reconciliation` separate download, local consume and authoritative server reconciliation; logout cannot discard a signed device receipt;
- POST /offline-start-assistance-cases accepts device-bound bootstrap_id, stable client_assistance_id, safe failure class and optional local/trusted-time evidence with uniform response; GET status and POST `/information|request-call|remedy-decisions` require owner/case authority. Data/SMS/voice adapters append typed channel evidence; only owner-DB CASE_COMMITTED sets server_received_at/RECEIVED, while provider acceptance/call initiation stays distinct. No force-start endpoint exists;
- POST /excursions/{id}/publish с If-Match и Idempotency-Key;
- GET `/guides/me/excursions/{id}/control-status` and `/control-impact-preview?command=PAUSE_SALES|RESUME_SALES|UNPUBLISH`, POST `/commands/pause-sales|commands/resume-sales|commands/unpublish`; GET `/guides/me/public-profile/control-status` and `/control-impact-preview?command=HIDE|SHOW`, POST `/guides/me/public-profile/commands/hide|commands/show`. Pause/unpublish/hide require ownership, `If-Match` and `Idempotency-Key` but no compliance ALLOW; they return command status, affected markets/existing-booking count, committed generation/receipt and remain reachable through server-rendered old-client fallback. Resume/show and existing republish endpoint require fresh exact authorization plus the same CAS/idempotency contract. Timeout/unknown command outcome is resolved through control-status before retry, and an old client cannot be forced to update merely to reduce visibility;
- POST /booking-attempts с обязательным client-generated Idempotency-Key/client_request_id — создаёт durable booking_attempt_id и replayable response до любого PSP side effect;
- GET /booking-attempts/{id} — authoritative resume/status после restart или timeout;
- GET /booking-attempts/by-client-request/{client_request_id} — owner-bound recovery после потери create-response;
- GET /bookings/{id}/compliance-status;
- POST /bookings/{id}/cancellation-quotes с Idempotency-Key — immutable eligibility/fee/tax/refund quote без отмены, bound to current CancellationTermEnforceabilityAssessment/term-copy/formula; response содержит lawful cap/calculation/reason и не возвращает collectible fee при UNCERTAIN/stale assessment;
- POST /bookings/{id}/cancel с If-Match, quote_version, current ExternalIntakeAuthorityAssessment version и Idempotency-Key — фиксирует cancellation intent/source obligation и возвращает platform/dispatch/recipient/legal-effective timestamps, effect class и required action; booking-state/refund/credit effect исполняется owner worker только после legally-effective gate и через EXECUTE_GOVERNED_CONSUMER_EFFECT envelope;
- GET /bookings/{id}/cancellation-status — current/superseded intake delivery generations, `CANCELLATION_SUBMITTED | PENDING_EXTERNAL_EFFECT | LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE | DELIVERY_FAILED | EFFECT_CORRECTED`, receipt effect, deadline, assisted/direct route и downstream governed-effect receipts;
- POST /bookings/{id}/cancellation-external-receipts with purpose-bound recipient/reference/evidence, current attempt version and Idempotency-Key records immediate EVIDENCE_ONLY; GET /bookings/{id}/assisted-deadline-case and POST `/information|request-callback` expose owner/next/due/absolute due, accessible/account-recovery channel, verification/corrected effect and never suppress FlyFy dispatch until authoritative proof;
- GET /bookings/{id}/remediation-proposals/current;
- POST /bookings/{id}/remediation-decisions с If-Match, proposal_version и Idempotency-Key;
- POST /consumer-complaints с ExternalIntakeAuthorityAssessment/context version и Idempotency-Key — создаёт platform receipt до routing и explicit `EVIDENCE_ONLY | LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE | UNRESOLVED` envelope;
- GET /consumer-complaints/{id} — отдельно platform/dispatch/recipient/legal-effective timestamps, current/superseded intake generations, respondent clock basis, required next action/direct route и complaint lifecycle;
- POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/external-receipts and GET/POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/assisted-deadline-case[/information|request-callback] use the same EVIDENCE_ONLY→authoritative verification/no-duplicate-dispatch contract and preserve the complaint platform receipt/deadline during account recovery;
- POST /assisted-deadline-recovery-authorities accepts opaque locator or minimized typed reference plus locale/accessibility method and always returns 202 with opaque attempt ID under `Cache-Control: no-store`; GET /{opaque_id} uses the same privacy-safe envelope/timing class before verification. POST `/{opaque_id}/verification|exchange|renew|revoke` applies proportional proof, consumes a digest-only one-time exchange, returns/rotates only a short-lived audience/device-bound token and never widens scope;
- booking/complaint AssistedDeadlineCase status, information, external-receipt, bundle and callback endpoints accept a live owner session or the exact current recovery authority. Writes require If-Match+Idempotency-Key and current case generation; all recovery endpoints use no query secrets, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer` and no reusable refresh token;
- POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/information с Idempotency-Key;
- POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/withdraw с If-Match и Idempotency-Key;
- GET /consumer-complaints/{id}/resolution-proposals/current — current proposal/settlement-term copy versions, deadline и complaint ETag без superseded-action controls;
- POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/resolution-decisions с If-Match, proposal_version, ACCEPT/DECLINE, отдельно confirmed settlement_term_ids и Idempotency-Key;
- POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/adr-referrals с If-Match и Idempotency-Key, только после REFER_COMPLAINT_TO_ADR authorization; BODY_RULE_CONFLICT не вызывает defective integration и возвращает alternative/manual route, absolute external deadline, required_next_action и `PLATFORM_INTENT_RECEIPT(EVIDENCE_ONLY, NOT_SUBMITTED_TO_BODY)`;
- POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/adr-referrals/{referral_id}/exit с If-Match, referral_version, optional current outcome_version, expected external_order_resolution_version и Idempotency-Key — единый `ExitADR` для entitled party на любой allowed незавершённой стадии; justification не требуется, response содержит linked attempt/party-decision versions, platform/effect receipt и rule-defined semantics, но не закрывает primary до sufficient effect + current order classification;
- POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/adr-outcome-decisions с If-Match, outcome_version, ACCEPT/DECLINE и Idempotency-Key; при ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED timely decision возвращает RECORDED_PENDING_EXTERNAL_ORDER receipt, а выход всегда идёт через `/exit`;
- POST /consumer-complaints/{id}/adr-referrals/{referral_id}/claim-dispositions/{disposition_id}/appeals с If-Match, expected disposition/allocation/global generation, ground/evidence и Idempotency-Key — owner-bound immutable receipt/deadline; GET `/claim-disposition-appeals/{appeal_id}` и POST `/information` возвращают current/superseded review, owner/next/absolute due и corrected projection without other-claim PII;
