- GET /respondents/me/adr-cases?cursor=...&status=... — owner/role-bound paginated inbox с unread/deadline/action-required facets без cross-party count leakage;
- GET /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id} — ABAC/party-scoped workspace для individual guide, organization либо другого contracting respondent: redacted substantive statement/structured allegations, material arguments/evidence/expert opinions, item-level redaction basis/disclosure-review route, own response history, procedure/binding basis, deadlines/reflection/challenge/party-specific ExitADR rights, current/superseded obligation chronology и тот же atomic three-projection set; claimant contact, irrelevant/privileged raw text, other-referral/provider identifiers не возвращаются, но redaction не удаляет material substance/right to comment;
- GET /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/submission — current `ADRRespondentSubmission`, current/superseded revisions и linked current/superseded `ADRRespondentResponseDeliveryAttempt`: scan/quarantine status, platform/external receipts, receipt_effect, dispatch/body timestamps, response/external deadline+tolling, missing fields, next action/update и fallback bundle без cross-party PII;
- PUT /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/submission/draft с If-Match, expected response revision и Idempotency-Key — создаёт/обновляет только новую append-only DRAFT revision; stale/offline write возвращает conflict+merge-safe current revision и не затирает более новую отправку;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/submission/submit с If-Match, expected draft revision и Idempotency-Key — атомарно фиксирует `SUBMITTED_PENDING_SCAN`, platform_received_at и immutable platform receipt до asynchronous malware/DLP scan; response явно сообщает, требуется ли external delivery, создана/когда планируется ли delivery attempt и ближайший внешний срок. Receipt доказывает intake FlyFy, но не external delivery/tolling, retry возвращает тот же receipt;
- GET /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/submission/delivery — `PLATFORM_ONLY | DISPATCHING | EXTERNALLY_DELIVERED | UNRESOLVED | FAILED`, отдельно platform/dispatched/body timestamps, receipt effect, внешний deadline/required action, next update и безусловно доступный downloadable bundle/direct-body или assisted fallback;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/submission/delivery/retry с If-Match, expected delivery generation и Idempotency-Key — retry того же external idempotency identity либо явно linked retry generation; никогда не обещает tolling и не дублирует response;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/submission/external-receipts с purpose-bound body reference/receipt evidence, expected submission/delivery generation и Idempotency-Key — записывает respondent direct-body fallback как EVIDENCE_ONLY до scan/signature/authoritative lookup; verified evidence supersede-ит delivery attempt, предотвращает duplicate platform dispatch и сохраняет original external timestamp. Forged/stale/cross-case evidence остаётся audit-only и вызывает safe error/security review;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/submission/information с If-Match, current NEEDS_INFO revision и Idempotency-Key — отвечает только на конкретный request, создаёт новую submitted revision и сохраняет всю chronology;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/disclosure-requests с If-Match, requested evidence/item, redaction snapshot/hash, reason и Idempotency-Key — создаёт durable `ADRRespondentDisclosureRequest` receipt, owner/due/next/absolute due и explicit deadline-treatment result без обещания автоматического tolling;
- GET /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/disclosure-requests/{request_id} — current/superseded decisions, disclosed replacement snapshot, basis, response/external deadlines, next action и appeal route;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/disclosure-requests/{request_id}/information с If-Match и Idempotency-Key — append-only ответ на NEEDS_INFO;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/disclosure-requests/{request_id}/appeals с If-Match, approved ground/evidence и Idempotency-Key — human review/maker-checker без раскрытия защищённых данных до решения;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/outcome-decisions с If-Match, outcome_version, ACCEPT/DECLINE и Idempotency-Key — party-scoped alias общего decision contract, не отдельная business semantics;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/exit с If-Match, referral/outcome/order versions и Idempotency-Key — party-scoped alias единственного `ExitADR`, только при current entitlement;
- POST /respondents/me/adr-cases/{referral_id}/challenges с If-Match, outcome/order versions, approved ground/evidence и Idempotency-Key — только когда applicable rule разрешает challenge; response сохраняет external-deadline/evidence-only semantics;
- GET /guides/me/payout-account;
- POST /guides/me/payout-account/onboarding-sessions с Idempotency-Key и recent step-up auth;
- POST /guides/me/payout-account/onboarding-sessions/{id}/resume с Idempotency-Key — новая one-time PSP session после owner/state check;
- POST /guides/me/payout-account/method-updates с Idempotency-Key и recent step-up auth;
- POST /guides/me/payout-account/method-updates/{id}/cancel с If-Match и Idempotency-Key;
- POST /guides/me/payout-account/method-updates/{id}/revert с If-Match, Idempotency-Key и independent verification;
- POST /guides/me/payout-account/close with If-Match, inventory/disposition preview confirmation and Idempotency-Key; non-zero/unknown balance without a current settlement route returns ACTION_REQUIRED and never closes;
- POST /guides/me/payout-account/reopen creates a new account generation after current checks; POST /payout-account-recovery-authorities and owner-bound GET /payout-account-recovery/{opaque_id} provide anti-enumerating locked/former/deleted-account read-only balances/receipts/disposition plus verified destination/manual-settlement/appeal path;
- PUT /guides/me/payout-account/mandate с If-Match, current capacity-law/capacity generations and Idempotency-Key maps to `CREATE_OR_CHANGE_PAYOUT_MANDATE` — MANUAL_REQUEST/SCHEDULED cadence/threshold preview и durable receipt; it never retargets an already PROCESSING payout generation;
- POST /guides/me/payout-requests с Idempotency-Key и current destination/amount preview;
- GET /guides/me/payouts/summary;
- GET /guides/me/payouts/{id};
- GET /guides/me/payouts/{id}/capacity-disposition — amount/currency and immutable payable provenance, explicit “not FlyFy revenue” protection, `HELD_FOR_CAPACITY_DISPOSITION | ROUTING | SETTLED | RESTITUTED | MANUAL_LEGAL_REVIEW`, privacy-safe reason, owner/next_update/due/absolute_due, lawful payout/representative/organization/restitution options, receipts and correction/appeal/support; it never exposes guardian or conflict-law raw facts;
- POST /guides/me/payout-restrictions/{id}/information с Idempotency-Key;
- POST /guides/me/payout-restrictions/{id}/appeals с Idempotency-Key;

Ответы не раскрывают внутренние fraud signals или чужие PII.

Каждый ADR referral/exit response и tracker projection различает `platform_received_at`, `external_dispatched_at`, `body_received_at`, `legal_effective_at`, `receipt_effect: EVIDENCE_ONLY | LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE | UNRESOLVED`, `tolling_status: CONTINUES | ENDS_AT | RESUMES_AT | UNKNOWN`, `limitation_or_filing_deadline` и `required_next_action`. GET complaint и respondent tracker возвращает versioned envelope `adr_execution_safety` с едиными `projection_schema_version`, `projection_set_version`, `as_of`, `minimum_supported_client_version` и тремя snapshot-ами одной версии:

- `revoked_authority_check`: status `NOT_APPLICABLE | CHECKING | ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT | EFFECT_FOUND`, stop manifest/cause, expected/pending/no-effect/found/retracted counts, oldest/next update и minimized current/carry-forward entries;
- `found_effect_remediation`: summary `NOT_APPLICABLE | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | ALLOCATION_REVIEW_PENDING | REMEDIATION_OPEN | RESOLVED`, current-valid privacy-safe operation/lineage count, unknown/allocation-review/open counts, protection, identity/validity/incident/allocation/global-convergence summary, due/next update и per-disposition counts `REMEDIATED | LAWFULLY_RETAINED | RETRACTED_CORRECTED | NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED | CLAIM_ALLOCATION_APPEALED` без alias/provider/ledger/other-claim PII;
- `remedy_fulfilment`: level `NOT_APPLICABLE | NOT_STARTED | ASSESSMENT_PENDING | NONE | PARTIAL | FULFILLED | SUPERSEDED_NOT_OPERATIVE`, current obligation/order/assessment generations, `unknown_attempt_count`, derived compatibility boolean `assessment_pending`, typed pending reason/missing-input owners/deadlines, expected slot manifest, а только после ASSESSED — fulfilled/missing/positive_excess/negative_excess vector, deficit IDs/dispositions, due/next update и signed final receipt reference. `ASSESSMENT_PENDING` имеет строгий precedence над NONE/PARTIAL/FULFILLED и запрещает deficit/re-execution/final-close CTA;

Mixed-version read возвращает `temporarily_unavailable/resync_required`, а не смешанный ответ. Клиент не выводит certainty/finality из HTTP 2xx, revoke, authority state либо individual receipt. `deprecated_compat.remedy_stop_status` существует только для старых clients как conservative output-only view: он не принимается в command/If-Match/finality, не имеет reverse mapping и при любой ambiguity, включая ASSESSMENT_PENDING, не выдаёт STOP_CONFIRMED/FULFILLED/RESOLVED. Corrected notice/version возвращается при newer FOUND, finality reopen, canonical split/merge, allocation/validity correction и FULFILLED→ASSESSMENT_PENDING/PARTIAL/NONE. Genuine remediated effect сохраняет factual chronology; retraction показывает отдельный corrected disposition, а не переписывает прошлое.

Privacy request intake и consent-withdrawal-authority intake поддерживают authenticated и отдельный rate-limited/accountless recovery channel. До proportional verification они возвращают только opaque case/attempt и одинаковые anti-enumeration responses; contact verification token short-lived и не раскрывает наличие аккаунта, grant или продолжающейся обработки. Original submitted_at privacy request сохраняется в обоих paths, а verified consent withdrawal исполняется немедленно и не ждёт DSAR queue.

Guide compliance API имеет capability handshake (`guide_compliance_schema_version`, `minimum_supported_client_version`, supported declaration/serviceability/appeal features и upgrade URL/copy version). Legacy `official_certificate_required` никогда не возвращается как authoritative input и не вычисляется обратно из новых states. Output-only compatibility projection маппит непредставимый state в `UPGRADE_REQUIRED | ACTION_REQUIRED` с server-rendered safe status/next step/support, но никогда в fake `REJECTED`, `CERTIFICATE_MISSING` или ALLOW. Client ниже required capability не может publish/republish/assign/start, если не способен показать exact requirements/decision; private draft, current status, data access/export/delete, correction/appeal/complaint/refund/support остаются доступны через server fallback/deep link. Server measures version adoption, blocked attempts and upgrade completion; staged min-version gate activates only after communication/accessibility review and retires old projection after documented adoption/time/support criteria.

The same resource-wide `ClientCapabilityEnvelope` is mandatory for cancellation/refund, payout/capacity-disposition, payment-lineage conflict, sensitive-ingress/deletion and non-ADR governed-effect reads/commands: resource kind/schema version, minimum supported client, closed supported-state list, closed supported-command list, server-rendered accessible fallback URL/copy, as_of and upgrade policy. An old client never maps `PENDING_EXTERNAL_EFFECT` to CANCELLED, `EVIDENCE_ONLY/UNRESOLVED` to legally submitted, `RETURNED|REVERSED` to PAID, `LATE_CAPTURE_RECONCILING | MULTI_ATTEMPT_PAYMENT_RECONCILING | PAYMENT_RETRY_SAFETY_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE` to failed/retryable payment, `ISOLATED_DELETION_PENDING` to stored evidence, or unknown/reconciling/frozen effect to retryable/complete. It cannot issue a duplicate cancellation/charge/refund/payout/upload or hide an amount/receipt because an enum is unknown. Unsupported late-payment state renders the server safety card with every pay/retry command absent; unsupported sensitive-ingress state exposes no uploader/preview and preserves deletion status/receipt plus non-sensitive route. Status, chronology, receipt, appeal/support, refund/payout information and AssistedDeadlineCase remain available through authenticated web/deep-link/account-recovery fallback without forced upgrade; irreversible command is disabled only when accurate disclosure/confirmation is impossible.

- RecordADRExternalDelivery с referral/attempt versions, recognised-channel assertion, external_dispatched_at/body_received_at, receipt_effect/tolling/deadline projection, signed evidence и idempotency;
- ApplyADRWithdrawalExternalResult с attempt/referral versions, EFFECTIVE/REJECTED/NOT_EFFECTIVE/ACK_UNKNOWN, authoritative sequence, отдельно legal_effective_at/withdrawal_effective_at/body_acknowledged_at, signed evidence и idempotency;
- CreateExecutionObligation с discriminated OUTCOME_REMEDY/EFFECT_LINEAGE_REMEDIATION subtype, canonical natural key `(referral_id,current_order_version,kind,remedy_id_or_canonical_lineage_target)`, command Idempotency-Key, expected current-obligation pointer/absence, immutable manifest/slots/caps/deadlines, current order/target и predecessor generation; одна complaint transaction CAS-создаёт/возвращает ровно один enforceable base+subtype aggregate, current pointer и initial `PENDING_INPUTS|ASSESSED` assessment/projection set;
- RecomputeFulfilmentAssessment с expected current obligation/assessment generation, full checksummed input-generation set и current GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member-manifest hash. Derived command key `UNIQUE(obligation_id, obligation_generation, expected_prior_assessment_generation, input_set_hash, cause_kind, cause_id, cause_version)` и Idempotency-Key обеспечивают one append: exact replay возвращает ту же generation/receipt, changed payload под тем же key конфликтует. Он append-ит ровно одну новую `FulfilmentAssessmentGeneration`: `PENDING_INPUTS` перечисляет missing inputs/owners/due/next/absolute due и выдаёт ASSESSMENT_PENDING без slot outcome/deficit/finality; `ASSESSED` публикует signed vector и deficits. Stale writer, incomplete input set или незавершённый global fence не может заменить current assessment;
- AllocateOrSupersedeObligationContribution и RevokeObligationContribution с stable allocation_id, source purpose/basis, current lineage-net/order/cross-referral claim, target obligation/slot/typed share, residual owner/no-double proof, expected current allocation/assessment/global generation, Idempotency-Key и maker/checker/approval policy для material manual share; только deterministic policy-derived direct causation допускает service-principal auto-allocation. Только current ACTIVE generation участвует в assessment; supersede/revoke атомарно запускает/входит в GlobalEffectReassessment и не оставляет double credit;
- ReserveADRRemedyEffect с authority/order/epoch, base obligation/manifest/slot, AttemptEffectPlan/hash, assessment, resource/financial и expected exposure-ledger versions; атомарно фиксирует authority EFFECT_RESERVED + single-use `ReserveExposure`, stale/revoked/mixed-generation command не резервируется;
- MarkADRRemedyEffectStarted с reservation/exposure token, ROOT_OUTCOME_EFFECT AttemptKey, exact obligation/slot/AttemptEffectPlan, required-source policy/hash и operation/provider idempotency; одной CAS переводит authority в EFFECT_STARTED, exposure в STARTED_RESIDUAL и creates/gets attempt + initial ATTEMPT EffectDiscoveryManifest. Changed plan/key/slot retry конфликтует;
- ApplyADRRemedyOwnerReceipt с authority/reservation, expected AttemptKey/attempt/result/discovery/plan/exposure versions, current `GlobalEffectReassessment` generation/member-manifest hash, factual owner result `ACTUAL_EFFECTS_OBSERVED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | NO_ACTUAL_EFFECT_OBSERVED`, immutable `effect_observations[]`, claimed slots, actual aliases, normalized fingerprints/source hashes, same-effect correlation, per-source watermarks/as-of/finality proofs, resulting resource/journal versions и signature. Owner не присылает FULL/PARTIAL и не создаёт deficit. Server append-ит OwnerEffectResultGeneration, canonical facts/lookup bindings, recalculates LineageNetContribution/FulfilmentAssessment/ExpectedEffectDeficit/EffectExecutionIncident/exposure refs и весь projection set в одной fenced transaction; finality выводится только из current EffectDiscoveryManifest. Если receipt меняет pinned input либо affected referral/execution-control member set во время PREPARING/FENCING/COMMITTING, текущая reassessment generation supersede-ится и restart-ится с новым complete manifest до commit;
- ApplyADRRemedyStopReceipt с manifest/entry/cause/current-order/epoch versions, authority original binding, stop generation, expected request-evidence/discovery/projection-set versions, current GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member-manifest hash, proof, discriminated discovery subject `STOP_REQUEST | ATTEMPT`, discovery generation/hash либо DispatchAbsenceProof, observations, sequence/watermarks и signature. Matching no-effect меняет только entry; factual FOUND не зависит от referral allocation и создаёт recovered attempt при необходимости; late/stale proof history-only. Transaction append-ит ADRRemedyStopRequestEvidenceGeneration и атомарно recompute-ит все три projections; новый affected member/input supersede-ит и restart-ит coordinator generation, а не проскальзывает после её fence;
- ReserveADRRemediationEffect и MarkADRRemediationEffectStarted с exact current order/remediation epoch, base EffectRemediationObligation/manifest/slot/AttemptEffectPlan, discriminated `EXISTING_EFFECT_LINEAGE | EXPECTED_EFFECT_DEFICIT` target, assessment/deficit/result/discovery/identity/validity/incident/allocation/global-reassessment/net/case/item/resource/financial/exposure versions. Deficit target не содержит fake source set; Mark creates/gets one REMEDIATION_EFFECT attempt и started-residual exposure, mismatch/harmful unresolved fence fail closed;
- ApplyADRRemediationOwnerReceipt имеет ту же factual-only semantics: expected authority/attempt/plan/target/result/discovery/exposure versions и current GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member-manifest hash, observations/aliases/fingerprints/correlation/source finality. Matching correction входит в existing target lineage, misdirected actual создаёт COLLATERAL_VARIANCE_EFFECT+incident; server, а не owner, пересчитывает obligation assessment/deficit/net/contributions/three projections. UNKNOWN использует тот же stable lookup root с purpose binding; changed input/member set supersede-ит и restart-ит coordinator generation до final commit;
- ClaimEffectOutcomeLookup и ApplyEffectOutcomeLookupEvidence требуют lease, claim/task/source generation, exact `active_binding_set_version` и для Apply current GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member-manifest hash; новое binding/reopen bump-ит claim version и fencing-ит старого worker, а result одной transaction обновляет factual result, assessments/deficits и все затронутые projection axes. Evidence, открывающее новую affected referral/lineage, restart-ит pinned global generation;
- ReserveExposure, MarkExposureStarted, ConsumeExposure, ReleaseExposure и ReconcileExposure — internal CAS single-writer APIs с operation plan/hash, typed measure/cap scope, action_class/direction/provisional-policy version, expected ledger epoch/version, current GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member/prepared-fence status and token. Reserve и immediately-before-effect Mark atomically verify that no incompatible active PREPARING/FENCING/COMMITTING/RECONCILING generation or prepared token covers the same exposure scope; harmful/final action fail closed либо joins/restarts coordinator. Только separately approved independently capped `CONSUMER_PROTECTIVE_INTERIM` policy can bypass via its own reserved bucket/token. Mark moves RESERVED_UNSTARTED→STARTED_RESIDUAL before effect; delayed Consume stays conservative. `RecordExternalUnreservedEffect` всегда доступен для verified provider/bank safety fact, records worst-case measure/class/direction as EXTERNAL_UNRESERVED_DISCOVERED+incident/freeze, bump-ит scope epoch и invalidates any prepared global token. Terminal no-effect либо proven already-accounted attribution даёт RELEASED_EXTERNAL_NO_EFFECT_OR_ALREADY_ACCOUNTED; newer proof симметрично reopen-ит residual/freeze. Reopen after cap reuse creates REOPENED_OVER_CAP_FROZEN, never silent breach/clawback;
- ReconcilePlanExposureAttribution с stable plan/scope ID, complete canonical member set+versions, signed conserved shares, action_class/direction, expected current attribution/ledger/global generation и Idempotency-Key; append-only supersession возможен только внутри fenced reassessment, сумма current shares не превышает canonical exposure, а missing/ambiguous attribution сохраняет conservative residual/freeze;
- ReconcileADREffectIdentity с attempt/discovery/observation/source-instance/alias/group/lineage versions, current GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member-manifest hash и signed lookup/correlation evidence; dedupes identical alias+facts, rejects changed-fact replay, creates distinct source instances per actual ref и append-only MERGE/SPLIT/REASSIGN EffectCanonicalizationGeneration. Command server-side under coordinator lock либо входит в current fenced generation, либо атомарно supersede-ит/restart-ит её с новым member set; any plan change bump-ит remediation epoch, fences authorities и создаёт cause-bound stop manifest;
- ResolveADREffectIdentityConflict с expected resolution/all affected record/current-order/epoch/global generation+manifest versions, distinct maker/checker + required Finance/Legal approvals, authoritative correlation-validity evidence и reason; идемпотентно создаёт RESOLVED/REOPENED receipt/generation, но не мутирует source facts и не auto-allocates cross-referral remedy; changed graph restarts coordinator before publish;
- ResolveADREffectEvidenceValidity с expected observation/source/group/attempt/discovery/item/plan/order/epoch/global generation+manifest versions, newer signed source sequence, distinct maker/checker и Finance/Legal approval; append-ит CONFIRMED/CONFLICT/RETRACTED_FALSE_POSITIVE generation, bumps remediation epoch/fences stale plans and atomically joins/restarts global reassessment before corrected notice/current-valid ledger projection;
- ResolveCrossReferralEffectAllocation с global group/net-cap и all referral claim/order/epoch/item/plan versions, allocation basis, current GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member-manifest hash, distinct maker/checker, Idempotency-Key; coordinator fences each referral, commits allocation receipts/outboxes и reconciles partial failure before any final compensation;
- RecordReferralEffectClaimDisposition с stable disposition_id, referral/lineage/allocation-claim key, expected current disposition/order/allocation/global generation, `ALLOCATED_TO_LOCAL_CLAIM | NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED | APPEALED | REOPENED`, signed legal/economic basis, appeal route, maker/checker и Idempotency-Key. Submit/ResolveReferralEffectClaimAppeal требует owner/appellant binding, appealed version, immutable original receipt, independent reviewer, expected appeal/disposition/allocation/global generations и reasoned outcome; exact replay returns same receipt. Создание/appeal/reopen идёт только через global coordinator; pending appeal публикует ALLOCATION_REVIEW_PENDING, а NO_LOCAL не создаёт phantom item, но оставляет auditable current record и durable notice;
- ReconcileEffectExecutionIncident с incident kind, obligation/slot/AttemptEffectPlan, current canonical-lineage/net/allocation/assessment/order/epoch/exposure и GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member-manifest versions, action class; поддерживает assess/remediate/lawful-retain/reopen generations, атомарно joins/restarts coordinator, блокирует harmful actions и допускает только approved capped interim relief;
- ReconcileADRLateEffectDiscovery с origin manifest/request/receipt, expected discovery/canonical-group generations, current external-order/case/task/item/global generation+manifest versions, authoritative watermark и Idempotency-Key; создаёт immutable batch InterveningOrderAssessmentManifest с one entry/current item/skip edge per canonical lineage, joins/restarts coordinator при новом member/input либо CAS-retry-ит на новом order;
- `api:complaint.ReconcileADRExternalOrder.v3` with expected resolution/rule/input watermark performs superseding classification, authority fencing, safe primary reopening, reflection-window restoration and atomic live intent+outbox. Legacy case conversion is a separate migration-origin path. `api:notice.PublishCorrectedDurableNotice.v1`, outcome lookup, `api:complaint.ApplyADRCorrectedNoticePublicationReceipt.v2`, next-update refresh and signed escalation form the independent receipt-backed saga; notification never writes complaint state, complaint never claims publication without receipt, and escalation never resets age or PUBLISHED truth;
- CoordinateGlobalEffectReassessment со stable reassessment ID, command generation/prior/current pointer, cause и immutable complete member manifest/hash. Referral watermark pin-ит current order/epochs, obligation/manifest/plan, result/discovery, task-state+active binding set, observations, group/lineage/net, contribution allocation/assessment/deficit/incident, claim disposition, case/item и projection-set versions; каждый affected execution-control scope является отдельным prepared member с current ledger epoch, buckets, external-unreserved facts, plan attribution и freeze generation. Durable PREPARING→FENCING→COMMITTING→RECONCILING→CONVERGED protocol имеет exactly one current nonterminal generation per scope, unique immutable member rows, per-member receipts и final linearizable compare-and-fence token/barrier. Changed input/member set или invalidated exposure token supersede-ит/restart-ит generation; external-unreserved after convergence opens a new generation, MANUAL_RECOVERY запрещает partial global finality;
- ApplyADRRespondentSubmissionScan с expected submission/revision/state, per-attachment scanner-policy/hash и signed results; safe answers сохраняются при quarantined attachment, whole-submission rejection требует unseparable result+human escalation, original platform receipt не меняется и stale scan не перезаписывает новую revision. DispatchADRRespondentResponse/ApplyADRRespondentResponseDeliveryReceipt/VerifyADRRespondentDirectBodyReceipt требуют expected submission/scan/delivery/rule/deadline generations, stable external idempotency identity, recognised channel, purpose-bound evidence, scan/signature/replay checks и authoritative body lookup; unverified direct receipt остаётся EVIDENCE_ONLY, verified receipt supersede-ит pending dispatch and prevents duplicate. PLATFORM_ONLY никогда не становится LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE без approved rule/evidence. TriageADRRespondentDisclosureRequest, ApplyADRRespondentDisclosureDecision и ReconcileADRRespondentDeadlineTreatment требуют expected request/redaction/rule/deadline generations, ABAC/minimization, maker/checker where sensitive и append-only receipt/appeal/reopen;

Complaint/referral transition constraints проверяются раздельно; withdrawal/party-decline/unrelated closure reasons не reopen-ятся;
- ReconcileADREffectRemediation с expected current order/remediation epoch, obligations/manifests/plans, attempts/results/discovery/tasks+bindings/observations, current-valid groups/lineages/net contributions, assessments/deficits/incidents, identity/validity/allocation, current GlobalEffectReassessment generation/member-manifest, case/items/projection set/execution-control exposure/owner/resource/financial versions, idempotent compensation generations и signed receipts. Harmful action fail closed; approved interim relief использует общий cap. Item CLOSED/case RESOLVED/complaint COMPLIED-CLOSED проверяются раздельно и только по causal gates; new proof/finality reopen/MERGE/SPLIT/retraction joins/restarts coordinator и атомарно reopen-ит соответствующие objects и весь projection set, не переписывая chronology;
- ComposeArticle18AvailableInformationSourceManifest, ApplySourceReceipt, ClassifyInformationItem, CompleteAllRelevantAvailableInformationManifest, AssessDSAArticle18Incident, ResolveArticle18RecipientRoute, Dispatch/ReconcileReport and AssessSupplement require exact hosting role/predicate/source/item/closed route generations, complete expected/observed hashes and every-concerned-MS coverage. Dispatch payload is exactly INCLUDED; DUPLICATE references canonical INCLUDED; lawful withholding needs explicit source+dual review;

Request/Assess/Approve/Deny/Revoke Article30 private disclosure, Mint/Consume one-use execution authority and Reconcile merchant execution receipt require exact record/recipient/order/purpose/field/channel generations; no generic private export bypass. Record relationship end and Schedule/Execute/Reconcile deletion use authoritative calendar/deletion manifests;
- ComposeDSAEnterpriseRelationshipManifest, ApplyDSAEnterprisePeriodEvidence, RecordEnterpriseStatusChange, ResolveEnterpriseStatusChangeTreatment, Determine/Approve/Invalidate/SupersedeDSAEnterpriseSize, Record/Invalidate/SupersedeDSAVLOPDesignation, Resolve/Invalidate/Supersede/GetCurrentDSASectionApplicability and ReconcileDSASectionTransitionImpact require exact source/relationship/period/pre-post transaction-control/effective-date/provider+service/VLOP/Section generations, maker/checker/counsel and complete expected/observed manifests. Only approved ARTICLE_4_2 loss can mint 12-month grace; structural-immediate loss applies from approved transaction time, ambiguous acquisition/divestiture stays UNRESOLVED, and VLOP override remains service-scoped. UNRESOLVED/excluded cannot mint Article30/31/32 statutory authority;
- EvaluateArticle30PromotionReadiness, Project/RevokeArticle30PublicProfileDisclosure and guide-owned ApplyArticle30ProfileVisibility require current exact provider/service/Section4/surface-use/trader/profile-schema/public-contact-preview generations and one action-bound dependency/fallback instance. UNRESOLVED/EXCLUDED cannot mint DSA collection, and a stale/revoked projection hides only the affected EU commercial surface. ResolveDSAArticle31Applicability, CompileInterfaceCapabilityManifest, ComposeOfferInformationManifest, Assess/InvalidateOfferCompliance, Project/RevokePublicArticle31OfferDisclosure, Build/CommitRandomCheckBatch and Execute/ReconcileOfficialDatabaseCheck require current Section 4 applicability, exact offer/source/manifests/source eligibility and idempotency. `OpenArticle31TraderResponseCase`, `RequestArticle31TraderInformation`, `SaveArticle31TraderResponseDraft`, `SubmitArticle31TraderResponse`, `ExpireArticle31TraderResponseWindow`, `ResolveArticle31TraderResponseCase` and `SupersedeArticle31TraderResponseCase` require exact case/check/response generations; draft save cannot claim submission and submit returns immutable receipt. Article23 authority cannot exceed a current complete determination; adverse privacy response cannot finalize without current jurisdiction/right/remedy copy. Restriction commands enforce epoch/member/ground/notice/recipient manifests and never use events as a processing fence;
- `MarkPaymentRetryChargeStarted` принимает exact booking-attempt/economic-obligation lineage, predecessor/descendant generations, current bridge/fence/current-pointer/member hash, FinancialExecutionAuthority ID/generation and signed `ProviderOutcomeLookupManifest` ID/hash with one capability-bound member per provider operation. Its discriminated one-use decision is issued by one booking CAS immediately before the PSP boundary: a complete fresh comparable unambiguous vector yields `RETRY_CHARGE_STARTED`, while any missing/stale/incomparable/ambiguous member atomically yields `LOOKUP_SAFETY_FROZEN`, cancels only unstarted work and opens conflict. `ApplyLateCaptureSafetyCorrection` accepts strictly newer signed capture/refund-reversal evidence only after proving actual-after-no-effect/void, distinct additional capture, invalidated expected binding or refund reversal; same physical expected capture is evidence enrichment, not remediation. It atomically appends the corrected bridge, transitions the current fence or creates linked frozen fence/conflict successors after CLOSED, swaps the single lineage pointer, freezes capabilities, closes only an unstarted exact retry and writes outbox. `ReconcilePaymentGenerationConflict` may close only from authoritative per-generation provider/subledger/contract/booking/capacity/exposure dispositions; missing lookup/lineage member, started unknown outcome, residual capture or stale sequence keeps the lineage frozen and never restores pay/retry;
- complaint-service `CreateADRFinancialOperationIntent` persists only its plan/source authority/intent/outbox. Payment-service `ValidateFinancialOperationIntent` and Mint/Reserve/Start/Consume/ReconcileFinancialExecutionAuthority is the only provider-boundary authority path; source services cannot mint/mutate it or call provider;
- Approve/Supersede/RevokeNotificationDisclosureProfile, Prepare/Publish/ConfirmEffect/Correct MandatoryNotice, Dispatch/RetryChannelDelivery, ApplyProvider/DeviceEvidence and Escalate with exact source/profile/copy generations. Source owner Prepare/Consume/AbortRestrictionIntent keeps ORDINARY effect pending until publication receipt. For EMERGENCY, source Prepare creates the execution row before `AuthorizeEmergencyRestriction`; `StartEmergencyRestrictionAuthority` is the compliance linearization CAS, `CommitEmergencyRestrictionEffect` is source-local CAS over the signed Start receipt, and `ApplyEmergencyRestrictionOwnerOutcomeReceipt` projects only the matching signed started EFFECT_COMMITTED/NO_EFFECT_FINAL generation. Expire/Revoke can close only an unstarted coordinator authority and return the coordinator-owned `EmergencyUnstartedClosureReceipt`; source-owned `ApplyEmergencyRestrictionUnstartedClosureReceipt` independently CAS-closes the exact PENDING execution+intent, creates signed `EmergencySourceUnstartedClosureReceipt` with outbox and no effect/notice, then coordinator-owned `ApplyEmergencyRestrictionSourceClosureReceipt` authenticates and records that exact source acknowledgement before successor eligibility. Ack loss replays the corresponding immutable receipt. `PublishEmergencyMandatoryNotice` and `ReconcileEmergencyMandatoryNotice` require exact authority/start/tombstone/source-outcome/copy/due generations. Acceptance/device/escalation never alias;
- Compile/Review/Approve/Schedule/Activate/Supersede/RevokeLegalTemplate, Compile/ApproveUserFacingLabelRegistry and RenderLegalCopySnapshot require typed discriminator schema, locale/fallback and exact source hash. Raw enums, literal dates, unresolved fields, wrong subtype/context or unapproved fallback block activation;
- Compile/Validate/Commit/SupersedeLaunchDependencyRegistry deterministically expands exact scoped partition members/set epochs and materializes one immutable action-bound FallbackArtifact instance/receipt per member. It rejects family-only green, action/scope mismatch, reused runtime instance and a missing explicit prohibition of the consumer command. Compile/Validate/CommitStateMachineCatalog and RequirementArtifactRegistry verify exact artifact existence/digest, stage, DoD and evidence. Evaluation returns per-partition ALLOW_PROMOTION|BLOCKED_HARD|SOFT_DEGRADED and missing input never becomes predicate=false;
- Article 24 internal commands are exactly `api:dsa.CreateArticle24ReportPeriod.v1`, `api:dsa.FreezeArticle24ReportFacts.v1`, `api:dsa.ReconcileArticle24Report.v1`, `api:dsa.GenerateArticle24Report.v2`, `api:dsa.ValidateArticle24OfficialTemplate.v2`, `api:dsa.ApproveArticle24Report.v1`, `api:dsa.PublishArticle24Report.v2`, `api:dsa.OpenArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.UpdateArticle24CorrectionMetadata.v1`, `api:dsa.ReconcileArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.ValidateArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`, `api:dsa.ApproveArticle24ReportCorrection.v1` and `api:dsa.PublishArticle24ReportCorrection.v1`. Every write pins current report/predecessor/source/template/calendar versions, exact numerator/denominator/fraction-scale/rounding, If-Match, Idempotency-Key, maker/checker and complete expected/observed or diff manifest; no command can write an Article 20/21 owner aggregate;
- Article 42 internal commands are exactly the APIs in `contract:DSA-ART42-REPORT-01:v2`. Applicability consumes but cannot mint the formal Commission designation. Template commands pin exact service, obligation trigger/ID/due, transition rule, separate HR/accuracy language manifests, MAU/source/template generations; correction commands pin immutable predecessor and complete diff. Audit commands pin the audit-receipt timestamp, exact member/recipient manifests, unredacted authority bundle, closed field-level redaction decisions and public deadline. A command in one branch cannot advance or produce a receipt for the other, and all retries resolve by immutable idempotency outcome rather than duplicate publication/transmission;
- SubmitDSAStatementOfReasons и ReconcileDSAReceipts, только при применимости DSA;

Все internal API требуют S2S auth, audience/role checks, timeout и trace context.

- privacy.consent_withdrawal_authority_verified;
- privacy.consent_withdrawn;
- booking.remediation_requested;

Envelope содержит event_id, aggregate_id, aggregate_version, occurred_at, schema_version, correlation_id и causation_id. ADR execution events дополнительно несут current order/authority epochs; execution-obligation/manifest/slot/AttemptEffectPlan; attempt/result/discovery/task+active-binding-set; observation/source/group/lineage/net-contribution; assessment/contribution-allocation/deficit/incident; identity/validity/cross-referral claim disposition/global-reassessment; exposure/plan-attribution refs; stop evidence; complaint-resolution/case/item generations и общий `projection_set_version`. Для projection streams обязательны projection kind, projection_stream_id/version, `projection_set_version/as_of`, input-generation checksum и final `ADRExecutionProjectionSetManifest` payload: exactly three `(kind, member_version, content_hash)`, member_count=3, input-generation-set hash, prior/current set pointer и committed_at. Consumer буферизует/reorder-ит member events до matching commit manifest; missing/duplicate/hash-skew timeout запускает resync и не публикует partial set. Доставка at-least-once; consumers идемпотентны; poison messages уходят в DLQ.

`remuneration_profile.changed` is an output-only compatibility projection; the five preceding `remuneration_profile.*` topics remain the authoritative lifecycle events.

Privacy-owned `privacy.sensitive_ingress_disposal_authority_changed.v3`, `privacy.sensitive_ingress_triage_authority_changed.v1`, `privacy.sensitive_ingress_revocation_coordinator_changed.v1` and `privacy.sensitive_ingress_legal_hold_changed.v2` carry only opaque scope/item, authority/condition-policy hashes, lifecycle/effective/expiry epochs and signed receipt refs; they never prescribe or claim file state. File-manager-owned `file.sensitive_ingress_admission_fence_changed.v1`, `file.sensitive_ingress_byte_lease_changed.v1`, `file.sensitive_ingress_hold_fence_changed.v1`, `file.sensitive_ingress_disposition_changed.v2` and `file.sensitive_ingress_deletion_receipt_recorded.v1` carry only opaque channel/file/fence/lease/disposition generation, applied authority/hold receipt refs, deadline class, shared tombstone pointer, expected/observed object-key receipt counts/hashes and safe user projection—never filename, category detail, diagnosis/offence hint, correlatable content/checksum, object URL or raw basis/hold narrative. PREPARED/FILE_FENCED/ACTIVE/HELD and deletion-won are distinct receipts; no event makes the other service's state true. `privacy.coppa_age_verification_statement_reliance_changed.v1` carries only opaque operator/service/audience/method/vendor and condition-manifest generation hashes, lifecycle/statement-status epoch and expected/observed deletion-receipt counts; it contains no age result, child/parent identifier, raw notice response, biometric/document signal or vendor payload and never authorises from an event. `organization.representative_*` events contain opaque organization/person-binding/membership/role-scope/authority generations, pre-approved delta hash and outcome, never token/contact/ID evidence or recovery claims; consumers still re-authorize synchronously against organization-service. `booking.payment_retry_fence_changed.v1`, `booking.late_capture_safety_correction_applied.v1` and `booking.payment_generation_conflict_changed.v1` carry opaque lineage/payment/fence/conflict prior+current generations, successor reason, capability/lookup-manifest refs, expected/observed member count/hash, fence/conflict disposition and safe amount/currency reference, never card/bank credentials or raw PSP payload. `mandatory_notice.emergency_unstarted_closed.v1` is an Ops reconciliation fact carrying opaque coordinator/source receipt refs, exact owner generations, acknowledgement state and manifest hash; it cannot materialize a user notice/rights case and contains no adverse reason/copy payload.

Processing-restriction/Article23/remedy events carry only opaque determination/restriction/scope/member refs, source/copy generations, monotonic epochs, state/reason codes and expected/observed counts/hashes; no subject, dataset content, legal narrative, authority contact or raw exception evidence. They trigger reconciliation/invalidation but never authorize/deny processing—the owner-local epoch/current-generation CAS does. Article 13/20/21/24/30/42 events carry only opaque provider/service/guide/surface/market/applicability/readiness/decision/route/body-certification/publication/cost/report/audit generations, state/reason codes and manifest hashes. Article 13 privacy-purpose/notice events contain no contact values; public representative contact, complaint/ODS/cost details and Article 24/42 public reports are fetched through their exact closed APIs. Article 21 cost events contain no bank/card data or raw expense attachment. Article 24 source/report events contain canonical dispute IDs/hashes only—never user complaint text or PII. Article 42 events never contain unredacted audit content, redaction-rationale narrative, moderator identity/HR/qualification records, authority delivery URL/key or recipient contact; they expose only opaque member/delivery/redaction-decision refs, digests and status. Private trader fields never enter events. Precheck evaluation events contain only approved coarse dimensions, time basis/date bucket/legal timezone, material-fact dispositions, branch context hashes and policy/notice versions. Export events contain only a fresh randomized envelope/import generation and terminal code and have no source-evaluation or server-receipt reference; handoff/pairing events contain only opaque generation/transport mode/confirmation/terminal code. None includes age response, IP/device/cookie, export/handoff token, raw route/site/date payload, contact or free text; local-only under-13 produces no event.

`ExecutionControlEventManifest:v1` — immutable exact topic list общего, не ADR-специфичного stream единственного exposure owner для cancellation/refund, complaint remedy, goodwill, dispute, tax и ADR effects. Он несёт operation plan/hash, action_class/direction, typed measure/dimension/cap scope, ledger epoch/token, reservation/current bucket, external-unreserved/freeze/reconciliation disposition и current `PlanExposureAttributionGeneration`, но не consumer PII. Legacy `consumer_complaint.adr_in_flight_effect_exposure_changed` допускается только как временный compatibility mirror и никогда не является command/finality source.

Global reassessment event envelope является discriminated по `member_kind`. Для `REFERRAL` он несёт pinned referral watermark и receipt. Для `EXECUTION_CONTROL_SCOPE` обязательны scope ID, ledger epoch/version, complete bucket/current-reservation hashes, external-unreserved fact set/watermark, PlanExposureAttribution generation/hash, freeze/reconciliation generation, prepared-token hash/status/expiry и before/after commit receipt. PREPARED/INVALIDATED/COMMITTED — разные append-only events; invalidation содержит superseded token/generation и cause. Lost/reordered event не заменяет synchronous compare-and-fence: consumer требует complete generation manifest и resync-ит scope snapshot, а stale committed receipt не проходит convergence barrier.

Guide-compliance event envelope для credential/organization/affiliation/invitation/responsibility/presence-allocation/permit/usage/insurance/cross-border/legal-capacity/evidence-binding имеет discriminator aggregate/declaration kind, stable ID, prior/current revision/generation, opaque subject/owner, lifecycle state, exact scope/claim/evidence-set hash, attestation/holder-binding/assignment/acceptance/presence/usage/assertion generation, effective/expiry/revoked_at, monotonic revocation/policy/source epoch, affected-resource hint и safe reason/correlation — без document number, DOB, nationality, contact, route free text или raw PII. Permit events additionally carry quota-authority mode/source generation, external reservation/reference hash, remaining-capacity proof hash/freshness and reconciliation disposition; GuidePresence events carry privacy-minimized interval/buffer/exclusivity/current epoch, never another customer identity. Producer assigns contiguous projection stream generation; consumer detects gap, blocks dependent ALLOW, fetches authoritative minimized snapshot and resumes. Critical revoke/expiry emits affected-resource impact request and must reach public resource/booking/remediation owners within SLO; event alone never authorizes action.

Respondent events содержат только referral/respondent-scoped IDs, submission/request revision, state, material-disclosure/redaction snapshot hash, receipt/deadline-treatment/rule versions и owner/due/next/absolute due без raw claimant text, protected evidence или attachment content; authorised API получает separately access-controlled redacted substantive snapshot, а event не становится каналом его утечки. Complaint-finality reopen event содержит causal prior/current `ComplaintResolutionStateGeneration`, obligation/assessment/projection-set refs, original receipt и corrected-notice ref; он не применяется к withdrawal/decline/unrelated closure reason.

Consent events дополнительно несут controller_legal_entity_id, purpose, target grant reference и monotonic consent_epoch без raw notice/free text; consumer не применяет event другого controller/purpose. Withdrawal-authority verification event не несёт contact/transaction proof, не активирует processing и пригоден только для security/audit reconciliation; само подавление начинается исключительно с `privacy.consent_withdrawn`. Merchant readiness events несут только scope/lane/status/assertion refs без raw TIN/document payload.

Assistance-recovery events contain only opaque owner-local refs, lifecycle/reason class and case/authority generation; selector/contact, verification claims, exchange secret, token/jti, recipient and deadline never enter events/logs/analytics. Offline assistance events keep `local_recorded_at` and `server_received_at` separate and cannot authorize start; notification events distinguish durable publication, provider acceptance, device evidence and escalation and contain only approved external payload hashes.

ADR external events дополнительно несут body/route, party, ADRWithdrawalRule/ADRDeadlineAssessment/source versions, external sequence/reference, platform-received/dispatched/issued/body-received/acknowledged/legal-effective timestamps, receipt/effect/tolling classes, external-order resolution/input-watermark versions и evidence hash. Platform arrival time не подменяет legal effective time; outcome и withdrawal получают разные deduplication keys и сохраняются оба даже при terminal race. Reclassification event содержит supersedes_version, new remedy-authority/remediation epochs, stop manifest id/version/expected count и reconciliation reason; authority revocations, immutable manifest/entry requests, case supersession/successor creation, primary reopening и notice фиксируются одной authoritative complaint transaction/outbox boundary.

ADR remedy/remediation events несут только privacy-minimized IDs/hashes и typed generations: authority; ExecutionObligation/subtype/manifest/slot/AttemptEffectPlan; attempt/result/discovery/observation/source/group/lineage/LineageNetContribution; FulfilmentAssessment/ObligationContributionAllocation/ExpectedEffectDeficit/EffectExecutionIncident; identity/validity/allocation/global-reassessment/exposure; lookup task+binding set; case/item; stop manifest/request/evidence; InterveningOrderAssessment/skip-edge; owner/action/order/epoch/watermark и projection-set refs — без raw complaint/evidence PII. Command consumers сверяют synchronous current order/epoch/plan/assessment/target/exposure/global-convergence fences; event никогда не заменяет Reserve/Mark CAS и не является authority.

Projector enforces one AttemptKey→attempt; discriminated stable lookup uniqueness `ATTEMPT(effect_attempt_id)` либо `STOP_REQUEST(stop_request_id,planned_operation_key)`; required-source finality; exact base-obligation/subtype/slot FK; same alias+same facts→one global source instance; changed-fact replay→conflict; distinct refs→distinct instances; current MERGE/SPLIT/REASSIGN and net-contribution generations; conserved group/allocation/slot/plan-exposure attribution; ROOT versus REMEDIATION lineage rules; global cap и one current skip-edge/item/claim-disposition per referral+canonical lineage. Reassessment event всегда несёт cause kind/id/version, complete immutable member manifest/hash и per-referral input watermark; new evidence/member during PREPARING/FENCING/COMMITTING supersede-ит/restart-ит generation. Non-order canonicalization/validity/incident/allocation change идёт через GlobalEffectReassessmentGeneration, bump-ит affected epochs и создаёт cause-bound stop manifests. Receipt projector меняет только matching request/task generation; factual FOUND materializes current-valid groups независимо от referral allocation, а items/contributions — только по current claim; `NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED` требует signed disposition, false-positive retraction действует лишь по terminal validity resolution, chronology immutable.

Три projections строятся независимо, затем коммитятся одной `projection_set_version`: RevokedAuthorityCheck квантифицирует только current/carry-forward revoked closure set; FoundEffectRemediation строится из allocated current-valid lineages, active purpose bindings, incidents/items/current claim dispositions; RemedyFulfilment — из current OUTCOME_REMEDY obligation, current assessment, qualifying signed net contributions и obligation-slot deficits. Ни один приоритет между осями не допускается: например `CHECKING + RESOLVED + PARTIAL` и `EFFECT_FOUND(pending_count>0) + REMEDIATION_OPEN + FULFILLED` валидны. Внутри fulfilment-оси valid committed PENDING_INPUTS нормально публикует ASSESSMENT_PENDING с owner/ETA, имеет precedence над NONE/PARTIAL/FULFILLED и не публикует deficit authority/CTA. Только missing/corrupt generation, checksum/invariant violation, mixed incompatible input/projection set, conservation/cap breach либо projector gap дают `temporarily_unavailable/resync`; они не маскируются под business ASSESSMENT_PENDING и никогда не выглядят ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT/RESOLVED/FULFILLED. `deprecated_compat` вычисляется после authoritative committed set и не участвует в commands/finality.

### 9.4 Booking/payment state machine

BookingAttempt, PaymentAttemptOutcomeBridge, PaymentOperation, Booking, RemediationApplication and Refund/Compensation are separate owner aggregates with closed catalogs.

Before any transition that accepts a hold, starts an external payment effect, commits a contract or confirms a booking, booking-service resolves the complete sale-admission scope-key set and locks `SaleAdmissionFenceCurrent` rows in canonical order. The same transaction checks `state=OPEN` and pins every epoch into the attempt/contract receipt. `FENCED` maps the not-yet-committed attempt to `ACTION_REQUIRED` with reason `SALES_PAUSED`, releases capacity and records a typed attempt disposition; it never maps to a denial against the guide and never cancels a pre-cutoff committed booking. `event:booking.sale_admission_fence_changed.v1` is only a projection wake-up: no booking command trusts event arrival/absence instead of the synchronous row lock.

    BookingAttempt:
      CREATED → ELIGIBILITY_CHECKING | CANCELLED
      ELIGIBILITY_CHECKING → ELIGIBLE | ACTION_REQUIRED | REVIEW_REQUIRED
        | TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE | DENIED | CONTEXT_STALE | CANCELLED
      ELIGIBLE → CAPACITY_HELD | CONTEXT_STALE | CANCELLED
      CAPACITY_HELD → PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED | PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_PENDING
        | HOLD_EXPIRED | CONTEXT_STALE | CANCELLED
      PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_PENDING → PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED
        | PAYMENT_OUTCOME_RECONCILING
      PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED → FINAL_AUTHORIZATION_RESERVING
        | PAYMENT_OUTCOME_RECONCILING
      PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED → FINAL_AUTHORIZATION_RESERVING
        | CONTEXT_STALE | HOLD_EXPIRED | CANCELLED
      PAYMENT_OUTCOME_RECONCILING → PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED | ACTION_REQUIRED
        | REVIEW_REQUIRED | TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE | DENIED
        | CONTEXT_STALE | HOLD_EXPIRED | CANCELLED
      FINAL_AUTHORIZATION_RESERVING → BOOKING_COMMITTING | ACTION_REQUIRED
        | REVIEW_REQUIRED | TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE | DENIED
        | PAYMENT_OUTCOME_RECONCILING | CONTEXT_STALE
        | HOLD_EXPIRED | CANCELLED
      BOOKING_COMMITTING → BOOKING_COMMITTED | COMMIT_RECONCILING
      COMMIT_RECONCILING → BOOKING_COMMITTED | COMMIT_PROVEN_NO_EFFECT
      ACTION_REQUIRED | REVIEW_REQUIRED | TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE
        | CONTEXT_STALE | HOLD_EXPIRED → ELIGIBILITY_CHECKING | CANCELLED

`DENIED`, `CANCELLED`, `BOOKING_COMMITTED` and `COMMIT_PROVEN_NO_EFFECT` are terminal for one BookingAttempt generation; appeal or a changed request creates a linked successor and never mutates them. Resume from any recoverable side state always re-enters full ELIGIBILITY_CHECKING and cannot skip quote/remuneration/capacity/compliance recomputation. `CAPACITY_HELD → PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_PENDING` is one booking-service transaction that creates an immutable signed `PaymentOperationRequestGeneration`, pins its requested payment generation/idempotency identity, creates current `PENDING_PAYMENT_EVIDENCE` bridge and outbox. Payment-service idempotently materializes the owner-local PaymentOperation from that exact request; no client capability or PSP command is emitted before its local operation/intent commit, and no cross-DB atomicity is claimed. A paid attempt may enter ACTION_REQUIRED/REVIEW_REQUIRED/TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE/DENIED/CONTEXT_STALE/HOLD_EXPIRED/CANCELLED or create a successor only when its current signed bridge is `TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT | VOIDED`, or conditionally `REFUNDED_REMEDIATED` under the complete retry guard below; capacity release is proven and no current chargeable ContractFormationObservation/ContractObligationRecord remains. Therefore the direct FINAL_AUTHORIZATION_RESERVING side/terminal edges are guarded `PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED`-only; a paid branch uses FINAL_AUTHORIZATION_RESERVING→PAYMENT_OUTCOME_RECONCILING, obtains safe bridge closure, then advances. `PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_PENDING → PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED` and paid `PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED → FINAL_AUTHORIZATION_RESERVING` require the exact current `AUTHORIZED_CURRENT` bridge; final authorization pins it and any newer payment receipt before booking commit returns to PAYMENT_OUTCOME_RECONCILING. `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` remains there. `CAPTURED_EXPECTED` from the exact BOOKING_COMMITTED capture intent advances ordinary confirmation and never opens remediation. `CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED` forbids cancel/retry/new charge and opens contract/financial remediation with owner/deadline; `CAPTURED_REMEDIATED_CONFIRMED` remains a captured, non-retryable closed payment. Before any PaymentOperation request exists, ordinary pre-payment cancel remains allowed. REVIEW_REQUIRED resumes only from a current review outcome. Capture belongs only to PaymentOperation. `PAYMENT_NOT_REQUIRED` requires one current COMPLETE RemunerationProfile, matching expected/observed source manifest, every member PRESENT/EXPLICIT_NONE, empty canonical component set and still-current revision at final fence. Price zero, client `is_free`, missing PSP row or missing source never qualifies. Free flow never creates PaymentOperationRequest/PaymentProviderSession/PaymentOperation/FinancialExecutionAuthority/PaymentAttemptOutcomeBridge and UI says «Забронировать бесплатно»; profile drift returns to updated conditions rather than silently switching to paid.

Booking-service additionally owns one current append-only `PaymentRetrySafetyFenceGeneration` per stable booking-attempt/economic-obligation lineage. It pins every predecessor and descendant payment generation, bridge/contract/quote/hold generations, exact shared execution-exposure scope and has a closed lifecycle: `CLEAR → RETRY_PREPARED | LATE_CAPTURE_FROZEN`; `RETRY_PREPARED → RETRY_CHARGE_STARTED | LATE_CAPTURE_FROZEN | LOOKUP_SAFETY_FROZEN`; `RETRY_CHARGE_STARTED → LATE_CAPTURE_FROZEN | LOOKUP_SAFETY_FROZEN | RECONCILING`; either frozen state → `RECONCILING`; `RECONCILING → CLOSED | LATE_CAPTURE_FROZEN | LOOKUP_SAFETY_FROZEN` when newer money or lookup evidence requires a new freeze. `CLOSED` is immutable inside one generation. Materially contradictory evidence arriving after CLOSED does not mutate it: the same booking transaction appends the corrected bridge, creates a linked successor fence already in `LATE_CAPTURE_FROZEN`, creates a linked successor conflict in `OPEN | RECONCILING`, swaps the single current-lineage pointer, removes every pay/retry capability and writes outbox. If a user-created successor is already current, that generation moves `CLEAR | RETRY_PREPARED | RETRY_CHARGE_STARTED → LATE_CAPTURE_FROZEN` instead. Safety correction and creation of a user-authorised `CLEAR` successor serialize on the same expected-current-pointer CAS; whichever loses reloads current state, and replay of one correction cannot create a second successor.

A new retry generation is created only in one booking transaction that proves the permitted terminal/refunded guard, appends the descendant member, creates `PaymentRetryExecutionGeneration(PENDING)` plus PaymentOperationRequest/outbox and moves `CLEAR → RETRY_PREPARED`. Immediately before any retry FinancialExecutionAuthority can cross the PSP boundary, payment-service compiles an immutable signed `ProviderOutcomeLookupManifest` from the exact current lineage: one member for every predecessor/descendant payment/provider operation, or a signed owner proof that the member never crossed a provider boundary. Each lookup member pins payment/provider operation generations, provider account/API/operation kind, current `PaymentProviderOutcomeCapability` generation/digest, fetched_at, canonical physical-effect identity domain/value or proved absence, authoritative outcome/finality, sequence domain/value/comparator and request/response receipt hash; the manifest pins expected/observed member count and ordered hash. Webhook and lookup aliases of the same physical effect normalize only under that pinned identity scheme, while two equal-amount captures remain distinct effects.

`MarkPaymentRetryChargeStarted` accepts the complete manifest ID/hash rather than a singular predecessor identity/watermark. One booking CAS rechecks lineage/current-pointer/member hash, every bridge, capability digest, freshness, comparable sequence and unambiguous physical-effect identity. A complete safe vector moves only the exact PENDING row/fence to `RETRY_CHARGE_STARTED` and returns the signed one-use Start receipt bound into FinancialExecutionAuthority. Any missing middle member, unsupported/unavailable authoritative lookup, stale capability/fetch, regressed or incomparable sequence, ambiguous identity or changed member hash returns a typed fail-closed decision and in that same booking transaction moves the fence to `LOOKUP_SAFETY_FROZEN`, cancels only an unstarted retry execution/authority, opens or appends the current conflict and removes pay/retry. Cached projection is never substituted. Payment-service rechecks its bound capability generation before its local authority START/provider call; capability activation is generation-fenced, and drift/unavailability before START produces the same negative decision rather than a provider call. Therefore correction, lookup uncertainty and retry Start serialize in the booking DB rather than relying on an async event or cached read.

`PaymentRetryExecutionGeneration` has a closed owner-local catalog: `PENDING → CHARGE_STARTED | REVOKED_LATE_PREDECESSOR_CAPTURE | CANCELLED_BEFORE_START`; `CHARGE_STARTED → PROVIDER_OUTCOME_LINKED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`; `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → PROVIDER_OUTCOME_LINKED | MANUAL_RECOVERY`; terminal generation is immutable and points to the exact PaymentOperation/FinancialExecutionAuthority/provider identity. `PENDING`, `REVOKED_LATE_PREDECESSOR_CAPTURE` and `CANCELLED_BEFORE_START` never imply that PSP boundary was crossed; factual start/outcome comes only from payment-owner authority/provider receipts.

`PaymentGenerationConflictGeneration` moves `OPEN → RECONCILING → RESOLUTION_PREPARED → CLOSED`, with `OPEN | RECONCILING | RESOLUTION_PREPARED → MANUAL_RECOVERY → RECONCILING`; every transition pins conflict kind, expected/observed descendant and lookup-member count/hash, per-operation capability/identity/sequence proof, current bridges, subledger/contract/booking/capacity/shared-exposure dispositions, owner/next/absolute due and user-projection version. CLOSED requires one complete signed manifest proving which single payment funds the booking and that every other actual/residual effect is authoritatively voided/refunded/otherwise lawfully disposed; operator choice, timeout or absence of an event can never close it. CLOSED is immutable inside that conflict generation; later contradictory evidence appends a linked `OPEN | RECONCILING` successor in the same current-pointer transaction as the frozen fence successor.

`PaymentAttemptOutcomeBridgeGeneration` is booking-owned but can advance only from a signature-verified payment-service `PaymentOperationOutcomeReceipt` bound to tenant, booking_attempt, payment aggregate/generation, provider account, operation kind/generation, physical provider-effect identity, amount/currency/merchant, contract/quote hashes, issued/effective time, monotonically comparable provider evidence sequence and signing-key epoch. One current bridge per `(booking_attempt_id, payment_generation)` has a closed append-only catalog: `PENDING_PAYMENT_EVIDENCE → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | AUTHORIZED_CURRENT | TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT | VOIDED | CAPTURED_EXPECTED | CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED`; `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → AUTHORIZED_CURRENT | TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT | VOIDED | CAPTURED_EXPECTED | CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED`; `AUTHORIZED_CURRENT → OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | VOIDED | CAPTURED_EXPECTED | CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED`; a strictly newer authoritative actual-capture receipt/provider lookup creates the mandatory safety-correction successor `TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT | VOIDED → CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED`; from `CAPTURED_EXPECTED` it does so only when evidence proves an additional/distinct physical capture or invalidates the exact booking/capture binding, while a newer sequence describing the same already-bound physical effect is an idempotent evidence-enrichment successor with unchanged business state. `CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED → CAPTURED_REMEDIATED_CONFIRMED | REFUNDED_REMEDIATED`; a strictly newer authoritative refund reversal/return/settlement correction may append `REFUNDED_REMEDIATED → CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED` with the same lineage freeze. Same receipt replay is idempotent; changed receipt sequence creates a successor generation and never rewrites history. `TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT` accepts only payment `DECLINED | NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED`; `VOIDED` only a current authoritative VOIDED receipt, but no terminal is allowed to discard later contradictory money evidence.

`ApplyLateCaptureSafetyCorrection` first proves a material contradiction: actual capture after no-effect/void, an additional/distinct physical capture or invalidated expected-capture binding, or a refund reversal. It consumes the exact newer signed receipt and, in one booking transaction, appends `CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED`, transitions a current nonterminal fence or creates the frozen linked successor after CLOSED, creates/updates the matching current conflict generation, swaps the lineage-current pointer where needed, removes every pay/retry capability and writes outbox; a reconciler then moves the current fence to RECONCILING. If correction wins before retry Start, it CAS-closes the exact `PaymentRetryExecutionGeneration(PENDING) → REVOKED_LATE_PREDECESSOR_CAPTURE`; any unstarted FinancialExecutionAuthority is revoked by receipt and the later `MarkPaymentRetryChargeStarted` fails. If retry Start won first, the started row is never falsely revoked/no-effect: correction records `RETRY_CHARGE_STARTED`, freezes all further charges and opens same-lineage payment/execution-exposure reconciliation. A successor already authorized/captured is voided/refunded or bound to the one lawful booking only through authoritative receipts and a complete money/contract/booking/capacity disposition; a second physical capture becomes an external-unreserved/over-cap incident, not a hidden overwrite. This protocol does not claim cross-service ACID, but correction, current-pointer successor creation and retry Start are linearized in booking-service, while every provider effect remains fenced by FinancialExecutionAuthority plus the shared execution-exposure scope.

`CAPTURED_EXPECTED` requires a signed CAPTURED receipt and exact current `BookingCaptureOperationIntentGeneration` created with BOOKING_COMMITTED, matching booking/contract/payment/capture-operation generations, amount/currency/merchant/quote hashes, FinancialExecutionAuthority and no winning cancellation/supersession. Any late, post-cancel, unbound, wrong-generation/amount or contradictory capture becomes `CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED`; partial refund, refund pending/failed/unknown or incomplete ledger proof cannot close it. `CAPTURED_REMEDIATED_CONFIRMED` requires complete APPLIED remediation owner manifest proving one valid booking/contract/capacity and settled captured amount; it never permits a second charge. `REFUNDED_REMEDIATED` requires authoritative full REFUNDED receipt, zero residual captured exposure in FinancialSubledger and complete APPLIED money/contract/booking/capacity disposition; it is immutable for that payment generation but does not by itself authorize retry. A ContractFormationObservation without capture never fabricates captured state: it remains an orthogonal contract guard and blocks incompatible cancel/retry until reconciled. Missing event, HTTP timeout, UI return, hold expiry or local PaymentOperation projection never proves an outcome.

User projection for a correction from `TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT | VOIDED` is `LATE_CAPTURE_RECONCILING`; if a descendant payment was prepared/started it is `MULTI_ATTEMPT_PAYMENT_RECONCILING`. The card headline is «Обнаружена поздняя оплата — повторно платить не нужно» and the correction notice says: «Ранее мы показывали, что оплата по попытке [time] не состоялась. Платёжный провайдер позднее подтвердил списание [amount/currency]. Мы исправили статус и сверяем все попытки». For N>1 it adds: «Есть [N] попыток оплаты, но это не означает [N] списаний. Статус каждой указан ниже». Each attempt is identified only by safe time/amount/currency/masked method and maps authoritative owner facts to one approved label:

- `PENDING`, `REVOKED_LATE_PREDECESSOR_CAPTURE` or `CANCELLED_BEFORE_START` with no authority/provider-start receipt → `NOT_STARTED_NO_CHARGE`, «FlyFy не отправлял эту попытку на списание»;
- started/unknown without authoritative outcome → `OUTCOME_CHECKING`, «Проверяем результат»; authorization without capture → `AUTHORIZED_NOT_CAPTURED`, «Авторизация подтверждена; списание проверяется»;
- authoritative capture → `CAPTURE_CONFIRMED`, «Списание подтверждено»; `VOID_PENDING` → «Отменяем авторизацию»; authoritative `VOIDED` → `VOIDED_NO_CHARGE`, «Отмена авторизации подтверждена»;
- refund pending/partial/failed/unknown separately shows the exact confirmed returned amount, residual amount and next state; only the complete full-refund/subledger manifest renders «Возврат подтверждён» with amount, rail-safe reference, effective time and receipt.

“Списания не было”, “отменено” and “возвращено” are impossible without their exact authoritative receipt/absence proof. The timeline shows booking status, owner, last authoritative sync, next update, absolute due and support, and exposes no pay/retry CTA until the complete lineage conflict is closed. Offline/stale view is read-only and never queues a payment command; old clients receive the same server-rendered timeline. Every attempt is a named semantic group, a correction is announced once without focus steal, and terminal copy appears only after the exact descendant/remediation manifest proves which single payment funds the booking and that every excess capture is fully disposed.

If the PSP cannot provide the required fresh predecessor lookup, retry is not exposed: projection is `PAYMENT_RETRY_SAFETY_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE`, copy says that FlyFy is checking the previous payment and that no second payment is needed yet, and shows owner/last check/next update/absolute due/support. It is not rendered as card failure, user fault or definitive charge; support cannot override the fence, while an alternative booking/payment method is offered only after authoritative disposition proves it cannot duplicate the same obligation.

    PaymentOperation:
      NOT_STARTED → AUTHORIZATION_PENDING
      AUTHORIZATION_PENDING → AUTHORIZED | DECLINED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
      AUTHORIZED → CAPTURE_PENDING | VOID_PENDING
      CAPTURE_PENDING → CAPTURED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
      VOID_PENDING → VOIDED | VOID_FAILED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
      CAPTURED | PARTIALLY_REFUNDED → REFUND_PENDING
      REFUND_PENDING → PARTIALLY_REFUNDED | REFUNDED | REFUND_FAILED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
      OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | VOID_FAILED | REFUND_FAILED → RECONCILING
      RECONCILING → AUTHORIZED | DECLINED | CAPTURED | VOIDED
        | PARTIALLY_REFUNDED | REFUNDED | NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED
        | MANUAL_RECONCILIATION
      OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | RECONCILING → LATE_AUTHORIZED_RECONCILING
        | LATE_CAPTURED_RECONCILING when a verified result arrives after its cutoff
      LATE_AUTHORIZED_RECONCILING → VOID_PENDING | MANUAL_RECONCILIATION
      LATE_CAPTURED_RECONCILING → REFUND_PENDING | MANUAL_RECONCILIATION

Every OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/RECONCILING generation pins operation_kind and operation_generation, so authorization, capture, void and refund evidence cannot be conflated. `NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED`, `DECLINED`, `VOIDED`, `REFUNDED` and `MANUAL_RECONCILIATION` are terminal for that operation generation; a corrected/new operation is a linked successor, never mutation.

    Booking:
      BOOKING_COMMITTED → CONFIRMATION_PENDING | CONFIRMED | CANCELLATION_PENDING
      CONFIRMATION_PENDING → CONFIRMED | CONFIRMATION_RECONCILING | CANCELLATION_PENDING
      CONFIRMATION_RECONCILING → CONFIRMED | REMEDIATION_REQUIRED | CANCELLATION_PENDING
      CONFIRMED → CANCELLATION_PENDING
      REMEDIATION_REQUIRED → REMEDIATION_APPLYING | CANCELLATION_PENDING
      REMEDIATION_APPLYING → CONFIRMED | REMEDIATION_RECONCILING
      REMEDIATION_RECONCILING → CONFIRMED | REMEDIATION_REQUIRED
        | CANCELLATION_PENDING
      CANCELLATION_PENDING → CANCELLED | CANCELLATION_RECONCILING | CONFIRMED
      CANCELLATION_RECONCILING → CANCELLED | CONFIRMED | REMEDIATION_REQUIRED

Refund/compensation never aliases Booking status. `RemediationApplicationGeneration` is booking-owned: `PREPARED → APPLYING → APPLIED | OUTCOME_UNKNOWN | FAILED`; `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN → APPLIED | FAILED`. It pins current proposal/decision/booking/contract/payment/capture-intent generations and a complete expected owner-effect manifest. `CompletePaymentRemediation` is one booking-local CAS transaction over signed payment/subledger/contract/capacity receipts: it appends the bridge resolution, RemediationApplication and resulting Booking transition together. `REMEDIATION_APPLYING | REMEDIATION_RECONCILING → CONFIRMED` and bridge `CAPTURED_REMEDIATED_CONFIRMED` require current `APPLIED`, exact expected/observed owner receipt count/hash and no unresolved money/capacity/contract effect; `REFUNDED_REMEDIATED` additionally requires full settled refund and explicit contract/booking/capacity disposition. Ack loss stays REMEDIATION_RECONCILING. Failure returns to REMEDIATION_REQUIRED or lawful cancellation, never false confirmation. Every transition has command, guard, authoritative owner, immutable receipt and explicit compensation/recovery edge. Manual reconciliation always carries stable reason_code, owner, next update and absolute due. `CANCELLED` is terminal; correction appends a successor generation rather than rewriting chronology.

Правила:

- client_request_id генерируется и durable сохраняется клиентом до create call; idempotency record уникален только по tenant + privacy-reviewed stable_account_subject_key + operation + client_request_id, а не по session/token hash;
- create transaction до любого PSP side effect атомарно сохраняет booking_attempt_id, canonical request hash/version и replayable response; повтор с тем же normalized hash возвращает исходный attempt, а тот же key с иным payload даёт 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT;
- versioned canonical serializer нормализует money/currency/timezone/defaults/ordered collections и включает stable subject, occurrence, quote/version, seats, amount/currency/tax breakdown, seller/merchant, payment-role/funds-flow/indirect-tax versions и contract snapshot hash;
- lookup по client_request_id требует того же stable subject/tenant и не раскрывает существование чужого attempt;
- occurrence, quote и merchant не входят в uniqueness key: они находятся только в canonical request hash, поэтому изменение любого из них под тем же client_request_id всегда конфликт, а не второй attempt;
- после истечения business response retention остаётся immutable minimal idempotency tombstone: subject key, operation/key, hash/hash_version, attempt/result reference и provider-operation generations без лишнего PII. Срок не короче максимального PSP retry, refund/chargeback/dispute и legally approved replay horizon; serializer migration сохраняет backward comparison, а не переинтерпретирует старый payload;
- PSP intent имеет отдельный unique invariant booking_attempt_id + payment_generation. Новая generation создаётся только после current signed `TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT | VOIDED`, либо after `REFUNDED_REMEDIATED` when a current remedy/cancellation decision explicitly sets `retry_disposition=ALLOWED`, full refund/subledger/contract/capacity owner manifest is complete, prior chargeable obligation is extinguished or separately non-chargeable, a new hold/quote plus full eligibility/compliance recomputation succeeds and the user gives new explicit confirmation. Provider refund alone, network retry or old-generation receipt never unlocks payment;
- каждый provider operation уникален по provider_account + payment_aggregate + payment_generation + operation_kind + operation_generation; partial refund дополнительно имеет стабильный refund_id/refund_generation. Все retry сохраняют исходный provider idempotency key;
- internal Payment aggregate является источником operational state после cryptographically verified webhook или authoritative provider lookup, а FinancialSubledger — источником истины для денег/liabilities/balances;
- каждая команда и webhook идемпотентны;
- seat hold имеет TTL, monotonically increasing fencing token и conditional conversion; expired/older token не может commit capacity;
- compliance authorization audience-bound к booking command;
- manual capture используется там, где это поддерживается и улучшает компенсацию; иначе payment authorization отменяется/возвращается по provider rules;
- при сбое после payment authorization выполняется подтверждение или compensation;
- refund state не выводится только из клиентского ответа;
- consumer contract snapshot сохраняет seller, disclosures, price и policies на момент покупки;
- payment intent immutable-bound к booking_attempt_id, booking/version, hold/fencing token, quote, amount, currency, seller/merchant и contract snapshot hash;
- webhook проверяется по raw body signature, provider timestamp window, expected account/merchant и event-id deduplication;
- out-of-order/late events проходят monotonic payment state machine и не откатывают terminal state;
- provider API reconciliation периодически подтверждает unresolved/financial states;
- BOOKING_COMMITTED фиксируется одной booking-service транзакцией: fencing token атомарно конвертирует место, сохраняются immutable contract/price/tax/disclosure snapshots, approved contract-formation trigger, contract_formed_at при наступлении trigger, technical commitment timestamp и BOOKING_COMMITTED outbox event;
- BOOKING_COMMITTED является durable техническим обязательством FlyFy исполнить либо применить прозрачную compensation; является ли именно оно юридическим моментом заключения договора, определяет approved Market Operating Model. Любой иной trigger — offer acceptance, PSP authorization, capture или final confirmation — явно моделируется, сохраняется и согласуется с пользовательскими terms/copy;
- если approved legal contract trigger наступает раньше BOOKING_COMMITTED внутри booking context, booking-service сохраняет immutable ContractObligationRecord в той же транзакции. Если trigger — PSP authorization/capture, payment-service сначала атомарно сохраняет verified ContractFormationObservation/ProviderOperationReceipt и outbox, а booking-service идемпотентно materializes ContractObligationRecord с исходным effective timestamp; до receipt действует reconciliation bridge и строго ограниченная observation-based service authority. Trigger не может существовать лишь в UI copy, PSP metadata или недоставленном transient event;
- immutable `BookingCaptureOperationIntentGeneration` and durable capture command are created in the same transaction as BOOKING_COMMITTED, with exact booking/contract/payment/amount/currency/merchant/quote/authority bindings; their matching CAPTURED receipt classifies as `CAPTURED_EXPECTED` and continues ordinary confirmation. Capture failure does not delete booking silently, while any unbound/late/contradictory capture starts the contract/financial remediation flow and controlled capacity handling;
- если external capture прошёл, а локальный final transition не завершился, failure state и durable void/refund command фиксируются через transactional outbox и reconciliation;
