- France L221-1 `UNCERTAIN` announces the exact scope and plain-language reason before status, then asks only the minimal factual operator/activity/exception question; it never shows legal-article jargon, upload UI, warning color or blocked/error semantics as a substitute for missing facts;
- public disclosure announces `basis_class`/reason before status. `VOLUNTARY_PROFESSIONAL_CREDENTIAL` uses neutral semantics with no warning/error icon or adverse CTA; composite law/venue/platform reasons remain separately navigable and long localized copy reflows;
- regional recovery presents profile/action availability, last authoritative sync, typed receipt_class/effect, absolute time/timezone, owner and next update. Old clients never collapse emergency intake, domain commit and external-recipient confirmation into one «получено»;
- receipt-trust `TRUST_UNRESOLVED`, `CORRECTED` and `MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED` preserve original request/deadline/status lookup, announce that repeat effect is disabled and do not steal focus; correction history is reachable without relying on color;
- web handoff announces broker unavailable/forward unknown separately from account claim outcome, retains the local result and exposes retry/no-account/native-cross-device actions in logical focus order; no crypto implementation detail is used as user-facing blame;
- corrected ADR tracker and notice publication are separate semantic regions: current tracker is immediate, while PREPARED/DISPATCHED/RECONCILING read as `PUBLICATION_PENDING` with age/next update and only exact receipt reads `PUBLISHED`;
- Article 42 «Первый отчёт», «Полугодовой отчёт» and «Публикация аудита» are separate headings/regions; HR and accuracy manifests have independent expected/observed completeness labels, and an aggregate green is not announced when either section is incomplete. HTML says the localized percentage while the Article 24 CSV download retains exact decimal fraction;
- all new states are covered at native 200%, web 320 CSS px/400% zoom, keyboard/switch, VoiceOver/TalkBack, RTL/BiDi, long locale, absolute dates/timezones, slow network, old client and no-focus-steal on background correction.

Offline draft contract:

- per-account local database шифруется ключом из platform secure storage и исключается из cloud/device backup;
- raw identity, biometric и evidence payload никогда не входят в offline draft store или generic operation queue;
- draft имеет local_revision, server_revision и stable operation IDs;
- operation queue идемпотентна и показывает PENDING, SYNCING, SYNCED, CONFLICT или FAILED;
- сервер применяет If-Match/CAS; concurrent-device conflict не разрешается silent last-write-wins;
- пользователь видит diff для конфликтующих редактируемых полей и выбирает merge/local/server copy;
- logout/account switch очищает account-bound local keys/cache после предупреждения о несинхронизированных изменениях, но не удаляет отдельно namespaced anonymous precheck result/session; его удаляет только явный `LOGOUT_AND_WIPE_ANONYMOUS_RESULT` после impact preview, подтверждения и разрешения claim/revoke race;
- account deletion немедленно блокирует sync и запускает локальный wipe плюс server deletion workflow;
- disk pressure, app kill и OS eviction не оставляют plaintext temp files;
- deletion/tombstone синхронизируется и не позволяет старой offline операции воскресить удалённый draft.

Минимальная device-матрица:

- Android 10/API 29, 4 GB RAM baseline;
- compact/normal/large Android разных производителей;
- iPhone 11 и актуальный большой iPhone;
- text scale 200%;
- web/server fallback at 320 CSS px and equivalent 400% zoom, tested separately from native text scale;
- keyboard open;
- EN/RU/KK и launch-market locales;
- RTL;
- VoiceOver/TalkBack;
- poor network и offline draft.
- Huawei/Honor device without GMS: HMS-capable/no-push durable-inbox fallback and map-free ordered-route flow.

Launch accessibility inventory исчерпывающе перечисляет каждую доступную в scope комбинацию screen × state × locale × input mode. Минимально в него входят pre-check, account, все identity states/fallbacks, workspace/draft/route, checklist/map-list alternative, credential wallet/upload, merchant-tax purpose lanes/correction/dispute, review/appeal/restoration, public profile/publish, tourist listing/checkout/cancellation/remediation-decision/complaint-resolution/ADR-referral-withdrawal/outcome/execution, non-ADR pending/external-reconciling/safety-frozen effect, guide/respondent ADR submission per-file scan/quarantine, external delivery/direct-body receipt, disclosure/deadline-treatment/decision-exit-challenge/execution, DSA public notice, SCA/payment/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, refund, payout-account attempt/recovery, manual/scheduled payout restriction/return/reversal, privacy request/risk-based verification/export/consent grant/authenticated-and-accountless withdrawal и support. ADR matrix покрывает cross-product трёх projections, общий set version, partial/carry-forward stop entries, found+pending, wrong-only, full+extra, ASSESSMENT_PENDING, current PARTIAL+unknown, superseded/current obligations, successor unmet_since plus BLOCKED_IN_FLIGHT_UNKNOWN/ELIGIBLE/PROVISIONAL_ONLY, slot/deficit progress, NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED and `ALLOCATION_REVIEW_PENDING/CLAIM_ALLOCATION_APPEALED` with receipt/owner/dates/no-final-close announcement, 0/1/N operations, identity/validity/incident/global/external-unreserved/exposure-frozen states, per-disposition mixed outcomes, complaint-finality corrected/reopened durable notices и late-discovery history. Три projection summaries, per-owner list и obligation slots — отдельные named semantic regions; screen reader получает atomic changed-set summary, затем «n из m», progress либо pending reason, oldest/next update без focus steal. Expand/history/receipt actions доступны keyboard/switch, chronology/amount/date — RTL/BiDi-safe, а status не кодируется только цветом/иконкой. Внутренний inventory отдельно включает reviewer queues/assignment/lease, respondent scan/delivery/disclosure/deadline queues, evidence comparison, registry ambiguity, policy diff/simulation, maker/checker, Customer Ops obligations/plans/results/tasks+bindings/contributions/assessments/deficits/claim-dispositions/incidents/execution-control/global reconciliation/three projections/guarded actions и Privacy Ops screens. Для каждого покрываются loading, empty, error, disabled, NEEDS_INFO, timeout/session-expiry/lock-conflict/offline, corrected/reopened и success states. Release gate требует ноль unresolved WCAG 2.2 A/AA failures во всём launch inventory, а не только в happy path.

Дополнительно inventory обязан явно содержать AssistedDeadline recovery `intake→verification→exchange→expiry|renew|revoke→exact-case resume`, offline device `NOT_SENT_OFFLINE|LOCAL_ONLY|CONTACT_REQUESTED` versus server `RECEIVED|ASSISTING|RESTORING|REPLACEMENT|REMEDY|UNRESOLVED|CLOSED`, notification publication/provider/device/read/escalation chronology, ManualReview stale-lease/conflict/per-task restoration и all parameterized legal-copy fallbacks. Эти состояния тестируются без обязательной биометрии, с keyboard/switch и 200% text; ни локальная запись, ни provider acceptance, ни escalation не озвучиваются screen reader как delivery.

## 15. Миграция текущих данных

### 15.1 Принцип

Legacy approval не доказывает современный assurance, scope или validity.

### 15.1.1 Universal account, workspace и persona isolation

Migration programme `mig:GUIDE-UNIVERSAL-ACCOUNT-01`, `mig:GUIDE-WORKSPACE-ENABLEMENT-01`, `mig:GUIDE-POST-AUTH-INTENT-01` и `mig:GUIDE-PERSONA-ISOLATION-01` выполняется additive/shadow-first и инвентаризирует:

- все `account_type`, `TOURIST|GUIDE` flags, JWT/gateway roles, global `guide_status/guide_approved`, guide-only signup endpoints и mobile routing assumptions;
- legacy applications, profiles, drafts, public excursions, future/existing bookings, reviews, chats, saved items, notification/privacy settings, disputes, appeals, balances/payouts и retention/legal holds;
- возможные отдельные tourist/guide accounts одного человека, но только как duplicate signals, не как доказательство identity;
- все consumers старых `guide.approved/rejected/disabled` events и blanket restrictions, способные скрывать tourist UI или разрешать public action.

Целевая migration semantics:

1. Каждый допустимый existing account становится universal `UserAccount`; legacy account type/role сохраняется только в history/compatibility record и не участвует в authorization.
2. Consumer capabilities включаются по общей account policy независимо от guide application history. Legacy guide denial/archive не блокирует tourist browse/book/chat/review/saved/payment.
3. Workspace backfill выполняется только при доказанном professional intent — application, guide profile/draft, published excursion, organization invitation/membership in guide capacity — и создаёт один idempotent current workspace. Остальным аккаунтам workspace не создаётся.
4. Legacy `APPROVED/REJECTED/PENDING` остаётся immutable policy history. Оно не превращается в OPEN/CLOSED, qualification, restriction или ranking signal.
5. Existing separate accounts никогда не auto-merge по email, имени, телефону, document HMAC или behavioral match. `CanonicalPersonBindingMigrationRecord` и explicit recovery/merge flow требуют strong proof, сохраняют отдельную financial/booking/review/appeal chronology и дают split/correction/appeal.
6. Guide-only legacy restrictions классифицируются: доказанный exact guide effect → scoped RestrictionDecision; доказанный account-security effect → отдельный AccountAccessEffect; ambiguity → manual classification без tourist spillover и без public allow.
7. Old clients получают safe compatibility projection и server-rendered/deep-link fallback. Они не могут восстановить exclusive account type, blanket certificate requirement, global guide badge или role-based public authorization.
8. Existing guide-directed acquisition links переводятся на common signup с one-use continuation. Открытый redirect, перенос intent на другой account, повторное создание workspace и потеря destination при OAuth/restart запрещены.

Cutover gate требует 100% inventory/classification, zero duplicate workspaces, zero weak-proof account merges, zero global role/status authorization, zero guide-restriction tourist spillover и green old-client corpus. Rollback переключает compatibility reader/routing only; он не возвращает separate guide signup, exclusive account type, universal certificate или старый blanket block.

### 15.2 Identity

- каждый legacy record создаёт `LegacyIdentityImportRecord` с classification `PROVEN_CURRENT_ASSURANCE | LEGACY_VERIFIED_UNMAPPED | ASSURANCE_UNKNOWN | REJECTED`, а не новый промежуточный IdentityAssertion state;
- `IdentityAssertion(source_kind=VERIFIED_LEGACY_IMPORT)` mint-ится только для `PROVEN_CURRENT_ASSURANCE` после current policy/verifier proof provider, method, exact claims и assurance;
- `LEGACY_VERIFIED_UNMAPPED` и `ASSURANCE_UNKNOWN` никогда не удовлетворяют authorization и создают purpose-scoped reverification requirement;
- raw legacy files классифицируются и получают retention owner;
- rejected users получают resubmit/appeal без нового аккаунта.

Migration ticket `mig:IDENTITY-PERSON-01` introduces `CanonicalPersonBindingMigrationRecord` and separately classifies every affected account with legacy identity/proof refs, proposed opaque person subject, proof method/version/strength, `CONFIRMED_STRONG_PROOF | PROVISIONAL_REVERIFY | CONFLICT_MANUAL | NO_BINDING`, account/person/resource effect-scope inventory/hash, duplicate-signal reference, merge/split review, affected decision manifest, owner/due/next/absolute due, checksum/idempotency and receipts. Current binding may be minted only from an authoritative provider subject, eID/cryptographic proof or approved manual proof. Account ID, normalized name, document HMAC and duplicate signal never create/merge a person; ambiguity stays PROVISIONAL and preserves private draft.

Account-scoped history is never carried. Person-scoped carry creates new scoped decision generations with maker/checker; until resolution existing facts remain account-scoped and new person-scoped capability fails closed. Former/deleted-account recovery, correction/appeal and uniform no-enumeration behavior exist before enforcement. Reader switch requires 100% classification, zero weak-proof auto-merge/unexplained effect carry and green second-account-evasion/split corpus; rollback keeps new binding generations.

### 15.3 Professional documents

- сначала inventory existing storage metadata/checksum/source/collection reason/access/hold без OCR, model extraction или нового reviewer exposure;
- затем precomputed non-content metadata inventory is routed through a current approved purpose/basis/Article 9(2)/Article 10 or non-EU-condition decision. Reading or retaining suspected sensitive content for triage requires a separate current exact legacy `SensitiveIngressTriageAuthorityGeneration`; file existence, encryption or a Privacy/Legal queue alone не являются condition;
- только proven current purpose разрешает purpose-limited extraction issuer/type/number/scope/validity, EvidenceArtifact и typed declaration creation; PersonCredential создаётся лишь при подтверждённом personal type, а known organization/affiliation/permit/insurance — в proper typed aggregate with owner/subject/scope provenance;
- unknown suspected-sensitive material may enter `LEGACY_UNCLASSIFIED_AUTHORISED_TRIAGE` only with a current exact triage authority, isolated permitted operations, named owner and non-extendable `triage_due_at = min(received_at + approved short policy TTL, authority_expiry)`; it never enters generic OCR/AI/search/reviewer/reuse or satisfies a requirement. Without current authority it becomes `LEGACY_SENSITIVE_AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`: all application/content access and related ingress are disabled, only precomputed non-content inventory reaches DPO/counsel, and an owner/decision_due_at/absolute_due_at escalation must produce a current disposal/triage/full-processing determination before any content or deletion operation;
- `NO_CURRENT_LAWFUL_PURPOSE/OVER_COLLECTED_LEGACY` can transition to deletion only through a current exact disposal authority; it never enters OCR/AI/search/fraud/ranking/reuse/generic-review. The subject receives a privacy-safe status and signed deletion/hold receipt where notification itself is lawful. A separately lawful item-scoped hold with exact category condition, owner, expiry and review may pause an already-authorised deletion; missing authority never becomes an implicit hold or an invented permission to delete;
- reuse legacy artifact для нового exact requirement возможен только через purpose-aware ProfessionalEvidenceBinding/current basis and user preview where applicable; migration не выдаёт silent cross-purpose grant;
- не выдавать universal badge;
- не переносить business/site документы в personal credential.

### 15.4 Profiles и excursions

- CREATE_DRAFT сохраняется;
- публичные capabilities пересчитываются по market/action;
- сначала shadow evaluation;
- impact matrix строится по jurisdiction × action × booking state;
- legally critical public offer может быть gated на cutover даже для legacy;
- существующие bookings переходят в remediation, не в silent cancellation;
- rollback не может повторно открыть юридически запрещённое действие.

Migration ticket `mig:GUIDE-REMUN-01`: legacy `is_free`, zero price or missing payment row never becomes `EXPLICIT_NONE`. Migration inventories price, tips, donations, sponsorship, commissions, bundles, barter and credits, builds a checksummed expected-source manifest for every public/future-booked resource and marks any missing/gapped member `INCOMPLETE`. Shadow compare explains every old/new paid-free difference; cutover requires 100% classification and zero false gratuitous. Rollback preserves the new RemunerationProfile writer and switches only the read projection.

Coordinated migration tickets `mig:GUIDE-RESP-01` and `mig:GUIDE-PRESENCE-01` build one immutable `LegacyResponsibilityPresenceMigrationRecord` per public/future-booked excursion/occurrence/booking-group assignment, but retain separate requirement edges, dry-run manifests, signed evidence and rollback gates: responsibility owns exact requirement/path/legacy guide/co-guide/organization/site owner, authority proof, acceptance classification and notices; presence owns segment/time, legal timezone/interval/buffer/exclusivity sources, presence result and conflict/remediation case. Shared checksum/idempotency binds the same source snapshot, while one ticket can never green the other. A legacy assignment is not owner acceptance: only a provable current signed receipt imports as accepted; otherwise it becomes `AWAITING_OWNER_ACCEPTANCE` with scanner-safe reconfirmation. FLYFY requires a policy obligation and SITE_OPERATOR is unavailable without approved integration or pre-existing signed receipt.

Presence generations are materialized only from authoritative current schedule timestamps. Overlap has no automatic winner: both affected facts enter `CONFLICT_MANUAL`, retain blocked intervals and create booking remediation with an owner. No current evaluation is satisfied without current acceptance and presence receipts. Reader switch requires 100% assignment classification, zero unexplained overlap/orphan allocation/stale acceptance and a single schedule writer; rollback cannot reinstate legacy implicit acceptance.

Migration ticket `mig:GUIDE-ORG-01` inventories every legacy organization actor, invite, session role, declaration signer and recent privileged action into a separate `LegacyOrganizationRepresentativeMigrationRecord`; it never extends `OrganizationRepresentativeMembershipGeneration` states. Migration record lifecycle is `DISCOVERED → VERIFICATION_PENDING | CONFLICT_MANUAL | REVOKED_LEGACY`; `VERIFICATION_PENDING → MEMBERSHIP_MATERIALIZED | CONFLICT_MANUAL | REVOKED_LEGACY`; `CONFLICT_MANUAL → VERIFICATION_PENDING | REVOKED_LEGACY`. `MEMBERSHIP_MATERIALIZED | REVOKED_LEGACY` are terminal; new evidence creates a successor record. Only `MEMBERSHIP_MATERIALIZED` may reference a valid membership, and only after current strong person binding plus official-registry/approved authority proof; unresolved records have owner/due/next/absolute due and grant no command authority. Email domain, contact ownership, guide affiliation, historical submitter or token role never auto-mints membership. At least one verified owner/admin must accept through the self-bound invite flow before organization writes cut over; otherwise declarations stay readable/private and organization mutations pause without blocking the guide's individual/other-organization path. Dry-run proves zero unknown membership state, last-admin guard, self-escalation/IDOR denial, maker/checker/step-up coverage, notices and complete privileged-action attribution. Rollback preserves the new roster/deny decisions and cannot restore token-only authority.

`LegacyGuideApplicationMigration` отдельно обрабатывает всех guides/applications со старым universal-certificate reason. Dry-run cohort report группирует `PENDING | BLOCKED | REJECTED` по reason/version/market, identity/evidence state, public resources/bookings и прогнозируемому current outcome. Старое `MISSING_UNIVERSAL_GUIDE_CERTIFICATE` не является fraud, adverse trust fact, RestrictionDecision либо основанием ухудшить ranking; original decision/history/appeal сохраняются как superseded policy record.

Этот backfill использует universal-account mapping §15.1.1: отсутствие universal certificate никогда не закрывает GuideWorkspace и не влияет на consumer capability. Public guide profile, excursion publish, booking/payment/payout/start переоцениваются независимо по exact action/scope; private drafts и tourist data сохраняются.

Governance backfill никогда не выводит favourable conclusion из отсутствующих legacy facts. Для каждого exact scope defaults are: EqualTreatment=`UNRESOLVED` (restrictive legacy rule cannot activate); MinorProtection/COPPA=`UNSUPPORTED_FOR_CHILD_ACCOUNT_OR_PUBLIC_GUIDE` until current approved route; COPPA age-verification-statement reliance=`NOT_APPROVED_NO_LEGACY_INFERENCE`, regardless of an existing age field/SDK/vendor; BackgroundScreening=`DISABLED_UNASSESSED`; BiometricProcessing=`CAPTURE_PROHIBITED_UNTIL_APPROVED`; SpecialCategoryProcessing=`LEGACY_SENSITIVE_AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED` (либо отдельно доказанный `AUTHORISED_DISPOSAL_ACTIVE | AUTHORISED_TRIAGE_ACTIVE`, но никогда implicit quarantine/deletion permission); CapacityLaw=`UNKNOWN`; ExistingFunds=`MANUAL_DISPOSITION_REQUIRED` preserving full payable amount/currency/ledger provenance and absolute due. Public disclosure remains absent until a fresh allowlisted projection is built. Reader switch requires one-current generation/owner/source evidence and may not fabricate PASS, statement reliance, parental authority/consent, biometric/special-category processing release, screening permission, applicable law or legal effect. Legacy child/guardian/biometric/medical or other special-category data never becomes OCR/training/fraud/reuse input; disposal starts only from a current exact authority.

Идемпотентный backfill создаёт/возвращает non-authoritative OPEN workspace только для cohort с доказанным professional intent и сохраняет уже существующие private drafts с их stable IDs/revisions. Новый excursion draft создаётся лишь при отдельном доказанном draft/excursion intent; application-only/profile-only cohort получает workspace, profile/history и next-best-action без synthetic empty draft. Backfill связывает сохранившиеся identity/evidence/review histories с правильными aggregates и переоценивает каждую реальную excursion/action/scope. Legacy APPROVED/REJECTED не map-ится в workspace state как qualification/restriction. Автоматическое снятие старого блока допустимо только при current exact `VERIFIED` coverage и доказанном отсутствии соответствующего personal requirement; иначе пользователь получает `ACTION_REQUIRED`, `REVIEW_REQUIRED`, `REQUESTED`, `TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE` либо `UNSUPPORTED` с exact reason/owner/next step — без нового blanket certificate. Добавление regulated museum/site/language/date segment может запросить только exact personal/organization/permit/insurance/recognition artifact; удаление segment либо подтверждённый qualified co-guide recompute-ит requirement и убирает stale personal block. Уведомление содержит before/after, сохранность draft/data, appeal/support и deep link. Cutover gate сверяет cohort counts, duplicate workspaces, synthetic-draft count=0, false-block/false-allow, notification receipts и public/booking impact; rollback возвращает compatibility read/status, но не resurrect-ит universal certificate rule и не теряет newly submitted data.

### 15.5 Migration mechanics

1. additive schema;
2. dual read;
3. backfill с checkpoints;
4. verification report;
5. authoritative source write + transactional outbox и compatibility projection; межсервисный dual-write запрещён;
6. shadow evaluation;
7. user communications и lawful grace period;
8. canary по CoverageScope;
9. enforcement;
10. old path retirement после audit.

Backfill является resumable, idempotent и checksummed. Каждая стадия имеет reversible technical rollback и отдельный legal rollback rule.

Migration ticket `mig:DR-REGION-01` creates v2 profiles/routes without mutating v1. `ACTIVE_ACTIVE` becomes `MIGRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED`; `BACKUP_RESTORE_ONLY` remains non-launch evidence; active-passive profiles require new production-like failover+failback, route tests, fences/no-dual-writer, owner receipts, residency and pointer/inbox/outbox reconciliation. A legacy receipt receives a v2 class/effect only from immutable source evidence matching the closed matrix. Missing/conflicting evidence yields `PROCESSING_DELAYED` with NONE/NONE plus migration-review record; it never fabricates domain commit, platform intake or external-recipient confirmation. No profile/route auto-enters TESTED/READY/ACTIVE. Rollback preserves latest epoch and never restores v1 as current or stale home writer.

Migration ticket `mig:SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01` builds exact producer×consumer×type×purpose inventory, producer-local sequence/issuance attempts, v2 prior-anchor cores, checkpoint proofs, memberships and fence epochs. Every allocated v2 sequence must have exactly one source-proven COMMITTED_RECEIPT or VOID_SEQUENCE leaf; missing outcome remains unresolved and fences only dependent effect, never backfills void/no-effect. Pending legacy keys cannot enter an unactivated terminal without HSM disable/destroy receipt. Rollout shadows issuance/verification, then warning/page and hard gating at 100% v2 coverage; crash replay spans reserve/sign/effect/outbox/leaf/checkpoint. TTL and15/30/60 fence are tested. Legacy unsigned/unincluded evidence stays unresolved; rollback cannot accept non-INCLUDED effect, reactivate compromised key or roll back epoch.

Migration ticket `mig:PRIV-TELEMETRY-DATA-CLASS-01` inventories every producer→sink→schema→path→emission-role, direct exporter, field/label/join/retention copy and owner. It first deploys signed edge-admission manifests and shadow bypass canaries, then hard-disables every direct route before v2 cutover. Startup without a gate disables only the optional emitter; first unknown/prohibited value is dropped before normal persistence. Raw quarantine is allowed only in the preapproved isolated security sink; otherwise incident evidence is metadata-only. Observed legacy data is never approved, marked merely “unverified” instead of physically contained, or used to fabricate an owner terminal. Cutover requires 100% edge coverage, zero direct bypass/normal-sink unclassified writes/identifier labels/cross-purpose joins and complete drift/enforcement/disposition receipt reconciliation; deletion/restriction/backup still respects current authority/hold.

Migration ticket `mig:LEGAL-COVERAGE-01` re-evaluates every France site-only legacy rule against the complete L221-1 predicate: covered guided visit, operator performing an operation specifically under Part I of L211-1 and the separately proven L211-18 III exception components. A legacy generic `L211-1 operation`, legal-person/non-profit label, federation membership or reviewer badge proves nothing by itself. The exception becomes true only for a legal-person association/non-profit body with source-proven membership in a declared federation/union, an exact guarantee for that subject and proof that the guarantor satisfies L211-18 I–II. Migration maps outer coverage to `INAPPLICABLE` when covered visit is FALSE, operator predicate is FALSE or the exception is TRUE; to `APPLIES` only for TRUE/TRUE/FALSE; and to `NEEDS_COUNSEL/UNCERTAIN` only for every remaining unresolved combination. Missing activity-part, subject type, membership, declaration, guarantee or guarantor-compliance evidence stays unresolved only when no conclusive outer branch already applies; every mixed `FALSE+UNKNOWN` row is recomputed with FALSE precedence and an order-independent result. No unresolved final result becomes `NOT_REQUIRED`, `APPLIES` or a certificate request. Law and venue-policy axes are backfilled separately; source expiry invalidates only the affected predicate. Cutover requires the complete France truth-table corpus and zero legacy location-only allows/blocks.

Migration ticket `mig:GUIDE-DISCLOSURE-01` rebuilds every public profile/excursion/title projection as v2 from the current authority graph, requirement effect and closed internal→public basis mapping. Existing copy, badge color, reviewer label or credential presence never proves `basis_class`. Unknown/unmappable basis suppresses only that claim and creates reconciliation; `FRAUD_RISK_CONTROL` remains internal-only and a voluntary credential cannot block an action. Cutover creates exactly one current row per subtype scope, validates each subtype field allowlist and validity window, and makes expired/revoked rows non-current before origin/search/CDN/old-client purge. Rollback never republishes an untyped, stale or law-mislabelled claim.

Migration ticket `mig:ADR-STATE-01` adds v3 intent and migration-origin `LegacyADRPublicationReconciliationCase` without rewriting v1/v2. Live source-proven reopen still commits tracker+intent+outbox. A legacy reopened row without complete recipient/copy inputs binds to `OPEN→INPUTS_RECONCILING`, not `PUBLICATION_RECONCILING`; it reaches `INTENT_CREATED` only through the atomic complete-inputs intent+outbox transition. `NO_NOTICE_REQUIRED` requires a current signed determination receipt. `MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED` requires a durable legal-review case with owner/due/next update; a later determination creates a successor legacy generation and preserves the original earliest/lower-bound age before no-notice or intent creation. If only a lower bound is knowable, the case stores `opened_at_lower_bound` and immediately enters hard Legal/Ops escalation. Case→successor→intent never resets age. `PUBLICATION_RECONCILING` is reserved for an existing attempted intent. Reader cutover proves every terminal-specific copy, no-notice/manual-case guards, manual successor, pre/post-outbox crash, binding swap, duplicate/ACK loss and fake-clock 10/15/30-minute escalation; rollback preserves tracker/case/intent chronology and never fabricates receipt/PUBLISHED.

ADR backfill не выводит factual effect, fulfilment или stop finality из старого authority/command status. Для каждого доказанного operative outcome/remediation order deterministic natural key создаёт base ExecutionObligation + ровно один subtype, immutable ObligationEffectManifest/slots и initial FulfilmentAssessmentGeneration; если complete historical input set нельзя доказать, assessment state=`PENDING_INPUTS`, projection=`ASSESSMENT_PENDING` с named reconciliation owner/deadline, а не fabricated FULL/NONE/0%. Contribution allocation создаётся только из доказуемой causation/basis; ambiguity остаётся UNALLOCATED, а `NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED` появляется только из signed `ReferralEffectClaimDispositionGeneration`, иначе MANUAL/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN. Existing COMPLIED/RESOLVED/CLOSED реконструируется в discriminated `ComplaintResolutionStateGeneration(subject_kind,id)` с original receipt; сомнительная remedy finality сразу создаёт causal reassessment generations, не сохраняет ложный close.

Для доказанного EFFECT_STARTED создаются role-correct EffectAttempt, deterministic recovered AttemptEffectPlan, initial OwnerEffectResultGeneration и ATTEMPT discovery generation; missing plan/source-policy evidence остаётся OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/manual с incident. Stable lookup root получает discriminated uniqueness: one `(effect_attempt_id)` для ATTEMPT либо one `(stop_request_id,planned_operation_key)` для STOP_REQUEST, binding generations сохраняют earliest provable opened_at/deadline и не создают phantom attempt. Actual observation/source instance создаётся только из canonical LOCAL_COMMIT/PROVIDER/LEDGER proof; aliases/fingerprints/source hashes сравниваются, multiple refs не merge-ятся без signed correlation. Initial groups/lineages, LineageNetContribution, contribution-allocation, assessment/deficit/incident, validity/cross-referral claim, global reassessment members/receipts и exposure refs строятся checksummed replay. Stop manifests реконструируются лишь при полном cause/membership/receipt proof; иначе создаётся LegacyADRStopReconciliationCase с unresolved sentinel и RevokedAuthorityCheck=CHECKING, без fabricated expected_count. Historical skip требует signed batch InterveningOrderAssessmentManifest. Backfill атомарно материализует exactly three projection members + committed `ADRExecutionProjectionSetManifest`; ambiguity fail-safe CHECKING/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/ASSESSMENT_PENDING. Replay доказывает MERGE→SPLIT, finality reopen, successor `unmet_since` continuity и contribution conservation без lost/double effect; reconciliation сверяет весь generation graph, external execution-control receipts и notices до reader switch.

Legacy respondent data мигрируется только при доказуемом referral/respondent/revision/receipt binding: safe drafts/submissions становятся append-only `ADRRespondentSubmission`, attachment scan status — per file; неизвестный scan остаётся PENDING_SCAN/quarantine, не ACCEPTED. Platform intake отделяется от `ADRRespondentResponseDeliveryAttempt`: без recognised-channel/body evidence status PLATFORM_ONLY/UNRESOLVED, внешний срок и assisted/direct-body route остаются активны. Disclosure correspondence создаёт `ADRRespondentDisclosureRequest` лишь при доказуемом redaction snapshot/basis; иначе Ops MANUAL_REVIEW не фабрикует disclosed/denied decision. Dry-run сверяет original timestamps, current pointers и stale revision collisions.

Legacy complaint/cancellation submission не получает external legal effect из одного local `submitted_at`/booking status. Backfill создаёт ExternalIntakeAuthorityAssessment/Attempt generation только из current source и доказуемого recipient/channel receipt; platform timestamp сохраняется отдельно. Missing/ambiguous authority/delivery становится `UNRESOLVED/EVIDENCE_ONLY`, не CANCELLED/ACKNOWLEDGED: пользователь получает corrected status, nearest external deadline и assisted/direct route. Dry-run сверяет old cancellations/refunds/complaint clocks с seller/provider receipts; reader switch запрещён при fabricated legal_effective_at, lost intent либо duplicate external idempotency key. Rollback сохраняет new receipts/generations и не возвращает blanket «platform submit = external effect».

Migration ticket `mig:EXTERNAL-INTAKE-RECOVERY-01`: existing AssistedDeadlineCase rows receive deterministic recovery_root_id and opaque locator only where party/resource/intent binding is proven; no active recovery token is backfilled. Unproven rows remain manual verification with original platform timestamp/deadline. Historical access lazily creates a root only after proportional verification. Old deep links route to uniform recovery intake and never reveal case existence.

Migration ticket `mig:GUIDE-OFFLINE-01`: no legacy occurrence receives a synthetic offline ALLOW/bundle. Existing/future occurrences default ONLINE_ONLY until current client capability, fresh bundle/bootstrap download, 24/7 roster and data/voice/SMS/no-signal safe-plan evidence pass. Legacy/beta tokens and keys are revoked with replay tombstones; incompatible local secrets are wiped while safe pending reconciliation receipts survive. Reader switch requires zero duplicate live bundle/orphan reconciliation, key-rotation drill and no force-start path.

Migration tickets `mig:NOTIFY-PRIV-01` and `mig:GUIDE-COPY-01`: notification migration inventories every active mandatory notice/deadline. Durable inbox history materializes only from proven source/copy publication receipts; provider-only history becomes UNKNOWN, never DELIVERED, and active near-deadline cases receive a current notice. Reader switch requires 100% notice-intent/source reconciliation and generic external-payload leak tests. New standalone ExplanationCopyVersion supersedes literal/context-only templates, reprojects current disclosures and purges edge copies without rewriting history.

Migration ticket `mig:GUIDE-REVIEW-01`: open manual reviews/restrictions/appeals are checksummed into new generations with original timestamps; all legacy leases are cleared. Unknown review state becomes TRIAGED/IN_REVIEW, never APPROVED/DENIED. Legacy restriction must receive exact affected-scope manifest or enter manual reconciliation; delivery/restoration receipts are never fabricated.

Migration ticket `mig:DSA-TRADER-RET-01`: Article 30 migration derives relationship end only from authoritative events. A legacy period already older than six calendar months has Article 30 purpose access disabled and becomes immediately deletion-due rather than receiving a new six-month window; independent DAC7/KYB copies survive only under their own purpose. Article 18 reports are never reconstructed from generic fraud/moderation records without every exact predicate and recipient proof.

Migration ticket `mig:DSA-ART30-PROMOTION-GATE-01` inventories guide profile/search/recommendation/SEO/CDN/old-client surfaces and requires a Legal-approved `PROMOTE_MESSAGES | OFFER | NEITHER`; missing classification is UNRESOLVED and absence of a booking button never proves NEITHER. Every affected EU promotional profile without current Section4/readiness/public-disclosure/profile-schema pins becomes `HIDDEN_PENDING_ARTICLE30` only in that market, with private workspace/correction/rights preserved. Backfill never fabricates trader data, assessment or preview acknowledgement and reuses an existing record only when controller/purpose/trader/service/freshness/field manifest all match. Search/edge is purged before reader cutover; visible true-predicate profile without READY is zero, and rollback keeps the affected projection hidden.

Migration ticket `mig:PRIV-PRECHECK-DATA-01` inventories CDN/WAF/reverse-proxy/access/security logs, rate-limit stores, IP/cookie/device/correlation identifiers, mobile local storage, crash reports, analytics and backups. Every actual field receives current purpose/basis/retention/audience/COPPA/processor classification; unsupported data is application-disabled and receives a current approved disposition before authorised deletion or purpose reclassification, waitlist contact is separated, and immutable legacy copy is superseded rather than rewritten. Gateway/body redaction and telemetry allowlist cut over before dynamic precheck; raw route/site/body in logs/traces/analytics and misleading live no-PII copy are zero. Legacy receipts without explicit time basis/date-range/legal-timezone or `NOT_SURE` discriminator are `AS_OF_LEGACY_UNKNOWN` and cannot authorize/reuse; no date or legal classification is inferred. Existing age fields, SDKs, vendor contracts or privacy copy never backfill `COPPAAgeVerificationStatementRelianceGeneration`; remote age-verification remains disabled until the current every-condition generation and deletion-receipt path are approved. Signed local age-route/static guidance ships before the new endpoint, and network/SDK tests prove zero under-13 local-only ingress. Old clients receive the server notice or static non-submitting guidance, and rollback cannot restore raw telemetry, merged waitlist purpose, fabricated statement reliance or dynamic child collection.

Migration ticket `mig:PRIV-PROCESSING-RESTRICTION-01` preserves original request receipts/submitted_at/deadlines, inventories open/historical restriction/objection requests and instruments every data-operation owner before enforcement. Legacy Article23 labels do not become APPROVED determinations: exact legislative measure, restricted right/obligation, objective, Article 23(2) particulars and notice decision require current counsel review, otherwise the exception is unavailable. Legacy adverse/no-action response templates remain non-finalizable until a current jurisdiction/right/controller `ExternalPrivacyRemedyDeterminationGeneration` supplies official complaint and judicial routes; the request stays open with owner/ETA. Legacy FULFILLED never becomes ACTIVE/LIFTED without exact epoch/owner/recipient/notice receipts; known applicable open scopes start APPLYING, unknown owners/recipients stay reconciling, and recipient members come only from proved disclosures. No synthetic determination, remedy, enforcement or notification receipt is created. Reader cutover requires 100% owner operation-registry/epoch/remedy-template coverage, official-link verification, backup-restore test and zero old-epoch non-storage effect; rollback preserves restriction epochs/fences and never silently lifts a restriction or restores a generic denial template. Intake retains a durable/manual accessible route during feature outage.

Migration ticket `mig:TRACE-DEPENDENCY-01` inventories every live cross-programme action/API/event/schema edge into a checksummed source catalog and requires one exact `RequirementArtifactRegistryGeneration` ID/hash. Every human-table provider requirement ID must resolve at compile time to exactly one current versioned contract, manifest digest/count/ordered hash and provider-member digest set; zero/multiple-current resolution, stale resolver generation, runtime `latest`/minimum lookup or a prior-version receipt after upgrade blocks dry-run. A contract upgrade creates a new dependency-member generation/epoch and re-runs its fallback fixtures. The migration also requires exact predicate evaluation and one action-bound fallback-instance receipt per expanded member/scope; it never infers `NONE` from missing owner/evidence. Dry-run rejects family-only receipts, instance reuse across actions, member/action/scope mismatch and fallback omission of the current unsafe command; reader/release switch requires 100% member↔instance bijection and proves unrelated predicate-false scopes remain available.

Migration tickets `mig:GUIDE-AUTH-FENCE-01`, `mig:STATE-CATALOG-01`, `mig:LEGAL-TEMPLATE-01` and `mig:TRACE-ARTIFACT-01` are additive. Existing unconsumed decisions are non-consumable after scoped-fence cutover; no legacy read-before-write path survives rollback. Legacy states map only through an approved exact state-catalog edge or become MIGRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Imported copy is `LEGACY_IMPORTED`, never APPROVED without proof. Requirement artifacts are discovered from actual schemas/migrations/tests/observability/config and missing digest/stage/DoD/evidence remains a promotion gap. Shadow mode compares old/new outcomes but can never authorize; rollback selects a prior signed scoped catalog/template generation or safe pause and never restores global invalidation, dual writer or unfenced consume.

`mig:GUIDE-AUTH-FENCE-01` additionally classifies every old reservation as provably UNSTARTED, COMMIT_STARTED/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or terminal only from a matching owner-local effect/no-effect transaction receipt. It backfills `AuthorizationOwnerOutcomeGeneration` and signed evidence only when business effect/outbox or authoritative no-effect manifest proves one mutually exclusive result; ambiguous, missing or conflicting legacy evidence becomes `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` and holds the exact key-set fence. A legacy pre-Mark abort label is never imported: only a coordinator-proved expiry/revoke with no CommitStartedReceipt may become `EXPIRED_UNSTARTED | REVOKED_UNSTARTED`, and its owner row is terminalized only by the matching signed closure receipt. A local timer can classify only proven unstarted work and can never fabricate no-effect. Cutover proves owner row creation precedes every Mark, every coordinator CONSUMED/NO_EFFECT terminal references the exact owner terminal generation and every unstarted owner terminal references the exact coordinator closure; it tests closure-vs-Mark and a delayed legacy worker against the terminal tombstone/CAS before activation. Subject/resource keys are backfilled from opaque current bindings and verified against the broad-partition shadow result before activation; a missing key becomes MIGRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED, never a global revoke.

Migration ticket `mig:BOOKING-STATE-01` maps BookingAttempt, PaymentOperationRequest, BookingCaptureOperationIntent, PaymentAttemptOutcomeBridge, PaymentOperation, Booking, RemediationApplication and ManualReview generations through exact StateMachineCatalog edges. Every paid in-flight attempt is joined to the exact request/payment generation and a signed payment-owner receipt: proved DECLINED/NO_EFFECT becomes TERMINAL_NO_EFFECT and proved VOIDED becomes VOIDED. A historical capture becomes CAPTURED_EXPECTED only when an exact durable BOOKING_COMMITTED capture intent, booking/contract/payment/operation/amount/currency/merchant hashes and non-cancelled generation are all proven; otherwise it becomes CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED. Contract observation alone never becomes capture. Historical full refund becomes REFUNDED_REMEDIATED only from authoritative full-refund+settled-subledger+complete contract/booking/capacity/APPLIED manifest; partial, missing or conflicting evidence stays remediation/reconciliation and blocks retry. Missing request/operation binding cannot fabricate a request or payment generation. No legacy attempt may map directly from payment pending/authorized/refunded to CANCELLED, HOLD_EXPIRED, retry or a new charge. Legacy REMEDIATION_REQUIRED becomes CAPTURED_REMEDIATED_CONFIRMED/CONFIRMED only with a complete APPLIED owner-effect manifest; otherwise it remains REQUIRED/RECONCILING. CONFIRMED bookings retain a cancellation edge, and QUEUED review cancel history is preserved. Dry-run includes ordinary matched capture, request→operation crash/ack loss, late authorization after apparent cancel, delayed void, capture/cancel race, partial/full-refund gaps and retry-after-refund/timeouts; no terminal, expected capture, retry eligibility or no-effect result is inferred from absence of evidence.

Migration ticket `mig:BOOKING-SALE-ADMISSION-FENCE-01` inventories every live pause/unpublish/profile-hide/Article-30/legal-safety source cause and expands its exact ordered excursion/occurrence/profile/assigned-guide market scope. It never infers an `OPEN` scope from an absent legacy flag or delayed event. Reader cutover requires shadow equality between source causes and booking active-cause count/hash, no post-cutoff booking in race replay, an exact disposition for every nonterminal attempt and RPO-0 restore/reconciliation evidence. Ambiguous cause, source generation or in-flight payment becomes `FENCED | RECONCILING`; a pre-cutoff booking is preserved only from an authoritative booking commit timestamp/receipt. Rollback may stop new UI rollout but cannot remove a current booking fence or restore event-only sale admission.

Migration ticket `mig:BOOKING-LATE-CAPTURE-01` builds a stable economic-obligation lineage from every provable predecessor/descendant payment generation, provider operation/idempotency/physical-effect identity, capability generation, comparable outcome evidence, bridge/contract/quote/hold and shared-exposure scope. A historical terminal/no-effect/void/refund label never suppresses a newer authoritative capture or refund reversal: it appends `CAPTURED_REMEDIATION_REQUIRED` and freezes the lineage. Ambiguous duplicate/missing generation, missing middle lookup member, stale capability, incomparable sequence, ambiguous effect identity, any started-unknown descendant or incomplete money/contract/booking/capacity disposition becomes a frozen `PaymentGenerationConflictGeneration(RECONCILING)` with pay/retry disabled; migration never fabricates a Start receipt, void, refund, no-effect or winning payment. Reader switch requires complete capability-bound lookup member hashes, 0/1/N operation dry-runs, late correction before/after retry preparation/Start and after a CLOSED fence/conflict, plus correction-vs-new-CLEAR in both orders. Rollback keeps the latest current-pointer fence and cannot restore a stale retry CTA.

Migration tickets `mig:REG-ROLE-01`, `mig:PAY-REG-01`, `mig:TAX-INDIRECT-01`, `mig:AI-GOV-01`, `mig:PRIV-RETENTION-01`, `mig:PRIV-SPECIAL-INGRESS-01`, `mig:BOOKING-REMEDIATION-01`, `mig:CONTRACT-FORMATION-01`, `mig:P2B-TERMS-01`, `mig:P2B-RELATIONSHIP-01`, `mig:DSA-SOR-01`, `mig:DSA-ART32-01`, `mig:NOTICE-ATOMIC-01`, `mig:NOTICE-EMERGENCY-01`, `mig:NOTICE-EMERGENCY-CLOSURE-01` and `mig:BOOKING-FREE-01` inventory live aggregates, source/config/copy/receipt provenance and current pointers. Unknown determination is not APPROVED, missing retention receipt is not DELETED, legacy remediation silence is not ACCEPTED, provider event without proof is not contract formation, terms are not EFFECTIVE without clock/waiver, notice provider acceptance is not publication, and zero price/missing PSP is not free. No historical adverse effect is classified EMERGENCY or mapped into an emergency notice without exact authority, source execution/tombstone/effect receipt, intent, copy, rights binding and publication chronology. A legacy authority becomes coordinator CONSUMED only when exact signed Start and source EFFECT_COMMITTED terminal reference the same immutable source transaction; ambiguous started work becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and stays fenced, while no synthetic tombstone/effect/no-effect is created. A coordinator authority proved expired/revoked before Start closes its exact source PENDING execution+intent only through the signed coordinator `EmergencyUnstartedClosureReceipt`; that same source transaction must create its distinct signed `EmergencySourceUnstartedClosureReceipt`, and only coordinator application of this authenticated acknowledgement yields `SOURCE_CLOSURE_CONFIRMED`/successor eligibility. Absent/mismatched source acknowledgement remains `UNSTARTED_CLOSURE_RECONCILING`, blocks only the successor for that source key and creates no effect, rights case, MandatoryNotice or adverse user card. If Start or any effect evidence exists, unstarted closure is forbidden and routes to started reconciliation. Proven effect-before-publication starts as `EMERGENCY_EFFECT_COMMITTED_PENDING_PUBLICATION`; proven ordinary publication-before-effect starts in the ordinary state set; ambiguous/mixed legacy rows enter mode-specific reconciliation and never `ORDINARY_PUBLISHED_PENDING_EFFECT` by default. Dry-run proves coordinator/source mode/state/signature/timestamp constraints, both receipt replays, Start-versus-closure exclusive branch, terminal Ops copy and exact authority-start-outcome-tombstone-effect-intent-notice-publication manifests before reader switch. In-flight records preserve user rights/timestamps and materialize the same interim rights case before notice where source proof exists; cutover requires 100% expected-observed manifests and rollback cannot reintroduce unsafe semantics.

`mig:PRIV-SPECIAL-INGRESS-01` uses only precomputed non-content inventory until an exact current disposal/triage/full-processing basis plus Article 9(2)/Article 10 or non-EU condition permits the corresponding operation. Expected-sensitive workflows without full authority receive no upload session; every generally available file-input channel first gets a current disposal authority or is disabled. Suspected-sensitive legacy blobs without current authority enter `LEGACY_SENSITIVE_AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`: content access and related ingress stay closed while named DPO/counsel resolves an exact authority by short decision/absolute deadlines. Only then may cryptographic/object deletion, narrow triage or lawful hold execute; every object/key receipt pins the authority. A generic hold, encryption or future possible use cannot preserve them. Cutover requires complete authority-resolution inventory, zero authorityless deletion/content access, complete object+key deletion receipts for authorised disposals, no generic OCR/AI/reviewer/vendor access, positive valid-hold/classification migrations and safe user projections; rollback never recreates deleted data, invents authority, silently attaches a classified file or re-enables ingress.

The v3 cutover additionally materializes file-owned admission fences/byte-lease epochs and two-phase hold/deletion pointers before promoting any privacy authority. A legacy ACTIVE authority without a coherent zero-live-lease fence disables the channel and enters reconciliation; a legacy ACTIVE hold without exact file-fence plus privacy-ACTIVE receipts becomes `ACTIVATION_RECONCILING` and deletion remains blocked. No row receives a fabricated receipt. Compatibility revoke/hold APIs delegate to the coordinator; rollback cannot restore direct terminal writers or presigned-upload bypass.

Migration tickets `mig:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-01`, `mig:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-TRANSPORT-01`, `mig:PRIV-PRECHECK-RESULT-EXPORT-01` and `mig:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-STATE-01` make handoff v5, transport v4, export v2 and state v4 current; predecessors remain immutable history. They deploy the dedicated web seal route and BFF body/IAM/log denial before enabling broker custody, and never “re-encrypt” a legacy secret without proved plaintext-safe source flow. Existing eligible local results are resealed only by an explicit user action; otherwise they remain local. Migration proves seal crash/ACK loss before/after guide creation, and converts a broker forward only from persisted authorization/start plus guide outcome. A missing post-Start outcome becomes `OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` with lookup within 1s and a fenced duplicate Commit; no timeout fabricates `NO_EFFECT_CONFIRMED`. Legacy server claim states still map only from exact guide effect/no-effect receipts; local discard, payload deletion and shred truths remain distinct. URI/JS/ambiguous-custody artifacts are revoked, current local drafts/account-switch preservation remain intact, and rollback cannot restore BFF crypto/body custody, pre-start-only cancel after Start, old causal ForwardReceipt dependency, silent merge or false terminal.

Migration ticket `mig:DSA-ART13-REP-CONTACT-PRIVACY-01` inventories every Article 13 representative contact, classifies natural-person/identifying fields and creates reviewed DSA/GDPR-scope, purpose, notice, transfer, retention and rights generations. Legacy rows are `PRIVACY_REVIEW_REQUIRED`, never auto-approved; publication turns current only after notice/exemption, DSC equality and closed-field validation. `mig:DSA-ART13-LEGAL-REP-01` adds the shared action epoch and exact guide/excursion/booking/edge owner manifest; any scope without provable current epoch/receipts remains `INVALIDATION_FENCING`. Direct old revocation writers and publication bypass are removed only after shadow reconciliation; rollback preserves the fence and cannot republish a revoked/stale contact.

Migration ticket `mig:DSA-ART21-COST-ENTITLEMENT-01` creates additive fee/outcome/case/expense/entitlement/payment tables, backfills existing cost dispositions as `LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED` with `recipient_liability=0`, imports authenticated fee schedules/outcomes and reconciles the financial ledger. Existing results are never declared compliant by inference. `NOT VALID` FKs/checks are validated after zero-gap shadow calculation; DB roles then deny direct writes and the compatibility `RecordArticle21CostDisposition` accepts only a generated entitlement ID. Rollback keeps recipient-charge guards and never restores arbitrary amount/outcome flags.

Migration ticket `mig:DSA-ART24-ODS-REPORT-01` pins current applicability and official `EU-2024-2835` template digest, adds canonical Article21 source events/timestamps, builds a replayable fact model and evidence-classifies historical proceedings without converting pending to omitted. It recomputes every percentage from authoritative numerator/denominator using exact decimal arithmetic: a legacy value in `(1,100]` becomes `METRIC_SCALE_REVIEW_REQUIRED` and is never automatically divided by 100; negative, `>100`, missing denominator and binary-float-only evidence remain unresolved. It shadow-generates/reconciles the official CSV against source ledger, validates `[0,1]` scale, rounding, zero-denominator context, HTML-percent/CSV-fraction parity, schema/no-PII/formulas and dual-approves publication before cutover. Published v1/v2 artifacts remain immutable history; correction rows are backfilled only from source-proven predecessor, reason, rectification methodology, `changes_made_at` and complete canonical diff manifest. An incomplete or cyclic legacy correction becomes `CORRECTION_RECONCILIATION_FAILED`, never a current corrected report. Every version and hash stays public for five years. Reporting remains asynchronous throughout, and rollback of its reader/publication path cannot roll back or synchronously block Article20/21/court/restoration/cost writes.

Migration ticket `mig:DSA-ART42-REPORT-01` imports only formal Commission designation/cessation evidence bound to the exact legal entity and named service; enterprise-wide flags, MAU estimates and internal labels remain `UNRESOLVED`. It derives the four-month Section-5 application date and creates exactly one `INITIAL_AFTER_SECTION5_APPLICATION` obligation due two calendar months later, plus separate recurring windows. A report may satisfy both clocks only through a source-backed approved transition rule; migration never lets a semester row suppress the initial obligation. Legacy combined language data is split into independent human-resource applicable-language and accuracy all-official-language manifests; missing provenance stays incomplete. HR rows require CEFR B2 Understanding classification, EQF/approved equivalent, training type/frequency/content, mental/physical support and calculation methodology; none is inferred from moderator count or locale. Audit migration requires the exact Article 34/35/37(4)/37(6)/consultation member manifest, re-encrypts source-proven unredacted authority evidence into the restricted KMS partition with immutable digest/access-audit linkage and explicit public-role deny, preserves public copies separately, and never fabricates transmission, recipient receipt, redaction ground or publication receipt. Legacy plaintext/unscoped objects remain quarantined and non-exportable until verified migration; their absence cannot be treated as deletion or successful transmission. Historical correction chains require complete source-proven predecessor/diffs/receipts or enter reconciliation failure. Every public predecessor is indexed for five-year availability. Shadow runs validate first and recurring clocks, transition overlap, both language manifests/semantics, VLOP-versus-VLOSE fields, official template/public CSV, deadlines, no-PII, restricted-role isolation, both correction chains and authority/public receipt independence. Rollback may disable only the new reporting UI/reader and cannot remove the initial obligation, merge language manifests, restore legacy plaintext access, undo a transmitted/published record, expose a redacted value, change designation truth or block any complaint, booking, payment, privacy or safety right.

Migration tickets `mig:GUIDE-DECL-WRITER-01` and `mig:PAY-EXEC-AUTH-01` move declaration rows and financial authority minting through owner-specific shadow projections. Ambiguous declaration owner becomes MIGRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED; submitted content remains immutable and compliance write grants to declaration tables are revoked at cutover. Booking/complaint/payout legacy financial commands become signed source intents only; payment-service mints no authority without exact current provenance. Started provider operations stay reconciling under the same idempotency identity, never reminted.

Migration tickets `mig:GUIDE-RIGHTS-RECOVERY-01`, `mig:GUIDE-DISCLOSURE-01`, `mig:GUIDE-SELF-SUSPEND-01`, `mig:GUIDE-OFFLINE-CHANNEL-RECEIPT-01`, `mig:GUIDE-APPEAL-EFFECT-01`, `mig:GUIDE-REVIEW-EXPIRY-01`, `mig:GUIDE-REVIEW-CANCEL-01` and `mig:GUIDE-COPY-LABEL-01` do not backfill live recovery tokens, route/date `N/A`, false RECEIVED, automatic stay, adverse expiry/cancel result or raw-enum labels. Expiry and cancellation have separate dry-run/evidence/rollback gates even when deployed in one release. Proven notices/cases get opaque recovery roots; public projections recompile into exact subtype; legacy gateway acceptance stays PROVIDER_ACCEPTED/UNKNOWN until owner case receipt; current copy reprojects through approved labels while historical snapshots remain immutable.

Migration tickets `mig:DSA-SIZE-APPLICABILITY-01`, `mig:DSA-ART18-INFO-01`, `mig:DSA-ART18-ROUTE-01`, `mig:DSA-ART30-PRIVATE-DISC-01`, `mig:DSA-ART31-01`, `mig:DSA-ART31-TRADER-RESPONSE-01` and `mig:DSA-TRADER-PUBLIC-CONTACT-UX-01` never fabricate micro/small status, VLOP designation, applicability, report completeness, recipient competence, retrospective disclosure approval, READY offer, historical response or random check. Legacy ownership/accounts/transaction labels are evidence only; provisional accounts remain UNRESOLVED, and every scope starts UNRESOLVED until Legal/Finance approves complete AWU/relationship/approved-period/source manifests or exact newly-established estimate. Merger/acquisition/divestiture/control-change flags do not select treatment: migration requires pre/post graph, transaction-effective evidence and counsel receipt; otherwise status/grace is UNRESOLVED. A historical generic `dsa_loss_grace_end_at` is not carried forward: grace is re-created only from proven ARTICLE_4_2 loss, while approved structural-immediate loss has no automatic grace and opens a transaction-time transition impact. Dry-run covers pre/post-transaction offer dates, acquisition into a large group, divestiture, stale evidence and historical remediation. A VLOP record is imported only from an authoritative Commission decision and binds the exact named service; enterprise-wide flags become UNRESOLVED and same-service designation still overrides size/grace. Existing Article30 data receives purpose/basis review; unresolved public projections safe-pause/reconcile but are not mass-deleted without current retention decision. Pending legacy possible matches create AWAITING_RESPONSE only from a proved current check, with no invented response/receipt/admission. Open Article 18 cases inventory source/item/route and assess later data separately; legacy arbitrary recipients stay unresolved. Future Article30 outbound access requires new one-use authority. Every live EU offer gets exact current Section applicability, complete interface/offer manifests before enforcement, and joins random population only at cutover. Existing sole traders receive public-contact preview/correction before next affected publish; no residential classification is inferred.

Legacy cancellation fee/terms не мигрируют как enforceable по наличию configured percentage. Backfill связывает exact term/contract copy и current CancellationTermEnforceabilityAssessment; неизвестная fairness/mandatory-right/cost/cap basis становится `UNCERTAIN` и не создаёт collectible deduction. Dry-run сравнивает configured fee с lawful cap/formula, existing refunds/credits и affected contracts; unexplained excess имеет consumer remediation owner before cutover.

До cutover `execution-control-service` inventory-ит все pending/in-flight/unknown cancellation refunds, voids, goodwill, dispute/chargeback, tax corrections, provider callbacks и ADR effects у каждого owner/rail. Для доказуемого FlyFy plan создаётся conservative reservation/start generation; provider/bank fact без pre-reserve — `EXTERNAL_UNRESERVED_DISCOVERED`; uncertain duplicate/no-effect остаётся EXTERNAL_RECONCILING до signed proof, а не release. Current `PlanExposureAttributionGeneration` строится только при conservation proof. Shadow compare owner/provider/ledger totals и cap headroom должен сойтись по каждому typed scope; новый Reserve включается только после RPO 0 restore test, reconciliation barrier и zero unexplained delta. Legacy pending commands без безопасного envelope замораживаются с user-visible status/owner/next update и same-key recovery; rollback не возвращает unfenced path.

## 16. Programme delivery

### 16.1 Планирование и команда

Последовательная сумма этапов составляет 35–50 недель. При параллельной работе legal foundation, evidence/financial foundation и UX research реалистичный critical path — 32–42 недели при команде не менее:

- Product Manager;
- Product Designer/Researcher;
- Legal Product Counsel и local counsel по launch markets;
- 6–9 backend engineers: compliance/legal knowledge, identity/guide, booking/complaint, payment/subledger/settlement и platform/integration owners;
- 2–3 Flutter engineers;
- 1–2 full-stack/admin-UI engineers;
- 2–3 QA/SDET, включая finance/concurrency и mobile/accessibility automation;
- Security/Privacy/DPO;
- Platform/SRE, Payments, accounting/financial-control и indirect-tax specialists;
- AI governance/model-risk owner, если используется любой AI-enabled feature;
- Accessibility/localization specialist;
- Data/Analytics;
- Customer/Legal Operations representative.

Срок уточняется после этапа 0. Сокращение команды не уменьшает scope, а меняет календарь.

Это portfolio estimate, а не один release train. Работы разделены на три independently funded/tracked programmes:

| Track | Обязателен для guide-compliance launch | Scope и оценка |
|---|---|---|
| GUIDE-CORE | Да | serviceability, legal rules, identity/capacity, typed declarations/assertions, requirement/evaluation/authorization, guide/tourist/admin UX, migration and operations; ориентир 24–34 недели |
| INTEGRATION-SAFETY | Только затронутые contracts | booking/payment/payout/cancellation/existing-funds/public-listing contracts needed by enabled markets; 8–14 недель, mostly parallel |
| ADR-EXEC-CONTROL | Нет, если launch flow не меняет или не зависит от соответствующего complaint/remedy effect | full ADR and shared economic-effect safety redesign in this document is a separate 24–36-week programme with its own budget, owners, rollout and go/no-go; it can run in parallel and must not silently enter GUIDE-CORE estimate |

Guide launch cannot bypass existing safe booking/refund/complaint obligations, but an unrelated unfinished ADR-EXEC-CONTROL feature does not block an otherwise complete unregulated guide scope. It becomes a hard dependency only when a named traceability row maps a guide-launch action to that changed contract; the stage gate records the dependency, owner, interface version and tested fallback. Conversely, GUIDE-CORE completion never authorises partial ADR/financial rollout. The long ADR/EXEC material below is therefore a separate dependency track/technical annex, not hidden guide critical-path scope.

Критический путь:

    Operating model
      → approved P0 coverage
      → domain/evidence + financial-ledger foundation
      → engine + server authorization + provider/contract bridge
      → end-to-end UX
      → shadow migration
      → controlled rollout

For GUIDE-CORE the critical path excludes independent ADR-EXEC-CONTROL implementation unless the stage-0 dependency manifest proves coupling. Each §16.4–16.9 ticket and dashboard carries `programme_id: GUIDE_CORE | INTEGRATION_SAFETY | ADR_EXEC_CONTROL`; capacity, estimates, evidence and go/no-go are reported per programme, never blended into one aggregate “green”.

Initial committed dependency catalog is compiled against one exact current `RequirementArtifactRegistryGeneration` ID/hash. Bare provider requirement IDs in the human table are compiler inputs only, never canonical runtime aliases: a total single-valued resolver must map each to exactly one current `contract:<requirement>:vN`, immutable contract-manifest digest, expected member count/ordered hash and exact provider-member digests, all persisted in the resulting `LaunchDependencyMember`. Zero or multiple current matches, a registry-generation/hash mismatch, an unversioned interface or any dynamic `latest`/minimum lookup fails compilation and promotion. A provider contract upgrade creates a new dependency-member generation/`member_epoch`, invalidates predecessor receipts for that member and re-runs the exact scoped fallback suite; runtime performs no version resolution. The first clause of every predicate cell contains only exact §5.1 action IDs. If a row lists several IDs, the generator emits one `LaunchDependencyMember` per action with unique stable `dependency_member_id = <DependencyID>:<action_id>`, the same dependency/predicate/provider family and a distinct compiled fallback instance `<FB-family>:<dependency_member_id>:<action_id>:<scope_partition_hash>`. The family ID shown in the table is never a runtime fallback receipt; prose after the semicolon only narrows that action's scope and can never substitute an action ID:

| Dependency ID | Consumer action и activation predicate | Provider requirements/interfaces | Criticality, tested fallback и accountable owner |

For `ACCEPT_BOOKING`, booking-service pins the exact expanded dependency-member IDs, member epochs/digests and predicate evidence into the hold/attempt generation. `CONFIRM_BOOKING` recomputes its own current action set and revalidates every still-material inherited ACCEPT member before contract/capture commit; it cannot treat a previously green global release as proof. Drift between listing, accept, hold, payment and confirm invalidates the old grant, blocks only the affected commit and moves payment/hold through its authoritative safe void/refund/reconciliation path. A free partition can never fall through to PSP or a paid contract, and a possible Article 31 match/window expiry alone never becomes an adverse restriction or admission.

Fallback catalog is executable and defines reusable families; release compilation produces and tests a distinct immutable action-bound instance for every expanded dependency member and scope partition. The “preserved/forbidden” cell is a family ceiling, while the compiled instance narrows it to the exact current action and must explicitly forbid that unsafe command:

Stage 0 may add observed members but cannot hide/delete an edge. Every member and action-bound fallback instance has exact predicate input/result, interface digest, green test receipt, owner, max duration and user copy. PUBLISH instances cannot expose the affected surface; ACCEPT instances cannot create hold/payment; CONFIRM instances must perform authoritative safe hold/payment disposition; rights-action instances cannot hide cancellation/complaint/appeal. Predicate-false/unrelated partition proof is mandatory.

UX research, localization, registry due diligence, support training и privacy work начинаются параллельно, но их gates нельзя переносить за production launch.

### 16.2 Этап 0 — Discovery и operating model, 3–4 недели

`stage_id: STAGE-GUIDE-00-DISCOVERY`. RequirementArtifactRegistry links every discovery/legal/product artifact to this ID. In scope: Article 31/29 applicability and official-source feasibility, Article18 source/route inventory, Article30(6) recipient matrix plus public-profile `PROMOTE_MESSAGES|OFFER|NEITHER` surface classification and third-party-persistence warning research, declaration/organization-representative ownership, scoped fence/notice/free-booking/payment-lineage ADRs, sensitive-ingress disposal-versus-triage authority/condition/alternative mapping, precheck network/telemetry/retention/COPPA/Rule-internal-operations versus FTC-2026-age-verification-statement/date-and-unknown-branch inventory, GDPR processing-restriction owner/processor/recipient topology plus Article23 legislative-measure and external privacy-remedy catalogs, public-contact/disclosure/copy prototypes and rights-recovery/usability/accessibility research.

- current-flow/user research;
- market demand и risk prioritization;
- Market Operating Model ADR;
- PaymentRegulatoryDetermination и IndirectTaxDetermination для каждого paid archetype;
- полный AIUseCaseInventory, включая vendor/embedded AI и запрещённые до approval experiments с реальными данными;
- legal applicability matrix;
- launch decisions for minor support/default, legal capacity, equality/recognition, biometric dataflows, background-screening disabled/enabled scope and external-intake authority;
- data inventory и DPIA screening;
- service boundary ADR;
- safety-critical requirement registry/traceability manifest с stable IDs, owners и обязательными API/event/DB/migration/UX/test/SLI/runbook/DoD columns;
- generated action/API/event/schema catalogs and initial `LaunchDependencyRegistryGeneration` whose exact member count/ordered hash are compiled from the canonical dependency table, with predicate owners, interface digests and named fallback test/runbook IDs; a hand-maintained count or partial list is forbidden;
- baseline metrics and signed ProductOutcomeScorecard per launch market/cohort: denominator definitions, entry intent→common auth(existing/new/cancel/switch)→workspace open→first private draft→contextual preflight→first eligible public action; separate optional precheck start→truthful result→hierarchical save/local/discard choice; typed-undecided/no-qualification completion, branch-group comprehension/expand use, intent/local-result preservation, auth-cancel return, optional handoff success by transport and 0/1/N draft path, merge-conflict recovery, time-to-draft/time-to-eligible-publish excluding disclosed external wait, 30-day guide-workspace retention, unnecessary-question/document requests, support contact, listing→checkout, public-contact/cost/suppression comprehension and accessibility task success. Entry path, existing/new account, client family, coarse market, locale and accessibility stratum are measured separately without cross-person tracking. Safety counters include duplicate account/workspace, lost/wrong-account professional intent, guide-restriction tourist spillover, workspace-as-public-authority, false SUPPORTED, linkability, silent overwrite, false terminal, improper certificate request, false suppression, unlawful recipient charge and rights-path block. Target/non-inferiority margin, sample/window and accountable owner are fixed before canary and cannot be redefined after seeing results;
- clickable guide/tourist/admin prototypes, including existing-user enablement, guide-directed common registration with deferred tourist preferences, optional anonymous research handoff, same-account traveler/guide switch, scoped denial, archive/reopen/close, new-country preflight, organization invitation and whole-account deletion impact;
- legacy-client capability/upgrade/fallback contract and over-collected-document cohort inventory;
- usability tests минимум с 5–8 участниками каждого ключевого сегмента, включая regulated и unregulated markets.

Gate:

- подписаны ADR;
- определены P0 launch scopes;
- нет неизвестного seller/contracting model;
- для paid scope утверждены funds-flow/tax-price/invoice owners; для AI use case определён role/risk/date gate;
- prototype critical flows прошёл accessibility и usability review;
- утверждены RACI, capacity и risk register;
- все launch-scope mandatory requirement rows имеют stable ID/owner и zero unresolved placeholder; CI/release traceability check спроектирован до implementation;
- каждый обнаруженный cross-programme edge имеет ровно одну current dependency mapping; predicate=false доказан evaluation receipt, predicate=true `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` имеет exact provider contract+version и green fallback test; неизвестная/неполная dependency блокирует только mapped action/scope, но никогда не считается `NONE`.

### 16.9 Этап 7 — Controlled rollout, 3–4 недели

`stage_id: STAGE-GUIDE-07-ROLLOUT`. Canary by exact action+CoverageScope partition with signed RequirementArtifactRegistry evidence, exact runtime fallback-instance receipts, active precheck/privacy-restriction/Article30-profile/payment/emergency/sensitive-ingress dashboards, alerts and runbooks, and zero false-scope blocks. GDPR rights availability and statutory safety controls are never A/B-disabled; DSA Article18 real reports are never generated for test sampling; production-like fixtures use synthetic/minimized data.

- internal;
- staff/partner beta;
- 1–5% canary по approved CoverageScope;
- 25%;
- 50%;
- 100%;
- отдельное расширение на следующие scopes.

Переход между стадиями только при выполненных error budget, legal и operational gates. Country-wide flag не используется, если scope покрыт частично.

Минимальное наблюдение:

| Stage | Минимальная длительность | Минимальная выборка |
|---|---:|---:|
| Internal/shadow | 3 дня | 100 golden/replayed decisions |
| Partner beta | 7 дней | 100 real или production-representative actions |
| 1–5% | 7 дней | 500 authorizations, включая publish и booking |
| 25% | 7 дней | 1 000 authorizations |
| 50% | 7 дней | 2 000 authorizations |
| 100% steady-state review | 14 дней | фактический market traffic |

Если малый market не достигает sample, окно продлевается; sample не waive-ится снижением процента.

Aggregate sample не скрывает рискованные cohort gaps. До promotion из canary нужны как минимум:
