- production-representative DSA packs cover every enterprise-size boundary/relationship/consolidation, organic two-period change, merger/acquisition/divestiture/lasting-control transaction timing, Article4(2)-eligible versus structural-no-grace, 12-calendar-month/VLOP/Article19-24(3)-29 cross-product and 100% of live EU scopes have a current signed section determination; they also cover every Article 18 predicate-negative/recipient/payload case and Article 30 private/public field plus month-end/leap-year/independent-purpose retention/deletion. Production reports are not generated for sampling;
- all current entries whose IDs have prefix `DEP-` have predicate true/false/unknown, interface-drift and fallback isolation evidence; catalog↔registry cohort reconciliation is 100%, not sampled;
- 50 identity attempts на каждый provider × major mobile client cohort, включая resume/retry/fallback;
- не менее 100 сессий для каждого major cohort iOS/Android, поддерживаемой app-version family и launch locale; accessibility evidence собирается отдельно по полному inventory и не заменяется traffic sample.

На стадиях 25% и 50% каждая risk-bearing action/provider/scope cohort как минимум удваивает предыдущую production выборку и не имеет zero-traffic blind spot. Synthetic/shadow evidence может доказать редкие negative paths, но не заменяет production evidence для реального PSP/funds-flow. При низком трафике stage продлевается либо scope/action остаётся ограниченным; статистическое исключение требует Legal/Product/SRE approval, documented confidence limits и не допускается для false-ALLOW, client-funds integrity или accessibility conformance.

Per-stage release scorecard:

- legal golden false-ALLOW: 0;
- unnecessary professional-document request in a current verified no-requirement scope: 0; precheck→private-draft completion ≥ pre-registered target and no worse than baseline by >5% relative at 95% confidence;
- median time to private draft ≤ 5 minutes for supported minimized precheck, while time-to-eligible-publish excludes and separately reports external authority/user wait; unexplained internal wait regression >10% blocks promotion;
- workspace-open→first-private-draft and draft→eligible-publish are separately non-inferior to cohort-adjusted baseline (lower 95% confidence bound above −5% relative); common-auth professional-intent return ≥99.9%, duplicate account/workspace and tourist spillover = 0. Thirty-day guide-workspace retention is a steady-state gate before permanent 100% rollout, not hidden by short canary conversion;
- unnecessary-document/support-contact rate does not worsen by >10% relative and every document-request complaint is sampled for false blanket rule; critical-task unaided completion/comprehension ≥90%; listing→checkout lower 95% confidence bound above the pre-registered −3 percentage-point margin;
- Product/Data publish denominator/sample/zero-traffic report and market/cohort confidence interval; missing sample extends/limits rollout and never weakens legal/safety/privacy zero-tolerance gates;
- every `metric:GUIDE-UNIVERSAL-ACCOUNT-01`, `metric:GUIDE-WORKSPACE-ENABLEMENT-01`, `metric:GUIDE-POST-AUTH-INTENT-01`, `metric:GUIDE-PERSONA-ISOLATION-01`, `metric:GUIDE-RIGHTS-RECOVERY-01`, `metric:NOTICE-EMERGENCY-01`, `metric:NOTICE-EMERGENCY-CLOSURE-01`, `metric:GUIDE-SELF-SUSPEND-01`, `metric:BOOKING-SALE-ADMISSION-FENCE-01`, `metric:GUIDE-REVIEW-EXPIRY-01`, `metric:GUIDE-REVIEW-CANCEL-01`, `metric:GUIDE-PRECHECK-BRANCH-01`, `metric:GUIDE-PRECHECK-INPUT-PRESENTATION-01`, `metric:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-01`, `metric:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-TRANSPORT-01`, `metric:PRIV-PRECHECK-RESULT-EXPORT-01`, `metric:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-STATE-01`, `metric:DR-REGION-01`, `metric:SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01`, `metric:PRIV-TELEMETRY-DATA-CLASS-01`, `metric:ADR-STATE-01`, `metric:DSA-TRADER-PUBLIC-CONTACT-UX-01`, `metric:DSA-ART30-PROMOTION-GATE-01`, `metric:DSA-ART30-URGENT-SUPPRESSION-01`, `metric:DSA-ART30-SUPPRESSION-TRUTH-01`, `metric:DSA-ART13-LEGAL-REP-01`, `metric:DSA-ART13-REP-CONTACT-PRIVACY-01`, `metric:DSA-ART30-REDRESS-01`, `metric:DSA-ART20-COMPLAINT-01`, `metric:DSA-ART21-ODS-01`, `metric:DSA-ART21-COST-ENTITLEMENT-01`, `metric:DSA-ART24-ODS-REPORT-01`, `metric:DSA-ART42-REPORT-01`, `metric:DSA-ART31-01`, `metric:DSA-ART31-TRADER-RESPONSE-01`, `metric:BOOKING-STATE-01`, `metric:BOOKING-LATE-CAPTURE-01`, `metric:BOOKING-FREE-01`, `metric:PRIV-PRECHECK-DATA-01`, `metric:PRIV-PROCESSING-RESTRICTION-01`, `metric:PRIV-SPECIAL-INGRESS-01` has the mandatory `cohort_applicability` fields from §6.27, an exact denominator, exclusions, authoritative domain outcome events, privacy-safe dimensions, query/test digest, pre-registered target/window and owner. Only `COHORT_OBSERVABLE` controls may have a matching `cohort:<requirement>`; `OPERATIONAL_INTEGRITY_ONLY` handoff-transport/export/Article-21-cost/regional-DR/receipt-trust/ADR-state and `GOVERNANCE_ONLY` telemetry-data-class/Article-13-contact/Article-24/Article-42 metrics have no cohort artifact, user/account dimension or conversion optimization. Missing denominator or zero traffic can never render 100%. `A11Y-REFLOW-01` is deliberately release-gate-only and cannot be waived or judged by cohort conversion;
- `metric:GUIDE-DISCLOSURE-01` and `cohort:GUIDE-DISCLOSURE-01` are `COHORT_OBSERVABLE` with the same mandatory registry fields. Their only dimensions are disclosure subtype, closed basis class, coarse market, client family, locale and accessibility stratum; user/account/resource identifiers, raw route/date, exact location and cross-product joins are forbidden. Cohort assignment may change only an already approved semantically equivalent copy/layout variant, never requirement truth, effect, visibility, ranking, adverse action or the zero-tolerance guards;
- for these critical flows unaided completion/comprehension is ≥90%, error/recovery route is demonstrated and all zero-tolerance guards remain zero. Acknowledgement, cancellation or publication conversion is not optimized: informed safe exit is a valid successful outcome and dark-pattern pressure blocks promotion;
- unexplained production decision mismatch: 0;
- incomplete/mixed RequirementEvaluation set, unauthorised/self responsibility acceptance, incompatible GuidePresence double allocation, stale holder/affiliation/insurance/cross-border/capacity generation consumed: 0;
- RemunerationProfile COMPLETE/gratuitous with missing/new/gapped/regressed source or mixed composition generation: 0;
- cross-subject/cross-purpose evidence or attestation reuse, declaration/public payload minting verified fields, permit quota oversubscription/orphan/duplicate consume or external-quota divergence accepted: 0;
- expired/untrusted offline bundle start, forbidden/stale/wrong-subtype public guide/excursion/title disclosure, incomplete PolicyRelease impact activation, biometric byte before authority, child PI without current COPPA/minor path, predicate-true unassessed significant decision: 0;
- offline local/contact/not-sent shown as server RECEIVED, assistance terminal without current authoritative receipt, support force-start path, AssistedDeadline recovery existence leak/cross-case/replay/stale authority: 0;
- legacy no-current-purpose object retained past due without scoped hold, legacy object entering OCR/AI/reuse, unsafe old-client command or universal-certificate compatibility response: 0;
- confirmed false-block rate ≤ 0.5% и не ухудшается более чем на 20% от предыдущей стадии;
- AuthorizeAction error-budget burn < 1× за observation window;
- manual queues без sla/absolute_due_at breach;
- orphan/captured-without-booking payments unresolved > 15 минут: 0;
- partial financial consistency-envelope transitions и financial/booking/ADR dual-authority/stop-request/remediation RPO 0 control-record loss: 0;
- server-originated PSP operations after execute_before, unremediated late SCA, duplicate operation-key или contract-trigger mismatch: 0;
- refund initiation и completion внутри target/provider/legal SLA ≥ 99%;
- payout unexplained hold/absolute_due_at breach и amount-ledger mismatch: 0;
- unauthorized payout-destination activation, unnotified update и duplicate payout after return/reversal: 0;
- stale MerchantTaxReadiness used for paid action, scheduled payout blocked by logout или stale remediation decision applied: 0;
- consumer complaint without immediate receipt/correct deadline или unresolved routing gap: 0;
- complaint resolution applied from stale proposal либо case closed without owner remedy receipt: 0;
- ADR referral marked withdrawn/closed without rule-sufficient evidence/current order, statutory right suppressed, false external filing/deadline, unresolved order auto-terminal, primary/order mismatch, effect without current EFFECT_STARTED or FENCE_BYPASS incident, direct authority→result, owner-declared FULL/PARTIAL, attempt-scoped deficit, missing obligation/plan/result/assessment/binding generation, stale harmful action, lost/double-allocated contribution, false alias merge/missed SPLIT, unresolved incident/allocation/validity/global reassessment/exposure, lost stop request/stable lookup binding, false ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT/RESOLVED/FULFILLED, mixed projection_set_version, missed factual/retraction/fulfilment corrected notice, late discovery without skip edges, orphan item/stale CTA, complaint closed by ExitADR либо with open causal second axis, early ADR/remedy/dispute finality: 0;
- consent withdrawal without immediate effective receipt, consumed authority without deterministic effective result или cross-scope authority acceptance: 0;
- consent-based processing without qualifying grant provenance: 0;
- mandatory ExplanationView missing/wrong-copy fallback: 0;
- reusable literal-date/incomplete/context-misused legal copy, manual-review stale lease/fabricated terminal/restriction-scope drift/incomplete restoration: 0;
- critical durable-inbox publication success ≥ 99.99%; configured external-channel provider acceptance ≥ 99.9%; undelivered escalation p99 ≤ 10 минут, причём escalation не засчитывается как delivery;
- notification provider acceptance/device evidence/read/escalation conflation, Article 18 report without every exact predicate/competent recipient, Article 30 private-field public leak/early-or-overdue purpose deletion, or affected EU promotional profile public without current readiness/visibility receipt: 0;
- dependency catalog↔registry coverage 100%; unknown/orphan/duplicate edge, stale interface, missing unique member/action/scope fallback-instance evidence, family-only/reused fallback receipt or action/scope block broader than current predicate: 0;
- precheck raw payload/identifier leakage or reuse, submit without current privacy/audience/COPPA/notice pins, misleading no-PII copy, identified under-13 network/SDK ingress, guessed material fact/omitted branch, export source-linkage, URI/JS/log handoff bearer, silent draft overwrite or false handoff terminal: 0. Expected-sensitive ingress without current full condition, incidental first byte/presigned bypass without current authority+file fence+lease, byte after drain/fence, incomplete two-phase hold shown active, deletion-won revival, overdue authority-bound object/key deletion, invalid/stale hold copy, silent classification attach or raw sensitive telemetry/offline copy: 0;
- Article 13 affected action under stale/missing shared owner fence or public natural-person contact without current purpose/notice/transfer/retention/DSAR projection: 0; Article 21 recipient liability without the complete authenticated statutory predicate, automatic debit/set-off, missing recipient-win reimbursement or cost outage blocking a substantive right: 0;
- Article 24 missing/duplicate source fact, formula/template/calendar/schema error, public PII, overwritten correction, five-year availability gap or reporting dependency blocking Article 20/21/cost/restoration: 0; suppression state/copy mismatch or late surface without successor notice: 0;
- restricted non-storage processing after winning privacy fence without exact authority, stale restriction/lift epoch, false ACTIVE/LIFTED/recipient-complete or lift before notice: 0;
- retry provider call after a winning late-capture correction, missing closed-lineage frozen successor, incomplete/stale/incomparable capability-bound provider-operation lookup, incomplete payment-generation conflict or stale pay/refund-complete CTA: 0;
- emergency unstarted source PENDING or coordinator unacknowledged closure beyond hard SLO, successor before source acknowledgement, delayed effect or adverse user artifact after pre-Start expiry/revoke: 0;
- crash-free mobile sessions ≥ 99.8%;
- unresolved WCAG A/AA failures по полному launch screen-state inventory: 0;
- P0/P1 security, legal, payment и consumer defects: 0.

Автоматический pause применяется при SLO/error-budget/queue threshold breach без доказанного harmful rule. Rollback применяется при false-ALLOW, wrong restrictive rule, payment/PII integrity defect или regression, если rollback version юридически допустима. Legal kill switch используется для urgent prohibition. Release commander и Legal duty owner совместно определяют действие; Security Incident Commander может немедленно остановить compromised path.

## 17. Testing strategy

### 17.0 Исполнимый test manifest

For every current RequirementArtifactRegistry entry `X`, `test:X` is a required versioned suite manifest in the test catalog, not a label invented by §21. It explicitly lists unit/model, contract, integration, race, chaos/security, migration, E2E/accessibility cases, runner/environment/build and signed result digest; `NOT_APPLICABLE` requires approved reason and cannot replace a required category. The registry compiler checks file/runner receipt existence and exact digest. A trace row without its suite manifest, a scenario referenced only by prose, a wildcard or an aggregate green result blocks promotion.

New/strengthened suite manifests include:

| Suite | Mandatory scenarios |
|---|---|
| `test:TRACE-ARTIFACT-01` | missing/orphan/duplicate/wildcard/digest/stage/DoD/evidence, bidirectional API-event-state-template coverage, contract-manifest member count/order/hash mismatch and group-only false green; exact `EventArtifactPair` set rejects inventory-only/registry-only topic, absent event or payload half, inferred/implicit schema, terminal-version duplication and AsyncAPI/schema digest mismatch. Grammar accepts schema/API/contract v1/v2/v37 and rejects v0/missing/negative/malformed versions. Metric compiler permits a cohort edge, user/account dimension or conversion target only for `COHORT_OBSERVABLE` and rejects each for `OPERATIONAL_INTEGRITY_ONLY`/`GOVERNANCE_ONLY`; attempted artifact/member/digest mutation is denied and full immutable predecessor/delta compatibility is verified |

### 17.1 Unit and model tests

Один root одновременно влияет на две axes без age reset;

### 17.2 Property-based tests

- expired/revoked attestation никогда не удовлетворяет requirement;
- no exact current rule can request a universal professional certificate; verified unregulated scope with current identity/capacity and no professional requirement can ALLOW publish without credential;
- no declaration/workspace/file/review state alone satisfies requirement; only exact current attestation/assertion/binding generations do, and workspace lifecycle is never an authorization input;
- cross-subject/cross-purpose/cross-audience artifact, credential or attestation reuse is impossible; same-subject exact replay is idempotent and cross-account duplicate signal is non-enumerating;
- verified second-account evasion cannot bypass current lawful PERSON-scoped revoke/quota, while ACCOUNT-scoped restriction never propagates; false merge/split restores affected scopes without revealing another account;
- holder/affiliation/insurance/work-authorisation/recognition/capacity/source revoke or generation change invalidates every dependent authorization, while unrelated artifact absence never blocks unregulated scope;
- no organization command can succeed without one current ACTIVE representative membership whose role/action/audience/scope covers it; no ordering of self-escalation, transfer, revoke, emergency suspend or recovery can leave zero active owner/admin without a recovery fence or let a stale token/member act;
- exhausted/stale aggregate, mixed currency without approved conservative FX, wrong limit basis, missing excess attachment point, claims-made/tail gap or mid-occurrence cancellation never satisfies insurance requirement or leaves affected booking without remediation;

Any FTC 2026 statement path implies general/mixed eligible audience, otherwise-current COPPA compliance, sole age-verification purpose and complete notice/accuracy/security/prompt-deletion/vendor-assurance manifest; missing condition, statement withdrawal or material drift makes the generation non-ACTIVE and every new collection impossible. Changing service date/range/timezone/model/work-mode makes every earlier precheck receipt non-reusable, and `NOT_SURE` can never be coerced into a favourable branch;

- misclassified/potential medical, disability or other special-category document cannot enter an enabled channel, be inspected/deleted or reach generic OCR/AI/search/reuse/training/reviewer without the current exact disposal/triage/full-processing condition for that operation; missing authority disables ingress and legacy content access, never requests diagnosis or invents deletion permission;
- seller cancellation fee is never greater than current lawful cap/formula and UNCERTAIN/stale assessment never produces a collectible deduction;
- platform complaint/cancellation timestamp never becomes external legal effect without matching current authority+recipient evidence;
- any order-independent combination/add/remove of price/tip/donation/sponsorship/commission/bundle/barter/credit components changes canonical RemunerationProfile only when semantics change; client `free=true` and platform price=0 cannot suppress a benefit component or produce genuinely gratuitous;
- for every permutation/concurrent interleaving of expected remuneration sources, COMPLETE uses one coherent source manifest and genuinely gratuitous implies every expected source is current and EXPLICIT_NONE; missing, newly registered, unavailable or regressed source can only produce INCOMPLETE/UNDETERMINED;
- RequirementDefinition/ResponsibilityAssignment/Acceptance/RequirementEvaluation complete-set manifest is conserved: lost/new/reordered member, duplicate subject/credential, uncovered simultaneous segment or stale group size can never yield ALLOW;
- incompatible cross-service guide presence overlap never yields two ALLOWs; timezone/DST/buffer/late schedule change and allocation revoke invalidate affected evaluation while privacy-safe alternatives remain;
- responsibility path cannot transfer an obligation without current authorised owner acceptance; reject/revoke/timeout invalidates dependent ALLOW and exposes a lawful alternative rather than silently assigning FlyFy/site/co-guide;
- boundary geometry, activity taxonomy, site classification or resolver generation split/merge/reclassification changes context hash and invalidates every affected published/action decision without blocking unrelated scopes;
- every closed public disclosure subtype contains only its allowlisted fields; identity, age, nationality, document number, raw reason/evidence and work-authorisation restrictions are unrepresentable, and a profile/excursion/title field cannot deserialize into another subtype;
- any assisted-recovery response before successful verification is distribution-indistinguishable by case existence within the approved timing class; any token replay, superseded generation, cross-case/party/resource/audience operation or broader renewal has zero effect;
- no ordering of offline local intent, gateway retry, reconnect, bundle revoke or remedy receipt can make `local_recorded_at` imply `server_received_at`, make an unreceived request RECEIVED, consume a nonce twice or reach a terminal assistance state without its authoritative receipt;
- no ordering of notice publication/dispatch/provider/device/read/escalation can label provider acceptance or escalation as device delivery/read;
- for `RestrictionIntent.mode=ORDINARY`, no source effect commits without the matching durable publication receipt; any source/publish race that loses that guard leaves the action uncommitted and produces the linked correction/withdrawal chronology;
- for `RestrictionIntent.mode=EMERGENCY`, no source effect commits without the exact compliance Start receipt and one source-local transaction containing the unique authority tombstone, effect, signed outcome, rights binding, notice intent and outbox. Once `EFFECT_COMMITTED`, pre-publication interim status/recovery is immediately reachable, and every later notice/correction remains linked to the same effect time, case, locator, appeal and deadline; publication outage or reordering can never fabricate no-effect, duplicate the effect/case or satisfy the notice manifest;
- no manual-review lease expiry/reassignment, concurrent reviewer, appeal or newer independent restriction allows stale decision/restoration to win; RESTORED implies all exact current owner task receipts and preserves newer unrelated restrictions;
- Article 18 report can exist only when all conjunctive predicates and allowed recipient route are current; Article 30 public projection is a strict subset independent of private storage, remains securely retained for exactly the applicable six-calendar-month period and is purpose-deleted after it without deleting separately justified records;
- Article30 affected public visibility implies a current exact persistence-warning acknowledgement for the same fields/sources/surfaces/version; Hide/Unpublish remains independent and no purge receipt can imply third-party deletion;
- every GDPR Article23 restricted-operation authority is a strict subset of one current complete APPROVED determination; every adverse rights response implies a current exact controller/jurisdiction/right remedy generation with official complaint and judicial routes, while missing/stale routes keep the request open rather than fabricating a denial;
- for every generated cross-programme edge the current dependency registry has exactly one mapping (or explicit approved set), and every hard true mapping has an exact current contract digest plus green named fallback; graph growth cannot silently retain a green release hash;
- ExistingFundsCapacityDisposition never reduces payable amount, creates FlyFy revenue, exceeds absolute due without incident or requires a new contract; settlement/restitution receipts conserve amount across races;

- старый authorization не подходит другому actor/action/resource;
- решение детерминировано для одинакового immutable snapshot;
- добавление независимого REQUIRE без supersession не превращает deny/action-required в allow;

- operator permit не удовлетворяется PersonCredential;
- unassessed либо changed AI model/purpose не может быть production-enabled;
- payment/tax authorization другой merchant, funds-flow, quote или tax version никогда не переиспользуется;
- одинаковый client_request_id одного stable subject/operation с любым changed payload никогда не создаёт второй BookingAttempt;
- canonical request hash сохраняет смысл между supported serializer versions и tombstone не допускает duplicate attempt после archival;
- сумма debit/credit каждого journal entry равна нулю внутри currency/legal entity; correction никогда не изменяет старый posting;
- server-originated provider side effect после execute_before никогда не выполняется без новой valid command authority;
- late asynchronous SCA result никогда не commit-ит booking и всегда имеет deterministic financial remediation;

- EXECUTE_SCHEDULED_PAYOUT никогда не требует user session и никогда не обходит current mandate/destination/ledger/restriction/tax epochs;
- consent projection не становится active без qualifying immutable grant; epoch монотонен по subject/controller/purpose, cross-controller withdrawal невозможен;
- provisional dispute/ADR outcome никогда не освобождает reserve и не закрывает case до final/remedy receipts;
- non-binding ADR outcome без полного current acceptance set никогда не создаёт financial/remedy command; DECLINE/ExitADR никогда не становится NONCOMPLIANT;
- submission platform receipt никогда не означает external delivery/tolling; quarantined attachment не удаляет safe response; только current verified body evidence makes delivery effective, same external identity никогда не dispatch-ится дважды. Disclosure request без approved deadline rule никогда не продлевает срок;
- delivered outcome/remediation command без successful current-order/epoch obligation-slot-plan-bound EFFECT_STARTED и STARTED_RESIDUAL exposure никогда не меняет owner/provider state; authority не принимает result state, а crash между owner effect и ApplyReceipt консервативно сохраняет residual exposure;
- для любой последовательности reclassification оба epoch возрастают; unstarted authority закрывается stop-only, started/unknown attempt сохраняет один stable lookup root, а current-valid allocated lineage имеет не более одного current item на referral/case и один successor. Stale plan/reversal/recovery/debit имеет zero effect, late receipt меняет history/current assessment, но не ставит stale COMPLIED;
- для любого числа revoked authorities/flips unresolved request не теряется; один receipt меняет только свой request. RevokedAuthorityCheck=ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT iff closure set complete and no current-valid causally bound effect; any factual effect yields EFFECT_FOUND even with pending requests and regardless of allocation;
- три projection functions инвариантны к event order и независимы: изменение stop request не может само изменить fulfilment; allocation transfer не меняет factual revoked FOUND; deficit не создаёт found effect. Единственная допустимая publication unit — complete common projection set version;
- valid PENDING_INPUTS всегда даёт ASSESSMENT_PENDING с no deficit/finality/operation CTA; missing/corrupt assessment generation даёт unavailable/resync, а не ASSESSMENT_PENDING. Concurrent assessment/allocation writer может сделать current только generation с exact full input/global fence;
- один canonical alias независимо от deliveries соответствует одному source instance; 0/1/N instances допустимы. N>1 создаёт incident только при violation of AttemptEffectPlan cardinality/cap/amount; signed same-effect correlation не нарушает group/net/allocation conservation. Unresolved identity/allocation/global/exposure fence не выдаёт harmful authority и не допускает causal finality;
- factual result может `NO_ACTUAL→ACTUAL→NO_AFTER_RETRACTION→ACTUAL` и terminal→OUTCOME_UNKNOWN только append-only generations; каждый transition атомарно reopen-ит dependent item/case/obligation/projections и corrected notice, но не мутирует prior chronology;
- для любого signed net fulfilled clamp находится в `[0, expected]`; negative net никогда не увеличивает exposure headroom, одна group/net contribution не credit-ится дважды, а sum allocated shares не превышает conserved source/net measure с deterministic residual;
- для любого external-unreserved fact terminal no-effect/already-accounted release требует signed proof+conserved attribution; invalidation/newer proof возвращает residual либо FROZEN. После любого release и cap reuse late reopen либо остаётся within cap, либо переводит scope в REOPENED_OVER_CAP_FROZEN; ни один generation order не допускает новый Reserve, silent over-cap, duplicate subtraction или automatic clawback до signed reconciliation disposition;
- GlobalEffectReassessment CONVERGED implies every exact REFERRAL and EXECUTION_CONTROL_SCOPE member receipt matches manifest/current epoch. External-unreserved write during prepared phase invalidates token/restarts; after convergence it creates new reopen generation, поэтому stale finality невозможна при любой linearization order;
- deficit successor relation equivalent/modified/new никогда не сбрасывает unmet_since; BLOCKED_IN_FLIGHT_UNKNOWN never exposes retry, PROVISIONAL_ONLY never exceeds independently approved cap;
- late effect discovery для любой последовательности intervening order versions создаёт один immutable contiguous InterveningOrderAssessmentManifest и ровно один current-order skip edge/item; concurrent reclassification может только CAS-retry к новому current order, но не создаёт orphan/branch/phantom case и не исполняет stale plan;
- stale/superseded ComplaintResolutionProposal никогда не создаёт remedy command; complaint не становится RESOLVED/CLOSED без COMPLIED owner receipt, включая unconditional remedy;
- invalidated fulfilment reopen-ит только remedy-derived closure in the matching subject-specific complaint/referral chain; WITHDRAWN/PARTY_DECLINED/WITHDRAWAL_EFFECTIVE/unrelated closed_reason remain unchanged, original success receipt persists;
- mandatory ADR withdrawal entitlement никогда не подавляется missing/conflicting body config; party scope не расширяется, а non-proposing procedure не наследует право без approved basis;
- ExitADR никогда не переводит underlying complaint в WITHDRAWN/CLOSED; ADR_WITHDRAWN/CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT(closed_reason=WITHDRAWAL_EFFECTIVE) требует sufficient effect evidence и current EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL version. Равные/неполные external facts дают ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED, а новый authoritative receipt создаёт superseding classification и атомарно reopen-ит/realign-ит только withdrawal-derived primary state; PARTY_DECLINED closure не reopen-ится. Platform intent evidence сохраняется, но external deadline/tolling не считаются сохранёнными без approved rule/evidence;
- withdrawal authority никогда не действует для другого subject/controller/purpose/target/consent_epoch и после CONSUMED/EXPIRED;
- aggregate precheck SUPPORTED implies every material branch has exact verified coverage and identical requirement-set hash; any unknown/missing/divergent branch disproves it;
- handoff claim implies exactly one bound authenticated subject, one receipt and one private draft commit, while never implying identity/KYC/credential/action authority;
- FLYFY_SUPPRESSED implies complete exact FlyFy-controlled receipt manifest and never implies third-party deletion;
- Article 13 ACTIVE implies all applicability, mandate, acceptance, powers/resources, DSC and public-contact predicates; Article 30(4) entitlement implies exact paragraph trigger and concurrent Article20/21/court routes;
- Article 20 final result implies qualified human reasoned review; Article 21 confirmed intake implies authenticated body receipt but never binding effect or court exhaustion;
- an Article 24 corrected public version implies one immutable same-family predecessor, complete exact diff and metadata with no cycle; an Article 42 template publication implies exact effective designation plus complete applicable fields, while an audit authority receipt and a public audit receipt never imply one another. VLOSE output never contains Article 42(2) fields and VLOP output cannot omit an applicable-language member;
- organization ordinary success implies current ACTIVE membership, except exact invite/recovery command discriminators; sensitive file state is writable only by file-manager from current signed authority/hold receipts;
- accessibility promotion implies both current-build native and web evidence manifests are complete with zero failing required member.

## 18. SLO, observability и product analytics

### 18.1 Service SLO

Начальные targets, уточняемые нагрузочным baseline:

- OpenGuideWorkspace availability 99.95% monthly, backend p95 ≤2s; professional destination p95 ≤5s on baseline network. Duplicate current workspace/effect, private-draft prerequisite KYC/certificate/merchant-tax or public action derived from workspace: 0;
- successful common-auth return to exact professional intent ≥99.9%; bind/consume/status p95 ≤500ms excluding identity-provider time. Wrong-subject/session/audience consume, arbitrary redirect, replay, lost intent within TTL or mandatory tourist-preference detour: 0;
- ActionDomainCatalog coverage of registered actions 100%; guide restriction tourist/rights spillover and shared-account effect without current AccountAccess authority: 0. Detection pages immediately and preserves unaffected/rights flows during remediation;
- AuthorizeAction availability: 99.95% monthly;
- cached assessment read availability: 99.99%;
- AuthorizeAction latency: p95 ≤ 300 ms, p99 ≤ 800 ms без внешней live registry проверки;
- AuthorizationGrant Reserve, MarkAuthorizationCommitStarted and signed pre-Mark Expire/Revoke p99 ≤ 300 ms; normal scoped fence drain p99 ≤ 30 seconds when no started/unknown work. Mark without a pre-existing matching PENDING owner row, owner unstarted terminal without matching signed coordinator closure, post-Mark expire/revoke, closure/Mark dual win, stale-epoch effect commit, effect without signed Mark receipt, coordinator started terminal without matching owner terminal, late owner effect after any terminal, false no-effect or unrelated subject/resource block: 0. COMMIT_STARTED/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and non-terminal/missing owner-outcome age are measured separately and never expired. Propagation SLO does not replace fence correctness;
- ReserveADRRemedyEffect/MarkADRRemedyEffectStarted и ReserveADRRemediationEffect/MarkADRRemediationEffectStarted availability: 99.95% monthly per gate, p95 ≤ 300 ms и p99 ≤ 800 ms; outage/partition fail closed и не использует stale cache;
- execution-control ReserveExposure/MarkStartedResidual availability: 99.99% monthly, p95 ≤ 200 ms, p99 ≤ 500 ms для всех ADR/cancellation/refund/goodwill/dispute/tax owners; outage fail closed для нового potentially duplicate effect. Consume/Release/Reconcile p99 ≤ 5 минут; задержка не освобождает cap, а сохраняет STARTED_RESIDUAL. External-unreserved ingest availability 99.99% и не блокируется prepared global fence; reconciliation backlog >15 минут, invalid prepared token, stale release/attribution создаёт incident/freeze;
- policy activation propagation: p99 ≤ 5 минут;
- PolicyRelease activation receipt is atomic; affected-owner impact manifest dispatch p99 ≤ 2 минут, missing receipt hard incident ≤ 15 минут, partial activation: 0;
- `DR-REGION-01`: current production profile is active-passive v2 and exact affected-action plus fresh READY-rights-route coverage is 100%; ACTIVE_ACTIVE/BACKUP_RESTORE_ONLY activation, dual writer, residency violation, regulated reopen before owner/rights manifests or any invalid `receipt_ui_state × receipt_class × effect` triple accepted/projected: 0. Each profile has numeric RPO/RTO/MTD and drill freshness. Rights routes precede regulated writes; route not-ready affects only exact writes while status/intake uses tested alternatives. Receipt semantic mismatch pages immediately, preserves evidence and never retries or promotes intake to domain truth;
- `SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01`: exact v2 producer×consumer×type×purpose and edge inclusion coverage before a new effect: 100%; unallocated/unresolved sequence, commit/void dual terminal, future-containing-checkpoint field, invalid proof/fork, non-INCLUDED consumer effect, unactivated key terminal without HSM disable/destroy receipt, stale snapshot or bad key/substitution/replay accepted: 0. Effect snapshot TTL≤60s, refresh p99≤10s; compromise/revocation adoption p99≤15s, warning at 15s, page at 30s, mandatory local hard fence by 60s. New effect after hard fence, revocation epoch rollback/gap or incident closure without complete consumer manifest: 0; read/status/rights remain available;
- `PRIV-TELEMETRY-DATA-CLASS-01`: signed edge-admission coverage before every optional write: 100%; sink without gate/direct bypass/unclassified normal-sink write/value-derived incident evidence: 0. Validated violation→exact edge fence p99≤5s/hard30s; owner terminal receipt p99≤60s/hard Legal/Privacy/SRE escalation5m. Hard breach disables exact optional emitter/path without blocking business action. Raw quarantine exists only in approved isolated security sink; disposition/hold/deletion remains owner-receipt and authority controlled;

- appeal resolution: p99 ≤ 14 рабочих дней, hard max 21 рабочий день либо применимый меньший законный срок;
- appeal absolute_due_at: не более 30 календарных дней либо меньшего обязательного срока; SLA_INCIDENT и daily user update после breach;
- overturned restriction restoration dispatch: p99 ≤ 5 минут; полное capability/data restoration p95 ≤ 4 часов, hard max 1 рабочего дня либо меньший обязательный срок, после чего RESTORATION_BLOCKED incident и daily update;
- booking-critical case: 24/7 safe automation немедленно ставит sales/charge на pause; human on-call acknowledgement ≤ 30 минут для markets с активными paid occurrences;
- material-change durable-inbox publication: p99 ≤ 2 минут после созданного remediation case; configured external-channel provider acceptance p99 ≤ 10 минут; provider rejection/unknown, optional trustworthy device evidence and user acknowledgement измеряются отдельно, undelivered escalation p99 ≤ 10 минут после failure и не считается delivery;
- refund initiation после выбора туриста: p95 ≤ 15 минут;
- PSP acceptance refund command: p99 ≤ 4 часов, hard max 24 часа;
- customer-funds settlement: p95 внутри меньшего из применимого legal/provider target; initial support escalation не позднее 10 рабочих дней, а более короткий обязательный срок имеет приоритет;
- ни один refund case не остаётся без next_update_at; превышение rail-specific hard maximum создаёт payment incident и manual reconciliation;
- OUTCOME_UNKNOWN payment: automated reconciliation ≤ 5 минут, hard escalation ≤ 15 минут;
- payout PROCESSING unknown outcome: automated rail lookup ≤ 5 минут, hard escalation ≤ 15 минут;
- payout HELD/ACTION_REQUIRED/IN_REVIEW всегда имеет next_update_at; first safe explanation ≤ 15 минут после restriction, human acknowledgement p95 ≤ 1 рабочий день, per-rail/legal absolute_due_at фиксируется до launch;
- payout FAILED retry/alternative-rail decision: p95 ≤ 1 рабочего дня; RELEASED scheduling ≤ 1 рабочего дня, если legal/provider hold снят;
- payout-account onboarding/update status после provider event: p99 ≤ 5 минут; destination-change notifications по старому/новому verified channel инициируются ≤ 1 минуты; cooldown/effective_at задаются rail-risk policy до launch;
- PayoutAccount close/recovery receipt is immediate; remaining-funds disposition owner assigned ≤15 minutes, former/locked/deleted-account recovery first response ≤1 working day and no payable amount passes its absolute due because account is CLOSED;
- payout RETURNED/REVERSED authoritative lookup ≤ 15 минут после signal; superseding notice и ledger reconciliation p95 ≤ 4 часов, hard max 1 рабочего дня либо меньший rail/legal срок;
- ExistingFundsCapacityDisposition is created/updated ≤ 15 minutes after capacity hold, human Legal/Payments acknowledgement ≤ 1 working day, next update at least daily and no case may pass its market/rail/legal absolute_due_at without incident plus executive escalation;
- where offline start is enabled, the assisted channel is staffed 24/7: the device records local intent immediately without calling it delivered; valid signed platform ingress must reach one owner-DB `CASE_COMMITTED` and same-key `server_received_at` p99 ≤ 1 minute, then human acknowledgement ≤ 5 minutes for start-critical cases. Carrier/provider acceptance starts neither clock and is shown only as not-yet-received transport evidence. A pre-approved replacement/cancel/refund/safe-remedy path remains available if authorization cannot be restored; with zero connectivity, cached safety/no-start guidance remains available and neither server-receipt nor human-ack clock has falsely started;
- critical public disclosure revoke/expiry projects to listing ≤ 60 seconds; disclosure correction acknowledgement immediate and user-safe corrected preview p95 ≤ 1 working day;
- authorised legacy triage and metadata-only no-authority/over-collected authority resolution use separate explicit short deadlines. Triage breach revokes object/key grants and continues only the disposition covered by its current authority; resolution breach keeps content/application access and ingress disabled, creates a Privacy incident and pages DPO/counsel continuously until a current disposal/triage/full-processing determination exists. Signed deletion or exact lawful-hold receipt is produced only under that current authority;
- self-service cancellation acknowledgement немедленно; void/refund initiation использует более строгий из consumer/legal/provider SLA;
- cancellation/complaint AssistedDeadlineCase opens immediately; support owner acceptance ≤ 5 minutes for deadline within 24 hours and ≤ 1 hour otherwise, next update ≤ 15 minutes/1 working day respectively, with absolute external deadline never paused by internal queue;
- AssistedDeadline recovery verification returns automatic result/next step p95 ≤ 1 minute or accessible human acknowledgement ≤ 1 working day, without resetting the case/external deadline; successful exchange resumes the exact case p99 ≤ 5 seconds, expiry/revoke is explicit and no recovery flow requires account restoration or biometric proof by default;
- ManualReviewCase acknowledgement is immediate, lease assignment p95 ≤ 15 minutes for booking-critical and ≤ 1 working day otherwise; every pause has non-pausable absolute due, daily update after breach and safe interim decision. Restriction appeal/restoration uses the stricter applicable deadline and never reports restored before every exact current owner receipt;
- DSA Article 18 eligible incident dispatch begins p95 ≤ 15 minutes after approved assessment and receipt reconciliation escalates at 15 minutes; Article 30 correction acknowledgement is immediate, public correction/revoke p99 ≤ 5 minutes/60-second edge cutoff, purpose access is disabled and deletion becomes DUE exactly at the six-calendar-month boundary, while physical purge/reconciliation completes p99 ≤ 24 hours or remains an escalated incident;
- Article 13 applicability/designation gap immediately assigns DSA Legal owner and blocks only new affected EU actions; revocation/DSC/public-contact/route drift acknowledgement ≤15 minutes, remediation plan ≤1 working day and user/public status correction within the tighter technical SLO. Imminent safety reporting never waits for that plan;
- Article 20 complaint receipt is immediate; first qualified-human triage ≤1 working day, next update at least every 5 working days and final resolution uses the shorter applicable legal/policy deadline. Overturn restoration starts ≤5 minutes and follows the existing hard restoration SLA. Article 21 route/body list is immediate; body intake/outcome/cost evidence is reconciled ≤1 working day after authoritative receipt, while registry outage opens assisted route ≤15 minutes and never pauses complaint/court clocks;
- urgent suppression origin status is immediate; if FlyFy propagation exceeds 60 seconds, SRE/Guide owner is paged and the user receives a truthful next update at least every 15 minutes until complete. Third-party assistance has provider-specific ETA and never delays FlyFy completion;
- branch clarification is synchronous; if compliance evaluation is temporarily unavailable, owner/next update appear immediately and user input remains local. Handoff failure never forces account creation or loses local draft; support escalation for a verified orphan claim begins ≤15 minutes;
- accessibility evidence failure blocks the release candidate immediately; owning surface team acknowledges ≤1 working day, remediation has explicit due, and no deadline/exception can convert FAILED or missing evidence to APPROVED;
- release dependency catalog drift opens an incident ≤ 5 minutes; a blocked release report names exact action/scope/owner/fallback immediately. Consumer/right-preserving fallback remains available within its own SLA and no cross-programme dependency exception may silently waive a hard predicate;
- consumer complaint receipt: немедленно; routing/acknowledgement p95 ≤ 1 часа и всегда не позже применимого legal/contract deadline; каждое unresolved case имеет due_at/next_update_at, а ADR disclosure/referral появляется при applicable deadlock без дополнительного support request;
- complaint resolution proposal decision receipt: немедленно; accepted/unconditional remedy dispatch p95 ≤ 15 минут, owner completion имеет применимый legal/financial deadline и next_update_at; отсутствие receipt никогда не маскируется RESOLVED;
- ADR outcome ingestion/acknowledgement p95 ≤ 1 часа; AWAITING_PARTY_ACCEPTANCE сохраняет statutory/reasonable reflection deadline; только ACCEPTED/BINDING_FINAL remedy запускается p95 ≤ 15 минут и исполняется не позже authority/legal deadline; DECLINED/ExitADR не считается NONCOMPLIANT;
- ExitADR platform intent receipt создаётся немедленно; external dispatch p95 ≤ 15 минут. Delivery/body-received/acknowledgement меняют receipt_effect/EFFECTIVE только по ADRWithdrawalRule и recognised-channel evidence, иначе остаются EVIDENCE_ONLY/UNRESOLVED и DISPATCHED/ACK_UNKNOWN с next_update_at. ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED запускает automated authoritative lookup ≤ 5 минут и hard human/Legal escalation ≤ 15 минут; сохраняется platform-intent evidence, но external filing/limitation/tolling deadline не объявляется сохранённым без rule reconciliation;
- superseding ADRExternalOrderResolution materializes the corrected primary state and live intent+outbox p99≤5m. Intent commit→exact publication-receipt application is p95≤5m/p99≤15m; warning at 10m, page at 15m and hard Legal/Ops escalation at 30m. Before 30m `next_update_at` is never more than 15 minutes away; after hard breach it refreshes at least hourly and sooner than any legal deadline. Timeout/ACK loss may enter `PUBLICATION_RECONCILING` only for an existing attempted intent, never for a legacy missing-intent case, never fabricates PUBLISHED and never rolls back tracker/rights;
- каждая superseding reclassification повышает оба epochs, отзывает unstarted authorities, supersede-ит incompatible obligations/assessments/deficits/plans, добавляет binding к тому же lookup root и p99 ≤ 5 минут публикует complete projection set. Started-without-actual не создаёт item; factual `ACTUAL_EFFECTS_CONFIRMED` materializes only allocated current items. Reserve/Mark synchronous CAS остаётся gate, fencing event p99 ≤ 1 минуты — только propagation;
- каждый stop request/binding имеет owner/due/next/absolute SLA; receipt target p95 ≤ 5 минут, hard escalation ≤ 15 минут. Carry-forward не сбрасывает age. Pending без factual found даёт RevokedAuthorityCheck=CHECKING; factual found даёт EFFECT_FOUND даже при pending_count>0; ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT только по full closure;
- lookup automated target ≤ 5 минут. Новое binding/reopen немедленно bump-ит claim+binding-set versions/clears lease; stricter active deadline применяется без age reset. Identity/validity/incident/allocation/manual conflict acknowledgement p95 ≤ 1 рабочего дня, daily update after breach; harmful/final actions remain fenced;
- factual no-effect→found→retraction→found, finality reopen, MERGE/SPLIT/allocation/net change и FULFILLED→ASSESSMENT_PENDING/PARTIAL/NONE recompute result/assessment/deficit/claim/item/case/execution-control refs/full projection set p99 ≤ 5 минут. For the `ADR-STATE-01` external-order path, corrected tracker+intent/outbox commit and notice publication are separate SLIs governed by the canonical p99≤5m and p95≤5m/p99≤15m plus 10/15/30-minute escalation policy above; notification failure keeps `PUBLICATION_PENDING` and never rolls back the tracker;
- valid PENDING_INPUTS publishes ASSESSMENT_PENDING p95 ≤ 1 минуты after detection with owner/missing inputs/due/next/absolute due; new complete input triggers ASSESSED recompute p99 ≤ 5 минут. Pending next update не реже одного рабочего дня и до меньшего legal deadline; any deficit/finality during pending is incident. Equivalent/modified/new successor preserves unmet_since immediately; BLOCKED/PROVISIONAL review target ≤ 15 минут for deadline-bearing action;
- projection-set commit after any authoritative input p95 ≤ 1 минуты, p99 ≤ 5 минут; mixed/skew/missing-manifest detection p99 ≤ 30 секунд, resync hard escalation ≤ 15 минут. Assessment/deficit/contribution/claim-disposition projection lag >5 минут блокирует COMPLIED;
- GlobalEffectReassessment normal convergence p95 ≤ 5 минут, hard escalation ≤ 15 минут; MANUAL_RECOVERY owner acknowledgement ≤ 30 минут. Execution-control prepared-token invalidation restarts coordinator p99 ≤ 30 секунд; external-unreserved after convergence opens new reassessment/corrected notice p99 ≤ 5 минут. External-unreserved/FROZEN acknowledgement ≤ 15 минут, Finance/Legal plan ≤ 1 рабочего дня, user update at least daily; scope stays conservative/frozen until signed terminal disposition;
- late discovery создаёт signed InterveningOrderAssessmentManifest + current-order item/skip edge p99 ≤ 5 минут; concurrent-order CAS retry либо missing/invalid range получает hard escalation ≤ 15 минут без stale-plan execution;
- ADREffectRemediationCase получает first safe status/intent ≤ 15 минут, automated lookup ≤ 5 минут, human acknowledgement p95 ≤ 1 рабочего дня и applicable absolute due. OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, unresolved identity/validity/EffectExecutionIncident/allocation/global/exposure и MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED получают next update не реже одного рабочего дня; item CLOSED→REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED→REOPENED и case RESOLVED→OPEN/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN сохраняют prior receipt, immediate corrected tracker и отдельно доказуемый notice-publication status;
- respondent draft/submit/info platform acknowledgement немедленно; per-attachment scan status p95 ≤ 5 минут, quarantine cure path issued ≤ 5 минут and safe answer never discarded. Where FlyFy dispatches externally, attempt schedules immediately after accepted safe content, dispatch p95 ≤ 15 минут or before earlier external deadline; UNRESOLVED/FAILED starts authoritative lookup ≤ 5 минут and human/urgent direct-body escalation ≤ 15 минут. Direct-body receipt records EVIDENCE_ONLY immediately and verifies p95 ≤ 15 минут where adapter supports lookup; it suppresses duplicate dispatch only after safe verification;
- respondent disclosure request receipt немедленно, triage p95 ≤ 1 часа, decision/partial/upheld/NEEDS_INFO p95 ≤ 1 рабочего дня or earlier than response deadline, appeal acknowledgement immediate; no rule-approved tolling means external deadline unchanged and assisted-response owner assigned ≤ 15 минут. ADR decision/ExitADR/challenge receipt немедленный; comprehension/support escalation и inaccessible-channel fallback измеряются отдельно;
- BODY_RULE_CONFLICT блокирует новые automatic referrals affected integration p99 ≤ 5 минут после detection. Existing entitled party немедленно получает ExitADR path; new user — approved alternative/manual route, PLATFORM_INTENT_RECEIPT(EVIDENCE_ONLY), absolute external deadline и assisted handoff, но не ложное подтверждение внешней подачи;
- privacy request receipt/submitted_at: немедленно до verification; proportional verification first response ≤ 1 рабочего дня и никогда не продлевает statutory response clock;
- adverse privacy response compiles only after a current external-remedy determination; official supervisory/judicial contact validation runs daily and on source change. Broken/stale route opens incident≤5 minutes, assigns Legal/Privacy owner≤15 minutes and publishes corrected downloadable response hard max24 hours without finalizing/closing the underlying request or resetting its statutory clock;
- consent-withdrawal authority: automatic verification result/next step p95 ≤ 1 минуты, human/accessibility path acknowledgement ≤ 1 рабочего дня; при подтверждении отзыва через VERIFIED authority её consume и withdrawal receipt/effective_at создаются одной синхронной операцией без DSAR wait;
- source review overdue: escalation в день просрочки.

Пользователь видит target, а не внутренний percentile.

### 18.3 Product metrics

Critical-flow metrics below are versioned `ProductMetricDefinition` artifacts. Completion numerator comes only from authoritative domain receipt, never analytics click; each matching `RolloutCohortGate` pins denominator, exclusions, supported client/accessibility strata, minimum production/representative sample, query/test digest, baseline/target/window and accountable owner. Labels contain no raw case reason, address/contact value, corporate size evidence or official-match data.

| Metric/cohort artifact | Funnel and quality evidence | Zero-tolerance guard |
|---|---|---|
| `metric:GUIDE-UNIVERSAL-ACCOUNT-01`, `cohort:GUIDE-UNIVERSAL-ACCOUNT-01` — `COHORT_OBSERVABLE` | professional entry by existing/new user→common auth→same-account consumer and guide surfaces; completion/time/comprehension split by entry/auth/client/locale/accessibility without cross-account identity joins | separate professional account, exclusive account type, `/register-guide`, global guide role/status authority, lost tourist data or weak-proof account merge = 0 |
| `metric:GUIDE-WORKSPACE-ENABLEMENT-01`, `cohort:GUIDE-WORKSPACE-ENABLEMENT-01` — `COHORT_OBSERVABLE` | explicit confirmation→one OPEN workspace→first editable private profile/draft→contextual preflight; archive/reopen/close impact comprehension, latency and recovery | duplicate workspace/draft effect, KYC/certificate/merchant-tax before private draft, workspace as public authority, archive implicit unpublish/cancel or reopen auto-publication = 0 |
| `metric:GUIDE-POST-AUTH-INTENT-01`, `cohort:GUIDE-POST-AUTH-INTENT-01` — `COHORT_OBSERVABLE` | entry intent→auth existing/new/cancel/switch/restart→registry-ordered owner destination→idempotent effect lookup; return success target ≥99.9% and at most one confirmation to private draft | lost/wrong-account/replayed intent, arbitrary redirect, mandatory tourist-preference detour, PII/legal data, wrong owner/cross-store write, incomplete plan, false no-effect or duplicate workspace/draft/membership = 0 |

Acknowledgement/cancel/publish conversion is never an optimization target by itself; informed safe exit is counted as a valid resolved journey. Promotion evaluates reachability, comprehension, errors/recovery and absence of dark pattern, not forced continuation.

- refund/reconciliation backlog.

Named observability catalog below is mandatory, versioned and registered in `RequirementArtifactRegistry`; a prose mention or a wildcard does not satisfy a release gate. Every alert carries only opaque identifiers, exact affected partition/action, first observed time, current generation, safe automated effect, owner and a link to the corresponding runbook. Aggregate health cannot hide a failing market, legal scope, client family or dependency member.

## 19. Runbooks и production operations

Обязательные runbooks:

- `rb:guide-universal-account`: disable legacy guide-only signup/account conversion and role/status authority, preserve common auth plus consumer access, inventory duplicate-account signals without auto-merge, route strong-proof recovery/correction and verify no tourist data/history loss before re-enable;
- `rb:guide-workspace-enablement`: reconcile idempotency outcomes/current pointer, reject duplicate or forbidden transition, restore private drafts/history, inspect archive/closure obligation manifest and fence any public command incorrectly derived from workspace; never set global approval manually;
- `rb:guide-post-auth-intent`: revoke compromised/replayed continuation generations, block non-allowlisted redirects, verify current kind→ordered-owner plan, reconcile each guide/excursion/organization owner receipt through the corresponding individually named §6.27 edge outcome API, never fabricate no-effect after OWNER_COMMITTING, preserve auth-cancel/local data, issue a linked one-use successor only after account preview and never copy intent to another account silently;
- `rb:guide-persona-isolation`: stop only erroneous action-domain/effect consumers, restore tourist/rights capabilities from authoritative owners, distinguish guide restriction from AccountAccess incident, invalidate decisions derived from UI/workspace/token role and issue scoped correction/notices without broadening access;
- `rb:regional-failover-and-failback`: reject unsupported v2 topology; fence source before target promotion; require fresh READY rights routes, complete owner/no-dual-writer manifests and a compatible `receipt_ui_state × receipt_class × effect` triple; preserve monotonic epochs through failback or immutable `MANUAL_RECOVERY_REQUIRED`;
- `rb:regional-rights-continuity`: restore each route through its `TESTED→READY` lifecycle, keep accountless rights independently available, preserve `NONE/NONE` or the last compatible receipt pair, and never upgrade local/platform/external evidence into a domain commit or legal effect;
- `rb:receipt-trust-drift`: fence only affected dependent effects; reconcile producer issuance attempt and exactly one sequence leaf, checkpoint root/proof and consumer membership; an overdue/forked proof stays fenced and is never “refreshed” into `INCLUDED`; preserve independent read/status/rights;
- `rb:receipt-key-compromise-and-reconciliation`: mark the key compromised, advance the consumer-fence epoch, inventory sequence→terminal leaf→checkpoint proof→membership, require every consumer acknowledgement by the 15/30/60-second policy, issue only source-proven correction and close from the complete signed manifest; no asserted issue time or fabricated void resolves uncertainty;
- `rb:telemetry-schema-drift-and-quarantine`: physically drop unknown paths and disable the exact optional emitter before normal persistence whenever owner-local admission is absent/stale/revoked; owner admission/enforcement reaches a verified terminal p99≤5s and hard30s, disposition outcome hard5m, and restoration requires current classified paths plus signed owner receipts; “mark unverified” without containment is forbidden;
- `rb:telemetry-pii-leak-and-containment`: isolate the exact sink within p99≤5s/hard30s, preserve metadata-only evidence without copying the leaked value into alerts/tickets, invoke Security/Privacy incident response, enforce deletion/restriction/hold and processor/recipient duties, rotate pseudonymization keys where applicable, and close only after owner disposition reaches a source-proven terminal within hard5m plus verified replica/backup disposition;
- `rb:precheck-handoff-crypto-broker`: prove persisted authorization→started receipt→outbound order and guide receipt issuer, reconcile seal or guide same-key outcome within 1s/p99≤5s, enforce warning15s/page30s/PREVIEW-hard30s/COMMIT-hard60s, reject post-Start cancel/expire/replay and duplicate Commit, deny BFF body/crypto access, rotate scoped cookie/KEK/capability, and prove egress/zeroization while preserving local/no-account. It does not handle a detected secret leak unless broker anomaly also exposed one;
- `rb:adr-corrected-notice-reconcile`: distinguish nonterminal pre-intent reconciliation, signed `NO_NOTICE_REQUIRED`, durable `MANUAL_LEGAL_REQUIRED` and post-intent publication; preserve earliest/lower-bound age, tracker and reflection window. Verify determination receipt or manual case/owner/due before terminal copy; a later manual decision creates an age-preserving successor. Replay only the same idempotency key or query outcome; apply only exact publication receipt; enforce p95≤5m/p99≤15m, warning/page/hard at 10/15/30m and ≤15m-then-hourly user updates; never fabricate intent/receipt/PUBLISHED, show generic pending on a terminal or reset age;
- official source changed;
- erroneous rule activated;
- mandatory legal copy missing/wrong locale/version, включая internal-deadline remedy fallback и external evidence-only submission disclosure;
- registry outage;
- projection stream gap/resync storm;
- requirement complete-set/cardinality corruption or newly added rule not invalidating decisions; block affected ALLOW, rebuild manifest/evaluations and prove distinct assignment/segment coverage before reopen;
- GuidePresenceAllocation cross-resource double-book/timezone/buffer/offline-consume conflict; fence starts, reconcile one schedule epoch, preserve privacy and offer alternate guide/time/route;
- responsibility owner acceptance self-assignment/reject/revoke/timeout or organization/site/FlyFy obligation mismatch; preserve draft, revoke stale decisions and offer current lawful alternative;
- declaration/verification projection gap, holder mismatch, evidence reuse revoke, organization roster/self-escalation/last-admin/transfer/recovery or affiliation invite token/scanner/replay incident;
- permit quota oversubscription/orphan reservation/CONSUME_PENDING reconciliation; insurance aggregate/layer/currency/claims freshness defect; cross-border assertion expiry/revoke;
- remuneration source/component drift, activity/site/boundary taxonomy reclassification and affected excursion reassessment;
- `rb:remuneration-source-drift`: fence affected publish/booking, inventory every expected source, rebuild one coherent manifest, revoke stale gratuitous decisions and notify without losing draft;
- offline trusted-time/reboot/backup/keystore failure and 24/7 assisted replacement/cancel/remedy fallback for enabled market;
- typed public disclosure forbidden-field/subtype leak, stale revoke/expiry or public-surface fallback; remove only affected projection within cutoff, notify affected users and rebuild exact subtype from allowlisted current facts;
- sensitive channel enabled/byte accepted without disposal-or-stronger authority, authorised legacy triage/deletion overdue, metadata-only authority-resolution overdue, invalid/late hold, key deletion failure or prohibited OCR/AI/generic-review access; stop ingress/access, obtain/validate exact authority before any object+key disposition and issue privacy incident/deletion receipts;
- old-client unsafe command/universal-certificate compatibility regression;
- SignificantDecisionInventory orphan/epoch drift, COPPA audience/VPC invalidation, biometric pre-capture, SpecialCategory ingress/triage/object-key deletion/minimised-assertion/revoke breach or background-screening chronology defect;
- CapacityLaw UNKNOWN/CONFLICTED and ExistingFundsCapacityDisposition overdue/amount mismatch; preserve payable ledger, route lawful settlement/restitution and prohibit forfeiture;
- sensitive notification/lock-screen/email disclosure; revoke content template, preserve durable inbox notice and perform privacy incident assessment;
- `rb:notification-privacy-delivery`: stop unsafe external dispatch, preserve/rebuild durable publication, classify provider/device/read/escalation separately, reconcile every intent and issue corrected generic notice;
- stale edge/CDN public offer, purge failure или external de-index request;
- credential mass revocation;
- jurisdiction boundary defect;
- compliance service outage;
- payment succeeded but booking unconfirmed;
- financial command expired/drifted between outbox and PSP, contract-formation mismatch;
- delayed/replayed SCA, provider session expiry/cancel race и LATE_AUTHORIZED/LATE_CAPTURED compensation;
- ContractFormationObservation не materialized из-за booking/broker outage;
- financial journal imbalance/duplicate economic event, PSP-bank-subledger reconciliation break, suspense и dispute/chargeback deadline;
- partial financial consistency-envelope commit или financial/booking RPO 0 replica incident;
- lost booking-attempt create response/duplicate-attempt suspicion;
- identity provider callback forgery/replay, key rotation failure или reconciliation backlog;
- CanonicalPersonSubjectBinding second-account evasion/false merge/split: freeze only affected actions, obtain strong proof/maker-checker, rebuild scoped decisions, restore incorrect restrictions and preserve no-enumeration;
- payment-role/funds-flow/PSP configuration drift, client-funds/safeguarding incident и sanctions/KYB escalation;
- indirect-tax rate/invoice/credit-note defect;
- payout hold/processing/failed aging, ledger mismatch, appeal/release и rail outage;
- payout-account onboarding/update stuck, suspected destination takeover, notification/cooldown/revert failure;
- payout-account close/recovery: freeze close on incomplete inventory, preserve payable/receipts, reconcile processing/returns, create lawful remaining-funds disposition and restore read-only/former-account access;
- scheduled payout blocked after logout, stale mandate/readiness или service-authority failure;
- late payout return/reversal, superseding receipt и alternative-rail recovery;
- tourist cancellation/refund quote defect или provider-notice backlog;
- cancellation/complaint AssistedDeadlineCase: urgent owner handoff, downloadable bundle/account recovery, user external-receipt EVIDENCE_ONLY verification, duplicate-dispatch suppression and corrected legal-effect notice without false tolling;
- `rb:external-intake-recovery-authority`: keep original deadline/case, apply uniform anti-enumeration response, revoke leaked/stale generations, offer proportional accessible verification, resume only exact permitted operations and reconcile every exchange/tombstone;
- consumer complaint receipt/routing/deadline, stale resolution proposal/decision, remedy-owner failure, subject-kind state-chain violation, remedy-finality invalidation/reopen/corrected-notice или early-close defect;
- ADR statutory withdrawal entitlement/party-scope/body-rule conflict, recognised-intake/receipt-effect/tolling/deadline defect, ExitADR dispatch/effect/negative/ACK_UNKNOWN, ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED outcome race либо superseding reclassification/primary reopening/corrected-notice failure;
- ADR authority/obligation/plan fencing: stale Reserve/Mark, direct authority→result, wrong discriminated target, FENCE_BYPASS recovery, conservative STARTED_RESIDUAL after cross-service crash and no-stale-plan procedure;
- ADR revoked-action check: membership/count mismatch, lost carry-forward, forged receipt, factual-found/allocation divergence or false ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT; reconstruct evidence generations/oldest age, recompute projection set, never set status manually;
- ADR lookup binding/lease: cloned root, lost purpose/SLA, stale worker commit or finality reopen; bump claim+binding versions, clear lease, preserve age, replay evidence idempotently and recompute all affected axes;
- ADR fact/identity/incident: 0/1/N source reconciliation, alias collision/false merge, AttemptEffectPlan cardinality/amount violation, collateral correction, validity retraction/reopen, maker/checker and safe interim protection;
- ADR fulfilment/contribution/deficit: PENDING_INPUTS/ASSESSMENT_PENDING versus corrupt-resync diagnosis, missing owner/next/absolute due, illegal slot result/deficit/finality CTA; stale allocation/claim disposition, conservation/double credit/rounding, wrong-only/full+extra, negative/positive excess, equivalent/modified/new successor with unmet_since and BLOCKED/ELIGIBLE/PROVISIONAL handling, late original after compensation and FULFILLED→ASSESSMENT_PENDING/PARTIAL/NONE corrected complaint/referral reopen;
- global reassessment: partial REFERRAL/EXECUTION_CONTROL_SCOPE commit, MANUAL_RECOVERY, newly affected member, graph mutation during COMMITTING, prepared-token invalidation and no final action until every exact manifest receipt converges;
- execution-control exposure: owner/action-class oversubscription, stale release, external-unreserved discovery/no-effect/already-accounted proof invalidation, PlanExposureAttribution/double-subtracted evidence/negative-net headroom, cross-cell epoch or REOPENED_OVER_CAP_FROZEN; block Reserve, preserve safety ingest, reconcile provider/ledger/canonical attribution, obtain signed Legal/Finance disposition, no automatic clawback, publish user-safe status;
- ADR three-projection publication: exact-three member/hash/commit skew, missing snapshot/compat misuse/stale offline regression; buffer/resync exact input generations and issue one atomic corrected notice without manually editing projections;
- ADR late-discovery/repeated-flip: InterveningOrder range/skip-edge/CAS, item CLOSED→REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED→REOPENED, case/obligation reopen, successor/current CTA, stale recovery/debit and no lost/double compensation;
- guide/respondent ADR: notice/redaction; submission revision/per-file quarantine/cure; PLATFORM_ONLY/DISPATCHING/UNRESOLVED external delivery and direct-body receipt verification/no duplicate; disclosure partial/upheld/NEEDS_INFO/appeal/deadline treatment; decision/ExitADR/challenge/ASSESSMENT_PENDING/accessibility fallback/privacy incident and durable receipt recovery;
- ADR procedure/binding/acceptance/reflection defect, outcome/remedy implementation, challenge/noncompliance или dispute-round finality defect;
- stale remediation proposal/decision race или unlawful silence-as-consent;
- merchant/tax readiness stale/dead-end/purpose-mixing или invalid assertion reuse;
- unassessed/prohibited AI use, vendor/model material change, AI security/fundamental-rights incident и emergency AI disable/fallback;
- active booking became non-compliant;
- reviewer account compromise;
- PII breach;
- appeal overturn requires multi-owner/version-safe reinstatement while a newer restriction/revoke/delete occurs;
- `rb:manual-review-recovery`: fence expired leases/reviewer access, reconstruct immutable evidence/decision generations, reassign with maker/checker and keep the user informed without fabricating outcome;
- `rb:appeal-restoration-fencing`: restore only overturned exact scopes after complete owner receipts, preserve newer independent restriction/revoke/delete and issue blocked/corrected notice with owner/absolute due;
- P2B terms change/termination notice delivery, invalid activation, clarification failure или incomplete capability/data reinstatement;
- DSA statement-of-reasons submission/receipt backlog;
- `rb:dsa-art18-routing-reporting`: re-evaluate every conjunctive Article 18 predicate and hosting role, stop wrong-recipient/excess payload, dispatch idempotently to the competent authority and reconcile without guilt inference;
- `rb:dsa-trader-public-disclosure`: remove forbidden/stale public fields within cutoff, preserve private trace correction, rebuild only the closed Article 30 public subset and notify affected trader/users;
- `rb:dsa-article30-profile-promotion-gate`: hide only affected FlyFy EU profile projections, purge origin/search/CDN, verify exact surface-purpose, Section-4/trader/readiness/public-contact and field/source/surface persistence-warning acknowledgement manifests, preserve safe exit/private workspace/unrelated markets/bookings/rights and reopen only from a signed visibility receipt; never promise third-party deletion;
- `rb:dsa-article30-retention-deletion`: recompute relationship end plus six calendar months, prevent early deletion, execute/reconcile due purpose deletion and preserve/delete independent-purpose copies only under their own schedules;
- Article 32 direct buyer notification/public fallback publication and reconciliation;
- privacy request deadline or 72-hour breach clock at risk;
- `rb:gdpr-processing-restriction`: keep exact scope restricted, stop new non-storage work, isolate unconfirmed processors, reconcile in-flight/owner manifests, revoke an Article23 authority lacking the current complete exact determination, permit only exact one-use exceptions, publish pre-lift notice and lift only after all grounds/prepared owners clear; separately reconcile Article19 recipients and user chronology;
- `rb:precheck-privacy-and-coppa`: disable dynamic submit while keeping bundled static help/coarse local draft; prove under-13/decline zero network/SDK activity, inspect CDN/WAF/proxy/app telemetry, isolate/delete leaked or overdue data under current authority, restore purpose/basis/retention/audience/COPPA/notice/time-basis/date/unknown-branch pins and force stale-result recheck; old clients cannot render misleading no-PII copy;
- consent withdrawal suppression gap или processing after effective_at;
- accountless consent-withdrawal authority enumeration/verification dead-end, replay/cross-scope attempt, expiry storm или consumed-without-effective receipt;
- consent presentation token/copy mismatch, invalid grant provenance, cross-controller withdrawal, bundled/preselected consent или legacy grant mistakenly activated;
- privacy-rights verification dead-end or adverse response missing current official supervisory complaint/judicial-remedy route for locked/former/accountless/representative user;
- unauthorised Article 10 upload/access/vendor disclosure;
- platform-work adverse action without valid human_decision_id;
- EAA non-conformity and authority corrective action;
- emergency market/action shutdown;
- `rb:mandatory-legal-copy`: block only gated/adverse action with missing/invalid copy, keep statutory/remedy intake reachable, compile complete parameterized fallback, reproject current surfaces and purge stale edge copies;
- `rb:scoped-dependency-promotion-block`: freeze the release candidate, resolve unregistered/prose action IDs, duplicate multi-action expansion, invalid criticality or provider-without-trace edge, regenerate scoped member/fallback catalogs, resolve orphan/unknown predicate/interface digest/over-broad partition, rerun exact fallback/isolation tests and create a new signed dependency receipt; never waive `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` or broaden its scope;
- rollback and post-incident communication;
- critical durable-inbox/channel delivery outage with separate undelivered escalation.

Следующие stable-ID runbooks обязательны как отдельные исполнимые artifacts, а не как aliases на общий incident handbook:

| Runbook | Detection and safe default | Recovery and closure evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `rb:regional-failover-and-failback` | v2 profile/route/action/owner/fence/residency/objective or receipt-semantic gap; fence exact writes, retain signed evidence, keep rights routes | execute exact step commands, prove source fence/approved target/owner+route manifests/no dual writer and valid receipt matrix; reconcile objectives and epochs through failback/manual terminal |
| `rb:regional-rights-continuity` | exact route not READY/fresh or local/ingress/external evidence shown authoritative | restore/test route by operation/access mode/destination, preserve intent, record domain success only at owner commit, publish owner/next update and prove writes outage cannot remove rights |
| `rb:receipt-trust-drift` | issuance sequence/leaf, proof/membership, signature/schema/snapshot/epoch/replay mismatch; fence only dependent new effects | reconcile producer terminal leaf, checkpoint proof and consumer membership/fence; refresh bounded snapshot and prove rights/status independence |
| `rb:receipt-key-compromise-and-reconciliation` | compromised key or forged/backdated receipt; emergency deny epoch and exact consumers fence | enforce 15/30/60 deadlines, collect consumer-fence manifest, inventory sequence→terminal leaf→checkpoint proof→membership, correct only from source evidence or retain unresolved history, rotate key and close only with signed complete evidence |
| `rb:telemetry-schema-drift-and-quarantine` | admission gap/direct bypass/unregistered path or manifest drift; drop before write and disable exact optional emitter by hard30s | owner applies physical reject/isolated quarantine, governance consumes receipt, policy is corrected and canaries prove gate+approved fields; no uncontained “unverified” closure |
| `rb:telemetry-pii-leak-and-containment` | prohibited direct/content value, raw-identifier scope/retention breach, metric label or product join; isolate exact sink without copying value into alerts | execute Security/Privacy incident, processor/recipient and deletion/restriction/hold/backup dispositions, rotate keyed pseudonym material if needed and close from complete owner receipts plus no-value/fingerprint telemetry probes |
| `rb:precheck-handoff-crypto-broker` | seal/authorization/start/outcome/egress/persistence/BFF-deny anomaly; preserve local result, fence only optional exact generation | query seal/guide same-key outcome within1s, respect15/30/60 clocks, never repeat Commit/fabricate no-effect, rotate scoped material and prove BFF denial/egress/zeroization before accessible retry/no-account |
| `rb:adr-corrected-notice-reconcile` | legacy case, terminal determination/manual-case binding or attempted intent is stale/mismatched; corrected tracker/rights stay available with truthful nonterminal/no-notice/manual/post-intent copy | verify signed no-notice receipt or durable manual case, create an age-preserving successor after legal decision, recover inputs then atomically create intent, or replay/query the same notification key; p95/p99 and10/15/30m escalation, ≤15m/hourly updates, exact receipt only, no cross-write/duplicate/PUBLISHED fabrication |
| `rb:authorization-fence-stuck` | fence drain, COMMIT_STARTED/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or missing/non-terminal owner outcome age; close only exact affected key set to Reserve/Mark | verify owner-row-before-Mark; expire/revoke only proved unstarted through coordinator CAS and signed closure applied to the owner row; require signed immutable EFFECT_COMMITTED/NO_EFFECT_FINAL for started, verify exact terminal cross-reference and activate only after zero-unresolved manifest |
