`ADR-STATE-01` invokes `rb:adr-finality-reopen` for any false/unrelated reopen or invalidated-fulfilment incident, alongside its corrected-notice reconciliation runbook; the original receipt and user rights remain preserved throughout.

Каждый runbook содержит owner, severity, detection, safe default, customer communication, legal contact, recovery steps и evidence for closure. Tabletop exercises проводятся до launch и не реже двух раз в год.

## 20. Ключевой risk register

| Риск | Ранний сигнал | Основной control | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ложный ALLOW из-за неполного research | coverage mismatch/appeal | scoped memo, counsel, golden cases, fail closed | Legal |
| Ложный block и потеря гидов | false-block/drop-off | precheck, explanation, appeal, usability analytics | Product |
| Универсальный сертификат вернулся через rule/client/migration | unnecessary-request/old-client mismatch | exact RequirementDefinition, compatibility no-mapping, 100% legacy reconciliation | Compliance + Mobile |
| Неполный requirement set или количественный double count дал ALLOW | manifest/count/hash or staffing mismatch | complete-set gate, distinct assignment/segment proof, property/race tests | Compliance Engineering |
| Обязанность назначена другой стороне без согласия | self-accept/timeout/support spike | signed owner acceptance/invite, authority verification, alternative path | Resource owner + Legal |
| Представитель организации получил лишние права, сам себя повысил или организация осталась без администратора | roster/ABAC/CAS/last-admin/recovery alert | authoritative scoped membership generations, step-up, maker/checker, last-admin guard, durable notices/audit and accountless recovery | Organization Product + Security |
| Приглашение/recovery требует уже существующего membership либо failover вернул отозванные права | bootstrap dead end, authority widening, RPO/current-pointer/revocation gap | self-bound invite authority, accountless exact-delta recovery authority, command discriminator, RPO0 roster and signed failover reopen | Organization Engineering + SRE + Security |
| Гид одновременно назначен на несовместимые экскурсии | overlap/stale schedule epoch | GuidePresenceAllocation single writer, buffers, cross-service reservation | Excursion Engineering |
| Permit quota превышена из-за off-platform consumption | external/local remaining mismatch | quota-authority mode, external reservation/proof/reconciliation, fail closed | Permit Ops + Legal |

Risk register пересматривается на каждом stage gate. High residual risk требует named executive acceptance, expiry и compensating controls; legal prohibition и privacy/security critical не могут быть waived продуктовой командой.

## 21. Production Definition of Done

Реализация завершена только когда доказано всё ниже.

Для каждого пункта DoD release evidence bundle содержит owner, artifact/report URL, environment, проверенную версию, дату, reviewer и результат. Утверждение без воспроизводимого evidence считается невыполненным.

### Legal and policy

- Market Operating Model ADR подписан для каждого launch market;
- legal authority DAG, source/current-version register, deterministic LocalCounselRequirementDecision and PolicyRelease compile/simulate/impact/atomic activation/rollback evidence are complete for every enabled action;
- каждый enabled CoverageScope имеет active approved CoverageAssertion;
- RemunerationProfile expected-source registry, coherent complete manifest, every PRESENT/EXPLICIT_NONE proof, combinations/genuinely-gratuitous derivation, site/activity/boundary generations and exact serviceability/correction outcomes are counsel-approved and in golden corpus; missing/new/gapped source cannot yield gratuitous;
- negative conclusion документирован legal memo;
- DSA/DAC7/GDPR/consumer/P2B/package-travel applicability зафиксирована;
- Platform Work, EAA и Consumer ADR applicability/transposition зафиксированы;
- consumer complaint routing, clocks, respondent responsibility, unresolved-case disclosure и current ADR body/referral зафиксированы для каждого launch market;
- internal complaint resolution templates фиксируют remedy, legal effect/no-hidden-waiver, response/implementation deadlines и когда acceptance допустимо либо unconditional remedy исполняется без него;
- ADR procedure kind, advance disclosures, reasonable reflection, party-specific binding basis/acceptance, challenge/noncompliance и remedy implementation allocation зафиксированы для каждого applicable route;
- ADRWithdrawalRule и ADRDeadlineAssessment зафиксированы по каждому body/procedure: statutory/body source precedence, BOTH_PARTIES/CONSUMER_ONLY scope, allowed stages/no-justification, recognised intake channel, effect-versus-ack semantics, limitation/filing/tolling/fees, required next action и underlying-complaint effect;
- Article 9 proposed-solution statutory path не подавляется missing/conflicting body config; BODY_RULE_CONFLICT блокирует defective auto-referral, но сохраняет existing-party ExitADR и alternative/manual direct-body path с absolute deadline/assisted handoff, не выдавая platform intent за filing либо tolling;
- Article 12/national-law memo подтверждает для каждого P0 route, когда limitation continues/ends/resumes, какое evidence создаёт legal effect и что UNKNOWN отображается без юридического обещания;
- ADR effect-remediation policy по каждому remedy class определяет lawful retain/reversal/compensation basis, запрещает automatic consumer-benefit clawback и назначает legal/financial owner/deadline;
- ADR obligation policy по каждому market/remedy задаёт exact expected effect slots, partial accumulation, cap/rounding, contribution/allocation basis, implementation/reopen deadlines, lawful excess/negative correction handling и no-double-satisfaction rules;
- respondent procedural-rights matrix подтверждает notice, meaningful redacted disclosure and reasoned request/partial/upheld/appeal/reopen path, response/evidence opportunity, platform-intake versus recognised external-delivery effect, rule-based deadline treatment/direct-body fallback, confidentiality, party-specific ACCEPT/DECLINE/ExitADR/challenge, reasonable reflection and accessible fallback; privacy redaction never removes information essential to a fair response without review/remedy, а platform receipt не обещает tolling;
- AIUseCaseInventory полон; каждый enabled system/model version имеет current AIActAssessment, role/risk/date gate, prohibited-practice screening, vendor evidence, human oversight и tested fallback;
- base AI Act и Digital Omnibus publication/entry/applicable dates разделены; pending dates не активируются до Official Journal verification;
- каждый paid archetype имеет approved PaymentRegulatoryDetermination и IndirectTaxDetermination, совпадающие с live PSP account/funds-flow/merchant/tax configuration;
- licensed PSP/agent allocation, possession/control, safeguarding, SCA/3DS, AML/KYB/sanctions, chargeback/refund/payout и client-funds reconciliation подтверждены договором и production evidence;
- accounting map связывает каждое payment/refund/fee/tax/reserve/dispute/payout/return событие с balanced journal accounts по legal entity/currency и approved settlement/safeguarding treatment;
- supplier/deemed-supplier, place/time/rate/exemption, registration/filing, commission/withholding, invoice/receipt, rounding, refund/credit-note и retention подтверждены для каждого paid launch scope;
- layered DSA obligation matrix, Article 24 submission receipts и обе Article 32 ветки — direct notice и public/easily-accessible fallback — имеют content/delivery/publication/reconciliation evidence;
- DSA Article 18 memo and tests pin the exact hosting-role + suspected criminal offence + life/safety threat + PAST|CURRENT|LIKELY predicate, competent Member-State recipient, complete all-relevant-information-available-to-FlyFy manifest and no-guilt wording; every single-predicate negative sends no report, while unrelated/speculative information is not newly collected or included;
- Article 13 exact provider/service applicability, written designation/acceptance/powers/resources/competent-DSC notification, current public contact and Article 18 route binding are proven independently from other representative regimes. If the public contact is natural-person data, a separate current GDPR purpose/basis/notice/transfer/retention/DSAR generation and closed public projection are mandatory; consent is not used as a substitute for Article 6(1)(c), and Article 27 reuse is never inferred;
- Article 21 ODS routing and Article 21(5) cost disposition are independent controls: current certified-body choice and court/restoration rights remain available during Finance outage, while every cost result is derived only from an authenticated body outcome and the exhaustive statutory branch. Recipient liability defaults to zero, recipient-win reimbursement is complete, and no automatic debit/set-off exists;
- Article 24(1)(a) ODS statistics use the current official Article 15/24 template, exact legal calendar and complete source manifest. Every percentage metric is an exact `[0,1]` decimal fraction derived from pinned numerator/denominator with tested zero-denominator, rounding and HTML-percent/CSV-fraction parity. Publication/correction versions are immutable, no-PII, accessible and publicly retained for five years; reporting lag never blocks Article 20/21 rights or remedy execution;
- Article 42 is activated only by a formal current Commission designation for the exact legal entity and named service. Exactly one initial obligation is derived from Section-5 application and remains independent of recurring half-year windows; overlap requires an approved transition mapping. VLOP/VLOSE fields, distinct HR applicable-language and accuracy all-official-language manifests with complete qualification/training/support/methodology semantics, Member-State MAU, Article 34/35/37 audit set, Commission/DSC receipts, redactions, immutable corrections and all publication clocks are independently counsel-approved; no group flag or reporting outage changes product/user-right availability;
- Article 30 private TraderTraceabilityRecord is physically separated from the closed public (a)/(d)/(e) disclosure; authoritative relationship end, full six-calendar-month secure retention, due deletion receipt and independent DAC7/KYB purpose survival/deletion are proven for calendar edge cases;
- P2B terms/change flow доказывает durable medium, reasonable ≥15-day/longer adaptation notice, termination/waiver semantics, 30-day full-termination notice/exceptions, statement of reasons, meaningful facts clarification, capability/data restoration receipts и null-and-void prevention;
- DAC7 Platform/Activity/ExcludedSeller/ActiveSeller election gates собирают statutory due-diligence dataset для требуемых NonExcludedSeller до residence/ReportableSeller conclusion и report передаёт только validated ReportableSeller;
- применимый Platform Work adverse action невозможен без human_decision_id;
- future 2028/2029 ADR/package-travel transitions протестированы без преждевременной activation;
- Article10Applicability утверждён для каждого offence/background/Article-18 purpose; raw criminal-record evidence default-denied, minimized official assertions и safeguards проверены;
- EqualTreatment/MinorProtection/COPPA/BackgroundScreening/BiometricProcessing/SpecialCategoryProcessing/CapacityLaw each has a current one-owner assessment, fail-closed migration default, user-safe status, alert/runbook and exact trace row. Neutral age routing runs locally before dynamic precheck; an identified under-13 local-only branch produces zero network/telemetry/cookie/SDK/server receipt, and a primarily child-directed service cannot use mixed/general-audience discretion. The Rule's sole-support-for-internal-operations exception is separately closed to a persistent identifier as the sole COPPA personal-information category and enumerated internal operations. The FTC statement issued 2026-02-25 is modelled separately and only as nonbinding, withdrawable age-verification enforcement discretion for an otherwise COPPA-compliant eligible general/mixed-audience Relevant Operator: solely age verification, clear notice, reasonable accuracy, security, prompt deletion, written vendor assurances and every other stated condition; it is never an internal-operations exception, VPC substitute outside scope or general reuse basis. No screening, biometric capture or expected-sensitive byte collection/storage occurs before its full gate. Every generally available file channel is physically fenced before the first byte, including presigned/object-store paths; a current file-owned byte lease is required, revocation drains and fences admission, and legal hold uses the two-phase privacy-PREPARED → file-fenced → privacy-ACTIVE → file-HELD protocol. Deletion that wins first cannot be revived by hold, and no special-category OCR/reviewer/vendor access occurs outside the stronger exact condition;
- CancellationTermEnforceability and ExternalIntakeAuthority are approved for each enabled cancellation/complaint route; AssistedDeadlineCase/direct-recipient evidence and legal-effect semantics are tested without false filing/tolling;
- AssistedDeadlineRecoveryAuthority is counsel/privacy/security-approved for exact case operations; uniform pre-verification copy, proportional accessible verification, expiry/renew/revoke and original external deadline semantics are tested without existence disclosure or broader authority;
- каждый consent-based purpose имеет доказуемый Article 7 Grant: exact controller/purpose/copy, affirmative/distinguishable/freely-given choice, no unnecessary conditioning и equal-ease withdrawal; Article 9/22 explicit route принимает только qualifying receipt;
- rule change lifecycle и maker/checker работают;
- source freshness имеет owner и SLA;
- user wording не обещает абсолютную законность/безопасность, external filing, tolling или сохранение срока без current rule и authoritative receipt.

### Domain and architecture

- every person uses one universal UserAccount with baseline consumer capabilities; separate guide registration/account, exclusive `account_type`, global JWT guide authority and `guide_approved/rejected` account state are absent from command paths and compatibility output;
- GuideWorkspace is an additive guide-service resource tied to immutable `user_account_id`; one-current lifecycle/idempotency/successor constraints hold, private drafts require no professional documents and workspace/readiness/UI mode never authorize a public action;
- common signup consumes only a signed one-use allowlisted GuideOnboardingContinuation; pre-auth cancel/expiry and consume races are closed. Current registry maps every kind to ordered owner-local effects, auth never writes guide/excursion/organization stores, and all three individually named §6.27 edge receipts/outcome lookups prevent arbitrary redirect, cross-account/owner substitution, false no-effect and duplicate workspace/draft/membership;
- ActionDomainCatalog and resource-owner enforcement prove persona isolation: guide restriction has only exact guide effects, tourist and rights remain available, and both persona can be affected only by a separate current AccountAccess decision with its own notice/appeal;
- identity, personal credential, organization, organization representative membership, affiliation и permit разделены;
- organization-service is the sole authoritative representative-roster writer: every role/action/market/resource scope has a current verified-person-bound membership generation, closed invite/verification/active/suspend/revoke/expire lifecycle, step-up and maker/checker for material privilege change, no self-escalation, last-active-owner/admin continuity guard, durable notices/audit and proportional accountless transfer/recovery. Token role, email/domain control, historical signer, affiliation or identity check alone grants no organization authority;
- organization invitation, transfer, accountless recovery, recovery authority, legacy migration and failover reconciliation each have an exhaustive closed state machine, explicit terminal/successor rules and RPO 0 owner receipts. Privilege removal/fail-close and ordinary roster propagation use distinct SLO/alert thresholds, so a cosmetic propagation target can never mask a security-relevant revocation breach;
- declaration, EvidenceArtifact/ProfessionalEvidenceBinding, VerificationCase/Decision, VerificationAttestation/assertion and CredentialHolderBinding have separate single writers/current generations; public payload cannot mint verified fields and wallet cannot collect “just in case” files;
- RequirementDefinition supports Boolean and quantitative/cardinality formulas; complete definition/evaluation manifests, ResponsibilityAssignment+signed owner acceptance/invitation and GuidePresenceAllocation prove every distinct role/segment/time requirement before ALLOW;
- permit quota authority mode proves exclusive/external/owner allocation and reconciles off-platform use; current InsuranceCoverageAssertion proves limit basis/available aggregate/layers/form/tail/currency freshness; cross-border assertions remain purpose-separated;
- Workspace lifecycle is technically forbidden as qualification input; standalone profile, excursion listing and protected-title surfaces accept only their respective current typed public projection and enforce subtype allowlist/revoke cutoff;
- typed disclosure/ExplanationCopy renderer requires every discriminator-specific semantic input, rejects forbidden cross-subtype fields, literal reusable dates, unresolved placeholders/context-only standalone reuse, and reprojects current reads through immutable supersession without changing history;
- RemunerationProfile composition has one excursion-service writer, complete expected-source manifest/count/hash and signed composition receipt; source change/gap atomically invalidates dependent decisions before any stale free exemption is consumed;
- OfflineOccurrenceAuthorizationBundle and AssistanceCase are complete owner-local aggregates with one-time nonce/tombstone, device binding, local/server timestamps, multi-channel receipts and receipt-bound terminals; no API/admin path can force-start or call local intent RECEIVED;
- AssistedDeadlineRecoveryAuthority is owner-local, current-generation/single-use/exact-scope and available without account restoration; secret material is absent from URL/event/log/analytics and every stale/cross-case operation is fenced;
- NotificationDisclosureProfile, DurableInboxNotice, ChannelDeliveryAttempt, device evidence, acknowledgement and escalation have separate writers/evidence classes; mandatory publication precedes external dispatch and provider acceptance/escalation is never delivery;
- ManualReviewCase/lease/decision, RestrictionDecision, ComplianceAppeal and RestorationPlan/task generations are fenced, maker/checker and exact-scope; no terminal/restored state exists without complete current receipts;
- LaunchDependencyRegistry is committed from generated action/API/event/schema catalogs with bidirectional 100% coverage, exact contract digest, predicate result/owner and named fallback test; hard true blocks only mapped action/scope and missing evidence never evaluates false;
- `RUN_GUIDE_SERVICEABILITY_PRECHECK` depends only on branch correctness and precheck privacy, never on account or handoff. `CLAIM_ANONYMOUS_PRECHECK_DRAFT` separately requires current export, transport and handoff-state controls. Article 13 action members require both the current representative readiness generation and shared action fence; Article 24 and Article 42 reporting are explicitly asynchronous and never hard dependencies of complaint, ODS, booking, payment, restoration, reimbursement, privacy or safety commands;
- CapacityLaw/LegalCapacity separate new obligations from ExistingFundsCapacityDisposition; CREATE_OR_CHANGE_PAYOUT_MANDATE is capacity-gated while owed/scheduled settlement is never forfeited or indefinitely held;
- PayoutAccount CLOSED prerequisites, former/locked/deleted-account read-only recovery and reopen/new-destination/manual restitution preserve all balances/receipts;
- ClientCapabilityEnvelope is enforced for guide, cancellation/refund, payout and non-ADR effects; old clients cannot infer false terminal state or repeat an unknown financial command;
- aggregate ownership matrix доказана; shared DB/direct admin writes отсутствуют;
- decisions разделяют coverage, applicability и fulfilment;
- AuthorizeAction server-side и context-bound;
- DelegatedPrincipal, caller delegation и actor-substitution protections проверены;
- user-delegated decision содержит delegated_principal_hash/auth_context_version и проверяет active session/token/roles/scopes; service-owned action использует только purpose-bound authority и action-specific non-session epochs;
- authorization consumption атомарно, одноразово и replay-safe;
- stale/replayed authorization отклоняется;
- fact bundles immutable/replayable; independent contiguous projection_stream_version не создаёт false gap на sparse aggregate updates, а реальные gaps блокируют ALLOW и восстанавливаются checksummed CAS-fenced snapshot resync с durable buffer/N+1 replay без version regression;
- каждая action enforcement-matrix строка имеет contract/chaos evidence;
- publish и booking consistency доказаны;
- seat fencing, payment binding, verified webhooks, provider sessions и reconciliation доказаны;
- FinancialSubledger balanced/reversal-only и является financial source of truth; unique economic refs, dispute/chargeback aggregate, three-way PSP/bank reconciliation, suspense workflow, RPO 0 AZ failover и restore drill доказаны;
- provider inbox/receipt + operational financial transition + balanced journal/observation + outbox атомарны в одной payment DB transaction; partial transition невозможен, а booking/payment control records входят в RPO 0 tier;
- complaint/ADR RPO 0 tier содержит contiguous external-order/epoch, discriminated complaint/referral state chains, respondent submission/delivery/disclosure receipts, base obligation+subtype/manifest/plan, authority execution, factual result/discovery/task+binding, observations/instances/groups/lineages/net contributions/allocations/claim dispositions, assessments/deficits/incidents, identity/validity/cross-referral/global reassessment referral members, stop evidence, cases/items и exact-three projection-set manifests; в complaint DB находятся только signed execution-control refs/receipts;
- independent execution-control RPO 0 tier содержит typed scope epochs, reservation/start/consume/release/reopen, external-unreserved, PlanExposureAttribution, prepared-global-fence/freeze/reconciliation generations. Cross-tier failover barrier сверяет current epochs/tokens, owner/provider/ledger receipts and graph hashes; ни один tier не открывает Reserve/Mark/COMPLIED/CLOSED до reconciliation, а complaint outage не лишает execution-control отдельного HA/on-call;
- DisputeRound finality/reopen/pre-arbitration/arbitration и provisional/final postings доказаны; reserve/payout не освобождается преждевременно;
- BOOKING_COMMITTED/contract-formation trigger однозначен; local trigger атомарно создаёт ContractObligationRecord, а PSP trigger атомарно создаёт payment-owned ContractFormationObservation и гарантированно materializes original effective timestamp через outbox/reconciliation bridge;
- server-originated PSP side effect проверяет command authority/config/execute_before на provider boundary; PSP-hosted capability bound/short-lived, in-window delayed SCA проходит fresh final check, а after-cutoff/drifted result не commit-ит booking и компенсируется; post-obligation remedies не зависят от live user session;
- identity provider attempt binding, signed callback/authoritative lookup, replay defense, key rotation и reconciliation доказаны; client-only completion не создаёт assertion;
- booking create idempotency уникальна по tenant/stable subject/operation/client_request_id; versioned canonical hash, immutable tombstone и backward serializer migration сохраняют replay horizon; changed occurrence/quote под тем же key даёт conflict;
- PSP intent уникален на booking_attempt_id + payment_generation; каждая operation уникальна по provider account/payment aggregate/generation/operation kind/operation generation, partial refund — по refund generation;
- RemediationProposal/TouristRemedyDecision version/CAS/idempotency/supersession доказаны; молчание не создаёт consent и stale decision не выигрывает cancellation/refund race;
- ComplaintResolutionProposal/Decision version/CAS/idempotency/supersession доказаны; acceptance не inferred, unconditional remedy не требует клика, но ни один path не закрывается без authoritative COMPLIED receipt;
- ComplaintResolutionStateGeneration имеет subject_kind-specific transition constraints/one-current chain; fulfilment invalidation creates correlated historical REASSESSMENT_REQUIRED + current REMEDY_PENDING only for remedy-derived complaint/referral closure, preserves original receipt and never reopens withdrawal/decline/unrelated closure;
- ADRRespondentSubmission/attachments, ResponseDeliveryAttempt и DisclosureRequest имеют stable IDs, append-only revisions/current pointers, If-Match/idempotency, per-file quarantine, platform/external receipt separation, direct-body authoritative reconciliation/no duplicate dispatch, redaction appeal and rule-only deadline treatment; stale scan/decision and cross-party disclosure fail;
- единый ExitADR отделён от complaint withdrawal: на любой allowed stage он создаёт/продолжает orthogonal versioned attempt, а post-outcome атомарно добавляет linked WITHDRAW party receipt; dispatch/EFFECTIVE/REJECTED/NOT_EFFECTIVE/ACK_UNKNOWN, retry generation и concurrent outcome не дают lost receipt/early close;
- external sequence/effective-time resolver сохраняет outcome и withdrawal; equal/missing facts дают ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED и RECORDED_PENDING_EXTERNAL_ORDER evidence receipt. Новый authoritative input допускает superseding EFFECTIVE classification; complaint-service atomically commits primary reopening/realignment, reflection-window restoration and one corrected-notice intent+outbox, while notification publication and exact receipt application remain a separate idempotent saga;
- ADR_WITHDRAWN/CLOSED_NO_SETTLEMENT возможен только при rule-sufficient effect и current EFFECTIVE_WITHDRAWAL version; invariant primary/order mismatch равен нулю;
- ADRPlatformIntentReceipt/ADRDeadlineAssessment различают platform/dispatched/body/legal-effective timestamps, EVIDENCE_ONLY/LEGALLY_EFFECTIVE/UNRESOLVED и CONTINUES/ENDS_AT/RESUMES_AT/UNKNOWN; внешний срок не считается сохранённым из platform intent;
- enforceable `execution_obligation` supertable/composite key/natural-key current unique имеет ровно один RemedyObligation/EffectRemediationObligation subtype; duplicate concurrent create/idempotency and expected-current CAS proven. Manifests/slots/plans/assessments/deficits используют ordinary FK/deferred kind-target constraints. FulfilmentAssessmentGeneration PENDING_INPUTS publishes ASSESSMENT_PENDING with no slot result/deficit/finality; only current ASSESSED yields NONE/PARTIAL/FULL. Attempts 40+60 accumulate, wrong-only/full+extra remain representable;
- ADR authorities bind exact current order/epoch/obligation/slot/AttemptEffectPlan/target/exposure and have execution-only lifecycle. Direct authority→result impossible; factual certainty lives in append-only OwnerEffectResultGeneration, fulfilment only in current signed-net assessment, and owner receipt cannot declare FULL/PARTIAL;
- execution-control-service ReserveExposure/MarkStartedResidual occurs synchronously before effect; owner receipt/outbox and idempotent ApplyReceipt/Consume are crash-safe without cross-service transaction. Its single writer typed exposure handles all causally relevant owners/action classes, external-unreserved no-effect/already-accounted release+reopen, PlanExposureAttribution, stale release, double-subtracted evidence, negative-net headroom and over-cap freeze without automatic clawback;
- stable lookup root has discriminated partial uniques for ATTEMPT(effect_attempt_id) and STOP_REQUEST(stop_request_id,planned_operation_key); append-only purpose/SLA bindings preserve age. Binding/reopen bump active-set+claim versions, clear lease and reject stale worker. Finality reopen and NO→FOUND→retracted→FOUND are symmetric generations;
- signed LineageNetContribution and current-only ACTIVE ObligationContributionAllocation generations enforce group/net/slot/referral conservation, maker/checker, clamp, deterministic rounding and no double satisfaction. ReferralEffectClaimDisposition audibly supports ALLOCATED/NO_LOCAL/REOPENED without phantom item. Deficit is obligation-slot scoped; equivalent/modified/new successor preserves unmet_since and BLOCKED/ELIGIBLE/PROVISIONAL authority semantics;
- GlobalEffectReassessment fences complete REFERRAL+EXECUTION_CONTROL_SCOPE member set and converges exact prepared receipts with linearizable execution-control token; graph mutation or external-unreserved evidence invalidates/restarts it, post-convergence evidence opens new generation. Partial failure uses MANUAL_RECOVERY. Complaint/item/case/obligation/projection reopen preserve chronology;
- stop evidence binds authority/order/cause/request/discovery generations. Factual FOUND is independent of allocation; ALL_STOPPED_NO_EFFECT requires complete closure. Late no-effect creates no item; current-valid allocated actual creates/reopens one referral-scoped item;
- RevokedAuthorityCheck, FoundEffectRemediation and RemedyFulfilment are independently derived and atomically published through exactly three hashed members + committed ADRExecutionProjectionSetManifest; consumers buffer until commit, compatibility is output-only. ASSESSMENT_PENDING is valid business pending, distinct from corrupt/mixed resync. COMPLIED/CLOSED requires current FULFILLED plus all causally related harmful-effect/global/execution-control gates, not unrelated axis work;
- remediation case/item/manual/frozen lifecycles all have owner/due/next/absolute due and explicit recovery/final dispositions; no automatic consumer-benefit clawback, operator-set finality or hidden collateral effect;
- ADR body adapter доказывает recognised-intake status, authenticated callback/authoritative polling, external-reference idempotency, sequence/timestamp fidelity, key rotation, receipt/tolling mapping, reconciliation и schema/capability-drift BODY_RULE_CONFLICT behavior;
- REQUEST_PAYOUT проверяет live delegated principal, EXECUTE_SCHEDULED_PAYOUT — service-owned mandate/destination/ledger/epoch authority без user session; logout не задерживает законную scheduled payout;
- MerchantTaxProfile/Readiness bootstrap возвращает canonical scope из precheck/preflight references; NEEDS_INFO имеет reply/resubmit transition; purpose lanes имеют single writers, scoped invalidation, correction/dispute и не смешивают DSA/DAC7/KYB/tax purposes;
- ConsentGrant/Withdrawal ledger append-only, single-writer и monotonic per subject/controller/purpose; presentation endpoint atomically binds shown copy/token, withdrawal targets grant/all-active with expected-epoch CAS, cross-controller effect невозможен;
- ConsentWithdrawalAuthorityAttempt даёт locked/former/deleted/accountless path с uniform anti-enumeration response, proportional/accessibility verification и single-use subject/controller/purpose/target/epoch-bound consume без восстановления аккаунта;
- restoration command version/CAS снимает только overturned effect и не перезаписывает более новое restriction/revoke/update/lawful deletion;
- PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY и все risk actions соблюдают 60-second stale-epoch cutoff, включая CDN/edge TTL/purge contract без stale-if-error;
- route-bearing precheck использует POST/no-store и не пишет route/site payload в URL/log/trace/analytics;
- anonymous precheck export is randomized, allowlisted, client-encrypted and structurally non-joinable to source receipt/network/age/device/cookie evidence; same-device native, web and cross-device transports have distinct secure profiles. Local/server lifecycle, account preview and merge plan are closed CAS state machines; silent replace, false terminal and optional-handoff blocking of the precheck are impossible;
- no cross-service DB reads;
- events versioned/idempotent;
- degraded behavior определено для каждого action.

### Guide UX

- pre-check доступен без KYC; neutral age band is evaluated locally before any dynamic call, and the under-13 local-only branch has no network/telemetry/cookie/SDK receipt while showing bundled, accessible guidance;
- route, official-site selection, guiding language and qualification possession have typed `UNDECIDED`/`NONE` states; UI never guesses a future route/site/language or treats «нет квалификации» as an error. When the group count is within the approved cap, the complete candidate partition is rendered as bounded verified-equivalent groups with key differences and accessible expand-all. Above the cap, every branch remains preserved and auditable server-side, while UI shows one highest-information clarification question and deliberately exposes no expand control that bypasses the cap;
- precheck captures combinable remuneration components, never equates price zero with free, pins action/route, `AS_OF_NOW | SERVICE_DATE | SERVICE_DATE_RANGE | DATE_UNDECIDED`, optional date/range and legal timezone, explicit individual/company and temporary/permanent `NOT_SURE` branches, `as_of/valid_until`, compared uncertain outcomes and separates REQUESTED/REVIEW_REQUIRED/TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE copy; date/model/work-mode change invalidates the receipt instead of silently reusing it;
- private draft не требует неуместного сертификата;
- after the optional anonymous precheck the action hierarchy is explicit: primary — securely save the result in the user's universal account through common authentication, secondary — continue locally without an account, tertiary destructive — discard/start over behind confirmation. Sign-in and sign-up are branches of the same primary authentication continuation, not competing CTAs. Authentication cancel returns to the intact local result. Account handoff previews 0/1/N existing drafts and defaults to a new separate draft; only explicitly selected fields merge, destructive replace is excluded from launch, and crash/conflict/status-unknown/device-switch paths have truthful recovery;
- checklist shows complete-set cardinality `required N / confirmed M`, owner acceptance/presence/permit/insurance scope, reason/ETA/CTA and reachable alternative without self-assigning another party;
- evidence переиспользуется;
- wallet is not a document vault; purpose/retention preview, expected-sensitive pre-upload gate, physically disabled channel without disposal authority, authority-bound `REJECTED_NOT_STORED | ISOLATED_DELETION_PENDING | DELETED_CONFIRMED | LAWFUL_TRIAGE_ACTIVE | LEGACY_SENSITIVE_AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED` truth, holder/reuse/revoke/deletion and composed read-only declaration/verification/appeal states have no dead end and never imply that isolation itself permits processing or deletion;
- manual review имеет SLA, NEEDS_INFO и escalation;
- manual review имеет capped pauses, non-pausable absolute_due_at, deterministic breach state, daily update и lawful interim-relief decision;
- merchant/tax readiness имеет progressive purpose-separated flow, verified assertion reuse, save/resume, deadlines, correction/dispute и scoped paid-action impact;
- organization workspace shows the authoritative roster and exact role/scope/status/source/validity, pending invitation/verification, resend/decline/suspend/revoke/transfer, last-admin continuity warning, step-up/maker-checker chronology, immutable receipts and an accountless recovery route; it never represents email possession, token role or affiliation as corporate authority and always preserves the user's individual/other-organization path;
- restriction имеет explanation, appeal, facts clarification и receipt-backed restoration всех отменённых capability/data scopes без undue delay;
- payout UX покрывает first setup, FAILED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED new-generation retry, PSP resume, secure destination update/cooldown/cancel/revert с сохранением old ACTIVE method, manual/scheduled payout, canonical amounts/states, late return/reversal, appeal и superseding receipt;
- payout UX covers capacity disposition and CLOSED/recovery with full payable amount, owner/dates/options/receipt/export/appeal, never confiscation;
- offline start is only an exact pre-issued one-time bundle with trusted-time/boot/key checks and a tested 24/7 assisted replacement/cancel/remedy path where enabled; device local/contact/not-sent states never look server-received, zero-signal cached guidance is explicit and every final status links an authoritative receipt;
- NotificationDisclosureProfile and APNs/FCM/HMS-capable/no-push transport keep lock-screen/email generic; durable inbox is authoritative and Huawei/Honor without GMS plus map-free route flow are tested;
- P2B durable terms/restriction notices, diff, termination/waiver и download доступны при применимости;
- privacy notice показан до upload;
- identity state UX покрывает cancel, app restart, camera denial, timeout/outage, resume/retry, eID/manual fallback и сохраняет private draft;
- manual review/restriction/appeal UX shows exact affected scope, evidence-safe reason, lease-independent owner/next/due/absolute due, NEEDS_INFO, appeal and per-task restoration progress; stale/reassigned state cannot show a false terminal;
- public guide/disclosure copy is parameterized, self-contained and subtype-specific: profile shows market/action/service/remuneration/basis/status/freshness/next step and forbids route/date; excursion additionally requires route/date/legal timezone; protected title requires issuer/territory/language/validity. No subtype embeds a reusable literal date, raw enum or blanket legality promise;
- before an affected DSA Article 30 publication, the exact public-contact preview prominently explains search indexing, copying, archiving, screenshots and third-party persistence, offers a lawful business-contact correction and informed safe exit, binds acknowledgement to exact fields/source/surfaces/version/locale, and keeps urgent FlyFy suppression independent; Hide/Unpublish/purge never promises deletion of third-party copies;
- urgent suppression copy is generated from the current state: origin fenced is never called fully removed, partial internal convergence names remaining FlyFy surfaces, and external deindex assistance is always non-authoritative. Discovery of a late FlyFy surface creates a visible successor and durable correction notice instead of silently rewriting the earlier receipt;
- the Article 13 representative-contact flow shows the exact closed public fields, business-contact correction, global-public/cache warning and GDPR notice without a consent checkbox. The public contact remains accessible without authentication and its correction/unpublication chronology is readable;
- guide/respondent ADR workspace показывает privacy-safe complaint/issues/evidence index, own versioned response and per-attachment PENDING_SCAN/ACCEPTED/QUARANTINED/REJECTED states, platform/external receipts, PLATFORM_ONLY/DISPATCHING/EXTERNALLY_DELIVERED/UNRESOLVED/FAILED truth, direct-body evidence reconciliation, disclosure request/partial/upheld/NEEDS_INFO/appeal/deadline treatment, procedure/party-specific binding basis, reflection/response/implementation/external deadlines и доступные ACCEPT/DECLINE/единственный ExitADR/challenge controls без claimant/other-referral/provider PII;
- current/superseded obligation chronology и три separate projection cards одной set version покрывают NOT_APPLICABLE, checking/found, remediation unknown/open/resolved и fulfilment ASSESSMENT_PENDING/none/partial/fulfilled states; ASSESSMENT_PENDING has owner/ETA and no progress/deficit CTA, successor shows unmet_since+current deadline and BLOCKED/ELIGIBLE/PROVISIONAL, wrong-only/full+extra/old-pending+current-partial copy понятна ≥90% tested participants;
- respondent upload/NEEDS_INFO/session failure сохраняет safe draft/platform receipt, quarantined file не удаляет safe answer, external delivery/disclosure fallback prevents dead end without false tolling; long locale/RTL/200%/screen-reader/keyboard works, and status/rights remain accessible through conservative fallback without forced app update;

### Tourist UX

- seller, contracting party и роль FlyFy видны до покупки;
- checkout повторно авторизован;
- contract snapshot сохранён;
- contract-formation event/copy и exact ExplanationView snapshot сохранены;
- self-service cancellation имеет idempotent eligibility quote, fee/tax/refund breakdown, race-safe confirmation, provider notice, tracking и receipt;
- cancellation/refund/goodwill/dispute/tax effects показывают pending confirmation/external-unreserved reconciliation/safety freeze, affected amount/service, protection, owner/next/absolute due/support, no duplicate CTA and no automatic clawback; approved provisional path is explicit;
- post-booking change создаёт immutable versioned proposal с before/after/choices/deadline/default;
- существенная замена требует explicit CAS-bound TouristRemedyDecision и durable receipt; молчание/старое proposal не считаются согласием;
- refund/support доступны;
- required notices публикуются в authoritative durable inbox и аудируются; external provider acceptance, optional device evidence, acknowledgement и escalation показаны раздельно и не обещают недоказанную доставку;
- unknown payment, restart, reconciliation, void и failed-refund recovery доказаны E2E;
- турист видит refund amount/currency/status/ETA/receipt;
- PAYMENT_VOID_FAILED, REFUND_FAILED, CANCELLED и MANUAL_RECONCILIATION(reason_code) имеют единую API/UI/analytics mapping и recovery CTA;
- consumer complaint имеет immediate durable receipt, correct seller/FlyFy routing, due/next-update tracker, evidence exchange, unresolved state и applicable ADR referral без потери иных remedies;
- cancellation/complaint direct-recipient fallback opens AssistedDeadlineCase, accepts user proof as EVIDENCE_ONLY, verifies/corrects effect, avoids duplicate dispatch and remains accessible through uniform proportional account recovery before deadline; pre-verification copy does not reveal case existence, and verified short-lived authority permits only the exact case operations without restoring the account;
- every profile/listing/title compliance claim comes only from its matching current typed public disclosure and never implies quality/global legality or applicability outside its scope;
- internal complaint resolution показывает versioned remedy/legal effect/deadline, explicit accept/decline либо clearly unconditional execution, supersession и фактический owner receipt до RESOLVED/CLOSED;
- ADR proposed outcome не исполняется без current party acceptance; imposed binding scope имеет statutory basis либо advance notice + specific acceptance; decision/reflection/remedy implementation видимы до COMPLIED/final challenge;
- entitled party использует одно «Выйти из ADR» на каждой разрешённой незавершённой стадии без justification; statutory control не скрывается body conflict, REQUESTED/DISPATCHED/ACK_UNKNOWN/REJECTED/NOT_EFFECTIVE/EFFECTIVE/ADR_EXTERNAL_ORDER_UNRESOLVED понятны, EVIDENCE_ONLY никогда не выглядит external-submitted, external deadlines/tolling/required action видимы, а underlying complaint и иные remedies не исчезают;
- before Article 21 body engagement the user sees the current fee schedule/calculation and that cost handling does not limit ODS, court or restoration rights. After an authenticated outcome the workspace separates body fees, each claimed/accepted/rejected reasonable expense, statutory branch, disputed/undisputed amount, payment ETA and immutable settlement receipt; it never threatens an automatic card/account debit;
- the public transparency area exposes an accessible Article 24 HTML summary and current official-template download with exact service/period, source date, methodology, version and correction history. A late/unavailable report shows a truthful reporting status and never suggests that an individual ODS case or remedy is unavailable;
- for a formally designated service, the same public area exposes separately headed «Первый отчёт», «Полугодовой отчёт» and «Публикация аудита» regions with service/designation source, obligation trigger and satisfied IDs, period, independent HR/accuracy completeness, language/methodology, signed version history, correction diff and field-level redaction explanations. It never exposes the unredacted authority bundle, moderator personal/HR data or a regulator-delivery link, and a late/missing reporting artifact never appears as loss of booking, complaint, payment, privacy or safety rights;
- поздняя authoritative reclassification безопасно reopen-ит ADR, сохраняет обе receipts, объясняет исправление и даёт новый полный platform response window; tracker correction is immediate, corrected notice stays visibly `PUBLICATION_PENDING` until the exact publication receipt, and external deadline/assisted remedy remain separate;
- ADR execution tracker shows three cards of one committed set. Factual found can coexist with pending; old all-stopped never means current fulfilled; ASSESSMENT_PENDING versus corrupt-resync, wrong-only, full+extra, partial+unknown, NO_LOCAL_CLAIM_ALLOCATED and ALLOCATION_REVIEW_PENDING/CLAIM_ALLOCATION_APPEALED receipt/owner/dates/no-final-close are explicit;
- newer proof/retraction/finality reopen/MERGE-SPLIT/allocation/claim/net correction atomically updates cards and durable versioned notice without offline regression. Remedy-derived complaint close reopens visibly with original receipt; current/superseded obligations/items remove stale CTA, show amount/service/progress or pending reason, successor unmet_since/current deadline/eligibility, protection/next update/final receipt and never hide automatic debit/clawback;
- DSA Article 32 public fallback доступен и не содержит buyer PII, когда direct contact невозможен;

### Security and privacy

- DPIA/processing matrix утверждены;
- generated SignificantDecisionInventory complete manifest covers 100% of actions/rules/models/manual shortcuts/owner commands and has one-current path/epoch; every predicate-true path has a current AutomatedDecisionAssessment and safeguards, while orphan or stale path fails CI/runtime authorization;
- Article 27/30/33/34/37 governance artifacts и Article 12 clocks имеют owners/evidence;
- Article 10 authorisation/safeguards, isolated ABAC/retention/audit и prohibited reuse доказаны;
- expected special-category/Article 10 upload has zero bytes collected before current exact full assessment/basis/condition. Every generally available file channel capable of incidental sensitive ingress is physically disabled until a current exact `SensitiveIngressDisposalAuthorityGeneration` authorises the first byte and closed signature-DLP/isolation/object+key-deletion/tombstone operations; retained classification/triage additionally requires the stronger exact short-TTL authority. A channel/byte/content inspection/deletion without that authority, quarantine-as-basis or invented retroactive authority is zero. Only a minimised assertion under a current full assessment leaves the isolated store; revoke, expiry, authority-bound per-object-key deletion/receipt, exact legal hold, legacy metadata-only resolution and non-sensitive alternative are proven;
- sensitive-ingress security evidence covers presigned/object-store bypass, byte-lease issuance/expiry, OPEN→DRAINING→FENCED admission, in-flight drain, two-phase hold activation, deletion-won conflict, shared tombstone pointer, AZ failover and RPO 0 restoration. No privacy event mutates file state and no file event fabricates privacy authority;
- EAA dossier, conformity information, five-year assessment retention и corrective-action flow готовы;
- RBAC/ABAC, MFA/JIT и audit проверены;
- raw route/free text/document/contact and other direct/content personal data are absent from telemetry; allowlisted opaque technical IDs are purpose-bound, access-controlled and deleted by the approved short retention;
- AssistedDeadline recovery selector/contact/proof/exchange/token never enters URL/referrer/event/log/analytics; rate-limit/timing anti-enumeration, one-use digests, current-generation revoke and cross-case isolation are penetration-tested;
- notification external schemas physically exclude sensitive fields; publication/provider/device/read/escalation evidence is purpose-separated, and durable inbox access does not depend on GMS or marketing preference;
- Article 18 reports use a purpose-isolated complete all-relevant-available item manifest with explicit lawful dispositions and no unrelated/speculative collection; Article 30 private/public/retention data use separate purpose ABAC, closed schemas, recipient access, audit and deletion manifests;
- Article 42 unredacted audit bundles use a separate ciphertext-only KMS partition, recipient- and purpose-bound short-lived delivery authority, JIT/MFA/maker-checker access and append-only access/export audit; public/CDN/report-reader roles are explicitly denied object/key access, and raw audit/redaction/moderator details never enter events, logs, traces or analytics;
- retention/deletion работают на уровне purpose;
- biometric/automated decisions имеют применимые safeguards;
- AI literacy, model/vendor change control, prohibited-practice kill switch, lawful logs и incident runbook проверены;
- threat model не содержит незакрытых critical/high;
- privacy-rights flow имеет original submitted_at/deadline, current-session default, proportional doubt-based verification, locked/former/accountless/representative/accessibility paths, cross-service manifest, secure export и E2E evidence. Every partial/denied/no-action response pins a current exact controller/jurisdiction/right determination, official supervisory/complaint and judicial-remedy route, readable verified contacts/links, locale/a11y/accountless access and durable downloadable receipt; missing/stale route keeps the request open with owner/ETA rather than finalising a generic denial;
- restriction/objection/privacy appeal доказаны E2E; every Article 23 exception pins a current counsel-approved exact legislative measure, restricted right/obligation, Article 23(1) objective, essence/necessity/proportionality, relevant Article 23(2) particulars and subject-notice determination. Consent presentation/grant proof исключает stale copy/preselection/bundling/unnecessary conditioning, а granular controller/grant-scoped withdrawal имеет expected-epoch CAS, immediate effective receipt, proportional auth и suppression reconciliation;
- consent withdrawal доступен без входа для locked/former/deleted/accountless subject; authority anti-enumeration, accessible verification, replay/cross-scope isolation, expiry/retry и same-scope immediate receipt доказаны E2E;
- portability имеет purpose-level eligibility, versioned machine-readable schema/data dictionary, third-party/derived-data exclusions, secure direct transmission where feasible и delivery receipt;
- offline draft storage/sync/wipe contract проверен на app kill, device conflict, logout и deletion;
- precheck export/handoff evidence proves forbidden-field absence, ciphertext randomization for identical input, no server-side source linkage, no bearer in URI/referrer/JS storage/log/analytics/backup, one-use exchange, shared-device deletion and accessible cancel/recovery. Product analytics uses coarse aggregate counters only and cannot reconstruct a person or draft;
- ExplanationView locale/copy/fallback snapshot воспроизводим; mandatory missing copy блокирует gated/adverse action, но не remedy/statutory-right intake. Internal deadline и external evidence-only effect различаются явно; typed interpolation не допускает injection;

### 21.1 Обязательная traceability matrix safety-critical требований

Каждый requirement ID является стабильным и присутствует в ADR/PRD, migration ticket, API/event schema, DB constraint name/comment, automated test metadata, dashboard/alert/runbook и release-evidence record. Ссылка только на общий раздел документа не считается трассировкой. Ни одна строка не может иметь unresolved placeholder, пустой owner/evidence либо waived test: изменение модели обновляет всю строку в том же change set, а release automation проверяет coverage manifest.

Таблица ниже — generated read-only human view committed `RequirementArtifactRegistryGeneration`; Markdown не является source of truth и вручную не редактируется после внедрения генератора. Build сверяет digest представления с registry и versioned action/API/event/state/migration/constraint/test/observability/template catalogs. Для каждого requirement registry хранит exact `programme_id`, один или несколько `stage_id`, `release_gate_id`, `dod_clause_id`, signed `evidence_generation_id`, artifact URI/digest, environment/build, accountable owner и independent reviewer. Отсутствие любого edge, wildcard, ссылка только на раздел, orphan/duplicate ownership, lost/reordered member, expected/observed count/hash mismatch или недоступный evidence URI блокирует build и promotion.

В human view технические поля ниже могут быть сжаты, но замыкание однозначно: для каждой строки с точным ID `X` проверяются отдельные `registry:req:X`, `gate:X`, `dod:X` и signed `evidence:X`; evidence record уже содержит exact release/build/environment, поэтому шаблонного значения нет. `contract:X:vN` — не group-label: `vN` обязан совпадать с current version из RequirementArtifactRegistry, а сам contract является immutable sorted manifest всех точных `api:` и `event:` members с expected/observed count, ordered hash и отдельным registry edge на каждый member. Missing current version, silent version downgrade или несовпадение хотя бы одного member блокирует promotion; прежние versions остаются immutable compatibility/history evidence и не удовлетворяют current gate. `programme_id`/`stage_id` берутся только из delivery mapping §16; companion closure index сразу после основной таблицы делает эту связь явной. Один агрегатный green result не может скрыть отсутствующий action/state/enum/API/event/constraint/test/template member.

| ID | Invariant и source of truth | API / event contract | DB / migration gate | User/Ops UX evidence | Automated evidence | SLI / alert / runbook | Accountable DoD evidence |

### 21.2 Обязательный dependency registry и promotion proof

Release candidate содержит machine-generated `action_catalog`, `api_event_schema_catalog`, committed `requirement_artifact_registry`, generated `requirement_trace_manifest`, `state_machine_catalog`, `legal_template_label_catalog` и committed scoped `launch_dependency_registry`; для каждого файла фиксируются schema version, source commit, ordered member count/hash, generator version и signature. Expected dependency membership компилируется только из canonical table §16.1: observed count/ordered IDs/hash обязаны совпасть, поэтому новый, удалённый, переименованный или скрытый внутри другой строки edge автоматически блокирует promotion. Ручной список «обязательных N entries» не является source of truth.

Promotion controller выполняет в одной проверяемой evaluation generation:

1. пересчитывает catalog↔registry↔trace bidirectional mapping и exact action/CoverageScope predicates;
2. проверяет current provider requirement IDs, interface/schema digests, owner acknowledgements и production-like contract evidence;
3. запускает named fallback test/runbook fixture для каждой true `HARD_IF_PREDICATE_TRUE` и `SOFT_OBSERVABILITY` dependency и сохраняет receipt; fallback «описан в документе» без test ID считается отсутствующим;
4. отклоняет `UNKNOWN` predicate, missing/duplicate/orphan mapping, stale digest, hash/count mismatch, ownerless edge и hard dependency без complete evidence;
5. доказывает negative isolation: false/none/unrelated scope remains executable, а block response содержит только exact consumer action/scope, safe fallback, owner и next update;
6. атомарно сохраняет `ALLOW_PROMOTION | BLOCKED_HARD | SOFT_DEGRADED` per entry и общий signed decision; один aggregate green без per-entry receipts недействителен.

Для этой доработки compiler обязан материализовать и доказать следующие exact edges; наличие provider в prose либо зелёный consumer без этих members является orphan и блокирует promotion:

- `DEP-GUIDE-PRECHECK-PRIVACY-01:RUN_GUIDE_SERVICEABILITY_PRECHECK` зависит одновременно только от current `contract:GUIDE-PRECHECK-BRANCH-01:v3`/`contract:GUIDE-PRECHECK-INPUT-PRESENTATION-01:v2` и `PRIV-PRECHECK-DATA-01`; privacy evidence не заменяет полноту material facts/branches, а branch engine не заменяет basis/notice/retention/COPPA. Account, auth, export, transport and handoff outage are explicit negative dependencies and cannot block this action;
- отдельный `DEP-GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-01:CLAIM_ANONYMOUS_PRECHECK_DRAFT` depends on current `contract:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-01:v5`, `contract:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-TRANSPORT-01:v4`, `contract:PRIV-PRECHECK-RESULT-EXPORT-01:v2` and `contract:GUIDE-PRECHECK-HANDOFF-STATE-01:v4`. Missing member disables only optional claim/export CTA with local continue/discard/start-over fallback; it never changes precheck eligibility, compliance result, authority or KYC. Every predecessor contract remains immutable history and cannot satisfy current promotion;
- `DEP-GUIDE-PROFILE-DISC-01:PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY` requires current `contract:GUIDE-DISCLOSURE-01:v2` plus `contract:GUIDE-PROFILE-DISC-01:v2`, both pinned by exact immutable manifest digest, when the exact profile must render a compliance claim or current public-information rule makes it a visibility prerequisite. A missing/stale/revoked projection omits only an optional claim; when disclosure is mandatory it keeps only the affected market/profile private while preserving workspace, correction, support, unrelated markets and unaffected content through `FB-PUBLIC-DISCLOSURE-SAFE-OMISSION-01`;
- `DEP-GUIDE-EXCURSION-DISC-01:PUBLISH_EXCURSION` requires current `contract:GUIDE-DISCLOSURE-01:v2` plus `contract:GUIDE-EXCURSION-DISC-01:v2`, both pinned by exact immutable manifest digest, when the exact occurrence listing must render a compliance claim or current public-information rule makes it a publication prerequisite. The receipt must match occurrence revision, route, territory, date and legal timezone; fallback omits an optional claim or keeps only the affected listing private and never imports profile/internal state;
- `DEP-GUIDE-TITLE-DISC-01:DISPLAY_PROTECTED_TITLE` requires current `contract:GUIDE-DISCLOSURE-01:v2` plus `contract:GUIDE-TITLE-DISC-01:v2`, both pinned by exact immutable manifest digest, for every public protected-title render. Missing, expired, revoked or cross-market issuer/territory/language/validity evidence suppresses only the title and never implies universal guide status or blocks workspace, base profile/listing, correction or unrelated claims;
- every generated `DEP-DR-REGION-01:<affected_action>:<scope_partition>` requires current `contract:DR-REGION-01:v2`, an exact ACTIVE `ACTIVE_PASSIVE_HOT | ACTIVE_PASSIVE_WARM` profile, approved destination/residency, current fence epoch, complete owner/no-dual-writer manifest, a fresh READY operation-specific rights route and a compatible `receipt_ui_state × receipt_class × effect` projection. Unsupported topology, stale/non-READY route or incompatible receipt disables only that affected regulated write; independent status, complaint/appeal, cancellation/refund, privacy and safety routes remain reachable, and no local/platform ingress evidence becomes domain truth;
- every `signed_domain_receipt=true` effect edge expands to `DEP-SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01:<producer>:<consumer>:<receipt_type>:<purpose>` and requires current `contract:SEC-RECEIPT-TRUST-01:v2`, a key authorised at issuance and currently verifiable/non-compromised, exactly one terminal sequence leaf, matching inclusion proof, consumer membership `INCLUDED`, a fresh effect-capable signed trust snapshot and current consumer-fence epoch. `PENDING | OVERDUE | FORKED`, a missing leaf/proof, unknown/compromised key or stale fence disables only the new dependent effect. Immutable v1 history cannot satisfy the v2 gate and is never retro-signed or converted into no-effect;
- every telemetry sink enablement edge `DEP-PRIV-TELEMETRY-DATA-CLASS-01:<producer>:<sink>:<schema_digest>` requires current `contract:PRIV-TELEMETRY-DATA-CLASS-01:v2`, complete current path+emission-role policy, a signed current `schema:telemetry.EdgeAdmissionManifest.v1` and matching owner-local ACTIVE `schema:telemetry.EdgeAdmissionReceipt.v1`. Startup without that receipt, stale/revoked manifest, unknown field or direct-bypass evidence disables the exact optional emitter before normal-sink persistence; it never blocks the business action. Mandatory legal/security evidence is explicitly outside this telemetry dependency family: the compiler requires its exact schema+guard in the owning action contract and rejects that action's promotion/commit when missing, rather than inventing a prose-only telemetry edge;
- `ARTIFACT-EDGE-ADR-CORRECTED-NOTICE-01` is an artifact-to-artifact saga edge, not a §5.1 action dependency and therefore is excluded from `LaunchDependencyMember` action expansion. Its immutable edge record pins the exact current `contract:ADR-STATE-01:v3` manifest digest, its own `edge_manifest_digest`, `expected_artifact_member_count=11`, ordered-member hash and per-member digests for exactly: `schema:complaint.ADRCorrectedNoticeIntent.v2`; `schema:notice.NoticePublicationReceipt.v1`; `api:notice.PublishCorrectedDurableNotice.v1`; `api:notice.GetNoticePublicationOutcome.v1`; `api:complaint.ApplyADRCorrectedNoticePublicationReceipt.v2`; `event:complaint.adr_corrected_notice_intent_changed.v2` + `schema:event.complaint.adr_corrected_notice_intent_changed.v2`; `event:notice.durable_notice_published.v1` + `schema:event.notice.durable_notice_published.v1`; `db:adr_corrected_notice_publication_receipt_match_ck`; and `db:durable_notice_intent_recipient_copy_uq`. Expected/observed count, order, hash and every digest must match; a contract upgrade creates a successor edge manifest. Both event pairs are non-authoritative wake-up/projection signals: neither can establish publication finality. Only exact `schema:notice.NoticePublicationReceipt.v1` returned or recovered through the notice API and accepted by `api:complaint.ApplyADRCorrectedNoticePublicationReceipt.v2` under both guards may set PUBLISHED, after matching intent generation, recipient, copy generation, idempotency identity, issuer/signature and publication time. Criticality is required only for publication finality; primary tracker reopen is an explicit negative dependency and remains transaction-local. Complaint Engineering+Notification own the edge; `test:ADR-STATE-01`, `rb:adr-corrected-notice-reconcile` and signed `evidence:ADR-STATE-01` close it. Missing/unknown receipt preserves the corrected tracker, restored reflection window and complaint/appeal rights while starting the 10/15/30-minute warning/page/hard escalation and ≤15-minute-then-hourly next-update cadence; only an existing attempted intent may enter `PUBLICATION_RECONCILING`, and no outage may fabricate intent, receipt or PUBLISHED;
- every `DEP-BOOKING-SALE-ADMISSION-FENCE-01:<source_cause>:<scope>` for `PAUSE_EXCURSION_SALES`, `UNPUBLISH_EXCURSION`, `HIDE_PUBLIC_PROFILE`, Article30 urgent suppression and legal/safety restriction requires current `contract:BOOKING-SALE-ADMISSION-FENCE-01:v1` before source copy may say new bookings are blocked. Booking hold/contract/payment-Mark/confirmation commands synchronously consume the matching current scope epochs; events/projections are explicit negative dependencies. Missing provider evidence keeps only that affected new-sale scope fenced/reconciling while preserving pre-cutoff bookings, cancellation/refund, itinerary, complaints/appeals, privacy/safety and payout rights;
- `DEP-GUIDE-DSA-ARTICLE30-PROFILE-01:PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY` зависит от current `contract:DSA-ART30-URGENT-SUPPRESSION-01:v2` and `DSA-ART30-SUPPRESSION-TRUTH-01`; `DSA-ART30-PROMOTION-GATE-01` и `DSA-TRADER-PUBLIC-CONTACT-UX-01` не могут закрыться описанием Hide/Unpublish без production-like origin/search/CDN/old-client convergence, state-copy and late-successor evidence;
- каждый expanded member `DEP-GUIDE-DSA-ARTICLE13-01:<action>` для `PUBLIC_PROFILE_DISCOVERY`, `PUBLISH_EXCURSION`, `ACCEPT_BOOKING` и `CONFIRM_BOOKING` требует current `contract:DSA-ART13-LEGAL-REP-01:v2`, current `DSA-ART13-REP-CONTACT-PRIVACY-01` when natural-person data applies, and current `GUIDE-AUTH-FENCE-01` member/epoch only при точном applicable provider/service/EU-market predicate. Each guide/profile/excursion/booking/edge owner validates the same scoped epoch immediately before its local commit. False/unrelated partitions остаются доступны, а fallback сохраняет private draft, existing booking service, cancellation/refund, complaints/appeals, privacy/safety и alternate Article 18 route;
- commit Article 30(1) refusal/30(3) suspension depends atomically on `DSA-ART30-REDRESS-01`, whose complete route manifest has current `DSA-ART20-COMPLAINT-01`, `DSA-ART21-ODS-01` and judicial-route contracts. Это owner-transaction invariant, не порядок исчерпания и не эксперимент; отсутствие любого route запрещает final commit/notice, но не отнимает уже доступное право;
- `DSA-ART21-COST-ENTITLEMENT-01` consumes an authenticated current ODS outcome and fee schedule asynchronously after substantive outcome recording. It may gate only recipient recovery/payment finality or reimbursement settlement for its exact cost case; it is an explicit negative dependency for Article 20 complaint, Article 21 body selection/filing/engagement/outcome, court information, restriction reversal/restoration and other remedies;
- `DSA-ART24-ODS-REPORT-01` consumes committed Article 21 source facts only through an asynchronous rebuildable read model. It is never a synchronous or hard runtime dependency of Article 20/21 intake, body selection, dispatch, outcome, cost, court, restoration, appeal or privacy paths; reporting failure blocks report publication/correction only and triggers its own incident/deadline escalation;
- `DSA-ART42-REPORT-01` consumes formal designation and reporting/audit source evidence asynchronously and is never a runtime authorization dependency of guide/profile/excursion/booking/payment/complaint/ODS/restoration/privacy/safety commands. Template reconciliation, authority transmission, public publication and correction failures freeze only their exact reporting branch; Commission, DSC and public receipts remain independent and uncertainty cannot be converted into a fabricated terminal;
- `A11Y-REFLOW-01` is a build-level `BLOCKED_HARD` promotion member for every affected client/surface manifest. It has no conversion cohort or runtime authorization predicate; failed/missing native or web profile cannot be waived by a product experiment;
- `contract:GUIDE-ORG-01:v3` и `contract:PRIV-SPECIAL-INGRESS-01:v3` must be current provider digests wherever organization authority or sensitive-ingress processing is enabled; immutable v1/v2 remain history/compatibility evidence and cannot satisfy current promotion members. Admission-fence/byte-lease/two-phase-hold and exhaustive organization terminal members are exact, not optional compatibility extensions.

Runtime `AuthorizationDecision` pin-ит только exact `scope_partition_id`, `scope_set_epoch` и ordered set `(dependency_member_id, member_epoch, predicate_receipt, interface_digest)`; global registry generation/hash хранится лишь как release/audit root и не участвует в eligibility. После matching catalog/interface change invalidируется только затронутая partition; unrelated market/action remains executable. Уже созданные законные user rights/intake/appeal/data-access paths не отключаются: они переходят на заранее протестированный rights-preserving fallback. Ни Release commander, ни Product, ни Legal единолично не могут заменить missing evidence ручным флагом.

Release gate: generated traceability report должен показать 100% rows complete, все named automated suites green, active dashboard/alert/runbook IDs, production-like evidence URL, artifact/schema versions, owner и reviewer sign-off. Любой orphan API/event/constraint/state/test либо safety-critical state без user-safe copy автоматически блокирует promotion. Product, Legal, Engineering, Security/Privacy и Operations проверяют только относящиеся к их ответственности columns, но итоговая строка считается complete лишь совместно.

Final go/no-go подписывают Product, Legal, Engineering, Security/Privacy и Operations. Ни один участник не может единолично waive юридический, security или consumer-remediation gate; exception имеет scope, expiry, compensating controls и executive risk acceptance.

## 22. Итоговая рекомендация

Целевое продуктовое правило:

> Каждый человек использует один универсальный FlyFy-аккаунт с базовыми туристическими возможностями. Желающий проводить экскурсии подключает в этом же аккаунте приватное рабочее пространство гида — без смены типа аккаунта, повторной регистрации, KYC или универсального решения «гид одобрен/отклонён». Личность, trader/tax data, профессиональные credentials, organization affiliation и permits запрашиваются раздельно и только перед тем конкретным публичным действием, для которого они действительно нужны. Публичное предложение, booking, payment и check-in разрешаются сервером для точного маршрута, ресурса, даты, участников и версии правил. Отсутствие найденного требования не считается разрешением без scoped legal approval.

Эта модель:

- сохраняет один аккаунт, одну историю и один social graph при одновременном использовании туристических и профессиональных функций;
- открывает приватный профиль и черновики сразу, а optional anonymous precheck оставляет вспомогательным исследовательским инструментом, не обязательным onboarding gate;
- возвращает пользователя после общей авторизации прямо к намерению «стать гидом/создать экскурсию», не заставляя проходить туристический preference-onboarding;
- изолирует публичные tourist/social и guide-professional projections, включая настройки видимости, отзывы, контакты и disclosure-поля;
- ограничивает отказ, restriction или истёкший credential только затронутым guide action/resource/market/date и не блокирует туристические функции; account-wide блокировка допустима лишь как отдельный `AccountAccessEffect` по самостоятельному security/legal основанию;
- убирает несуществующий универсальный сертификат;
- снижает friction и объём собираемых PII;
- не ослабляет требования регулируемых рынков;
- объясняет пользователю каждое действие;
- защищает туриста при изменении обстоятельств;
- выдерживает country/state/city/site-level регулирование;
- поддерживает continuous legal operations;
- даёт инженерной команде проверяемую production-декомпозицию, а не набор разрозненных исключений.
